tshog /'phags pa rdo rje mi 'pham pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs/(1)༄༅lda /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya nya badz+ra a dzi ta (5)a na la pra mo ha nī 94)nā ma dhā (ger tsā/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rdo rje mi 'pham 96)pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag sgyu gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa can gyi ri'i gangs ri sul gyi mchog /ri rab kyi smad dang rked ltar gser gyi rdo sna tshogs kyis gang zhing re'ur 2bres pa 'bar ba/ rin po che'i rdo du ma'i 'od sna tshogs 'ja' lta bu byung ba'i rdo leb yangs pa/ me tog dri zhim po bkram zhing phye ma dang / bdug pa dri zhim pa mang pos phug gi nang dang nags bsgos pa/ gdugs ri(7dang / a ga ru dang / phye ma dang / dril bu dang / bla bores mdzes par byas pa'i ri bo mchog la bzhugs te/ de na bcom ldan 'das lha rnams dang / lha'i bu rnams 96wa 3

dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi (1bu rnams dang / rlung ( lha rnams dang / rlung lha'i bu rnams dang /ri nam mkha' lding rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / srin po rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams dang /'byung po rnams dang / log 'dren rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / snang ba dang / mi snang ba'i ma mo'i tshogs khyab par byed pa rgya chen po dag gis dpag tshad lnga brgyar 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur par 'dus te/ de na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bdun khri lnga stong dang / dge slong khri nyi (4)stong lnga brgya dang thabs cig 5go/ /bcom ldan 'das ni chos ston te/ gnas par bde ba/mnyan na bde ba/ 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba'i chos ston to/ /de na lha rnams dang / lha'i bu rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi bu rnams dang / rlung lha rnams dang / rlung lha'i bu rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / srin po rnams dang / srin po'i bu rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / rig sngags 'chang ne grub pa rnams dang / 'byung po rnams dang /log 'dren rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / snang ba dang / mi snang ba'i ma mo'i tshogs rnams dang / 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang /ri ni 'byung po'i tshogs rnams rnam par rgyu zhing ku co dang / 'jigs pa dang nyam thag pa'i sgra 'byin to//bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas sgra de dag gsan nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye bzhin bzangs nadag ci'i phyir ku co dang / 'jigs pa dang / nyam thag pa 96—4

dang / 'khrug pa'i sgra 'byin/ de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi 0)dbang du bgyis te/ gnod pa dang drang bas bkug cing drangs te tho btsams 95)na/ bcom ldan 'das bskyab tu gsol/ de /skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad kyi steng gi dkyil 'khor yangs pa ston pa'i mchog gi blo gros dang / blo dang / las dang / las kyi mtha' dang ldan pa/ sa chen po las sa gzhan thob pa rgyal tshab tu nye ste/ chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang bskur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rjes su dgongs par mdzad pa tsam gyis 'ongs te/ rdo rje'i zom ltar dpung mgo yangs pa rdo rje ltar mkhregs pa'i cod pan 'od zer 'tsher ba can/ rdo rje'i dpung rgyan dang ldan pa/ lus mkhregs 4shing sra ba dang 5/ lag na rdo rje dang / zhags pa dang / lag na 6brtan po 'bar ba thogs pa/ rdo rje phur bu sra bas rab tu 'joms 97)par byed pa/ mthu chen po g.yog bzhi 'bum lnga khri dang ldan pa/'jig rten gyi khams 'di kun du snang bar byed cing rdo rje'i rigs kyi gzhon nu dang / rdo rje'i sde dang /8 rdo rje'i be con dang / rdo rje'i snying po dang / rdo rje'i tog dang / rdo rje'i snang ba dang / rdo rje sngon po dang / rin po che'i rdo rje dang / gsang ba'i rdo rje dang / 'khor lo rdo rje la sogs pa dang / rdo rje'i dmag dpon chen po rnams dang / dmag skyong rnams dang / sa skyong rnams dang / rdo rje rig 9pa'i rgyal po yang dag pa dang / yang dag pa ma yin pa yang dag par rtogs pa rnams dang / rdo rje'i yul 1 rnams dang / rdo rje rnam par 'dren rnams dang lhan cig tu rdo rje gzhon nu'i gdon rnams dang / rdo rje gnon po rnams dang / rdo rje rmi lam ngan byed rnams yang dag par skul/1196—5

rnam par skul 1)zhing 'khor gyi khyams chen por 'dus pa thams cad la nubakun du (misnang bar byed/ rnam par snang bar byed/ gsal bar byed/ rnam par gsal bar byed/ rab tu dga' bar byed/ yang dag par skula'ad/ so sor skul ⑤zhing bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ bla gos phud (nyanas zhabs la cod pan gyis gtugs te/ lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas thal mo sbyar te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su yi rang ba mdzad de/rdo rje 'chang khyod song la lha rnams dang / lha'i bu rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi bu rnams dang / rlung lha rnams dang / rlung lha'i bu rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / nam mkha' lding gi bu rnams dang / 'dus pa chen po'i bar dag sgra 'byin cing nyam thag pa myong ba rnams kyi bsam pa rdzogs par gyis shig /de nas rdo rje 'chang stan las langs te/ lha dang / lha ma yin dang / rlung lha dang / nam mkha' lding dang / 'byung po'i tshogs kyi nang du song nas rjes su ston cing rdo rje'i 7)mtshon cha'i me sgron zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su me lce 'bar ba'i 'od 'phro ba dang / me stag rnam par 'phro ba dang / lce 'bebs pa'i glog 58)rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams rnams gzir te9ri/ de nas bskal pa chen po lngar mimi lam dang / chu dang /gang gā'i 1 klung 1 gi 1 bye ma'i grangs kyi tshad tsam dag gis mdangs dang / gzi brjid dang / tshangs par spyod pa dang / gtsang 8ma dang / bzod pa dang /tshul khrims dang / brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub dang / rang gi longs spyod thams cad las byung ba'i las grub pa'i rdo rje de byang chub sems dpa' lag 96—6

pa'i sngags/17༄༅ga /rgya gar skad du/ kro dha byur rku kū ṭa 9nanarā dza sto 6)tra man+t+ra(pe/bod skad du/ khro bo'i rgyal po sme brtsegs la bstod pa'i sngags/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ byur rarku ma hā pā ṇa ri ya/ byur tsi byur ki ma nā se / u tsusma gro dha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal bstod / khro la khros pas khro bo che/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas sngar sangs rgyas/ /chos/ sku longs sku sprul pa'i sku/ /sme brtsegs zhes bya bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar dbus na/ /pad ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /ljang nag chen po sme ba can/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug steri / /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang ba/ /spyan gsum 'jigs pa'i mche ba 'byin/ /mi gtsang bdud rtsi sman bzhin gsol/ /g.yas pa rdo rje ral gri bsnams/ /g.yon pa zhags pa lcags kyu'o/ /tha ma sdigs mdzub 8thugs kur 9bsnol/ /sme 96—30

gtsang med pa'i las dag brtson/ /gdug pa sbrul gyis 1)dbu lus brgyan/ /'jigs dngangs (2med par brtul zhugs spyod/ /khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//mi gtsang ba ni gtsang bar mdzad/ /khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jigs pa kun las skyob par mdzad/ /khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nad dang rims las bsrung ri stabar mdzad/ /khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mi gtsang zas dang mi gtsang gos/ /thams cad sel bar byed pa'i mchog /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin gdon/ /thams cad ma lus dga' bar mdzad/ /nad dang rims dang dal ka yams/ /bsrung ba'i las mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag la bsrung ba mdzad du gsol/ /mi gtsang ba rnams gtsang bar mdzad/ /sme ba rnams ni mi smer mdzad/ /lci ba rnams ni yang bar mdzad/ /dog pa yangs par mdzad la bstod/ /khro bo'i rgyal po sme brtsegs khyed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /gang dag khyed la mos rten rnams/ /lus bde sems bde dbang po bde/ /bde ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus dag sems dag dbang po dag /dag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus gtsang sems gtsang dbang po gtsang / /gtsang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus dang sems dang dbang po dang / /dang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus gsal sems gsal dbang po gsal/ /gsal ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha klu yi dgas 'dre srin sogs / /gnod sbyin 'byung pos 'di thos na/ /sdug bsngal zhi nas bde bar 'gyur / /gangs rgyud bzhin du dkar bar 'gyur/ /shel dkar bzhin du gtsang bar 'gyur/ /me long bzhin du gsal bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dang bar 'gyur/ /sa dang mkha' la 'khod pa yi/ /lha klu la sogs sde brgyad 96—31

༄ga /'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā ba la nā ma ma hā nayā na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 4dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ri btang bzung 5chen po na chos ston te6/ de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags te/bkur nas mngon par dga' bar byas pa yang de nyid du 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 7phyag gis sems can rnams dbugs 'byin cing / shar phyogs na me lce kun du 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i pad ma'i gdan la bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas logs na stobs po che lag pa bzhi pa lag pa gcig na ni rnga yab thogs/ lag pa gcig gis ni phyag 'tshal/96—33

g.yas 1na ni be con thogs/ g.yon pa na ni zhags pa thogs pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mig dmar ba(na / de'i 'og na ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /g.yas na ni rig sngags kyi rgyal po gnod mdzes so / /g.yon na ni bdud rtsi thab na)sbyor ro/ /de nas snying po rnams ni zla ba kham (4)pa lta bur bzhag 5go/ /snying po ni ki li ki la dang / 'gro lding ba'i gzungs dang / lus dmar po dang / rdo rje 56 rnam par 'joms pa dang / rdo rje 7rgyan chen te snying po'i mchog go/ /rig sngags kyi 58)rgyal po drag po chen po dang / nye ba na ni 'phags pa mā ma khri'o/ /'phags pa 9bdud rtsi thab 7sbyor gyi 'og na ni rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang rdo rje lu gu rgyud do/ /sgo'i nang logs su ni khro bo rdo rje'i tho ba dang / rdo rje'i be con gnyis mngon du phyogs par bzhag 11go/ /g.yon logs su ni bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas logs su ni gos dkar mo'o/ /de'i 'og tu ni sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can no/ /g.yon du ni gerig sngags kyi rgyal po rta mgrin 1 dang / de la 7sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brgya phrag stong dang ngo / /de bzhin du shar phyogs su ni zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / yul 'khor srung dang / dbang po'o/ /me'i phyogs na ni me'i lodrang srong chen po rnams kyis bskor ba'o/ /lho phyogs su ni gshin rje dang khyab 'jug go / /bden bral gyi 7phyogs su ni srin mo'i ’ bdag po ma mo rnams kyis /8bskor ba'o / /nub phyogs su ni klu'i bdag po klu la sogs pas bskor ba'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su ni rlung lha 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /byang phyogs su ni lus ngan po 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /dbang bdag gi phyogs su ni dbang bdag tshogs kyis 96—34

bskor ba'o/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang / khyab 'jug dang /tshangs pa chen po dang / de la sogs pa gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa dag dang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas te snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba tsho1pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje mdo sde 'di sgrub pa po 'di la gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di rgya cher yang dag par bshad par bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o ki li ki (5)li badz+ra/ ki (dasali ki la / ya 5swā hā/ spyi gtsug la swā hā/ dpral ba la swā hā/ mig la swā hā/ drag shul can la swā hā/shin tu drag shul can la swā hā/ rdo rje'i zhags pa la swā hā/ lus dmar po la swā hā/ lag na rdo rje la swā hā/ lag na zhags pa la swā hā/ lag na ral gri la swā hā/ lag na dgra sta la swā hā/ gzhu 'dzin la swā hā/ gtun shing ne'adzin la swā hā/ lag na 'khor lo la swā hā/ lag na mdung rtse gsum pa 7la swā hā/snying po la swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po la swā hā/ drag po ki li ki la la naswā hā/byis pa ki 99dmi ki la khol swā hā/ dmar po ki 11li ki 12la 1ril swā hā/ stobs po che la swā hā/ ral pa can la swā hā/ gsus 'phyang po la swā hā/ khro bo chol 7pa la swā hā/ gshin rje la swā hā/ srin po la swā hā/ srin po ya mun la swā hā/drag po chen po la swā hā/ sprin la swā hā/ ri 'dzin la swā hā/ ri btang bzung 7'dzin la swā hā/ rdo rje labe+e con la swā hā/ 'jigs byed chen po la swā hā/lus 'jigs byed 7la swā hā/ sdigs 12byed la swā hā/ rdo rje 17lu gu rgyud la swā hā / rdo rje'i gtan pa la swā hā/ rdo rje'i 2 lus la swā hā/ 'gro lding ba 21la swā 96—35

hā / bdud rtsi la swā hā/ dka' thub 'dzin la swā hā/ lcags kyu la swā hā/don yod la swā hā/ gtsug tor rgyal po la swā hā/ mdog dkar po la swā hā/sngo bsangs mdog la swā hā/ 'phyang 1bo la swā hā/ glang po che (nal swā hā/ ba glang 'phel gyi lag pa la swā hā/ bdud kyi rnam par 'phrul pa la swā hā/ sbrul gyi ska rags cacan la swā hā/ rdo rje 55phur pa la swā hā/ lag pa gnyis ka la swā hā / ā 6rdo rje la swā hā/ 'bar ba'i 'od byed 7)la swā hā/ blo gros brtan pa'i rdo rje la swā hā/ myu gu la swā hā/ 'od byed la swā hā/ rdo rjes 58)rnam par 'joms pa la swā hā/ rdo rje'i dra ba la swā hā/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la swā hā/rdo rje khu tshur la swā hā/ sprin rnam par 'thor ba la swā hā/ char pa rnam par rton pa la swā hā/ rdo rje lcags kyu la swā hā/ rdo rje 11sting po la swā hā/ rdo rje nye ba'i snying po la swā hā/ mthe bo'i rgyal po la swā hā/ be con gyi rgyal po la swā hā/go cha'i rgyal po la swā hā/ oṃ dhī 15i/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban dha ban dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ 1 te hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/oṃ a mṛ 7te hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yul 'khor srung la swā hā/ mig bomi bzang la swā hā/'phags skyes po la swā hā/ lus ngan po la swā hā/ dbang po la swā hā/ me lha tshal swā hā/ drang srong chen po thams cad la swā hā/ nyi ma la swā hā/ zla ba la swā hā / gshin rje la swā hā/ khyab 'jug la swā hā/ srin po'i bdag po la swā hā/klu'i bdag po la swā hā/ rlung 1 la swā hā/ dbang bdag la swā hā/ dbang bdag gi chung ma la swā hā/ brgya byin la swā hā/ nor lha'i bu la swā hā/ rdo rje chen po la swā hā/ tshangs pa chen po la swā hā/ sa la swā hā/ dbyangs can la swā 96—36

hā / lha mo dpal la swā hā/ lha mo dka' thub zlog 1)la swā hā/ rig sngags chen po stobs po che'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su 'chang zhing yid la byed na srung rdon ba dang / skyob pa dang / sbed par byed par 'gyur ro / /las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas brtan blo gros chen po sha radwa ti'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par song ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa rnams ri skul phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ mu ni mu ni/ ma hā mu ni/ ki li ki li/ma hā ki lipo ri/ dhi ke'atsho/ ka ṭa ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma hā ka ṭa/ sha ma sha ma sha ma tsho/ma hā sha ma/ shā tri shā tri shā tri/ shān+ta shān+ta shān+ta/ dan+ta dan+ta dan+ta / dhī ra dhī ra dhī ra 9ri/ ma hā me gha 7dur dha ra/ ha ri ha ri ha ri/ kurtsi kurtsi kus11/ ts+tshan+da ts+tshan+da sbyin/ bhin+da bhin+da hin12/ sarba nyi duṣ+ṭanas/ gu mu gu mu gu mu/ ha ra ha ra ha ra/ mā ṇan tshad ma ni da ma ni/ ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭhā ṭhā ṭhā/ ḍā ḍā ḍā/ḍā ḍā 77/ tsa tsa tsa/ tsa tsa tsa/ pa tsa pa tsa pa tsa/ da ha da ha da ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ (1 / he he he/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sha ba ri 18sha ba ri nya6sha ba ri / ma 21tang na gi/ tsaṇ+ḍa /li/ hu hu hu/ dzu hu dzu hu dzu hu / ha ta pra t+yaḥ na pa/tsi li tsi li tsi li/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha tsho/ tiṣ+ṭha tha tiṣ+ṭha tha tiṣ+ṭha tha/mā 2 ti kra :mā mu tha/ ma tang gi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ 1/ he he he/ gal te mi 'dug na lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / kha dang / mid pa dang / mig dang /96—37

snying dang / ngag thams cad bcing ngo / /dbrog go/ /dz+wa la dz+wa la dz+wa la3)/dun dhu dun byu dun dhu/ ban dhu ban dhu ban dhu/5)/ nī la nī la nī la( )/ nī lāng cag badz+ra dha ra/ stobs po che zhes bya ba'i snying po dran par gyis shig /ko ṭi 5ko ṭi 6ko ṭi 7ni/ sarba bhū tā na ni/ badz+ra ma 5)ni / badz+ra dha ra/ badz+ra aṣ+ṭa hā 11sa/ tsar tu nar tu mar tu/ ku ru ku ru ku ru/ hu ru hu ru hu ru/sems can chen po dran par gyis shig / hūm̐ hūm̐ junyu2/ he he he/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa / tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa/1ri ma hā tsaṇ+ḍas/ durtu turta hutwa/ mu ru mu ru mu ru/ groṇ+ḍi grihā groṇ+ḍa'i/ badz+ra pā ṇis/ ha na ha na1 / ma ma 51snyesarba 37sha tū 3 tsho'on/ mūrti ni tā ḍa 2 ya phaṭa/ ku ru ku ru ku ru/ lag na rdo rje'i las dang 'gal bar ma byed cig /dam tshig las 'gal bar byas na dam tshig dral ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'ang bslus par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags kyi gzhi ni 'di rnams yin no/ /tsu tsu tsu/ ha ra ha ra ha ra/ phuṭa ṭu phuṭa ṭu phuṭa rikhu/ ta pa ni ta pa ni ta pa ni/ pa tsa ni pa tsa ni pa tsa ni/ lag na rdo rje'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa dran par gyis shig /tsi li tsi li tsi li/phu lu phu lu phu lu/ phu phu phu/ bcom ldan 'das gal te rdu ribadag gi snying po 'di dang 'gal bar bgyis na/ de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu gsungs pa'i mtshams med pa lnga dang ldan par gyur cig /dar phu/ tsar phu/ nar phu/rdo rje 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag la gsang sngags kyi gzhi 25rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/ rdo rje 'dzin gzi brjid chen po sal phyag 'tshal lo/ /swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ na phaṭa phaṭa swā hā 9/ de nas de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub 96—38

pa'i 'od zer kun du 'bar ba'i snang bas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams las 'das nas bdud kyi khyim 0 thams cad kun du 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu mched cing 'bar te/ me lce gcig tu gyur par 2kun du snang ngo / /de ltar gyur pa dang / bdud sdig can ral gri dang /'khor lo dang / gzhu dang mda' la sogs pa'i mtshon cha rnams lag na thogs te bgegs kyi tshogs 8)rnam par 'phrul pa du ma byed do/ /de nas skad cig de nyid la bdud sdig can bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad dang lhan cig tu bdud kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen pos/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba bzhugs pa cader dong ngo / /de nas de 5ltar gyur pa dang / khro bo chol 6ba mdog dmar po/sbrang rtsi ltar mig dmar ser po/ mche ba gtsigs pas 7mi bzad pa/ skra kham 8pa gyen du brjes pa/ 9lag pa g.yas pa na be con thogs pa/ lag pa g.yon pa na rdo rje thogs pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan 7)pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs bgos pa / shar phyogs su 11'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bye ma snyed 'das shing de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang gi phyogs su yang kun du snang ngo / /de nas bdud sdig can dang / bgegs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgya khro bo chol 1 bas 'dar bar gyur to/ /bdud sdig can myos shing gzir te/ phongs nas srog la mi lta ba dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes zhags pa'i 1 bcing ba lngas bcings so/ /de ltar gyur pa dang / de'i tshe 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyis spos dang / me tog dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan sna tshogs la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la ci nus kyis mchod nas 96—39

phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags 1te/ 2mngon par dga' bar byas nas( ri/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 4rjes su thugs rangs pa 5mdzad pas sems can thams cad kyi don dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir rig sngags mchog gi rgyud chen po'i nang nas/ don 'dod pa thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba stobs dpag tu med pas/ pha rol gnon pa/ stobs po che stobs chen po'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag smras so/ /gang la la zhig 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston tam/ bsti tsistang du byed dam/ bla mar byed dam/ rim gror byed dam/ mchod par byed na dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol gyis byas pa'i gsang sngags thams cad bshig pa dang /bcom pa dang / bskyel bar yang 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin gyis rig sngags mchog gi rgyud chen po'i nang nas 'byung ba smras so/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su thugs rangs pa mdzad pas don 'dod pa thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba stobs dpag tu med pas pha rol gnon pa/ stobs po che'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi smras pa/ /o badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bi dh+wan 7)ya/ dza ṭi 8lo 9 bo da t+t+waṃr / u tsurmi 11gro dha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis 12chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas 96wa 40

'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston tam/ rim gror bgyid dam/ mchod par bgyid na dkyil 'khor thams cad du 0nodabang bskur bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes yang gsol pa/ stobs po che'i snying po 'dzin pa la ni gnod sbyin nam/gnod sbyin gyi bu'am/ srin po'am/ srin ngo/'i bu'am/ grul bum mam/grul bum gyi bu'am/ ca nam mkha' lding ngam/ nam mkha' lding gi bu'am/klu'am / klu'i bu'am/ dri za'am/ dri za'i bu'am/ sha za'am/ sha za'i bu'am / smyo byed dam/ smyo byed kyi bu'am/ mkha' 'gro ma'am(gu/ mkha' 'gro ma'i bu'am/ sgrub (lasapa'am/ sbrul 'dzin bcas pa la (5༄sogs pa dang /brjed byed dang / lus srul po dang / ro langs la sogs pa dang / gnon po'i (6༄gdon thams cad dang / brjed byed la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad 17kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdas po lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /stong pa nyid do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid do / /phyi ma'i mtha' stong pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid do/ /chen po stong pa nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang mdo sde 'di rab tu ston pa de mchod par bgyi ba 98༄dang / phyag bgyi ba dang / rim gror bgyi ba dang / bskor bar bgyi ba'i 'os su 'gyur ba lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rjes stobs dpag tu med pas pha rol gnon pa stobs po che'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi smras pa/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ 499 / phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/96—41

lag na mdung rtse gsum thogs pa drag shul can/ hūm̐ hūm̐ (6)/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/oṃ byo tirna nad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ tsū / o o o/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ stobs po che la swā hā / oṃ rdo rje khro bo stobs po che/ ha na da ha pa tsa/ ma tha bi ki ra/ bi dh+wan caya/ dza ṭi 5lo bo da 50skur/ u tsuṣ+ṭha ( )kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/sarba 8duṣ+ṭan/ stam bha ya/ stam bha ya/ du rā tsa 'on 5)duṣ+ṭan ⑩ni bā ra ya/bdag la srungs 1 shig srungs 12shig swā hā/ oṃ a nan+ta bi dza ya/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa (1 rtsu ḍiphaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dh+ri ka ngartsu laphaṭa/ oṃ shri ri1 / shi ro mā nyu8yi nitherte/ si ni si ni / shi shi ni/ shi shi ni/ oṃ sarba /ād+ma nyedza/ ma hā te :dza badz+ra/ a sha ni badz+ra / pā 2 sha a nu/ pra 2 bi sha pa/ sarba ci dziduṣ+ṭan/ stam bha ya/ stam bha ya/hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ 8/ ban dha ban dhas// oṃ a nan+ta/ bi dza ya/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍis /hūm̐ 1phaṭa/ o phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra gro dha hūm̐ 5phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra garta lhari ka ra ka ra / sbyin ts+tshan+da/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha/ ma hā ba la/ dha ka dha ka / dz+wa la dz+wa ri la hūm̐ 26phaṭa/ oṃ bi pu ra/ rak+ṣa badz+ra/ pañdza sa ra hūm̐ sa phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li/ badz+ra badz+re bhur rteban dha ban dha hūṃ tshophaṭa/ o badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ā /sgo ya/ ā kun+ta ya/ hūm̐ 2phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ dha ga ra dha 6nar / dhā dir ya dhā tsir ya/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha 8/ da ra da ra/ dā ra ya/ dā ra ya/ pa ṭa ya pa ṭa ya/ mo ṭa (tshe ya mo ṭa 5 ya/ hūm̐ 51phaṭa/ o badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ta ṭa ta ṭa/ ta ṭa ni ya ta ri ṭa 5 ya/ hūm̐ 55phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha ma hā ba la/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/ di pya di pya/ dī 50pa ya dī 5 pa ya/ hūm̐ 5nyephaṭa/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru rte/ u tsuṣ+ṭha gro dha/ shi kha 6 rir ha ra kyi ha ra/ hūm̐ sgo phaṭa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 96wa 42

'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo / /o badz+ra kro dha ma hā tsaṇ+ḍi1)/ ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bi ki ra/ bi dh+wan 5ya/bcom ldan 'das tshur gshegs tshur gshegs/ ha na ha na/ ha ra ha ra/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bi dh+wan ya/ bi dh+wan (guya/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi 4bdag pos mchod pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid risasnalas skyes pa/ gzi brjid chen po / su ru su ru/6ri/ mu ru mu ru/ ku ru ku ru/ ghu ru ghu ru/ kurba kurba /ma hā kurba/ bi kurba/ ku nartsi(8ri/ ku nasapo)/ na ṭi 97na ṭi/1/ shi ni shi ni/khi ni khi ni/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ku ru ku ru/ tu ṭa tu ṭa/ tuṣ+ṭa tu(1 / tras tra(nyu / tu ru tu ru/ 'byung potshibadag po/ klu'i bdag po/ lha ma yin gyi grong khyer rnam par 'joms par byed pa/ khro bo chol sgopa stobs po che/dha ma dha ma/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ su ru su ru/ hūm̐ tshaphaṭa/ ha na ha na hūm̐ saphaṭa/ da ha da ha hūm̐ tsho17phaṭa/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ 1 phaṭa/ 1 hri hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tsu lu tsu lu ru rdo ཿswā hā/ o badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ sarba 22duṣ+ṭan lhe / stam na smabha ya stam 2gebha ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya hūm̐ 25phaṭa/ o ha ha/sa ra sa ra/ bi sa ra bi sa ra/ bhā ta ya bhā ta ya/ o bi sa ra/ san tā 2 sa ya rtsu 'o/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ha ra ha ra tsho/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/nā 8nyesha ya nā nasha ya/ hūm̐ gephaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ — 4/ mā ma lta/ mā ri5ma ri phaṭa/ oṃ dh+ri gi ka kro dha ni tshe/ bdag la srungs 8 tshoshig srungs 7shig swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la/badz+ra dha ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ban dha ban dha hūm̐ 82phaṭa/ swā hā/ oṃ dz+wa tshal gra sa/u tsuṣ+ṭha sā sdo cig ra hūm̐ 5/ /rdo rje'i pho nya mo drug cu 7rtsa bzhi po de dag kyang bsrung ba dang / yongs su srung cho ba dang / skyob 8)pa dang / sbed par 5 tshobyed par 96—43

'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ gang gzungs 'di 'chang ba ni dge bar 'gyur / dug mi gnod par 'gyur/ shi ba sos par byed par 'gyur/ dgra rnams kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ bu mang bar 'gyur ro/ /sa phyogs kyang gsal 1bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad kyang nus par 'gyur ro/ /gdug papas zin pa rnams la ni skyor chus 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /dug thams cad kyang dug ma yin par byed par 'gyur / mngal na gnas pa'i khye'u dang / bu mo yang bde bar btsas par ca'agyur ro/ /mdo sde 'di zhag gsum bcangs na rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun bcangs na zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'byung po'i bdag po dbang bdag rig sngags 'chang bye ba phrag du mas bskor ba 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de nas langs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /stobs po che'i bstan pa thogs pa med par/ stobs dpag tu med pas pha rol gnon pa/ lag na rdo rje dga' ba/ lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang /tshangs pa dang 6dbang pos phyag byas pa/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /ro langs dang / lus srul po 'jigs par byed pa/ smyo byed dang / skyod pa dang / gsod pa dang / skems 7byed dang / sgo legs 8dang / 'khrul 'khor dang / gtan pa dang / rdo rjes rnam par 'joms pa las thams cad byed pa/ dkyil 'khor gsang ba dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bshad du gsol/ de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 96—44

'khor gyis 'byung po'i bdag po dbang bdag la 'byung po'i bdag po legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje spar te/ rdo rje la bzhugs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i ci1'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par gzigs nas rdo rje mi bzad 92pa khro bo chen po bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad la cher snying rje ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od zer 'bar zhing nasnang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /chos thams cad kyi dga' ba kun du ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /bdud thams cad kyi yul 'joms pa 4zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad kyi yul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /5 chos kyi sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / stobs po che zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rjes sdom 6bag can du rdo rje spar te/ de nas rdo rje pad+ma la gnas pa'i tshul gyis gnas te/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par bltas nas/ rdo rje mi bzad pa khro bo chol 7pa lus sprul gyi ska narags kyis brgyan pa/ dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ / snyoms par 9zhugs ma thag tu/ khro bo chol 1 pas bgegs bye ba brgya stong phrag 11du ma 'dar te gzir bar bdag nyid kyis mthong ngo / /de dag tshig nas smre zhing srog btang ste/ sreg pa'i bskal pa snyam du sems shing nyam 12thag pa'i skad kyis ngus te/ byang chub sems dpa' lag na 96—45

rdo rje'i gan du song nas/ bcom ldan 'das yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das kyis 1)khro bo chol tshon pas gzir cing myos te/ phongs ( nas srog la yang mi lta'o / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje ting nge 'dzin de las langs te/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la smras pa/ kye ma'o khro bo chen po 'di ni rdzu 'phrul che ba'o/ /mthu che ba'o/ /de dag gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das de de bzhin te/ kye ma'o khro bo chen po 'di ni rdzu 'phrul che ba'o/ /mthu che ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje seng ge'i lta stangs kyis bltas nas 'byung po'i bdag po la 5)khro bo chol (6)pa'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba dang bcas pas 7smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ha na ha na na/pa tsa ma tha bi dh+wan sa ya/ dza ṭi 7lo bo da 31ra/ u tsuṣ+ṭha mgro dha hūm̐ nyugephaṭa/ a ā ma k+ṇi mā /rihā laswā hā/ grogs po dag gang la la zhig khro bo stobs po che 'di'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs na de'i don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dus ma yin par 'chi bas dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i lus la drag po'i las dang /nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /de la bgegs dang / mi dang /rnam par log 'dren gyis glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /'dir zhugs na gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /khro bo thams cad kyi cho ga yang lhun gyis grub pa nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'dir dbang bskur na bkra mi shis pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dpal gyis 7byin gyis 96—46

brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas khro bo chen po lan khris sngar spyad pa byas 1)te/khro bo chen po'i dkyil 'khor byed pa/ byas pa gzo (5)ba/ rgyud shes pa/ gso sbyong ( )yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ gsum la skyabs su dong ba/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ snying rje can du gyur pa/dkyil 'khor mthong ba/ dbang bskur ba/ bla ma rnams kyi lung byin pa/gang bdud thams cad dang / sdang ba'i sems rnam par 'jig 4)par byed pa/rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che zhes bya ba 'di 'chang ba dang klog pa de la 5bdud dang / dgra thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dgas ༄6)dang / sha za dang / lus srul po dang /mkha' 'gro ma 7dang / brjed byed dang / sgrub pa dang / sbrul 'dzin bcas pa la sogs pa thams cad dang / 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro / /dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gsad tshonapa dang bcing ba thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gcad 9pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rmugs byed dang / rengs byed dang / rmongs byed la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /klu'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /bkra mi shis pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dbul po gang la la zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dus gsum du 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ yid la byed dam/ rjes su dran par byed na dbul ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /lo nyes pa byung ba'i tshe/ stobs po che lan bdun bklags na/ sprin chen po las char 'bab po / /gal te char mi 'bab na sprin gyi lha rnams kyi srog skam 7par 'gyur ro/ /96wa 47

klu'i rgyal po nag po dang / klu'i rgyal po 'khor lo dang / klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis (1sprin chen po las char 'bebs so/ /gal te char mi 'bebs na srog skam (na par 'gyur ro/ /gong du smos pa'i cho ga bzhin du phyogs ( kyi cha'am/ klung ci gi ngogs sam/ rgya mchoXre 'gram mam mtsho'i 'gram mam55ci/ mchod rten gyi gnas su byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la mchod pa chen po byas te/ tsan+dan dmar po dang /ka ra bī phyira'i me tog dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / a ti muk+ta ma'i 57)me tog dang / tsam pa ku'i me tog dang /85 rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dmar po la sogs pa dang 9/ bum pa spos chus bkang ba la sogs pas mchod pa chen po 1 byas te/ gang mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang / klog pa de 1lhagayul ngo thams cad du zhugs kyang pha rol gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /bkra mi shis pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs po che rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te g.yul ngor song na pha rol gyis 12mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags gro ga 41 la bris te spyi bor btags nas / g.yul ngor mtshon cha rnams me tog bzhin du ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdud des bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas stobs po che zhes bgyi ba ci lags zhes gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stobs po che zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /stobs po che zhes bya ba ni chos so/ /stobs po che zhes bya ba ni chos kyi phung po'o/ /stobs po che zhes bya ba ni chos kyi tshul lo/ /stobs po che zhes bya ba ni theg pa chen po'o/ /stobs po che zhes bya ba ni lag na rdo rje'o/ /de 96—48

nas bdud sdig can gyis smras pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /dge bsnyen gyi yan lag gzung bar bgyi'o/ /bde dang thar tsho1)dang mtho ris dang / /mkhas pa dag dang sems can ni/ /dam pa kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /stobs po che ni gzung bar bgyi/ /de nas bdud sdig can chos la dga' tshon)zhing yid bde ba dang rangs par gzigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che'i mdo sde 'di ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas cadang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal las thar bar byed pa'o/ /de bskal pa stong phrag nyi shur lha'i rgyal po byed par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa mtha' yas par gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur 57bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'jog par byed do/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che'i snying po 'di ni gtsang sbra can nam/ gtsang sbra med pa'am/ smyung bar byas pa'am/ smyung bar ma byas pa'am/ 'khrig pa'i chos la sten 6pa la'ang 'grub par byed do/ /de la bar chad du mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas rab 'byor 'khor de nyid na 'dug par gyur pas bcom ldan 'das rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/dam pa ni ci zhig 465 ces gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / lag na rdo rje la dri ba dris shig /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ dam pa ni ci zhig sbyin par byed / lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ 'bru sbyin par byed do/ /gos sbyin 96—49

par byed do/ /dngul sbyin par byed do/ /gser sbyin par byed do/ /ba lang (1)sbyin par byed do/ /dam pa gang 'dod pa'i dam pa de sbyin par byed do/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ spyi'i na'abras bu zhes bya ba'am/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/rab 'byor de de bzhin te/ sems can nyon mongs pas bsgribs pa rnams la (kyeni 'bras bu'i dus su gnas so/ /'bras bu'i dus kyi yon tan gyi don du gnas so / /yon tan gyi don gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam la 'jog par byed do/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ lag na rdo rje legs so legs / /gsang ba'i mtshan nyid ri ldan pa ste/ /stobs po che ni shes rab ldan//gsang ba'i mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs/ /spyi nas dbang bskur yid kyang gzhungs / /mtshan dang yang dag ldan pa ste/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims shes rab che / /rdzu 'phrul che zhing stobs kyang che/ /dbang cher grags shing bsod nams che / /yon tan rtse mo stobs po che/ /mdo sde 'di la dbang bskur phyir/ /sangs rgyas brgyad stong der gshegs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes mdo sde 'di nyid kyis mi 'jigs pa'i lag pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ dge ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis gzungs sngags ne 'di sa'am/ ri'am/ klung 7gi ngogs sam/ rgya mcho1re 'gram du bcangs na 'jigs pa thams cad kyis 'jigs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /su mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa de bro nad ma mchis par lo brgya 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rjes yang gsol pa/chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/96—50

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdo sde 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya bar zung (1)shig /chos kyi nyi ma zhes bya bar yang zung 55)shig /chos kyi zla ba zhes bya bar yang zung ri shig /don thams cad grub pa zhes 4bya bar yang zung sa༄shig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin ces bya bar yang zung 6)shig /sdig pa thams cad byang bar byed pa'i gzungs sngags zhes bya bar yang zung 75shig /rig sngags 'chang thams cad grub pa'i rgyal po zhes bya bar yang zung (8)shig /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya bar yang zung 99)shig /chos kyi dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba zhes bya bar yang zung (7shig /rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che zhes bya bar yang zung kyi shig /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje su mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / yi ger 'drir 12'jug pa dang /bsti /shestang du byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor 'byed pa dang /mchod par byed pa de'i/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba rnams kyi tshamachod rten sku gdung dang bcas pa la mchod pa ’ byas par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /shin tu zab pa'i chos bstan pa dang / cho 'phrul gyi yon tan gyi rgyan gyi chos bstan pa gzung bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo 1 gang mdo sde 'di 'chang ba de la sdang ba'i sems can rnams chu 'gram gyi shing ltar ma rungs par 'gyur ro/ /spos dang / me tog 96wa 51

dang / bdug pa dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs la sogs ༄1)pas mchod pa byas rin bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro / /de la bar chod mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mdo sde 'di gnas gang yang rung ba na 'chang na lha dang mir bcas pas mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che/ bgegs dang / rnam par log 'dren thams cad 'ching ba yid la byed na sangs rgyas brgyad stong dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / drang srong chen po rnams dang / lha dang / klu dang / dri zar bcas pa rnams dgyes dga'o/ /stobs po che'i gzungs sngags 'di la dgyes pa'i dus kyi tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya ri thub pas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje su mdo sde 'di cal gus par mi byed pa de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po brgyad po dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje su mdo sde 'di la gus par byed pa dang / rim gro byed pa dang / mchod pa byed pa de bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /yi ge 'dri'am5/tshig mnyan na phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub kyi lam thob par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ thub pa'i chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ shin tu phra ba/ shin tu zab pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sems can rnams kyi nang nas gang log par sems pa de myos par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir mdo sde 'di bshad par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa bsal ba dang / zhi bar bya ba dang / rgyas par bya ba dang / dbang bskur ba dang / bkra mi shis 96—52

pa thams cad las thar bar bya ba dang / dpal gyis 1byin gyis brlab par bya ba dang / sdig pa thams cad byang bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i (5byang chub thob dpar bya ba'i phyir bshad par bya'o/ /de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad ( stong dang bar mdzad nas/de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la lan gsum bskor ba mdzad de/ thal mo sbyar nas legs par 5/rab tu bshad pa legs so zhes mngon par dgyes par mdzad do/ / de nas (6)de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas sangs rgyas de dag la slar gsungs pa/ bcom ldan 'das dag legs par rab tu bshad pa legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stobs po che'i gsang ba'i 7chos bstan pa 'di'i mthus byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes sdang ba bgegs dang / rnam par log 'dren thams cad kyi snying 'dar zhing 'gul bar mthong ngo / /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra /da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ su ru su ru / mu ru mu ru/ ka ṭaṃ 9ka ṭi/ dza ye/ bi 1 dza ye/ a dzi te11/a pa rā 12dzi te/ mā 15ra si n+ya/ pra 1 mar da nā ya saswā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje bgegs dang sa rnam par log 'dren thams cad sdigs 1 shig /chings shig1 /rnam par choms 19shig /ma grub pa rnams grub par gyis shig /grub pa rnams dul bar gyis shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'bab par gyis shig /lha dang / klu thams cad tshur shog tshur shog /ngas stobs po che khro bo'i mthus 96—53

dge bar bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 1logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'du byed thams cad kyi mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa nyon cig /'du byed thams cad ni dri za'i grong khyer dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni glog nadang sprin dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad rmi khyim dang dbu ba dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni /mar me dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni chu'i chu bur dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni chu shing dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni ri mo'i rnam pa dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni me tog dang 'dra'o / /'du byed thams cad ni rmi lam dang 'dra'o/ / 'du byed 'di dag ni bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed 'di dag ni bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi klung dang 'dra'o/ /'khrug par 'gyur bas rgya mtsho 5dang 'dra'o / /skar ma dang 'dra'o/ /sems can rnams ni 'du byed 'di dag skye bar mi sems/ mi mthong / mi shes/ mi mjal 6)gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis gzigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mjal 57)lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen to/ /'du byed thams cad ni stong pa nyid du mtshan nyid gcig 8par mkhyen to/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi 96wa 54

mtshan nyid du mkhyen to/ /de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to//'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa mtshan nyid 'di dag 17mthong zhing mtshan 'di nyid (2)shes te/ spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /mtshan nyid 'di nyid shes pa ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba'o / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mdo sde 'di mtshan nyid gang gis na ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i las rnams mdo sde 'dis 4byed par 'gyur te5/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o/ /mdo sde 'di yongs su nub pa'i tshe/ de 6de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yongs su nub par 'gyur te/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i )sprul pa zhes bya'o/ /mdo sde 'di 'tsho zhing sdod na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yang 'tsho zhing sdod de/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs 8pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang mdo sde 'di nyid la phyag 'tshal 9te/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 7bcom ldan 'das la rjes su yi rangs 1 tshonas bka' lung bzhin bgyi zhing / su mdo sde 96—55

'di 'chang ba'i gan 1du mchi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdo sde 'di nyid kyi namathus sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / lha thams cad kyang 'ong ngo / /lha thams cad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /legs so legs so/ /bdag cag kyang dam pa stsal bar mngon par dga' ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang dam pa 'di nyid stsol ba mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje stobs po che'i gsang ba'i snying po ni sems can thams cad la bde ba thams cad sbyin par byed pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes 3'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mtshan nyid gang gis na mdo sde 'di chos kyi dbyings sngon du 'gro ba zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byung nas zhag sum cu 4rtsa gnyis lon pa'i nyin mo ri btang bzung 5chen por mdo sde 'di nyid kyi 6chos bstan te/ mtshan nyid des na chos kyi dbyings sngon du 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /mdo sde 'di nyid kyi mthus sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sems dang po bskyed pa la 7gnas te/ mtshan nyid des na chos kyi dbyings sngon du 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /mdo sde 'di nyid kyi mthus lha'i bu grangs med dpag tu med pa dag rgyun du zhugs par gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu su mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang klog pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sras su 'du shes bskyed do/ /'khor de nyid du 'chi ba'i dus byas nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam la 'jog par mdzad do/ /lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba bgrod dkar 96—56

sems can gyi/ /srid pa'i phur pa 'byin cing shes rab kyis/ /srid phur sems klung 'joms shing thub pa yi/ /chos bstan pas ni sdig 'joms chos legs spyod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rjes 1legs par rab tu bshad pa legs so legs so/ /lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ su mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pas bsod nams kyi phung po ci zhig 'thob par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu su mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa ni ting nge 'dzin bye ba 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa bye ba mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 2bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po mthong nas/ bsam pa rgya chen pos bste ciristang byed par 'gyur ro/ /bla mar byed par 'gyur ro/ /rim gror byed par 'gyur ro/ /mchod par byed par 'gyur ro/ /chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal cha dang / na ba'i gsos sman dang / yo byad rnams kyang 'bul lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' la yang bde bar sbyar ba sgrub bo/ /dge 'dun gyi tshogs la yang rim gro byed par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo 5bar byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la bsnyen bkur 6byed par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis chos bstan pa de la yang bsti stang 7du byas te nyan to/ /'dzin to/ /klog go/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje ji lta ba dang /96—57

mtshungs par stobs kyi pha rol gnon par 'gyur ro/ /stobs po che pha rol gnon pa'i khro bo 'di'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad/ swa sti swa sti/sid dhi sid dhi swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /'phags pa byams pa dang / 'jam dpal dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 1la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po la sogs pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa de dag thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa de dag thams cad dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de 2dang / lag na rdo rje yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la yi rangs te mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba'i 4theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs storari// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa (ne 96—58

nyid las6)/ /nam mkha'i khams su grags par 'gyur/ /bde chen ye shes mnga' bdag nyid/ /rdo rje zhes pa'i mtshan ldan pa'i/ /lha mo lu gu rgyud tshonam la//bdag cag rnams kyis gus par 55)'dud/ /sku yi 'od zer sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs sel byed pa'i/ /'od kyis bdag la bde ba skyes/ /lha mo bde ba khyod phyag 'tshal/ /stong nyid smon byed ( rimatshan ma bral/ /rgyal ba kun gyi rig pa las/ /ya mtshan lha mo'i rang bzhin thugs/ /mi rtog rang bzhin phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rjes rgyal ba kun 'dus pa'i/ /gzugs sogs rig pa'i lha mo yis/ /'khor lo 'di la legs mchod nas/ /mgrin ri5rigacig tu ni 'dus nas su/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa yis(6/ /rdo rje'i 7tshig gis stod 8par byed/ /rdo rje nam mkha' las byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum/ /spros bral nam mkha'i rang bzhin gsal/ /rdo rje thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje gzugs kyi sgra yis ni/ /lha tshogs 9ma lus rnams ska'aching mdzadakyi/ /bdud rnams tshar gcod 11rdo rje sgra/ /nam mkha'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo'/ /'gro drug bdud 'joms 12zhal drug ma/ /phyi nang rten 'brel dag phyir phyag /sgeg cing cung zad 'jigs par byed/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de skad rdo rje lha mo lang/ /lha la sogs pa thams cad kyis/ /rmad byung bstod pa'i rgyal po des/ /bstod pa'i de ma thag tu ni/ /lha mo gzi mdangs cher skyes nas/ /rang gi snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra shri tsha' le hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rig pa gzungs kyi phreng ba 'am/ /gsang sngags 'di nyid bshad tsam gyis/ /rims dang shu ba g.yan pa dang / /lhog pa sha bkra mdze nad 'a bras / /klad tshand mig nad rna nad dang / /lkog nad glo mchin nad rnams 96—69

dang / /rgyu gzer snying nad mkhal nad dang / /rkang lag nad dang khyab par na / /chu ser nad dang khrag nad dang / /bad kun rlung (1)dang mkhris pa dang / /shin tu 'khrugs 2pa'i nad la sogs/ /yams nad thams cad zhi bar byed/ /gzhan yang 'byung po brjed dbyed gdon ri/ /sha za mkha' 'gro ma mo dang / /gza' dang rgyu skar log 'dren dang / /byad stems drag po phyi rol gyi/ /rig sngags gtum po la sogs pa/ /'jigs pa'i gnod pa thams cad kun/ /rlung gis 5sprin bzhin gtor bar byed/ /gzhan yang stag gzig (6)dom dred dang / /'phar ba spyang ki 7gung po che ri/ /sre 59rimong byi ba sbrul byi la/ /sbrang bu mchu rings 1 pa tre ka /khwa dang se'u byu'u rta la sogs/ /'jigs pa rnam 17mang ji snyed 1 pa / /gsang sngags 'di brjod thos tsam gyis/ /thag rings gesu ni skyod dpar byed/ /gnod pa rnam mang thams cad kyang / /sngags kyi sbyor bas sel bar byed/ /gnod byed tsharnams ni gnod med byed/ /gnod med gnod nyu tshodang ldan byed cing / /sbyor ba yang ni sbyor ba 'gas/ /gzhan gyi sbyor ba 'ching bar byed/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud 18kyi rtog pa las gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas 'dir ni bshad bya ba/ /mdzes ma rdo rje khro mo yisatsho / / lha yi nu byeting 'dzin sbyor ba rnams/ /thig le chen mos mnyan par gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra shri 1khā 22le/ ut+na gerak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsang sngags 'dis 2 ni bsrung 25ba dang / /tha mal rtog pa'i lus sbyong 27byed/ /snying gar 2 zla steng hūm̐ yig gi 8/ /'od kyis 29rigs kyi gtso mo dang / /bla ma sangs rgyas spyan drangs 96—70

nas / /mdun du legs par dmigs nas ni/ /snying ga 1sa bon 'od rtse las/ /me tog sogs 'dzin lha mos mchod/ /gzugs sogs rdo rje ma rnams kyis/ /'dud cing so sor legs par mchod/ /thog ma med pa'i srid rgyud nas/ /lus ngag yid kyis spyad pa yi/ /sdig pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun/ /bgyis dang bgyid du stsal ri ba dang / /bgyid la rjes su yi ri rang ba/ /sdig pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun/ /thams cad so sor bshags par bgyi/ /slan 4nichad mi bgyid sdom pa yang / /rgya chen bdag gis gzung sgrubar bya/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mdzad pa dang / /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi phyirang / /rgyal dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rigs 7ldan rdo rje lha mo dang / /sngags rgyud rgya chen 'khor lo la/ /kun nas dang bas skyabs su mchi/ /mi rtog 8blo gros bskyed 9pa'i phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /gdul bya ji srid tshim pa ru/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya/ /gdod nas ji srid da lta yi/ /bar du lus 'dis ci ma byas/ /da ni srid pa'i rlung rtogs nas/ /rang gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyis/ /theg chen bla na med pa yi/ /lam chen rgya mtsho gang yin pa//theg chen 'bras bu thob bar du/ /rgyun mi chad 11par bsten par bya/ /de ltar dad sems 'dun byas te/ /bsod nams rgya chen rnams 12bsags pa'i/ /dge ba bla na med pa de1 / /thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo'o1 / /dang po byams pa'i 'od zer gyisad/ /'gro rnams bde la dgod par bya/ /gnyis pa snying rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal 'bral sems bskyed/ /gsum pa dga' bas bde ba thobatsha/ /bzhi pa chags bral btang snyoms 7so/ /de rjes rags 1896—71

pa'i stobs spong 1zhing / /bag chags dri ma bsal nas kyang / /nam mkha' lta bur sgrub dbyed pa'i/ /de nas dag pa rjes dran bya/ /oṃ swa gabhā cirab shud ṅgāḥsarba gadharmāḥ6su bhā ba shud rnyo3 rtsu kyi/ de yis (8)dag par byas nas ni/ /stong nyid rjes su bsgom par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā (9nodzñā ngon badz+ra swa bhā tunyeb (1ཿāt+pa ko3nya6)/dngos po thams cad ma lus par/ /nam mkha' lta bur bsgom par bya/ /der ni raṃ skyes nyi dkyil 'khor/ /dmar po 'od zer 'khrigs pa skibasgom/ /de dbus hūm̐ yig sngon po yi/ /'od kyis 'gro ba'i bdud bsal te/ /slar yang yi ge la gzhug dpar/ /rdo rje khro mo yongs su rdzogs/ /zhal gsum phyag drug me phung 7bzhugs/ /thugs kur nyu nyi mar hūm̐ sngon bsam/ /'od kyis bsrung hu ba'i 'khor lo bya/ /shar du rdo rje lhor dbyug pa/ /nub tu chu ste byang du mda'/ /byang shar rtse gsum shar lho 19me/ /lho nub ral gri nub byang rlung / /'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje brag /steng phyogs rdo rje rtse lnga'i gur/ /gsang sngags zhu )brjod pas bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ las 'od zer rab spros pas/ /'khor lo bkod tsho stopa'i phyi rol du/ /rdo rje rtse gsum ra ba dang / /gur ni rab tu bsgom par bya de rjes rdo rje khro mo ni/ /zhu nas rang bzhin med par gyur/ /de las nyi ma'i steng gnas pa'i/ /bdud bzhi mnan cing nyi zla ni/ /ā 2 li kā sa li las byung ba'o/ /bar du hūm̐ las rdo rje ni/ /khro mo'i rang bzhin 'od kyis bskor/ /khro mo dang bcas 'od zer rnams/ /rdo rje la bzhugs sku bzhengs te/ /zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug gam / /yang na zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi mnan/ /zhal kun sngo 25zhing khro gnyer can/ /dmar ser gyen skra thod phreng can/ /rdo rjes lus brgyan 27nam mkha'i mdog /bcu gnyis phyag ste 2 g.yas pa na/ /rdo rje zhags 96—72

pa mda' gsor zhing / /sprul dang dgra sta gri gug 'dzin/ /g.yon pa dril bu sdigs mdzub (1)gzhu/ /dbyig pa rtse gsum tho ba'o/ /yang na phyag drug g.yas dang pos/ /rdo rje gnyis pas lcags sgrog ste/ /gsum pas mda' ni gsor bar byed/ /g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub (5ste/ /gnyis pa sprul gyi 5zhags (4)pa'o/ /gsum pas gzhu ste 'gengs pa'i tshul/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma yi/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /yon tan kun gyi bdag nyid kyi/ /sngags kyi rtsa bar 'gyur ba'o/ /sngags kyi bdag nyid yongs 5bskyed ri cing 7/ / lha yi zhinarang bzhin bsgrub 95pa yi/ /rin chen gzungs 7kyi phreng bas ni/ /chos rnams mtha' dag thob 'gyur te/ /ral gri mig sman 31 ril bu 12dang / /rkang pa byug dzinadang gter chen dang / /sa 'og 'gro dang bcud bolen dang / /nam mkhar 'gro dang gser 'gyur skadang / /de bzhin sa gzhan 'gro ba dang / /zhi tshadang rgyas dang dbang mngon spyod/ /rmongs dang rengs dang bskrad 1 pa dang / /dbye dang dgug dang rig sngags 'ching 18/ /bsrung 19dang phyir bzlog 2 chen po dang / /zha dang lkugs 1dang sems brgyal rtadang / /long dang sna tshogs nad skyed ne pa'i/ /sbyor ba rgya chen 'grub pa dang / /mngon shes drug po yongs skye zhing ske/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /phyag rgya chen po thob 'gyur na/ /ltas mthong tsam la sogs pa yi/ /dngos grub phra mo smos ci dgos/ /sngags kyi sbyor ba bskyed 'gepa'i lha/ /dmigs pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa yi/ /hūm̐ las skyes pa'i lha mo ni / /sngon mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ /g.yas pa ser zhing g.yon pa dmar/ /spyan gsum sdang mig khro gnyer can/ /dmar ser gyen skra 25thod pas brgyan yo/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras shing 'gying / /thod pa'i phreng can klu yis brgyan/ /96—73

zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro la 17brdzis/ /phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na/ /rdo rje gnyis pas 55gri gug ste/ /gsum pa nasasbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi dang po sdigs camadzub 5ste/ /gnyis pas thod pa gsum pa na/ /sbrul gyi zhags pa dkar po'o/ /yang na zhal kun sngo bsangs 6)nyid/ /'dis (7)ni 'ching dang dbang gi las/ /mtha' dag rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /srid par bram ze 85skyes lha mo9 / /sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon lcags sgyu sgrog /gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan ldan pa/ /bsad 511pa'i las rnams thams cad ni / /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'dis bsgrub12/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /chos rnams thams cad 'byung byed cing / /dngos grub myur du skyed 12pa yibo/ /phyag rgya 'byung zhes bya ba yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /yan lag phyag rgya bka' stsal pa/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar byas shing / /slar la mkhu tshur bcang byas te/ /rgyab gnyis sprad nas mdzub lamo dang / /mthe'u chung lcags sgrog bcing 1 byas te/ /kha yi 18thad kur bzhag nas ni/ /rig pa'i phreng (7ba brjod pa yis / /'dod pa thams cad 'grub par byed/ /phyag 1rgya bcings sa nas gsang sngags da ni/ /rjes su dran par byas tsam gyis/ /lam du 'gro yang bde bar thar/ /gzhan gyi rig sngags gcod par byed/ /'phags 5 rim rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma'i 25rgyud kyi rig sngags las lha dang phyag rgya gtan la 27dbab pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rdzas kyi sbyor ba bla na med/ /mtshungs pa'i tshogs kun 'grub byed pa/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yis nyon/ /oṃ sarba 2 ta thā 96—74

ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ri1 tu me/ oṃ sarba rinata thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta nas ma ya shri 4ye hūm̐/dbang bskur ba ni bla na med/ /dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag 55byed cing / /ji srid ye shes tshogs rgyas nas/ /rig pa'i rgyal po thob par byed/ /dzaḥ6 rtsu baṃ 7hoḥ58) / oṃ badz+ra saspre āḥ47rtsu swā hā/ dhū pe dī 7pe 1lhagan dhe/ nai wi 12bye 1 āḥ swā hā/ oṃ k+ṣi yihrīḥs ka la/ gha yin bi na pa 7re/ sh+ya r+ya sa pa ri wā 1 ra a a a/ a bhi ti rarnyi/ a bhi ta radhe/1na sa bhi 19ta ran tu/ sarba 21da sha na di ku(ste /lo ka pā 2ril/ lo ka pā li rnyi/ i me ba lo 5griṇ+ḍa 2 (tu/ khā dan tu 8pi ban+tu 296 phaṭa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ l+li l+li 1badz+ra dha ra ya 2/ ā 'a dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ ye shes sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis tsho / / tha dad mirtog 7pa spong bar byed / /mchod pa dang ni gtor ma yis/ /bar du tshogacod pa kun 8sel 9byed//oṃ kā ri )ya badz+ra swa /bhā ba /ād+ma ko3 narta/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /rnam par spras pa'i mtshan ma la/ /mtshan ma med pa rnams gnas pa/ /shes nas mtshan nyid rnam par dag /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3 haṃ/ gang zhig dbang pos 5yul mtshon pa tsi/ /mtshon bya mtshan nyid rnam shes dang / /ye shes nyid ni mngon sum du/ /skye ba nyid la the tsom med/ /de nas rgya chen sbyor ba'i gtso/ /'khor lo'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /gro ga /ras sam shing shun la/ /gur gum gi 'oglu tsan+dan bcas/ /pu ka ser pos 5 'khor lo ni / /rtsibs 51bcu pad+ma'i steng du bri/ /mtha' nas me yi 52phreng bas bskor/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma bcu la ni/ /phyogs ri bcu kun du bcing ba yi/ /rdo rje la sogs 54bcu po bri/ /de yi rgyab tu phyogs bcu rnams/ /bcing ba'i sngags ni rim bzhin bri/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs 55rnams bcu po la/ /hūm̐ gnyis bar du 96—75

bsgrub bya'i 1ming / /bsrung 2nob dang da bcas bri bar bya/ /phyogs bzhir sngags dang phyag rgya cadang / /'khrul 'khor gcod dang 'ching ba dang / /'gugs 5pa'i sngags su bcas pa bri/ /gzhan yang mtshams rnams drug por ni / /lha dang klu dang lha min gyi ni/ /gnod sbyin grul bum la sogs ri ripa/ /bcing ba drug po bri bar bya/ /lte bar bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /skyil krung thugs kur thal mo sbyar/ /mdzes pa'i gos ldan bri bar bya/ /de rjes gsang sngags phreng ba nyid/ /stong phrag gcig tu brjod byas nas/ /de rjes bstod 8pas bstod byas te/ /gser sogs dril nas lus sam mgul6nye/ /gang bde'i gnas su gdags par bya/ /des ni rnal 'byor bsrung yidon du/ /ji ltar bsam 11pa kun 'grub ste/ /'jigs pa brgyad po med par byed/ /de nas gzhan yang rgyal po'i ras/ /gsar 1 la tsan+dan ga bur dang / /dri zhim rnams kyis byas 1 nas ni/ /rgyu bskar rgyal gyi nyi ma la/ /gur gum gyis tsheni 'khor lo bri / /dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa'i/ /phyi rol mu khyud gsum ldan pa'i/ /pad+ma'i lte bar bsgrub bya'i gzugs/ /yan lag rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ /de la snying po'i sngags kyis ri7bskor/ /de rjes lte ba'i mu khyud la/ /steng 'og bcing ོba'i sngags 1 kyis bri/ /phyogs mtshams ci19sngags rnams 'dab ma la'o/ /phyi rol mu khyud dang por ni/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ring 2 nodagod par bya/ /gnyis par 'od kyi ra ba bri/ /dri zhim dkyil 'khor steng bzhag 7ste/ /rang nyid lha yi 2sbyor rdzogs bya/ /thugs 2dka'i 2 sa bon 'od kyis ni/ /nam mkhar dge'akhor lo sbyangs byas te/ /yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par bsam/ /de yongs gyur las sku tshogs sasgom / /de dbus shes rab rnam par bsam/ /zla dbus steng du hūm̐ las ni/ /96—76

'khor lo rtsibs ldan bsgom par bya/ /der ni yi ge'i rnam pa ni/ /mar me lta bu gsal dmigs la/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang dbyer med bya/ /rang snying sa bon las byung ba'i/ /gsang sngags 17stong phrag bzlas byas nas/ /gser sogs nadril (minas lus sam mgul/ /btags (can 'jigs pa brgyad las skyoba'i/ /thams cad du ni bsrung 96)bar nges/ /yungs kur 7ba yi rnam lnga dang / /dur 8ba'i snye kyi)mar bcas pa la/ /gsang sngags stong phrag bzlas nas ni/ /rgan mo ming med sbyor ba yis / /gnas gsum thig le byas bsrung /lhan/ /tshe ni stong phrag du mar 'phel/ /ku sha ba mar yungs kur 1 til/ /gsang sngags stong phrag bzlas byas te/ /shis nyu par gyur pa'i nyi ma la/ /mchod rten spyi bor gdags 1 byas nas/ /'go ba'i nad rnams tsha'achad par 'gyur/ /khrag dang khro chur bcas pa la/ /gsang sngags nyu stong phrag gsum bzlas te/ /zla ba gzas gzung 1 dus su ni/ /nye bsnyen rdzogs 19par byas nas ni/ /rdzas ni shin tu spa byas te/ /lha tshogs gnod pa gang dmigs pa'i/ /snying gar sngags 1ni bsnun byas na/ /gang dmigs bgegs ni rnam par 'jig /ras bal gsar 22par gyur pa la/ /shes rab mtshan ldan khrus byas te/ /shis 2 pa'i nyi ma la bkal nas/ /bcings pa'i grangs 5kyis mdud byas te/ /stong phrag gcig gi 0sngags bzlas nas / /lus sam mgul rna lam spyi bor gdags / /des ni tshe lo stong phrag thub//yang na rang lus rnams 29bsgrims sdo nas/ /chu yi tshogs kyis 1dag byas te/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig grangs ldan par/ /gzungs kyi phreng ba brjod byas na na/ /gser phyag lag tu ma blangs shing / /bden bral phyi rol ma song bar/ /gzhan gyi na'ajigs pa ma bsal zhing / /tshe lo brgya ni rtsa brgyad par/ /rims nad tsam 96—77

yang mi gnod do/ /gos dang zas dang snod spyad dang / /sman la sogs 3)pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /mi 'khrugs nargyal po'i phyag rgya yis(5)/ /bsrungs na cis kyang mi shod de/ / seng chen 4rngam pa'i stabs kyis ni/ /'ug pa'i sgra gsum brjod byas na/ /phyi rol rig sngags stong phrag ni/ /du mas cis kyang mi tshugs so/ / klu yi 5dbang po gnas 5lugs kyis/ /rtse gcig rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas/ /de nas gsang sngags gsum brjod na/ /nad dang gdon la sogs (7)pa sel ri bong 8na ma'i mtshams 9)byas nas/ /hūm̐ gis mnan pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /dmigs med ting 'dzin yid brtan 7cizhing / /'dis kyang gnod pa las bsrung (1'gyur / /phyi rol sogs pa kun spangs nas/ /snang ba yid kyis bslabs ⑩byas te/ /mi snang ba la mngon dmigs nas/ /bsrung hu ba rnams kyi gedam pa bshad / /de nas gzhan yang sbyor ba bshad/ /dur khrod la sogs 'jigs gnas sam/ /mtsho dang mtshe'u dang dgon loganas dang / /gnas dang skyed tshamos tshal chen dang / /me tog tshal lam yul 'khor ljongs/ /chu yi 'gram mam tsoshing gcig gam/ /yang na rang gi khyim nyid du/ /maṇ+ḍal legs par byugs pa la / /brten nas lha yi sbyor ba sgrub1 / /ras ris la sogs mdun byas te/ /bde ba'i stan 19la skyil krung gis/ /bsdad nas mnyam gzhag 27brtsam par bya /tha mal sbyangs pa'i lus kyis ni/ /thar pa chen po thob 'gyur te/ /gzhan du de ltar ma yin no/ /sa gzhi shin tu nyams dga' zhing / /legs par bkod pa'i ri bo la/ /nags 22tshal shin tu sdug pa la/ /bsil ri naba'i chu rgyun 'babs 2 pa'i phyogs/ /rnam bkod me tog tshal gseb tu/ /shar du sgo bstan khang pa la//sngags bzhis 25mtshams bcings 20cho ga yis/ /gsal khung dang bcas brtsigs 96—78

pa'i phyogs/ /snyan pa'i bya yis sgra sgrogs (1)shing / /dri zhim spos ngad ldan pa la//dril bu sil sil sgra snyan nasgrogs kyi/ /lda ldi gos kyi phreng bas dkris/ /lhag 4pa'i 'du 'dzi rnam ri457spangs nas/ /spyod pa mthun 6)pa'i grogs dang ni/ /bde bar byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /'on kyang 7riganas dang grogs la sogs(8ri/ /rnal (9)'byor yid 'jug phyir brtsam 7ste/ /mtha' dag spangs pa'i pha 11rol na/ /lhag pa'i byang chub ma mchis paso/ /bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs rnams/ /rang gi sems las 'byung mod kyi/ /sems rtog 1lham lus spang ba 1 las ngas ni chos gzhan 'ga' ma bshad/ /de bas sems rtog sna tshogs rnams/ /spang bar bya phyir sna tshogs thabs/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin dang / /sbyor ba rgya chen rnams bshad do/ /drag po sgrub dpa'i thabs 'ga' ni/ /rig pa'i khro mos mnyan par gyis/ /sa gzhi tshabadud rtsi lnga yis 1 byugs18/ /me yi dkyil 'khor sa bon bcas/ /dur khrod pha 19gus bri bar bya/ /der ni pho mo thod pa la / /phyi rol dmar nag tshon gyis byugs / /nang du sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ /mu khyud gsum ldan bri bar bya/ /dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i kā/ /snying po sngags bcas bri 22bar bya/ /rdo rje rwa ni thams cad la/ /hūm̐ bri mu khyud gnyis phreng 2 sngags/ /gsum par khro bo'i sngags bri'o / /thod pa kha sbyor 25nang du ni//ske tshe yungs kur sabatsan dug dang / /lan tshwa khrag dang sha chen dang / /rkang rjes sa la sogs pa blugs/ /gcer bu rnal 'byor skra bshig nas/ /lha yi sbyor ldan lhor bltas nas 8/ /zhabs kyis thod pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /mnan te sngags phreng brjod par bya/ /khro bo chen po'i sbyor ba yi rte/ /mnyam bzhag ni nas ni stong phrag tu/ /bzlas 1pa mtshan phyed par byas na/ /bsad 2pa nyid la the 96—79

tshom 1med/ /dur khrod ras la 'khor lo ni/ /dbus su me yi dkyil 'khor can / /rtsibs brgyad mu khyud gsum ldan pa/ /dbus (nasasu snying po sngags rnams la / /hūm̐ gnyis bar du bsgrub bya'i ming / /bsad kyis nyid dang ldan par bya/ /mu khyud gnyis pa phreng sngags kyang / /ming dang bsad (4)par ldan pa'o/ /gsum pa khro bo'i 5sngags bris te/ /'khor lo mchod cing byin brlabs 6)nas/ /dgra gzugs sor brgyad snying gar 97)gzhug /de nyid til mar gyis byugs te/ /thod pa gnyis kyi 'khor lo yi/ /bar du bcug nas me steng gzhag(8ra /seng ldeng phur pa 9sor brgyad pa/ /mnyam gzhag tshesbyor bas sngags 37de gdab/ /bsad nyu2pa'i sbyor ba 'di nyid kyis/ /shi bar 'gyur 12la gzhan du min/ /yang na byang chub yan lag las/ /dur khrod khrag gis 'khor lo zisko/ /gru gsum brtsegs pa'i gzugs dbris te/ /dbus su dgra ming gsang sngags bcas/ /rtsibs la bcu gnyis bar du ni/ /ming dang bsad lapa bcas pa bri/ /mu khyud dang po'i sngags phreng yang / /rgyas pa'i yan lag ldan par bri/ /spra tshil gzugs yi tshobarnyan sor brgyad pa'i/ /snying gar 12bcug nas skra yis 19dkri/ /rnal 2 )'byor pa yi ༷ lhanyal ba'i zhabs/ /mgo bo lhor bstan gzhag 22par bya/ /chu shel ma mthong ( gebar du ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags brjod nas/ /mi yi rdo rje'i (mudar gyis brgyan pa / /sdang byed sa steng 'dir mi gnas/ / klu yi 'ganas su grags pa 'am / / chu yi rdzing 8la sogs 'gram du/ /dkyil 'khor ba yi rnam lngas byugs 9 / /pad+ma dmar po'i ri mo la/ /lte ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /gser gyi mdog can thal mo sbyaras / / klu yi gdengs ra ka bdun ldan pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng gnas pa/ /shin tu bltas pas gnas par bya/ /dga' bo 96—80

nyer dga' 'jog po dang / /mtha' yas dung skyong rigs ldan gzugs/ /pad+ma pad chen rnams byas te/ /dkar 17dang ( ser dang ljang ba dang / /dmar dang ljang skya sngo (5)skya dang / /dmar ser ljang ser 'dzum pa'i gzugs / /gtso la thal mo sbyar btud nas/ /rgyu skar phreng ba dang ldan gnas5/ /'o ma 'bras can 6)mkhal zho sha /pus ka tsa ti ri ril sogs sman/ /khur (8ba tshogs bu dang bcas pa/ /rin chen snod du dgram par bya/ /gza' dang rgyu skar 9rnams dga' zhing / /klu rnams bde ba'i sems thob shog /lha rnams yid ni mnyam bzhag rtanas/ /snying rje'i blo chen skye bar shog /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za sogs/ /byang chub sems chen dang ldan nas/ /thugs rje /1nye bar dgongs nas kyang / /dus su char chen 'beb nyu2par shog /smon lam de yi rjes su ni18/ /gzungs kyi phreng ba brgya yirtsa brgyad/ /brjod pa'i de ma thag tu ni/ /char gyi rgyun yang 'bab 'ipar 'gyur/ /gal te cung zad mi 'bebs na/ /me la bsdigs sapa tsam gyis ni/ /glog / gi phreng ba gtor byed na/ /char chen 'bebs la the tshom 18med / /wa yi khrag gis gro ga 19la/ /gang 2 gi 'khor lo bskrad pa yi/ /thabs dang ldan par bri byas nas/ /dur khrod sa las byas pa yi/ /rnga mo'i snying gar 1bcug nas kyang / /rkang pa g.yon pas mnan nas ni/ /lhor bltas bka' yi sbyor ba yis/ /gsang sngags khri phrag gcig brjod na/ /bskrad pa nyid la the tshom 22med/ /sbrul dang sre mo'i khrag gis ni/ /rta dang ma he'i pags na pa la/ /mnyam du gnyis kyi gzugs bri 2 te/ /dbye ba'i sngags dang bcas pa yi/ /'khor lo thod pa'i gzugs 5bris la/ /pags tshopa gnyis kyis dkris byas pa/ /zla gam bye brag dkyil 'khor la/ /brten pas dbye ba'i sbyor ba rdzogs/ /96—81

mtshal dang tsan+dan ga bur bsres1ci/ /zla gam dbyibs kyi nanodakyil 'khor la/ /snying po dbang gi sbyor bar zhibacas/ /nub tu bltas nas bsgrubs 0pa yi55)/ /lha yi dbang po dbang du 'gyur/ /rgyud kyi khyad par sbyor ba'o/ / dri yi 96)rgyal po sna tshogs kyis / /shing gi lo ma dkar po la/ /rdo rje rgya gram gnyis kun brtsegs kyi9/ /phyogs kyi rwa 7rnams hūm̐ gis spras/ /mtshams 11kyi rwa k+ṣ-i/rtarnams kyi dbu kham la/ /hūm̐ bri tshar 7yi 1 yan lag la/ /phaṭa ni phyir la bltas pa bri/ /rgya chen gsol ba gdab par bya/ /gos bzang 12ngam (19ni skags shing du/ /btsug 2 nas rgyal mtshan rtser 21btags na 2/ /rlung dang thog dang ser ba gcod lha / /dman pa rnams dang 'brel ba spang / /thal ba chu dang yungs kur ri la gi / /sngags kyi phreng ba bzlas byas te/ /sprin la sogs pa 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /gtor ba tsam gyis 'chad par 27'gyur/ /'bru mar yungs kur ( ser po la/ /sngags nanas lus la byugs tsam gyis/ /phran tshegs nad rnams thams cad las//ma he shin tu brtan par byed/ /'phags ma rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sbyin sreg 29thab kyi sbyor ba yis/ /dngos grub thams cad myur byed de/ /sna tshogs da1lha mos mnyan par byos 2/ /ser sna spangs ri shing g.yo sgyu med/ /dul la dpa' brtul 5bzod pa che/ /mkhas shing rig pa da brtson 'grus bzang / /sngags la mkhas pas sbyin sreg brtsam / /thab ni ri nyi shu sor tshad la/ /phyed brkos 29kha phyir rdo rje ni/ /rtse gsum dur khrod tshon gyis bri/ /phyi rol phyag rgya rnam 1bkod nas/ /dri zhim me 96—82

tog gcal 1du bkramanyan / /der ni mchod cing bsreg ri pa'i rdzas/ /tshogs nas rdzas rnams bsang gtor bya/ /bong 4kyibu rnga mo'i ril ma dang / / gsal shing 5cher bcas shing la me/ /sa bon las skyes spar /67bar bya/ /der ni rdo rje lu gu rgyud / /bskyed 7pa'i cho ga rin rdzogs byas nas/ /mchod cing bstod nas der 9rjes su/ /ske tshe yungs 1 kur btsan 11dug dang / /rus phye sha chen til nag po/ /dang bcas sbyin sreg 12stong phrag gcig1da /phreng ba'i sngags kyis 1 sbyor bar lobya//thog ma tha mar mar sachen dang / /til mar brgya phrag re re sbyin/ /sbyor bcas sbyin sreg 1 rdzogs pa dang / /zhag bdun gyis ni bsgrub bya de18/ /shi bar 'gyur 19la the tshom na med/ /glang sha sbal 51sha pri yang ku/ /sbyin sreg stong gis bsgrub bya zhing / /ba 22bla ldong ros ru rta dang / /ling ga /glang po bse shar bcas/ /ser por byas la stong phrag ni/ /gcig gis 'phral du rengs par byed/ /sprul rta 25ne'u le ma ho'i sha /bya rog 'ug sha stong phrag gcig /bsregs 24pas bsgrub bya 'byer 2 bar nges/ / bra bo na'abras bu ra sha khrag /stong phrag gcig gis lkugs 29par 'gyur/ /rnga mo ri bya rog rgan po'i sha /sā 21lu dmar til dkar po dang / /yungs 2kar da ser po la sogs pa/ /stong du bsregs pas skyod par byed/ /'bru lnga smad 'tshong rang byung gigis/ /nam phyed nub tu kha bltas byug ne /me tog pad+ma dang bcas pa'i/ /kha dog dmar dang ldan pa yi / /'od zer dmar ldan stong phrag gis/ /nges par 'gugs /dang dbang du 'gyur//til bcas mar gyi sbyin sreg 9ni / /stong phrag byas na sdig pa 'byang /mar dang drar 1ba tsan+dan bcas/ /sbyin sreg 2stong gis rim 'phel 'gyur/ /ku sha byang chub shing 'bras bu/ /yungs kur dkar po lan tshwa yi 5/ /stong bsregs tsi96—83
