bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (414)96wa 294

dzo /'phags pa gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs bde byed ces bya ba/1༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ kā 2ru ṇi ka su ār+ya dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra su shaṃ ka ra nā ma dhā ra tī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs bde byed ces bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das nor bu'i grong khyer gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po byang chub sems dpa' nor bu bzang po'i bu'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nor bu bzang po'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhig bdag gi snying po nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum sems par bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag rtag tu de'i rjes su 'brang bar bgyid/bdag dpag tshad brgyar yang gnod sbyin rnams las bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /96—295

bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /'dod pa dang ldan pa'i kha na ma tho ba ma gtogs pa 'di lta ste/ zas dang / skom dang / bca' ba dang bza' ba dang / nor dang 'bru dang / dbyig dang / gser stsal bar bgyi'o//tabya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ o e h+ye hi tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha me sā dha ya swā hā/ tar+ya thā / pū ta ne pū ta ne/ su ru me/ su mā te/ su brnye su pū sgye(1/ hi li mi li swā hā/ cho ga ni zla ba yar gyi ngo tshes bcwa lnga la tsan+dan dkar pos dkyil 'khor byas la/ a ka ru bsregs nas bzlas brjod byas na de'i 'og tu gser thob par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs bde byed ces bya ba rdzogs sto// //96—296
bsdur mchan/295 0)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ rin 〈〈khu 〉〉ka 〉〈〈khu 〉〉ar+ya/296 ①〈〈khu 〉〉rtse/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (415)96wa 297

'byung ba'i rtog pa zhes bya ba/1༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ya thā lasta dkalpa nā ma / bod skad du/ 'phags pa gnod gnas dbang po ci ltar 'byung ba'i rtog pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 3dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das lang kya'i gling dang nye bar gyur pa rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram na bzhugs te/ sangs rgyas kyi 4chos rnams las 5phyir mi ldog pa thob 6par gyur pa'i rnam par 'jigs pa dang /zla ba'i sde la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 7chen por tshorag she(1 /rnge/ /rdo/ rtse(( res/ 1re/ 1nge/ she/khrogyur pa' 'a ra sa ba ra nas ma na du byas / / nas ra ba ma ldan 'das nam mkha' la gshegs 8nas slar babs te dpag bsam gyi shing bi tsu war+bha'i k+ṣ-i rtsa bar bzhugs so/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi dbang po gnod gnas rab tu dga' ba dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po dang / klu'i rgyal po mi zhum pa dang /96—298

grul bum gyi rgyal po mngon shes lnga pa dang / dri za'i rgyal po zur phud 1lnga pa dang / srin po'i rgyal po ki 5li ki la dadang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gshog ri tshopa can dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa dang / zur phud 5lnga pa dang / srul po dang / lha'i bu sprin gyi shugs can dang / zla ba dang zla ba la mngon par gus pa dang / lha'i bu rgyal bas byin rnams nub mo 'das dzinas tho rangs gsal ba'i dus su/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der nye bar lhags te/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag byas nas/ bskor ba lan gsum 7byas te/phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyi 'od kyi 8kha dog shin tu gsal zhing rgya che ba dpag bsam 9gyi shing gi 'irtsa ba thams cad gsal zhing rgyas par gyur to11/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams la bka' stsal pa / rgya mtsho chen po 12grong khyer du ngo mtshar zhing rmad du gyur pa'i chos brgyad la bzod pa dang / ji nyu ltar rtogs pa la khyed rnams bar chad dang don 1 med par ma gyur tam/ 'di skad du gsungs pas gnod sbyin gyi dbang po gnod gnas rang gi stan las langs nas 5bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der thal mo sbyar nas lophyag byas te1 / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rgya mtsho chen po'i grong khyer du bzod pa dang / ji 1 ltar rtogs par byed pa la mngon par dga' bar byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgya mtsho chen po'i grong khyer du ji ltar gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon khyed rnams ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba'i 19chos brgyad la mngon par 96—299

dga' bar byed pa de ltar rigs kyi bu chos 'di rnams 'dod pa dang / dad pas mngon par dga' ba ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba'i 1chos brgyad la gnas pa 2de ni tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi dbang po gnod gnas kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar zhing rmad du gyur pa'i 45chos brgyad la gnas pa 'di la nga yis bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung 5ba dang /yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang / bkra shis pa dang 'jig rten pa la rjes su brtse bas skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di yongs su gzung 6zhing / bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bdag gis rtogs 7pa 'di/ log par dad sel dang / gser thub dang / 'od srung 8dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de rnams la snying po 'di yongs su phul 9lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyis kyang snying po 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon khyod 1 kyis gang dus la bab cing mno ba de smros shig /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon 1rtaganod gnas kyis 'di skad ces smras pa/ 'di lta bu'i ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do12/ /mchod /sbyin rnams kyi 1 nang na sbyin sreg bogatso/ /rig sabyed rnams na dbyangs 1 can gtso/ /mi rnams na 18ni rgyal po gtso/ /chu rnams na 19ni rgya mtsho gtso / /rgyu skar rnams na 2 zla ba gtso/ /drod rnams na 21ni nyi ma gtso/ /steng dang 'og 22dang thad ka na/ /ji risnyed 'gro ba gnas pa dag /gang zhig bsod nams 'dod pa yis / /tshogs rnams na ni 'phags pa gtso/ /lha dang bcas 96—300

pa'i 'jig rten na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso/ /de nas yang gnod sbyin gyi dbang po gnod gnas kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 1rjes su gnang ba thob nas rang gi sngags smras pa/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha dā 5ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ oṃ dzam bha la dza len dā ya cas hā/ de nas sngags kyi rgyal po 'di smras pa tsam gyis/ de ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 5rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de nas ji srid phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po rnams kyis mgrin 6gcig gis 'di skad ces bya ba'i tshig brjod pa / bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa/ ji /srid chos kyi rnam grangs sngar ma 9byung ba'i ngo mtshar rmad du nges par gyur pa/ ji 1 srid chos kyi rnam grangs phan yon chen po ngo mtshar ba/ sdug bsngal ba rnams dang / skyabs med pa rnams dang /yongs su skyob pa med pa rnams dang / gnas med pa rnams kyi skyabs 11dang /gnas dang skyob pa dang / yongs su skyob pa de bcom ldan 'das bshad du gsol / /sems can rnams kyi don du 1 lha dang mi rnams kyi 1 phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir snying po 'di rtog pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang gsang chen dang /sems can gang gi sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa yongs su rdzogs shing / bde ba nyid kyis 1 bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par 'thob 15pa'o / /de nas yang 'khor saganod sbyin de 1 rnams dang / nyan thos chen po rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin la 1 sogs pa bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas rang rang gi stan las langs nas thal mo sbyar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 19nas/96wa 301

bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol ba btab bo6)/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin de rnams 'khor de rnams dang bcas pa la bka' stsal pa/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rigs kyi bu khyed rnams nyon cig /gnod sbyin chen po'i snying po 'di dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / sngags dang gsang sngags 2chen po ri shin tu ngo mtshar ba dang / shin tu rmad 4༄du gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs par)/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / yi dgas (6skudang / sha za dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyis phyag byas shing mngon par bstod pa/sems can rnams la kun du phan pa'i phyir yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang bum pa bzang po dang / dpag bsam gyi shing ci 7ltar mngon par 'dod pa bzhin du don thams cad sgrub par byed 8pa 9de'i phyir/ nga yis 〉rjes su gnang shermizhing byin gyis brlabs pa 'di dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bsags pa'i sems can rnams kyi rna ba'i khung du thos shing grag par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bsags pa'i sems can rnams kyis nyan pa dang / 'dri 51geb dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa tsam yang nus par mi 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang sems can gang snying po 'di 'dzin pa nga yis 1 rjes su gzung khabar 'gyur zhing phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa 7yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /ngan 'gror skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dbul po dang / yid mi bde ba dang / lus kyi zug rngu 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs 96—302

su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /mkhas pa thams cad kyis 1)mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur ro/ /lha tshams cad dang / klu dang gnod sbyin rnams 'dus pas kyang 5)sngags 'di 'dzin pa'i yon tan dang phan yon rtogs par mi nus so/ /'on kyang nga ni de bzhin gshegs pa gcig pu dang / gzhan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis /yon tan dang /phan yon rgyas par mthar thug par labarjod par mi nus so/ /gzhan la gtam tsam yang mi grag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 5rnams dang /nyan thos rnams dang / de las gzhan pa'i rgya che ba'i lhas 'di'i yon tan ston pa dang / shes pa tsam yang mi nus so/ /mdor na ci 6ltar de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mthar 7thug pa dang ldan pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs kyis so/ / 'di dang na'adra ba'i sngags kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa snying po'i mchog go/ /gdug 9pa rnams la 1 gnod gnas kyis/ /phongs 11pa rnams ni gso bar byed/ /sems can rnams kyi 12gnas yin cing 1 / /'gro ba rnams ni yang dag srung / /dbang po kun shes go 'phang ldan/ /gnod gnas rgyal bar brjod pa'o/ /mdor na 'di las gzhan pa yi / /de bzhin gshegs pa tha dad pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan na 15med / /'di 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa la nye bar samachod pa'i gnas yongs su byas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rtag tu byin gyis brlabs 1 pa'o/ /pha rol du phyin pa'i stobs dang sa 'thob 1 par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ji 19ltar gnas pa'i 'khor rnams la gzigs nas/ gnod sbyin gyi dbang 96—303

po gnod gnas la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gnod gnas kyi dbang po khyod kyi rtog pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / sngags dang /gsang chen rnams sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang bstan pa yod de/rnam par gzigs dang / gtsug tor 14can dang / na'akhor ba 'jig dang / log par dad sel dang /da gser thub dang / 'od srung dang / da 4ltar shākya thub pa ngas kyang 5bshad desnyo/ de ni legs par nyon la legs par yid la zung 7shig /da 8ltar nga yis bshad kyis lha dang mi'i phan pa dang bde bas dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel ba'i don du nga yis yang dag par shes so/ /gang gi kau 9sha'i grong khyer du shing khur nas 'tshong ba de'i tshe/ der nga la dgon pa na sdod pa'i dge slong gcig k+ṇi bud shing gi don du nga la shing slong du 11'ongs te/ der ngas dgon par shing khyer nas lhanadage slong gi gan du phyin te/ me spar nas dge slong gi nad sos par byas te/ nyi ma gcig gi bsod snyoms kyang 1 drangs so/ /de nas dge slong de sems yongs su mgu 1 nas des nga la gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed nas dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang /sngags dang / gsang dba'i rtog pa nga la byin no/ /ngas kyang yang dag par bsgoms nas yod do/ /de'i tshe sngags kyi rgyal po nga la byin nas/ de ltar de nyid bsgoms pas/ tshe de nyid la laji ltar 1 'phags pa gnod gnas kyi dbang po mthong 18ba'i lam du gyur to/ /de nas de nga la yongs su mgu nas phyag rab tu grol ba zhes bya bar ming btags so/ /der yang nga rgyal por dbang bskur bas grong khyer gyi mi rnams chos dang ldan par byas nas/ de la nga rgyal por rab tu gnas pas ngas sems can thams cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la nges par 96—304

sbyar 1)ro/ /ji 2ltar don du gnyer ba rnams la skal dab dang ldan pa rnams la dus med par thams cad la nye bar phan pa rang carang gi khyim du rdzogs par byas so / /de la sogs pa 5ngas sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa yongs su rdzogs bzhin snyopas byang chub sems dpa'i sa la rab tu zhugs so/ / rim gyis 7ngas thams cad mkhyen pa yang dag par rdzogs so/ /dbul ba thams cad nyams par byed pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal nye bar gcod pa ngas yang dag par mngon par shes so/ /gang yang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes shin tu rtogs pa de rnams kyis kyang sngon du 8sngags kyi rgyal po 'di bsgrubs pas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bo/ /de'i phyir gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po khyod 9de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa bskyed pa1 /'dod don 11thams cad sgrub 12pa'i thabs/ /gang zhig mthong ba tsam gyis kyang //de ni skye ba gcig nas gcig /sngon du bsags pa'i las rnams kyang / /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /de bzhin skye ba 'di la rmongs/ /shin tu sdig pa mi bzad byas/ /gnod sbyin dbang po gzi brjid che/ /gang gis mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / /byang chub sems dpa' thob pa dang / /sangs rgyas dang ni yang dag 'phrad15/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa yang ni/ /yun mi ring bar 1 'thob pa'o15 / /mthong ba tsam gyis sa yon tan ni/ /nga yis bshad kyis khyod rang nyon//dbul ba dang ni yid mi bde/ /sems ni nad kyis gzir ba dang / /gdon dang byad dang 1 sgyur ba yis/ /de yis 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /lha dang klu dang dri za dang / /lha min 18dang ni 19mkha' lding sogs / /de las gzhan 96—305

yang yid mi bde/ /rtag pa nyid du srung ba'o/ /gnod sbyin de nyid mthong tsam gyis / /dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa/ /'dir ni yon tan de dzo1rnams 'byung / /bsgrubs par gyur (2na lta ci smos45)/ /gang zhig dad pas de bzhin rtogs/ /gus pas brtan gepas gzhan mi 'jug /'di la gus pas don du gnyer5/ /bslab pa sdom pa sogs pa yis/ /des na 'bad pas gu rigatsang sbra bya/ /yid las byung ri ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /shing gi 'bras bu sna tshogs bcas/ /pus nub tsam gyi rinas sbyangs la9/ /ba yi rnam lngas byug par bya/ /mnyam par brdung zhing bcag bepar bya/ /lag mthil lta bu'i mnyam pa la/ /khru tshad nyi shu tsam la ni/ /gnod sbyin dbang po mngon par bsngags11/ /me tog sna tshogs gcal 1 du bkram/ /a gar 1 bdug pas bdug pa dang / /nyi ma rlobazang po de bzhin gza'/ /de bzhin dus tshod bzang po la/ /dkar po'i phyogs la legs par dge/ /slob dpon legs par bsngogs gepa yis/ /ba yi rnam lngas legs par sbyang / /bdag nyid sngags bzlas 7rgyal po yis/ /snga dro dag par gyur pa yis/ /mnyam par gzhag pas bsrung 1 bar bya/ /steng dang 'og dang phyogs bcu ru/ /phyogs ni de bzhin bcing bar bya/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po dri yi chus/ /mkhas pas 1 brgya rtsa brgyad du bsngags19/ /ji ltar shar sogs mngon par gtor/ /phyogs bcing sngon rna gyi rim pa bzhin/ /gzhon nu ma yis bkal ba yi/ /tshon sna lnga yi 21skud pa la/ /gur gum chu yis byugs pa dang / /phur pa u dum shing la byas/ /shar gyi phyogs nas brtsam 2 par bya/ /thig gdab snga dro'i dus su'o/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /zur bzhi re'u na mig bzhi dang 2 ldan pa/ /de la dang 96—306

po'i dkyil du ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bri bar bya/ /rnam pa kun mchog ldan pa yi/ /thams cad mkhyen pa zla ba'i 'od/ /de 'og (1gnod sbyin dbang po ni/ /mtshan nyid thams cad mtshon pa yin/ /sngon po sprin lta bu yi tsho/snamadog /rgyan ser po yis mdzes pa dang / /rkang gdub lag gdub mgul rgyan dang / /rin chen sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa/ /seng ge'i gdan la rin chen dang / /sna tshogs tha dad rnam par brgyan/ /ri mo sna tshogs rin chen 'od / /'od 5'phro yid 'ong 56)'bar ba'i 'od/ / skyil krung mephyed pas bzhugs pa legs par mdzes /de nyid dbus su nor bu bzang po legs 8par bya/ /rab tu 'bad pas g.yas pa'i phyag /mchog sbyin sa bon yongs su bya/ /de bzhin du ni g.yon pa'i phyag /ne'u 59 le rin chen skyug 1 pa'o/ /sna tshogs gter rnams steng na 11legs par bzhugs / /de bzhin dung dang pad+ma yi12/ /rin chen char ni 'bebs pa'o/ /mnga' bdag g.yas dang g.yon du'o/ /nor bu bzang po de yi phyogs/ /gnod sbyin bzang po dngul 1rimadog can/ /mkhas pas ngasngar bzhin du ni dgod/ /spyod pa'i dbang po gdong dbang po/ /g.yas dang g.yon du bya ba'o12/ /rnam pa kha dog 'dra ba yi/ /gter gyi steng du yang dag bzhugs/ /de yi 'og tu gnod sbyin mo/ /bdun po dag ni bri bar bya/ /de las gzhan du bu dgu ste/ /de las gzhan ni chu skyes so/ /rin chen lte ba nor sbyin dang / /gnod mdzes dang ni gnod mdzes gzhan/ /lte mdzes dang ni lte chen po/ /mtshams su bum pa bzang po'o/ /'phar ba gnyis la dgod bya ba'i/ /gnod sbyin dbang po stobs po che/ /gnod gnas hu lu hu lu tshadang / /sde 1 mdzes dang ni zla ba'i sde / /rengs pa dang ni gdul 1 ba dang / /lce 19dmar dang ni gsus po che/ /96—307

snam bu gsum pa 1la bya ba/ /gnod sbyin mo ni lta (2)mdzes ma/ /rgya chen ma dang dri bral ma/ /zla mo blo gros snying po spyan/ /pad+ma'i snying po smin rimadzes ma/ /gnod sbyin lag pa lag mangs po/ /sprin chen ma 4skudang skra mdzes ma/ /gter gyi phreng ba g.yem pa mo/ /ljon shing phreng 55ba phreng ba mo/ /'dod pa kun gyi 'bras ster ma/ /yid shugs ma dang 'dod gzugs ma/ /thos ngag ma dang lha mdzes ma/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po rnam bshad pa/ /nyi shu mchog ni ster ba'o/ /ci lta'i 6rim pas rnam dgod pa / /ji ltar mdun dang phyogs gzhan 85dgod/ /dbang po la sogs dgod par 9bya/ /de rnams 1 phyi rol dra ba ste/ /rdo rje shag ti 1 dbyug pa dang / /ral gri zhags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /'khor lo rtse gsum mtshon cha rnams1 / /sngar bzhin du ni dgod par bya/ /steng 'og mda' yi dra ba dang / /de bzhin rdo rje 'bar ba'o/ /mkhas pas phyi rol du ni dgod/ /de nas spyan drang brtsam 1 par bya/ /tshon rtsi lnga ni dkar po dang / /ser po dmar po sngon po gnagaci /dbyangs kyi sngags kyis mngon lobasngags late/ /phyi rol rgyal mtshan brgyad dgod ’ bya/ /de bzhin phyogs rnams ar+gha'i 1 snod/ /chu ni me tog gis bkang bya19/ /spyan drang mchod sbyin yis ni bya/ /sngags pas bya bar the tshom 2 med/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams rang sngags kyis/ /mkhas pa yis ni spyan drang bya/ /lha dang lha min spyan drang bya/ /gnod gnas dbang po stobs po che / /ma li ka phreng shin tu dkar/ /pad+ma ut+pa la yi tshogs/ /nā 21ga ge sar ke su dang / /dri dang bdug pa sgron ma dang / /bshos gtsang gtor ma kun 'dod pa rna / /rim pa bzhin du mchod pa ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bya ba yin/ /ga bur dang ni gu gul lam ri/ /yang na tsan+dan dkar po yis/ /'bum phrag du ni sbyin 96—308

sreg 17bya/ /stong phrag brgya yi sbyin sreg nabya/ /nor bu bzang po'i mdun du'o/ /ji ltar rigs dpas bzlas pa dang / /sbyin sreg cho ga bzhin du'o/ /'bad pa yis ni mchod pa bya/ /mtshams su bum pa dgod pa ni/ /rin chen 'bru dang sman rnams ldan/ /dri yi chu yis yongs su dgang / /tsu ta pa la sa yis lagayogs / /mgrin pa ras kyis dkris pa dang / /de srid bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags / /rang rang gi ni sngags bzlas pa/ /de snyed 5bum pa dgod par bya/ /'di las phyi sngags rnams 'byung ba ni/ /oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra 7ya swā hā/ gtso bo'i ste 8las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /ma hā 9yak+ṣa rā 1 dzā 11ya/ bi na ma te 12ma ṇi 12bha dā r+shaya dhi 15ma he 7tasto yak+ṣa pra tsot+ta 1 ya dha bi 918/ gnod sbyin gyi dbyangs kyi sngags so/ /o yak+ṣa 19ya swā hā/ gnod sbyin gyi snying po'o/ /na spyan drang ba dang / gshegs su gsol ba dang / mchod pa dang / bum pa la 21mngon par bsngags 2 pa'i sngags te so sor sbyar bar bya'o/ /a nan+ta pad+mā 2 ya swā hā / pad+ma'i 2 gter gyi sngags so/ /a nan+ta 25so khā 3ya swā hā/ gter gyi dung gi sngags so/ / ra dza 2 ya na bha na ya dha na 29a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ dngul ri gyi mdog can gyi sngags so/ /tsa ren dā ya swā hā/ spyod pa'i dbang po'i sngags so / /mu khe na drwa /ya swā hā/ dbang po gdong gi sngags so/ /oṃ dha na dā ya ri swā hā/ gter sbyin gyi sngags so/ /ma ṇi na bhā 5ya dha na/ a dhi ri pa ta ye swā hā / rin chen lte ba'i sngags so/ /su ṇa gha ya dha na a dhi 2pa ta ye swā hā/lte mdzes kyi sngags so/ /oṃ sum̐ bha ṇa bhā 9ya dha na a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/gnod mdzes kyi lte ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a sum̐ bha ṇa bhā 1ya dha na a dhi 2pa ta ye swā hā/ gnod mdzes lte gzhan gyi sngags so/ /oṃ e dabha ṇa bhā ya dha na a dhi 596—309

pa ta ye swā hā/ chu'i lte ba can gyi sngags so/ /ni ṇa bhā (1)ya dha na a dhi ri pa ta ye swā hā/ lte sngon /rican gyi sngags so/ / bai shra ba ṇa 4༄ya /5stadha 96)na a dhi (77pa ta (8)ye swā hā/ rnam thos sras kyi sngags so/ /ma hā na bhā 9)ya dha na a rnyi ngopa ta ye swā hā/lte chen gyi sngags so/ /oṃ dzi bha drwa gha ṭā ya 11swā hā/ bum pa bzang po'i sngags so / /ha 15ra dzam bha ka 1 rtsu phaṭa swā hārme/ rmugs byed kyi sngags so/ /yak+ṣa yin dhā 15ya swā hā/ hu lu hu salu zhes bya ba'i sngags so/ / su se nā lte ya swā hā/sde mdzes kyi sngags so/ /ha ra ha ra tsan+d+ra 18se nā tsho19ya swā hā/ zla ba sde'i sngags so / /dzam bha lā rna ya swā hā/ gnod gnas kyi sngags so/ /mo 2)tā ri 2ya swā hā/'dul byed kyi sngags so/ /rā 2 ga dzi hā ya swā hā/ lce dmar po'i sngags so/ /ma ho da rā 25ya swā hā/ gsus po 7che'i sngags so/ /bi :ma le bi ma 38la dar+ṣa ( shweni a ya ti swā hā/ dri bral ma'i sngags so/ /bha sa la ṇa ya ṇi 1bo dhā 9 2ya swā hā/rgya nachen ma'i lasngags so/ /tsan+d+ra sasnyesu ma ti 7su ra pu dzi ti tsan+de tsan+de tsan+d+ra (rtem ti swā hā/ zla 'od blo gros ma'i sngags dang dgug gi pa'i spyan can ma'i'o/ /oṃ tsan+d+ra pa: 9su hā/ pad+ma'i snying po ma'i ji sngags so/ / su byu 1ma no ra bhe swā hā/ smin mdzes pa'i 2sngags so/ /oṃ ba hu dpra tā sdo riya swā hā/ lag pa dang lag mangs rima'i sngags so/ /li ti tsig ti mo ti swā hā/ sprin 8chen ma'i sngags so/ /su gi 9ma li ke sha 5 bha ri ṇi 51swā hā/ skra mdzes ma zhes bya ba'i sngags so/ /ba ga na mā gi la ba li ni swā hā/ nags kyi phreng ba ma zhes bya ba'i 54sngags so/ /u tiṣ+ṭharin lhun dza 56li swā hā/ g.yem pa 5 mo'i sngags so/ / dru mā rinali mā 59li ka li spyo ka ha li dru 61mi ki li ki ga li swā hā/ ljon ma phreng ba dzinama'i sngags so / /kā 4 ma mā zhal bi rnal si ni swā hā/ 'dod pa'i phreng ba ma'i sngags so/ /96—310

sarba dha (1)yi bha tshonasarba a gra ma no dza ba be nacig ba te (4༄swā hā/ /yid kyi shugs can ma'i sngags so/ /kā 5)ma bi ne༄kā 97mi ni swā hā/ 'dod pa'i gzugs can ma'i sngags so/ /shu na ta bā 9ke 7ka ri swā hā/ thos ngag ma'i sngags so/ /su da (nyunyer sa 12ni kā nyusnye'i lani swā hā/ lta skomadzes ma'i sngags so/ /ma ho 7ste bha ya ka ri tsho/ tshos hā/ rdzu 'phrul chen mo'i 18sngags so/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams kyi'o/ /in+d+ra nya/de bā dhi 2 7pa ta ye swā hā/ dbang po'i 2①snying po'o/ /asna ye lha ud byā dhi 2 pa ta 3 ye swā hā/ me lha'i snying po'o/ / ya mā 25 ya pre tā 2༷dhi pa ta ye 3 swā hā/gshin rje'i snying po'o/ / nai ṛ t+yā /ya rak+ṣa 9sna dhi pa ta lhaye swā hā/ bden bral gyi snying po'o/ / pa ru ḍā ya dza lā dhi gi pa ta ye ri swā hā/ chu bdag gi snying po'o / /bā geya be 5an+ta rik+ṣa a rnyi 7pa ta ye swā hā/ rlung lha'i snying po'o/ /ku be ra ri dha na a dhi 8pa 9ta ye swā hā/ lus ngan gyi snying po'o/ / yī sha nā 1ya bhū 82ta a dhi napa ta ye swā hā/ dbang ldan gyi snying po'o/ /ur dha 5brah+ma ne ༷swā hā / tshangs pa'i snying po'o/ /a ho biṇ+ḍa be swā hā/ khyab 'jug gi snying po'o//a bhi /bar 5 7ta kā ri ya swā hā/ rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /hu ta sa nā ri ya swā hā/shag ri ti'i 8 skusnying po'o/ /ma hā su mā 55ya swā hā/ dbyug pa'i snying po'o/ /khan 57bi 5 ma la bha ri ṇi rinaswā hā/ ral gri'i 59snying po'o/ /pa ru ṇa ta mā dhi gyi tshopa ta ye swā hā/ zhags pa'i snying po'o/ /pra bhañdza nā ya 61swā hā/ rgyal mtshan gyi snying po'o/ /ma hā su mya rasma ye swā hā/ 'khor lo'i snying po'o/ /bha la pi hu le 62swā hā/ rtse gsum pa'i snying po'o/ /bhi la sha bhi hu le chu swā hā/ phyogs kyi sngags so / /sha re dzā la snyo swā hā/ mda'i dra ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ur 5lha dzā sprol badz+ra pañtsa rā snyo ya swā hā/ rdo rje dra ba'i sngags so/ /'di rnams 6 rang rang gi ni 6996—311

sngags / /mkhas pas bum pa la bzlas 1bya/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor du yang gzhug /dbang bskur ba ni narab tu dbartag /rgyal po dbang bskur bar ni mdzod / /skye ba ragang rnams dngos grub 'dod/ /de rnams dbang bskur don du bya/ /brgyan pa'i don du rab tu 'bad/ /'di 6ltar dkyil 'khor chen por bstan pa'i cho ga bzhin dbang bskur ba dang / dam tshig bstan pa dang /rjes su gnang bas 7phyag rgya chen po'i skal 8ba can du shes par bya'o/ /rang rang gi sngags 9dang phyag rgyas dbang bskur la/ yang mchod pa rgya chen po dang /sbyin sreg byas la bsdu ba dang gshegs su gsol bar 1 bya'o/ /de ltar gnod gnas kyi 11bdag po'i dam tshig bstan pa dang / rang gi sngags sgrub pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ro12/ / des na 1 nyin re bzhin du dus gsum du/ sngags dang phyag rgyas 1 bdag bsrung 15ba byas la/ 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te zhabs bsil ba 1spyodang / mchod yon la sogs pa phul nas/ nye bar spyod pa'i mchod pa nyi shu sngags dang phyag rgyas phul la cho ga ci 1 ltar tshogs pa'i mchod pa byas nas sngon du bsnyen par 1 bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya dang sngags kyi tshogs nga yis rgyas par bshad par bya ste/ de nas yang gnod sbyin gyi dbang pos gus pa nye bar skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab po/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 19'khor rnams la gzigs nas seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas 'di skad ces 2 bka' stsal pa na/ khyod 2 rnams nyon cig 'da' 2 dka' 5ba 'di bstan pa snying rje chen po'i bdag nyid sems 20can rnams la phan pa dang bde ba dang ldan pa/ gnod gnas kyi dbang po'i phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid sngags dang ldan pa/ de nas gnod gnas kyi 2 dbang pos thal mo sbyar te/ pus mo sa 96—312

la bzhag ste phyag byas nas cang 1 mi smra bar sdod (2do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das seng ge bzhin 'jigs pa med pas sngags dang phyag rgya 'di gsungs pa/lag pa gnyis thal mo mnyam par sbyar nas/ gung mo gnyis phyir bzlog ming med kyi rtse mo gnyis la 4sbyar la/ mdzub 5mo gnyis tshigs gsum pa bcag 6nas der bzhag 7ste/ mthe bong phyogs su bzhagan / mthe'u chung 9gnyis khab kyi rnam pa ltar byas pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /'di bcings pa tsam gyis gnod gnas kyi 1 dbang po nye bar gnas par gyur nas sgrub pa po la lta 11zhing mchog ster bar 'gyur ro1 / /'di'i sngags ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha dā 1 ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ o dzam bha la dza len dā 1 ya swā hā/ sngags 'di dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya yis gnas rnam pa lngar sbyar bas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /gnod gnas dang so sor mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /lag saganyis khu tshur bcangs 1 tshonas mthe'u chung gnyis khab kyi rnam pa ltar byas pa ni spyod pa'i dbang po'i phyag rgya ste/ bdag bsrung 1 ba la nges par sbyar 1 bar ro19/ /'di'i sngags ni/ o tsa ren dā ya swā hā/ de ltar khu tshur byas te mthe'u 21chung gnyis nang du bcug nas srin lag gnyis khab kyi rnam pa ltar byas pa ni dbang po gdong gi phyag rgya ste/ bdag bsrung 2 ba la 2 nges pa ste / 'di'i sngags ni/ o mu khen dā 25ya swā hā/ dbang po gdong gi phyag rgya las ming med kyi tshigs gsum pa bcag pa ni gnod sbyin mo rnams kyi spyi'i phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/ o a ni/ 'dis kyang bdag bsrung bar 0bya'o/ /spyan 'dren pa'i dus su yang 2 gnod sbyin mo rnams spyan drang bar bya'o/ /steng dang 'og dang phyogs bcu ru ra ba dang dra ba dang phur bu ste / lag pa gnyis khu 2996—313

tshur byas la mdzub 1mo gnyis so sor khab kyi rtse mo ltar byas pa 'di ni dra ba'i phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/ o tsa ren dra ban dha di rdo sha phaṭa/ ra ba dang nges par sbyar bar ro / /de nyid las mdzub 4)mo gnyis khab kyi rnam pa 55ltar gcig tu byas pa ni dra ba'i phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/4ri ma mu khe na dru (7)ya swā hā/ dra ba'i don du nges par sbyar bar 98)ro/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur byas nas 'og tu bzhag 9pa ni phur pa'i 7phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ hri hu ta ta / spyan drang bar bya ba ni rtsa ba'i phyag rgya las mthe'u cung zad / dgug pa ni spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/ e 1 bye tsu lu tsu lubo/ twa ra twa ra / dzā tshal sa ya rna 7khri 1 yā 1 ya swā hā/ rim pa 'dis 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang bar bya'o/ /de nas ar+gha 19sbyin par bya'o/ /lag pa gnyis brtan dzo ri tshopa'i thal mo sbyar nas mdzub mo lhamathe bo'i 22ngos la sbyar te/ 'di'i sngags ni/oṃ yak+ṣa nā dha ya ken dha rin pri 2 skuya pa na sha pa sa sha swā hā/ de nas gdan dbul bar bya ste/ phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo sbyar te/ mdzub mo gsum pa mnyam par byas nas tshigs gsum par bcag na ste/ dbu mar 29sbyar nas gzhan so sor byas pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi seng ge'i gdan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /'di bstan zhu snapa tsam gyis gnod sbyin gyi dbang 1po 'khor dang bcas pa sa seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs par 'gyur ro/ /seṅge'i gdan gyi phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ rdza bha la dza len dra na.in+d+ra ya sa ma kai 5swā hā/ de nas khrus kyi phyag rgya bcings nas gnod gnas 'khor dang bcas pa khrus gsol bar bya/ lag pa gnyis yang rten gyis ri thal mo byas mthe'u chung gnyis phyin ci log tu byas la ming med gnyis dkyil du byas pa/ gung mo gnyis khab kyi rnam pa ltar byas/ de'i phyi 96—314

rol du gung mo'i tshigs gsum sbyar bar mthe bo 1gnyis phyogs su bzhag tshonapa ni/lha thams cad kyi khrus kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ nā nā pri /ya gha ta ri kum bha dz+wa la 95swā hā/ gos kyi phyag rgya bcings nas gos dbul bar bya ste yang lag pa gnyis mthe bong dang mdzub 6mo gnyis lu gu rgyud kyi rnam pa ltar byas te/sor mo phyi ma rnams brkyang ba 'di ni gos kyi phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/ o rnyi ri dhi ri ma hā sa mu dra 7o dha nar dha ka swā hā/ rgyan 9gyi phyag rgya nye bar bya sterku / lag pa gnyis sor mo gsum gyis 11mthe bong bkab nas sdigs mdzub nyina'akhyil ba'i tshul du byas nas phan tshun steng du bskor nas/ gcig tu byas pa 'di ni rgyan gyi phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ mi me gha bha ra ṇa 1 dzā 15la bu gha san swā hā/ yang dag par skyong 1 tshonul bya ba'i phyag rgya ni/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs nas/ lag pa g.yon pa nor bu 'ching ba'i mtshams su lag 18gdub 1)ltar bzung ba ni skyong 2 nul bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ ha ra ha ra dzo gh+ra ṇa lhaya swā hā/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya nges par bstan par bya ste/ de nyid las sor mo rnams so sor brkyang nas kha 'og tu dbub pa ni/ dkyil 'khor nye bar byug pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni/oṃ ku ti dzu ga bha ra ta pri yā ya swā hā/ rdul tshon gyi phreng ba'i phyag rgya nye bar bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya las sor mo lnga lharnams kha 'og 2 tu byas nas bzhag 25pa ni/ rdul tshon gyi phreng ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni/ he he phe na bha li pri dgaya so bha nā 27ya swā hā/ dri'i phyag rgya nye bar bstan pa ni/lag pa gnyis rten 2 pa'i thal mo sbyar la mthe'u na chung khab kyi rnam pa ltar byas nas / ming med dang / gung mo dang mdzub mo rnams nang du bkug ri pa ni/96—315

dri'i phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni/ o la lā gā la gā la su gan dha gan dhā 51ya swā hā/ de nas me tog gi phyag rgya nye bar bstan pa ni/ dri'i phyag rgya las mthe bong drang por gyen du 'greng 2ba ni me tog gi phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni/o put+pa dpra bha ha car put+pa 5me gha swā hā/ bdug spos kyi phyag rgya ni me tog gi phyag rgya las tshigs gsum pa cung zad bkug par bya ba ni bdug spos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni/ /oṃ ru ru ma hā dhū 6pa pri 7lnga 8ya swā hā/ gtor ma'i phyag rgya nye bar bstan pa ni/ bdug blospos kyi phyag rgya las sor mo thams cad longs spyod pa'i rnam par bkod 1 nas mthe'u 11chung gnyis nang du byas pa ni gtor ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni/ o sa ka sa ka bha ri la dza na gi 12pa ka pa le ta 15yak+ṣa de 7nyi de 15nyi swā hā/ me mar gyi phyag rgya nye bar bstan lapa ni/ gtor ma'i phyag rgya las sor mo thams cad khu tshur byas la mthe'u chung gnyis dang mthe bong gnyis khab kyi rnam pa 1 ltar byas pa ni me mar gyi phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni / oṃ phu ru 1 phu ru pra ka sā 19ya swā hā/ dri'i phyag rgya nye bar bstan 2 pa ni/lag pa g.yas pa khong stong la thur du byas pa ni dri'i phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/o ki ni ki ni gan dha kur+ṇa kur+ṇa gho shaṃ me tri mu 1swā hā/ gdugs kyi phyag rgya nye bar bstan 2 pa ni/ yang lag pa gnyis phan tshun du mngon par phyogs nas gcig tu sbyar zhing nang du zhum nas mthe bong phyogs su bzhag pa ni gdugs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ groṇ+ḍa tsha 2 pra ti yats+tsha ṭ+wāṃ ka rak+ṣa 2 ka swā hā/rnga yab kyi phyag rgya nye bar bstan pa ni/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u 25chung gi sen mo mnan nas sor mo lhag ma rdo rje ltar mtshon pas phyogs gnyi ga 27bskor ba ni rnga yab kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ tsa ma ra tsa dzom ka 96wa 316

ra pri 91)ya ke 2chikhu ṭu swā hā/ rlung yab kyi phyag rgya nye bar bstan pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos nasamathe'u 4)chung gi sen mo bkab 5nas sor mo lhag ma rnams brkyang 6ste rdo rje ltar mtshon nas yongs su bskor ba ni rlung yab kyi phyag rgya ste /'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ bhe raṃ /bha bha yu dha kā 9ya swā hā/ rgyal mtshan gyi phyag rgya nye bar bstan pa ni/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong gis ming med dang mthe'u 1 chung gi sen mo mnan 11nas mdzub dang 12gung mo gnyis gcig gi rnam pa ltar byas nas 'og tu bskyod pa ni rgyal mtshan gyi phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ tu sha tu sha 1lhaka la sa ha 'dza pri 15lnga ya swā hā/ gdan gyi phyag rgya nye bar bstan pa ni/yang lag pa gnyis kyi ming med dang mthe'u 7chung rim gyis mnan 1 nas gung mo dang sdigs mdzub 18gnyis khab kyi rnam pa ltar byas la steng du bskyod pa ni gdan gyi phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i sngags ni/ dzā la dzā 19ma tu ru khe dza yan ti 21sri 22yā na ya swā hā/ gdan gyi sngags so/ /'di rnams ni gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i nye bar mchod pa nyi shu'o/ /sngar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yid las byung ba'i mchod pa mthong ba dang thos pas rang bzhin gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod pa 'di thams cad dbul 2 bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid dbul 25ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba gdab pa dang /bstod pas mnyes par bya ba dang / gleng gzhi 27dang / ched du brjod pa'i mdo la sogs pa gdon pa dang / mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gdon pa dang /mchod sbyin gyi 29tshigs su bcad pas bskul ba dang / rtag tu chu sbyin pa dang /lha thams cad la gtor ma sbyin pa dang / 'di rnams thams cad byas la/ bo 96—317

de tse 1sngags kyi skud pa yongs su bzung la gnod gnas dang 'dra bar rang bsgoms pa'i2/ oṃ yig spyi bor )dgod par bya/ /rdza 4yig kha ru nges par dgod / /bha yig lag pa g.yas par dgod/ /lā yig g.yon par dgod par bya / /dza 5yig snying gar 6dgod pa'o/ /brla ni g.yas dang g.yon pa la/ /len dra 7nges par nadagod par bya/ /ye 95yig mtshan mar dgod par bya/ /de nas blo dang ldan pa yis/ /rkang pa'i mthil du swā hā dgod/ /'di rnams gnod sbyin dbang po rgyal/ /gsang ba'i snying po ⑩rab tu grags/ /'di rnams gang shes blo ldan yin/ /de yis dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji ltar nus par 1 bzlas pa bya/ /bdag nyid bsrung 12ba byas nas ni/ /sems can rnams la bsod nams gang / /mnyam par gzhag pas dbul bar bya/ /ji ltar 'dod pas blangs nas ni/ /de nas gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /sngar gyi spyan drang phyag rgya las/ / mtheb mo brkyang 12bas bskyod pa'o/ /sngags dang ldan mupas gshegs su gsol/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ḍi ḍi tshekyi po tā te pā 1 ga ta adz+ra gats+tsha gats+tsha 1 swā hā/ rim pa 'di yis sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum byas la phyi nas ji ltar 'dod pa bsgrub 1 par bya'o/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ji srid rim pa 'di yis sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung 2 chen por 'gyur ro 1/ /bcom ldan 'das shin tu ngo mtshar ro na/ /bde bar gshegs pa shin tu ngo mtshar ro snye sems can thams cad khyad par spro ba dang / don thams cad sgrub pa dang / snying rje chen po'i bdag nyid can sems can gang gis gnod 2 gnas kyi dbang po'i rtog pa mnyan 25'dod pa'i don 25ma lus pa na sgrub 28pa 9/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad 96—318

du gsol/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 1thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor la gzigs nas/ gnod gnas kyi rtog pa 'di gsungs pa/ sngar brjod pa'i cho gas sngon du bsnyen napa byas la/ de nas yang gnod gnas kyi dbang po la dri dang me tog gi mchod pa byas na/ rgya mtsho'i chur zhugs ril stong phrag bcu bzlas pa byas na sngon du bsnyen par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yar ngo'i tshes chogacig la rgya ga rimatshor 'bab pa'i chu bo'i 6'gram du phyin nas rked pa nub pa 7tsam du chur zhugs te/ nyin mtshan gcig tu smyung ba la 8gnas nas/ khyor ba 'bum gyi chu sbyin sreg byas na 9gser srang stong rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /sbyor ba 'di nyid kyis pus mo nub tsam du chu'i nang du zhugs nas 1 stong phrag bcu'i sbyin sreg byas na grong bcu'am gser srang stong rab tu ster 11bar 'gyur ro/ /chu bo de nyid la rked pa nub tsam du 12chur zhugs nas pad+ma la zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsi 1 sbags nas stong phrag bcu sbyin sreg byas na gter 7gyi bum pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /yang sbyor ba de nyid kyis zar ma'i me tog stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg byas na rgyal po 1lhadabang du 'gyur ro/ /mya ngan med kyi 7yam zheng la me sbar te/ a pa marga'i 1 tshoste 1snyem 19la mar dang sbrang rtsis 2 sbags nas sbyin sreg stong phrag bcu 21byas na 'khor los sgyur 22ba'i rgyal po dbang du 'gyur ro/ /a pa marga'i yam shing gis me rab tu sbar la ri/ a pa marga'i 2 sa bon zho dang mar dang / sbrang rtsis byugs la ming med dang mtheb mos bzung nas garang gi khyim du gter mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas nyin re bzhin til gyi me tog zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags nas/ dus gsum du stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg 27byas na gang 2 don du gnyer ba de thob 28par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma gcig gis 'khor nyis brgya dang 96wa 319

bcas pa 1ma bslangs 2par bza' ba dang bca' ba yang 5rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /mya ngan med kyi came tog la zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs te dus gsum du stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg 5byas na gang gsol ba btab pa de 'thob 6par 'gyur ro / /mya ngan med kyi me tog dang / a pa marga'i sa bon bsregs 7la zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs la stong phrag bcu sbyin sreg byas na rgyal po'i bu mo dbang du 'gyur ro/ /ming bzung nanas sbyin sreg de nyid stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg byas na rgyal po'i bu de nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /me tog dmar po ma nyams pa yongs su bzung nas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor phyin la rked pa nub tsam du chur zhugs nas stong phrag bcur 9sbyin sreg byas na gang me tog de'i dri tshor ba dang /reg pa dang 1 de rnams 1 thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /cho ga de nyid kyis gnod sbyin mo rnams 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ /yang na 12chu de nyid la a pa marga'i shing gis 1 sbyin sreg stong byas na nyi mas mchog ster bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar man dā char ba'i me tog gis sbyin sreg byas na brgya byin gyis mchog ster bar 'gyur ro/ /til gyi me tog gis ni tshangs pas mchog ster bar 'gyur ro/ / be ta la'i 15me tog gis ni nor lhas mchog ster bar 'gyur ro/ /sngags de nyid zlos bzhin pas mthe'u chung dang mtheb mo laganyis kyis 1 gzugs brnyan de nyid btsir 18nas ji srid sngags stong phrag bcu bzlas pa de srid gang 'dod pa de rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dngos grub thams cad ster 19bar 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag bzlas pas rgyal po 'gugs rna par 'gyur ro/ / 'bum tsho gnyis bzlas te gnod sbyin mo rang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'bum tsho gsum bzlas pas sems can thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ / 1yang na dka' 22bas zla ba drug tu mi smra 96—320

bar bzlas la (1yid la gang 'dod nade rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i 5)arga'i rang bzhin gyi shing la gzugs brnyan byas la ma bcos pa'i kha dog gi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa de nyid kyi 4mdun dug/ zla ba drug tu mi smra bar bzlas na 6lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du sngags khri mngon par bzlas la / gter gang na yod pa'i sar phyin nas 8steng du lag pa bzhag ste9/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na gter thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes lnga la mya ngan med kyi rtsa nas 1 gnas pas nyin mtshan du gso sbyong gis gnas shing /nyin mtshan bar 11chod kyi zas za bas nyi shu rtsa gcig tu sbyin sreg byas na dgos pa thams cad sgrub par nus so/ /rgya skyegs 1 kyi khu ba dang zho bsres nas sreg blugs 1 stong byas na gser srang stong ster bar 'gyur ro/ /a pa marga'i yam shing zho dang / mar dang sbrang rtsis mngon par sbags nas nyin mtshan du smyung bar gnas pas stong phrag brgyad du 1 sbyin sreg 15byas pas shin tu shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang tshigs bcad sastong yang 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /arga'i rtsa ba la cho ga 'dis sor mo drug pa'i gzugs brnyan cod 1 pan dang thor tshugs ldan par byas la de'i mdun du 1 a pa marga'i yam shing la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drwa ya/19 ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ so ma ma 2 so bid kri 21khyi na ya mi ri ti ma ni na ri ti swā hā/ sngags 'dis sbyin sreg stong byas na dong tse brgya 5rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gnod gnas kyi snying pos 2snyomachog rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /'di nyid kyis 2 gnas pas pus mo nub tsam du chur zhugs nas 'bum phrag drug bzlas na nor rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /nim pa'i shing gi rang bzhin la chu zheng du sor bzhi mnyam pa'i nor bu bzang po 8byas la gso sbyong dang ldan pa'i ri mo 96—321

mkhan gyis bris la nye bar mchod pa dang / gtor ma byin nas du ba med pa'i me la dus gsum du de'i mdun du rgya skyegs 1 kyi sreg blugs na stong phrag brgyad du snyesbyin sreg byas na phyug po rnams dbang du 'gyur ro/ /legs par yan lag ster ba dang / /rmad gyur cachen po'i brtson 'grus dang / /ltos pa med pa'i snying rje dang / /yang dag ci 5bzhin ston pa dang / /rdzu 'phrul gyis 6'gro gtso bo tsho dang / /thams cad du ni skyon med pa/ /sdug bsngal ba ni nyon mongs nyams/ /dzam bha la yi sgom pa po/ /de nas yang gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i snying po rgyas par bshad pa ni mchog gi dngos grub dang / bskul ba'i yi ge dang yang dag par ldan pa 'di/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha dā 85ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 9pa ta ye/ sa ma ya ma nu 7 sma ra / ma ṇi 12bha drwa 1 ya/ bha ga bī teng/dza 'itsit+ta da rtas/ dha ma dha 1 ma/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ma ri tsi 1 ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 10pa ta ye/ tu lu tu lu ma ṇi 2 bha dra21/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi 22bha dran / tu ṭi tu ṭi ma ṇi 2 bha dra 5/ ti ṭi 27ti ṭi ma ṇi bha dra da swā hā/ tshes grangs med cing rgyu skar med / /smyung ba'i cho ga yod ma yin/ /arga 'am na nim pa'i shing / gzhan ma 29rnams la nor bu bzang po'i gzugs byas te/ de'i mdun du 'dug la nyi ma phyed kyi dus su dri dang me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa byas nas yungs kur dkar po tsha ba'i mar nag dang btags pa'i ril bu 1byas la nanor bu bzang po'i ltor bcug nas rig pa stong phrag brgyad bzlas na dong tse dbargya rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de nyid du zad par bya'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rtog pa gsungs pa/ gang gis lo ma btsos 55pa za ba dang /bsod snyoms kyis 'tsho zhing 'bum phrag gsum bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas de 96—322

bzhin gshegs pa'i mdun du rgya che ba'i mchod pa byas nas stong phrag brgyad du bzlas pa byas na nor mang po rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba drug tu chu nang du 1chu'i sbyin sreg byas na stong phrag brgya rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin dkar gsum gyi gtor ma dang 2mchod pa phul la/ a shwat+tha'i yam shing zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags canas stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg 5byas na bar snang las sgra thos pa'am ri/ yid la 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'bras bu 'grub pa dang / sems kyis byas pas tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du las tshogs gzhan yang 7'grub ste/ ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la/'bum phrag gcig bzlas nas/ dkar po dang nag po'i /phyogs la bsod snyoms za zhing re mos kyis smyosmyung 1 bar gnas nas gtor ma dang mchod pa cho ga bzhin byin nas til nag mang 11po la zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsis 1 sbags la stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg byas na grong gi 1 mchog bcu gnyis rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /bag med pas salas ma grub na stong phrag bcu'i nang nas grong gcig rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /chu bo'i 'gram du nor bu bzang po bzhag nas mar dang 'o thug za zhing mchod rten gdung dang ldan pa la 'bum phrag gcig bzlas nas/ gnam stong la mtshan mo smyung 15bar gnas pas/ dzā sati'i me tog la stong phrag brgyad du re re la mngon par bsngags 1 nas mchod rten la phul na nang par phyugs stong phrag ster 18bar 'gyur ro/ /bsod snyoms za zhing rigs gtsang ma la dus gsum du khrus byed cing 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas nas/ nag po'i 19phyogs kyi brgyad la mtshan mo smyung bar gnas la 'dzam bu'i yam shing la me sbar la/ na 2 ga pus 21pa zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags nas stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg 2 byas pa 96—323

dang / mngar 1gsum gyi bshos gtsang ma dang gtor ma byin nas sbyin sreg 2yongs su rdzogs pa dang / bram ze'i gzugs kyis 'ongs nas nga yis ci byed ces smra bar byed do/ /de la smra ba dong tse snalnga byin cig ces smras pa dang / de ltar bya'o zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur te nyin re bzhin du ster 4bar 'gyur ro//lhag ma 5med par zad par bya'o/ /pad+ma skyes pa snyomatsho'i 'gram du phyin te chu dang bcas pa'i phye za ba'am/ yang ci 7ltar rnyed pa'i zas za zhing nor bu bzang po 8kha phyir 9bstan par bzhag la gsol ba btab nas1 / ji srid du stong phrag brgya rdzogs par pad+ma'i 11sbyin sreg byas na/ de'i rting 12la dpal mo 1ri'ongs te 'ongs pa 1 de la pad+ma 15nye bar phul nas dri dang bcas pa'i chu'i arga 10byin na/ des smras pa bu gcig ci 1 bya zhes smras na/ sgrub pa pos smra bar bya ste/gter mang po bdag la rab tu stsol cig /de ltar bya'o zhes zer 18nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gang du 'gro ba der khyer nas byin 19pa de zad pa med par 'gyur ro/ /nor bu bzang po'i mdun du zla ba phyed du na bzlas nas ci 1srid zla ba nya'i nub mo smyung bar gnas pas/ sha med pa'i gtor ma byin nas/de nas nor bu bzang po'i snying gar 2 ming med bzhag nas ci srid du bzlas pa de srid du g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas nyin re bzhin du dong tse 2 lnga lnga 2 ster bar 'gyur ro/ /lhag 25med par zad par bya'o/ /dur khrod chen por phyin nas dur khrod kyi thal ba la mchod rten byas te/ bsod snyoms za zhing dus gsum du khrus byas nas 'bum phrag gsum du 27bzlas la / nag po'i phyogs kyi bcu bzhi la mtshan mo smyung bar gnas pas/ bcom ldan 'das la rgya che ba'i mchod pa byas nas lhag ma med par rab tu zad 9par bya'o/ /dur khrod chen por nor bu 96wa 324

bzang po la sha ta put+pa 1phul lan/ a ka ru dang du ruska 4bsres pa'i bdug pa phul te/ gdong phyin ci log tu bzhag nas ci 5srid mtshan phyed pa de srid du bzlas so/ /de nas sha za'i bdag po rang 'ongs pa dang sngar bzhag pa'i gtor ma phul la/ 'khor rnams la chang 6yang dbul/ de nas sgrub pa pos gsol ba btab 7par bya'o/ /de nas de nga namagu'o zhes smra'o/ /sgrub pa 9pos smras pa/nyi ma re re g.yog re re byin cig /de ltar bya'o zhes zer nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro1 / /de nas mngag gzhug pa la sogs pa 11rab tu sbyin to1 / /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pas 1 las kyi tshogs bya ba gsungs pa/ ri'i rtse mor 'dzegs te khru gang tsam gyi nor bu bzang po bzhag nas 'o ma dang 'o thug za zhing dus gsum du khrus byed cing 'bum phrag gsum du bzlas nas/ de nas dkar po'i 1 phyogs kyi nya la thug pa'i mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas nas/ nor bu bzang po la rgya che ba'i mchod pa byas pa dang / gtor ma'i cho ga rgya che ba byas nas ku sha'i chun po 15dag byed lonas/ ci 1 srid sgra grag 1 pa de srid du bzlas pa bya'o / /de nas de ma thag tu gnod sbyin thams cad nye bar 'ongs nas/ de rnams la me tog dmar po dang / dri dmar po dang / arga sbyin par bya'o/ /du ru ska'i 19bdug pa yang 0bdug par bya'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin des legs so zhes bya ba byin nas smras pa/ ngas khyod la ci byed ces 1zer ba dang / de nas de la smras pa dang / nyin re bzhin mngag gzhug 22rab tu byin cig /de ltar bya'o zhes zer nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de la sogs pa bsam gtan tsam gyis gnas pa la ma mthong bar 'khor gyis bskor nas gnas so/ /gang dang gang na'adod pa de dang 2 der khang pa brtsegs pa dang / lha'i bzhon 25pa sprul te 96—325

stong phrag gcig dang bcas pa la rab tu 'dod pa la rab tu 'dod 1pa'i zas rnams ster bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin re bzhin du gnod sbyin mor sprul zhing 'ongs nas tho rangs 2kyi dus su 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nyid kyi tshe lo stong du 'gyur ro / /rgya mtsho'i 'gram du nor bu bzang po'i gzugs brnyan bzhag ste/ bsod snyoms za zhing 'bum phrag gsum bzlas nas dkar po 45phyogs kyi tshes lnga la thug par nub gsum du smyung bar gnas pas rgya mtsho chen po dang nye bar phyin nas/ji 5srid rgya mtsho chen po rang 'ong ba de srid kyi bar du bzlas par 6bya'o/ /mdun du rgya mtsho chen po rang 'ongs pa 7de la dri dang me tog gi namachod pa phul la9 / a ka 1 ru'i bdug pas bdugs la/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa mchog gang khyod la 11rab tu sbyin pa 1 smra'o/ /des smras pa/ rgya mtsho chen po ru 1 nga thogs pa med pa 1 'gro bar gyis/ de ltar bya zhes lozer ba tshanas mi snang bar 'gyur ro / /de nas rgya mtsho la zhugs nas1 / rgya mtsho na yod pa'i nor bu rin po che blangs nas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtsho na yod pa'i klu rnams kyang dbang du 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas yang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po / shedabyangs snyan gyi sngags gsungs pa/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drwa ya19 / ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 2 pa ta ye/ ma ṇi 21ni swā hā/ rtsa ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi brgyad dam/ yang na dkar po'i bcu bzhi la nyin zhag gcig 25smyung bar gnas pas/ ro hi ta'i nya la ba'i lci ba dang / mar gyis byugs nas stong phrag brgyad du 2 sbyin sreg byas na dong tse 25brgya rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang nye bar mchod pa dang / sngon du 'bum tsho 2tshogasum bzlas nas / nya ma god pa 96—326

la zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsis mngon par byugs nas 15stong phrag bcu sbyin sreg byas na dong tse na stong phrag rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /ma grub na yang kār ṣā pa ṇa stong phrag gcig 5rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ 'dzam bha la dza len dru ya 7snya hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /8de nas yang nor bu bzang po bsgrub par 'dod na mchod sbyin gyi shing dkar po la nor bu bzang po'i gzugs brnyan byas la/ mchod pa chen po 9rab tu gnas pa 7byas nas11/ de'i mdun du yang 12a pa marga'i yam shing la mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs la 'bum phrag tu sbyin sreg 1 byas na 'dod pa'i 'bras bu rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /be ta la'i me tog rnams kyis 'bum phrag tu 1 sbyin sreg dbyas na/ gser srang stong rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /til dang 'bras thug po che'i sbyin sreg 'bum byas na gser srang stong rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sha ta put+pa lodang gu gul dang / ku na da 1 dang / tsan+dan dkar po dang /du ru ska 18la sogs pa de rnams re re 'bum du sbyin sreg 19byas na dong tse stong phrag rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /til dang 'bras kyi sbyin sreg byas na rgyal po dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nye'u ci 21ltar 'tshong ba nyos la/ chu bo'i rgyun la lte ba nub tsam du chu'i nang du zhugs nas kha shar du bltas te sbyin sreg da brgya byas na sum 'gyur gyi dong tse 2 rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /ras bal gyi sa bon la mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs nas stong phrag gcig 25sbyin sreg 27byas na nyi ma bdun gyi bar la ras gcig rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas na gos dang bza' ba rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /'bum du 2 bzlas na dong tse 2 lnga stong rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /'bum tsho gnyis bzlas na grong rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /'bum tsho gsum bzlas na longs spyod chen po rnyed par 'gyur zhing grong brgyad kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ / be'u'i 96—327

lci 1ba la sbyin sreg 2stong byas na ba lang 3stong rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dud 'gro rnams kyi lus la zho dang sbrang rtsi 5spags la nyin re bzhin sbyin sreg byas na ra lug la sogs pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /ba lang 6gi lhas kyi nang du ku sha'i me tog mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs nas 'bum tsho gcig 7sbyin sreg 8byas na 'byung po dang / sha za dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar 'dod pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /yang ba lang 9gi lhas kyi nang du 'o ma dang 'o thug za zhing / shri ri pa 1 la'i yam shing la sbyin sreg 'bum byas na gang 'dod pa'i don 11gsol ba btab pa de rnyed 12par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas la zla ba'am/ nyi ma gzas bzung 1 ba la ldong ros dang gi wang 1 srang lngas a shwat+tha'i 15'dab ma bzhi la g.yas skor g.yon skor 7du bzhag 1 nas/ yang 'dab ma bzhis g.yogs la ji srid dro bar gyur pa de srid du bzlas pa bya'o/ /du ba dang 'bar bas 'di ltar sa bla sa 'og sa stengs 1 gsum 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ba lang 19gi lhas kyi nang ngam 2 chu bo 'dus par/ bsod snyoms za ba'am 'o thug za bas/ arga'i 'o thug mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs nas stong tsho lnga sbyin sreg 21byas na rang nyid kyis 22nor gyi bdag po nor bu bzang po nor gyi bdag po nor dang bcas 2 pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /nga mgu'o zhes de smra na/ mchog brgyad gang 'dod pa ster bar 'gyur te /rgyal po dang / gter dang / rdzu 'phrul gyis 'chag pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa dang / thams cad dbang du byed pa dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / grul bum dang / lus srul po rnams thams cad 25dbang du 'gyur ro/ /dran pa tsam gyis mdun du 'dug 96wa 328

par 'gyur ro/ /rkang bzhi pa la sogs pa'i sems can shi ba 1rab tu zhi bar byed pa dang / sa 'og tu 'jug pa dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / sa 'og gi 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'jig pa dang / chu rengs pa dang / bcud len dang / tshar bcad pa dang / rjes su gzung rab brgyad po 'di rnams las 3de'i mdun du gang na gang 4gcig blang bar bya'o/ /des gang ci 'dod pa de ster bar 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs nas 'bum du sbyin sreg 5byas na/ pad+ma rā 6ga'i 7nor bu rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ut+pa la sngon po dang / ku mu da 8rnams 9dri zhim po dang ldan pas kha dog sna tshogs pa'i nor bu 1 rin po che rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /yungs kur 11dkar po mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs la gang gi ming nas bzung 12nas sbyin sreg byas na mtshan mo bdun gyis dbang du 'gyur ro/ /til nag po la mar dang sbrang rtsis sasbags la 'bum du sbyin sreg 'byas na nor nye bar 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /arga'i 15shing la me btang la stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg byas na/ nyi ma bdun gyis nad zhi bar 'gyur ro//dkar po'i tshes gcig nas brtsams nas sha ta put+pa 1 smodang / kun da 1 dang /ta ka ra dang / ba sha ke 1 dang / du ruska 19dang / gu gul rnams ji ltar 'tshong ba nyos la/ mchod pa byas nas mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags 21la/ stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg byas na/ nyi ma bdun du 2 bdun 'gyur gyi nor rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag bzhi bzlas na/ bdag dang gzhan nye bar 'gyur bar byed do/ /yul srung dbar 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha dā 2 ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 25pa ta ye/ ki ṇi ki ṇi ghaṇ+ḍa 6kar+ṇa swa ba rna me dha ra 2 sa ma 29ye swā hā/ arga'i mar khus ku mu da'i ri me tog sbyin sreg byas na/96wa 329

brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/1༄ri /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzam+bha la nā ma aṣ+ṭa sha ta ka /bod skad du / 'phags pa gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya bge/'phags pa gnod 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gnod sbyin 'brog gnas po / /gser dag gis ni legs par brgyan/ /rin chen gyis ni rab mdzes shing / /me ni rab tu 'bar 'dra ba/ /lcang lo can du zhugs nas kyang / /gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang ba yi/ /zhabs gnyis la ni rab 'jus nas/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag dris pa ni/ /bcom ldan gnod 'dzin rgyal dbang po/ /gsang sngags tshogs ni kun gyi bdag /rig sngags 'chang rnams kun gyis mchod / /lha dang lha min phyag byas pa/ /ma rungs 'dul la brtson pa po/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan ldan/ /mgon po sems can kun don mdzad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'dzin/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /96—342

snying rjes non pa'i yid kyis su/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir/ /bdag gis kyang ni sems bskyed de/ /mi rnams nor ni nyung ba dang / /bsod nams chung zhing dbang chung ba/ /mthong nas sdug bsngal chen po yis/ /rab tu gzir to 91gsang ba'i bdag /de nas gnod 'dzin gyis smras nas/ /bcom ldan gsang ba gsang ba'i bdag /snying rjes non te smras pa ni/ /legs par nyon cig gsang ba pa2/ /mgon po gnod 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /sems can kun gyi don byed pa/ /dbul ba'i nyon mongs sel ba po/ /nor ro cog gi dbang phyug gi/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad bsod nams ldan/ /dbul ba'i nyes sdig sel byed pa/ /gang gā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyis5/ /rgyal mchog rnams kyis sngon gsungs pa/ /'od zer brgya pa zhes pa yi/ /zhing na sangs rgyas nyi ma'i zhal/ /chos ston pa na bdag gis kyang / /de ni rang gis sngon thos te/ /dbul ba sel cing bsod nams ldan/ /de ni bdag gi shes rab kyis/ /sems can kun don brtson pa po/ /khyod la legs par bstan par bya/ /khyod ni mnyam gzhag nerab tu nyon/ /'phags pa lha dang lha min bla/ /shes rab ldan zhing chos la gus/ /snying brtse'i bdag nyid bzod ldan brtan/ /dbang po zhi ba dbang po thul/ /dge bas sdig 'joms shes nyen can/ /des shing don kun sgrub pa po/ /mi gnod mi slu dpal dang ldan/ /mdzod bdag gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs gcig pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gzigs pa po/ /gter rnams skyong ba gzi brjid can/ /rtag sbyin nor ni 'phel byed pa/ /rin chen 'byung gnas skye bo 'dul/ /chu yi bdag po chu 'bebs pa/ /gnod sbyin chu spyod bdag nyid can/ /gter don nye bar 96—343

ston pa po/ /gser gyi ri bo lhun po ste/ /dbul ba'i gdon las thar byed pa/ /dbang po nye dbang 'gro ba'i mgon/ / chu yi 1dbang po sprin mdog can/ /'jig rten mig dang 'jig rten bla/ /nyi ma zla ba ther zug pa/ /nor chen rgyal po chen po ste/ /lag na ne'u le rab gnas pa/ /gzhon nu seng ge tog can te/ /gnod sbyin chen po rdzu 'phrul che/ /tshig gi bdag po bzhin 'dzum pa/ /gsong por snyan par smra ba po/ /bram ze 'dod pa'i lcags kyu ste/ /che ba don grub grub pas mchod/ /rig sngags 'chang ba 'khor los sgyur/ /ku be ra dang mi la zhon / /bum pa'i lto can mig yangs pa/ / lha yi 2dri ldan yid ltar mgyogs/ /khyab bdag bde 'byung nor bzang chisras/ /sems can rnams ni skyong la dga'//'dod dgur bsgyur gzugs yid kyi lha/ /cod pan can de rigs dga' ba/ /g.yon phyogs cod pan lag na cadabyug /lag pa brgya pa stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug lha yul pa/ /zla ba nya ba'i zhal mdog can/ /ded dpon tshogs kyi bdag po ste/ /gnas brtan tshong pa skal bzang bar/ /yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang / /dpag bsam ljon shing mi yi bdag /mchog don 'os pa gtso bo ste/ /mchog sbyin mi'u thung khyab 'jug pa/ /skyabs 'os bkra shis srung ba po/ /rin chen phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /lha yi seng ge'i khri la bzhugs / /byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi bdag /rab tu dar ba nor mi zad / /seng ge'i rtsal gyi mthu rtsal can/ /ston pa 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /gtso bo tshong pa rigs kyi mchog /pad+ma'i lte ba thub med rgyal/ /tshangs par spyod pa rgya mtsho che/ /gnod 'dzin bdag nyid che ba yi/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad ngas 6bshad 'di/ /sdig pa thams cad 'joms byed cing / /dbul ba'i nyon 96—344

mongs sel byed pa/ /'byor dang skal bzang skyed pa po/ /glang po rta nor 'phel byed pa/ /gza' dang rgyu skar rmi lam ngan/ /ltas ngan sel bar byed pa ste / /nags sam gal te grong dang ni/ /dur khrod yang na ri yang rung / /mkhas pa gang na klog pa der/ /g.yul dang dgra ni nyam nga ba/ /sbrul dang me chu chom rkun sogs/ /stag dang dom dang 'jigs pa che/ /rgya mtsho bgrod dka' 915mi bzad las/ /mi ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /dbang po me dang chu lha dang / /gshin rje srin bdag rlung lha dang / /nor sbyin dpal ldan ku be ra2/ /nor bu bzang sras lngas rtsen dang / /rtsed byumo can dang 'brog gnas dang / /lha dang gnod sbyin gzhan dag kyang / /g.yel ba med par nyin mtshan du/ /rab tu dga' bzhin srung bar byed/ /gang na ming 'di klog pa der/ /glang chen rta dang ba lang dang / /lo tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /'bras bu me tog rnams kyang 'phel/ /mi nad dang ni 'go ba'i nad/ /gnod pa kun las byung ba rnams/ /thams cad du ni bde legs 'gyur/ /lhag par byis pa rnams la shis / /de la yi dgas klu rnams dang / /ma mo dang ni gdon drag dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang mi 'am ci/ /srin po rnams kyang 'tshe 5mi byed/ /nad do cog las rnam par grol/ /de bzhin bde zhing nor dang ldan/ /bu dag dang ni tsha bo dang / /dpal dang gtong ba rnams kyis rgyas/ /rigs mchog rgyal ba 'byung ba dang / /longs spyod chen po'i nang du skye/ /tshe dang dpal dang ldan pa dang / /nad med rims snyodang bral bar 'gyur/ /tshe rabs kun du skye ba dran/ /lobs skyen thos pa 'dzin pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan ldan/ /skal ba bzang po nyid du 'gyur/ /phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal gnod sbyin rje/ /96—345

gsang bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal te/ /ma rungs 'dul la brtson pa po/ /lag na rdo rje khyod la 'dud/ /sems can dad la mnyes gshin pa/ /nor bzang 1sras kyi grags pa 'di/ /dbul ba'i nad ni zhi byed pa/ /rab tu bshad pa legs par gsungs/ /don kun grub pa gsang ba'i sngags/ /bdag gis kyang ni 'dir dbul te/ /de ni legs par dran tsam gyis/ /mi ni dbul las grol 'gyur zhing / /gzhan gyis mi tshugs srung bar 'gyur/ /dgra rnams kyis kyang mi choms shing / /skal nab bzang dang skal dang ldan/ /lo brgya yang ni 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /lha yi glang po rin chen dang / /rgyal dang rgyal srid 'os rnams kyang / /nges par myur du thob 'gyur te/ /rgyal srid kyang ni the tshom med/ /na mo rat+na tra yā 3ya/ na mo ma ṇi 4bha dru 5ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/o hrī traṃ k+ṣu dz+rī trī 63/ dī pya rasna 7ga pa ri/ sha na a ta bā ka 8de ba yak+ṣa sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hrīḥtsū 9phaṭa swā hā/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa rdzogs sto// //96—346
