bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (417)

༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mi 2kha lā nanā ma dhā ra hā / bod skad du/'phags pa me kha la zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 5dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das shākya'i yul ser skya'i gnas na/ shing dzin gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe gzhon nu sgra gcan mazin mal na nyal ba las / srin po zhig gis sngangs par byas par gyur to/ /de nas gzhon nu sgra gcan zin de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas gzhon nu mang po rnams kyis 8mdun du bdar cing yongs su bskor te/ ser skya'i gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 9te/ spyan sngar 'dug nas ngus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 96—349

gzhon nu sgra gcan zin bsrung 1)ba'i phyir me kha la zhes bya ba'i rig sngags bshad kyis 5)khyod kyis zung risashig /lha'i tshogs dang / klu'i tshogs dang / gnod sbyin gyi tshogs dang / srin po'i tshogs dang / lha ma yin gyi tshogs dang /nam mkha' lding gi tshogs dang / mi 'am ci'i tshogs dang / lto 'phye chen po'i tshogs dang / sha za'i tshogs dang / yi dgas 4)kyi tshogs dang / grul bum gyi tshogs dang / srul po'i tshogs dang / gza'i tshogs dang / rgyu skar gyi tshogs dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / drang srong 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams dang / gangs 5skul gnas pa dang / phyogs bcu na 'byung po gang dag 'khod pa dang / srin mo'i tshogs dang / bā li dang / kā ṭa li di dang / bo da ri dang / grong rna dang / yid bzang dang / 'phrog ma chen mo dang / ma mo'i tshogs rnams nga la nyon cig /rgya mcho1re 'khor gyi sung sgom shar phyogs kyi phyogs cha na srin mo 'phrog ma zhes bya ba dang / lho phyogs kyi phyogs cha na srin mo glang sna ma zhes bya ba dang / nub phyogs kyi phyogs cha na srin mo ral pa can zhes bya ba dang / byang phyogs kyi phyogs cha na srin mo sa'i gtsug ces bya ste/ srin mo drag mo de dag re re yang 7'khor bye ba drug cus nasabaskor ba me kha la'i rig sngags las brjod pa de 95thams cad kyis bsrung 9bar gyis shig /tar+ya thā/ gha ne gha ne/ gha ne gha ne/ gha ne gha ne/gha ne gha ne ba ti/ ghu me ghu me/ ghu me ghu me/ ghu me ghu me/ ghu me ghu me 1lhab ti/gha re gha re/ gha re gha re/ gha re gha re/ gha re gha ro12/ ghi 12ri ri nisko/ gha ra ba ti swa mar ba ti/ dha na ba ti/ su ra ba ti/ 7a hi/ me nyu ba ti/ ma ti / a pa ti/ su pa ti/ ba 1 hu ba ti/ ha la ha la/ ha la ha la/ ha la 96wa 350

ha la/ ha la ha la(1/ hi li hi li/ hi li hi li/ hi li nyi li/ nyi li hi mi(2ri / hu lu hu lu/ hu lu hu lu/ hu lu hu lu/ hu lu hu lu ri/ ti li ti li/ti li ti li/ ti li ti li/ ti li ti li / hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ pe ta ya ba/ a ma de55/ ma bi sa re/ ha ha/ hi hi/ sa man+t+ra kyis re/ a sa man+t+ra 7)sa re/ pa ri kha sa me/ a brte sa man+ta brten/ gha ne/ me 9kha le/kun dga' bo me kha la zhes bya ba stobs mo che 7rdzu 'phrul dang ldan ma brtson 'grus che ma 'di ni/ rig sngags 'chang rnams dang / 'byung po rnams dang / ro langs rnams las/ gang du yang 11bkag pa med de kun du thogs pa med par 'gro'o / /kun dga' bo me kha la zhes bya ba'i rig sngags 'di ni sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir dang / bde ba'i phyir dang / bsrung 12zhing sba ba'i bar du bya ba'i phyir 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 1 kyis gsungs so//drang srong chen po gzhan dag gis kyang smras te/ kun dga' bo me kha la'i rig sngags ni sems can rnams la phan par byed pa'ong/ /gang su dag sdig pa'i las dang ldan pa gzi byin lo'aphrog pa sa la gnas pa de dag thams cad me kha la'i larig sngags thos nas shin tu skrag ste phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 1 su 'gro'i18/kun dga' bo me kha la'i rig sngags legs par bzung 19ba byas pa la kun nas dpag tshad bcu gnyis su bsrung ba 2 gyis shig /yongs su bskyab pa dang /yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang /21 zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar gyis shig na /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chad pa spang bar gyis shig /mtshon cha spang ba dang / dug gzhil bar gyis shig /mi mdza' ba bzlog par gyis shig /mtshams bcad 2 par gyis shig /skud pas bcing bar 96—351

gyis shig /sdang ba thams cad bzlog par gyishā shig /mi'am 1mi ma yin pa sdig pa 2byed pa rnams 'tsher ma gzhug cig /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams grub par gyur cig swā /hā/ de la cho ga ni de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal 4te/ me tog dang / bdug pa dag gsol nas skud pas 5bcing bar bya'o/ /byab pa dang mnye ba dang / legs par khrus bya'o/ /cho ga 'dis gdon thams cad bzlog pa dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya'o / /tabya thā/ ti le/ pe le/ bi ma le/ ta ma le/ hi li 6ni ri si ri /ma sa ra/ rig sngags 'di ni thos gyur nas / /sa rnams thams cad g.yos par 'gyur9/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams rab tu g.yos/ /lha tshogs rnams kyang lhags par 'gyur1 / /klu yi rgyal po rnams kyang lhags/ /'byung po'i rgyal po rnams kyang lhags/ /bcom ldan byams pa'ang der phyin to/ /tshangs pa dang ni dbang po'ang lhags/ /dbang phyug che dang gzhin nu yang / / gnyis ka 11der ni lhags par 'gyur1 / /me kha la las gang su dag /brjod pa'i 'byung po rnams kyang lhags/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang 'di la bsrung 15ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su bzung 1 ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang /mtshon cha spang ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / mi mdza' ba skabazlog pa dang /mtshams dgum pa dang / me kha las yongs su bzlog pa stsal bar bgyi'o/ /tar+ya thā/ a bas nis/ bas 1 ni/ i ’ bi bsna 19ni/ tsu lu tsi 2 li/ udha rādhe 1 / sa man+ta rādhe 2/ nir muṇ+ḍi/ ni mi mu ni/ zhi ba dang / bde 96—352

legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /swā hā/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo bde legs su gyur cig / swā hā/1 de nas de'i tshe 2mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas me kha la'i rig sngags kun nas 'dzin pa'i 'khor gyi tshig 'di phul 4lo/ /stod ya the 5dan/ i gu re/ a du re/ du du re/ shi khi shi khi shi khi shi khi shi khi tshi / ba re/ da ra da ra pa ti/ mu tsa mu tsa/ bi mu tsa/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe lha'i bu rab 'thab bral gyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ sngad 7ya the nadan/ bra 9duṣ+ṭi/ru dhi ra /rje1 tsho/ gi dhī 11re/ dur da she na mu tse 1 mu tse ri/ shākya rā 1 dze/bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ myud 15ya the tshadan/ so ṇ+ḍi1 /bho 18 de ḍi/19 bhe da ḍa me 1/ dan+ti li/ ti li mi li/ bsrung bar gyis shig /bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o ri/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe rgyal po chen po 25lus ngan gyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ stad ya the nacadan/ ghu me ghu me/ ghu me ghu me ghu me / u ke/mu ke/ dz+wa 9le/ da le/ ma ti pha le/ swā re/ sa ra a dhi ba ti/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du 51bgyi'o/ /swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 2gis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ sngad ya the nadan/ dha dha re / dha dha re/ dhā dir tī tsiṅgā ra tī / dhā re a tsu te mu tse/ mu ru mu ru 9/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ / mtshams dgum pa'i bar du rgya cher bgyi'o/ /swā hā / de nas de'i tshe rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes pos me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 96wa 353

'khor phul ba/ stad ya the 1 dan/ aṇ+ḍa nanore/ paṇ+ḍa re / ka ra ḍi / pa ra pa tre/ ka ri 5)ru te6)/ ka ri 7nobha (8re/ ka na ka pa tre/ ru ru me/ k+ṣu k+ṣu/a k+ṣi me/ bak+ṣi/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /9nomatshams dgum 1 pa'i bar du bgyi'o/ /swā hā/ de nas rgyal po chen po 11mig mi bzang gis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ stad ya the 12dan/ dza 1 ma la dza krim la/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bhi ri bhi ri bhi ri/ sa man+ta bhi ri45/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o/ /swā hā/de nas de'i tshe lha'i bu zla bas me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ r+sād ya the ladan/ a la he/ te la bhe/ ma ḍi/ bi ma ḍi/ dha ke/1 dha ra ke/sa ki ni/ ba ki ni/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o/ /swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe lha'i bu nyi mas me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ stad ya the 18dan/ o bā de/ bi ma le pra bhā 19swa re / sha ha ra smre 1ha nas ha sra ra smra 2 ris ta 2 choswa 2par si/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe lha'i tshogs rnams kyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/stad 27ya the 2 dan/ ku ru ku ru/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe rgyu skar gyi tshogs rnams kyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/sngad 2 ya the 2 dan/ ta ma la ta le / a he/ da he/ ā kā shā ri bi ma le/zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar da bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe klu'i tshogs rnams kyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 96—354

'khor phul ba/ sngad ya the 1dan/ e len/ me le/ a tsa le/ ba dhe ā shu ri ba dhe/ (gemo k+ṣe/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur 5bar 6bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe lha ma yin gyi tshogs rnams kyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ sngad ya the 7dan/ nas dha dha re9/bi pu te/ saṃ papu te/ darnyi/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ sngad ya the 11dan / tsha tsha ba ti/ tsha tsha ba ti/ ru ru dā 15rā/ u bhi ra bha rā1na/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur 1 bar skabagyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe yi dgas sadang / sha za dang / grul bum gyi tshogs kyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 1 'khor phul ba/ stad ya the 1 dan/ bhū 1 ti bi bhū (1ti/ a ti bhū 3rtati/ sa brta 2lhan bhū ti/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe srul po dang lus srul po'i tshogs kyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ myud ya the (spyadan/ pha du me/ kā rā ḍi tsi/ a dhi ta / tsu te/ sa mi ra ṇi 8/ tshu tshu ba ti/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe ma mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ stad ya the 29dan/ ke ri le ma ke 1le/ ḍa rinam/ke le pa ra (sheḍa ne re di/ ḍa ma re tsi/ ḍa ḍa re/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe phyogs bzhi'i srin mo chen mo rjebazhi po ri dag gis me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/96wa 355

stad ya the 1dan/ ā na ba nane/ kha dze kha ba dze/ khu khu/ ri ri/ mi ri/hi ri/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o / /mtshams dgum 4pa'i bar du bgyi'o swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe sring 5mo chen mo 'gro lding mas ne me kha la'i rig sngags kyi 'khor phul ba/ stad ya the 7dan/ da ra da re/ da ra da re/ha ha/ hi hi/ hu hu hu hu/ shi ki/ gli ba gli ba/ ma khu ma khu/ dzu kha nakhri/ṭa ba ṭa bi/ asbya rasbya rtsu 9ra/ kla ma/ ku dzu ku dzu/ dri dri dri/ dru dru dru / tshi mi li/ ༄mi rlo/ a ṭa/ kwa ku11/ kwa ka 12yi/ du du/ ti thi ti thi / ti mi li/ mi ti / shi ting/ mi ti li/ ba ti/ pre tri lobre tri rteris/du hi ni/ a hā ni/ ha le / ba he/ tha ṭa bai tha be〉8/ btsun pa 'di ni 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags te me kha la'i gzungs sngags kyi 'khor du phul ba lags so / /bsrung 19ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung 2 ba dang /yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / mtshon cha 2 spang ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / mi mdza' ba bzlog pa dang / dpag tshad bcu gnyis su mtshams dgum pa dang / yongs su bskyang 22bar bgyi'o/ /lha'am/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/grul bum maman / sha za'am/ dri za'am/ yi dgas sam/ srul po'am/lus srul po'am/ lha ma yin nam/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ mi 'am ci'am/lto 'phye chen po'am/ skem byed dam/ brjed byed dam/ smyo byed dam/gshed byed dam/ byad 25stems sam/ ro langs sam/ nyin gcig pa'am/nyin phyoganyis pa'am/ nyin gsum pa'am/ nyin bzhi pa'am/ mi'am / mi ma yin pa gang gis kyang 2 gnod par bgyid par ma gyur cig /co 'dri ba'am/96—356

rnam par 'tshe ba'am/ glags 1lta ba'am/ glags 2tshol ba las glags rnyed par 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma mchis te sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa cam gtogs so/ /'jigs pa thams cad dang mi thams cad dang 5/ mi ma yin pa thams cad las rtag tu bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis me kha la'i rig sngags 'khor dang bcas pa zung 6shig /kun dga' bo me kha la'i rig sngags 'di ni sprin 'ching ba rlung gnon pa tshar gcod pa bdag srung 7ba / gzhan srung 8ba grong dang grong khyer srung 9ba mtshams gcod pa ste/ lha'am/klu'am / gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/ yi dgas 1 sam/ grul bum mam11/sha za'am/ lus srul po'am/ dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ spyod pa pa'am/kun du rgyu'am12/ gcer bu pa'am/ 'tsho ba'am15/ mi thod 1 can nam/lus skya'am/ mi'am mi ma yin pas 'da' bar bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /kun dga' bo me kha la'i rig sngags 'di ni gshed 15byed dang / byad stems 1 dang /ro langs thams cad 'jig pa ra byed pa'o/ /gdon thams cad bzlog pa'o/ /bkra mi shis pa thams cad 'jig par byed pa'o/ /kun dga' bo me kha la'i rig sngags 'di ni dge sbyong gis byas pa gcod par byed pa'o/ /bram zes byas pa dang spyod pa pa 1 dang kun du rgyu 1 dang 'tsho ba pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcod par byed 19pa'o/ /dbang phyug chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcod par byed pa'o / /tshangs pas byas pa dang / brgya byin gyis byas pa dang / lha'i rgyal pos byas pa dang / rgyal po chen pos byas pa dang / khyab 'jug gis byas pa 2 dang / 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gis 1byas pa'i rig sngags gcod par byed pa'o//96—357

rgyal po chen pos byas pa dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon gyis byas pa dang / zla ba dang nyi ma dang / rgyu skar dang gzas byas pa'i rig sngags gcod par byed pa'o / /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcod par byed pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcod par byed pa'o/ /lha khang 1pas sa byas pa'i rig sngags gcod par byed pa'o/ /dur khrod pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcod par byed pa'o/ /shing drung pas byas pa dang / ri drung pas byas pa dang / ri rtse bas byas pa dang / sa pas byas pa dang / nam mkha' pas byas pa dang / gnas thams cad pas byas pa dang / mis byas pa dang / mi ma yin pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcod par byed pa'o/ /me kha la'i rig sngags 'di ni gcod pa'o/ /phyir gcod pa'o/ /phyis gcod pa'o/ /kun dga' bo gang gis me kha la'i rig sngags 'dis bsrung 4ba dang / yongs su bskyab 5)pa dang / yongs su gzung 56)ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang /chad pa spang ba dang / mtshon cha spang ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / mi mdza' ba bzlog 7pa dang / dpag tshad dam dpag tshad gnyis sam/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi bar du mtshams gcad 8par byas nas9/ gang me kha la'i rig sngags 'di 1 las 'da' bar byed pa ni/ lha dang bcas pa dang / bdud dang bcas pa dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong 11dang lobacas pa'i skye dgu'i 'jig rten dang / lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ngas ma mthong ste 1 de ni gnas med do/ /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas 96—358

thams cad kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / bden par smra ba thams cad kyi bden pa dang / drang srong thams cad kyi bden pa 'di las 1sems can gyi tshogs 'gal bar ma byed cig /kun dga' bo dus las 'da' bar 5mi bya ba lnga ni 'di yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa las 'da' bar mi bya ba dang / chos kyi bden pa las 'da' bar mi bya ba dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa las 'da' bar mi bya ba dang / bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden pa las 'da' bar mi bya ba dang / drang srong gi bden pa las 'da' bar mi bya ba 4ste 'byung po thams cad dang nad thams cad dang mi thams cad dang mi ma yin pa 5thams cad kyis 'da' bar bya ba ma yin pa'o6/ /nad thams cad dang / 'byung po thams cad dang / sdang ba thams cad dang /mi mdza' ba thams cad las bde legs su gyur cig /gang yang rnam par tho 7'tsham par ma byed cig /'tshe bar ma byed cig /gang yang rdeg par ma byed cig /swā hā/ me kha la'i rig sngags kyi cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas la me tog nadang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / lha bshos dag phul nas phyis bsrung bar 9bya'o/ /gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgos 1 te/ ba lang gi lci bas dkyil 'khor byugs nas me tog dag 11bkram ste ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma'am phye'am 12pad+ma dang / bza' ba dang btung ba dang me tog 1 bsres 1 pas bum pa bkang ba'am snod bkang ba'i dbus su 'dug nas spos kyis 15rgyun mi 'chad par bdug lapar bya'o/ /rtswa ku shas thams cad la byab par bya'o/ /bdag bsrung 1 ba dang / gzhan bsrung bar bya ba 1 ni skud pas so/ /sprin bcing ba ni me tog sna ma'i shing dang sna ma'i 19mar gyis sbyin sreg 2 bya'o/ /rlung dang char pa bzlog na 96—359

pa ni rtswa muñdza'i lhas ma la lan gsum bzlas brjod byas te rtsa ba'i rig sngags kyis lan bdun btab nas mdud pa bdun dor bar bya'o/ /lam grub pa dang / bde bar bya na chos gos kyi grwar lan bdun 1gsum bzlas brjod byas te mdud pa gsum bor 2bar bya'o/ /zas dkar gsum zos la nyin zhag gsum smyung bar byas nas pad+ma dang yungs shar 5dkar po la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ grong ngam 'grong khyer mtshams gcad 7par bya'o/ /rig sngags thams cad gcod par 'dod pas sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te chu la gcad 8par bya'o/ /snod sar 9par chu blugs nas lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te khrus byas na log 'dren thams cad bcing ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /me tog dkar po dag la bzlas brjod byas te bsnun na dug med par 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad la shing ka ra bī 1 ra'i lcug mas byab par bya ste/ bdag bsrung 1 ba byas na gang du gdon gyi phyir yang las thams cad bya'o/ /'thab 1 mo dang / rtsod pa dang 'gyed pa'am 1 rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du sna ma'i me tog gi 'bru mar gyi 1 nang du a ti mug 15ta ka smyugs pa'i 1dziyam sreg 1 shing la 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyis btab ste lan bcu bzhir sbyin sreg 18bya'o/ /'byung po dbang du bya bar 19'dod pas ra'i 'o ma dang / ra'i mar dang / 0 shing a pa marga'i yam sreg 21shing dag la 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyis btab ste lan lngar sbyin sreg 2 bya'o/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi ched du sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas 'bras thug po che dang ba'i 'o ma dang / ru rta dang /rgyam tsha dang / shing ka ra bī ra dkar po'i yam sreg 25shing la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te 26sbyin sreg byas na sems can thams cad kyi ched du 96—360

sbyin sreg byas par 'gyur ro/ /rnyed par bya ba'i don du ru rta dang 'bru mar las 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyis lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te gdong bkrus 1nas smras na gang bslangs pa de thob par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du yang 2de bzhin gshegs pa 'am de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / byug pa rnams kyis mchod 4cing ci nus kyis lha bshos dag 5kyang dbul 6bar bya ste / bsrung ba dang bcas cho ga dang bcas pas mi mjed kyi sems can thams cad bsrungs par gyur cig swā hā/na 'di ni 9dngos grub po/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang /gzhon nu sgra gcan zin dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang lha dang mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi 1 rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa me kha la zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs sto11// //1 rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā war ma 1 dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de 1 ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur 5cing zhus te gtan la phab pal// //k+ṇi 96—361

kyang bskyed1/ /ser sna dregs dang rgyags pa rnam 2spangs te/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad pas bsnyen bkur bya/ /rdo rje carigs zhes 5ribarjod pa rgya chen dang / /nga la yang ni dad cing dga' bar bya/ /tshig rtsub phra ma 'khyal 6pa smra ba dang / /gzhan gyi bud med bgrod dang brdzun smra dang 7/ /rku dang gzhan gyi srog gcod gnod byed dang / /chang dang byed pa rtag tu spang bar bya/ /rmongs pa gang 8gis lus dang ngag dang ni/ /de bzhin yid kyis bsod nams bsags byas kyang / /thams cad log par lta bas bcom pas na/ /de yi rnam smin mi 'dod 'bras bur 'gyur9/ /dper na sa dang chu dang dus ldan yang / /sa bon tshig pa myu gu mi skye 1 ltar/ /de bzhin mi shes log ltas bcom pa yi/ /sems la 11dge ba'i chos rnams mi skye'o/ /de phyir log par lta ba rnam spangs la15 / /yang dag lta ba la ni bsten 1 par gyis/ /rtag tu sems ni dge ba bcu dag gi/ /chos kyi lam la gnas par byas na legs/ /lha dang lha min sha za khrag 'thung chob/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba mi bzad 15'jig rten na/ /sems can rnams la gnod pa byed cing rgyu/ /bzlas brjod brtson pa'i sems ni g.yeng bar lobyed/ /de dag rnams kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i phyir/ /nga yi 1 gsang sngags rig 1 pa'i tshogs mthong na/ /skrag par byed do snyam du dogs skyes 19pa/ /de phyir zlos pa'i sems ni g.yeng bar byed/ /de ltar gnod byed de dag gzhom pa dang / /bdag nyid 'byor par bya phyir nges 2 gsungs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha dang lha min gnas gyur pa/ /dam tshig ci 21bzhin bsod nams 22don du blta / /sna tshogs pa yi 2 gdon rnams gnas 25pa la/ /gang zhig rnam pa sna tshogs las byed pa'i spyo/ /dkyil 'khor der 2 ni gnod byed gzhom pa'i phyir/ /96—436

mi yis rab tu bsgrims 1nas 'jug par bya/ /gang yang rig pa namachog tu gsungs pa dang / /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du yang 'jug par bya/ /der ni dam tshig sna tshogs ngas bshad pa/ /sdig pa bsal 4phyir rgyun du blta 5bar bya/ /rdo rje 6)rigs ( gtso pho nya 8mo yi tshogs/ /rig pa mang pos bsten pa'i lha mo de/ /zlos 9pa mthong na bgegs rnams phung ba dang / / rngam pa 'don 1 zhing 11shin tu skrag par 'gyur/ / ji lta ji 12ltar dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang / /de lta de ltar rdo rje'i 1 rigs bsten dang / /rig pa'i tshogs la bsten pa'i bsod nams kyis / /de yi lus la ma 7lus 15byin rlabs sa'ajug /mi tshugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid de mthong dang / /sa phyogs rdo rje'i me 'bar de shes nas1 / /lha klu lha min gnod sbyin grub pa'i 18rnams/ /bzlas brjod byed pas skrag nas 'byer bar 'gyur / /nga 19yi dam tshig mthong ba'i bu dag gis/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pas bshad pa yi / /gsang sngags des 21ni ma bsgrims bzhin du 'grub/ /bgegs rnams thams cad brlag par byed par 'gyur/ /rig 2 dang dam tshig ma thob /snying rje med/ /de bzhin byang chub sems ni ma bskyed cing / /sangs rgyas ma dad lha gzhan la brten 2 pas/ /nga yi 25gsang sngags bzlas na phung bar 'gyur / /bsam pa zhan cing nyams kyis mi lcogs pas/ /dkyil 'khor de kun blta bar mi nus na'ang / /de las 2dzigang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gcig 2 tsam zhig kyang dad pas mthong gyur na/ /gnod sbyin tshogs dang mtshan mo rgyu ba dang / /sa bla'i gdon rnams kun dang klu dag dang / /lha la sogs dang bgegs dang log 'dren rnams/ /brtul zhugs 9gnas pa de la glags mi lta / /dper na lo tog thams cad sa dag la/ /brten nas skyon med par ni 96—437

skye ba ltar/ /de bzhin tshul khrims brten nas chos dkar mchog /snying rje'i nyu)chus brlan pas ni rnam pa skye2/ /rgyal ba ngas gsungs so so 4thar pa yi5/ /tshul khrims rnam dag 'dul ba ma lus las/ /sngags pa khyim pas rtags dang cho ga spang ne / /lhag ma rnams ni nyams su blang bar bya/ /de ltar sdig pa'i chos las rnam grol nas/ /bde bar gshegs pas legs par gsungs pa'i chos/ /dag cing grol ba dang ni ldan 'gyur ba'o / /bzlas pas skyo na mdo sde bklag rinapar bya/ /gtsang zhing 9dben pa sa yi 3 phyogs su ni/ /'jim pa 'am ni bye ma las byas pa'i/ /bde gshegs mchod rten rten 'brel snying po can/ /sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir ni rtag tu gdab/ /ring bsrel can gyi sku gzugs mchod rten la//bstod cing phreng ba dri dang 11mar me dbul12/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo dang / /mchog tu dad pa yis ni mchod par bya/na/ /nam yang 'khor lo gcig pa'i shing rta ni/ /rta dang ldan yang sna lam du mi 'gro ltar/ /de bzhin sgrub 5pa 7yi ni 1 grogs med na/ /lus can dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ni blo ldan gzugs bzang gtsang sbra che/ /rigs ni btsun zhing chos la gzhol ba dang / /spobs pa che zhing dpa' la dbang po dul18/ /snyan par smra zhing sbyin phod snying rje can/ /bkres 19dang skom dang nyon mongs bzod pa dang / /bram ze dag dang 2 lha gzhan mchod mi byed/ /sgrin zhing gzo 21la byas pa gzo na ba dang / /dkon mchog gsum la dad pa grogs po yin ri/ /de lta'i yon tan rim lus 5ldan pa dag /rtsod 20pa'i dus na shin tu dkon pas na/ /yon tan phyed dang bzhi cha'am 2 brgyad cha can na/ /de lta bu dag sngags pa'i grogs por bsten 9 / /'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i le'u 1dang po'o// //96wa 438

rang sangs rgyas dang bde gshegs nyid skyes dang / /rgyal ba sngon chad gang na bzhugs bzhugs pa'i(1no/ /gnas gang bsod nams ldan zhing yid dga' ba/ /lha dang lha min 925sogs pas ciphyag 'tshal ( —skumachod/ /gso sbyong sdom pa dag (5)dang 56)ldan pa yis/ /bdag nyid dag par bya phyir bsnyen par bya/ /de lta bu dag ma rnyed gzhan yang ni/ /chu bo chu klung 'bab chu mod pa dang / /pad+ma ut+pa las ni brgyan (7)pa'i mtsho/ /skye bo rnams kyang shin tu mi rgyu ba/ /dang rin zhing zhim pa'i chu ni mang ba dang / /mi bzad gdon rnams kyang ni mi gnas pa/ /me tog 'bras bu gtsang ma yod pa dang / /sman ljongs ljon shing sna tshogs dkrigs (9)pa dang / /sa steng 1 gnas mal shin tu gtsang ba dang / /gang na stag gzig seng ge med pa dang / /yid 'ong mnyam zhing tsher ma med pa dag /mi yi dngos grub gnas su bsgrags pa yin/ /grog 11po grog mkhar thal ba skra shad dang / /nyal nyil sol ba tsha lho sgo'am 15rtsog sacan spang / /der ni sa brkos sbyangs nas gnas brtsigs dpa/ /dro la brtan zhing 'jim pas 7zhal zhal bya/ /shar ram byang ngam nub tu sgo gtod 1 tshocing / /lho phyogs su ni nam yang sgo mi gtod/she/ /dri gtsang khang pa de yi phyogs gcig 19tu/ /rgyal ba lam mchog rnam par rdu 4ston pa yi/ /ras kyi sku gzugs las phyir brtan 21par gdags / /yang na shing gzugs legs pa mchod phyir bzhag /tha ga pas btags 'jam la snyoms pa dang / /thags bzang 32de bzhin skra shad med pa dang / /kho lag che zhing ma nyams kha tshar bcas/ /ras kyi gzugs de 2lhami la dngos grub ster dī/ /gtsang ma'i 35spos chus 20btab pa de la ni/ /tshon 2 rtsi 96wa 439

spyin med snod gsar blugs pa yis/ /khrus byas gtsang la 91gso sbyong bzung tshanaba'i mi/ /mkhas pas ba lang /spu yis bri bar bya/ /phreng ba bdug spos mar me lha bshos dang / /byug 5pa dag gis 6sku gzugs cher mchod de/ /nub phyogs zhal bstan mi g.yo brtan par 7gdags/ /de yi spyan sngar dngos grub brtsam par bya/ /gtsug phud bzhag ste 8spa ni bregs nas su/ /'byung khung 3ritshon gyis gos kyi 1 kha dog bsgyur/ /gos dkar dag gam shing lo'am gso ma 'am / /zar ma'am 11shing shun rnams kyi gos bgo'o/ /ku sna ba'am lcags sam 'jim pa las byas pa'i1 / /dbyibs ni legs shing mi rtsub 'jam pa dang / /ma chag 1 zlum zhing ma gas 1rirma med pa/ /yid du 'ong ba'i lhung bzed bcang bar bya/ /ha cang mi nye ha cang mi ring la/ /bza' btung mod cing dmangs ge rigs mang ba dang / /'gron 1 la mchod byed legs par gnas 18pa'i grong / /bram ze phyi rol skye bo 19med par bsten / /nga rgyal gyis 21ni non pa'i bram ze rnams / /rigs kyis rlom zhing snying rjer 22mi ldan pa/ /de dag bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten la/ /mchod pa mthong nas gegs da kyang byed par 'gyur / /bram ze sangs rgyas pa las ci 2 ltar dman/ /smrang las bram ze dag la dmangs 5rigs rnams/ /bsnyen bkur dang ni mchod par 'byung tsibs na / /dmangs /rigs kyis kyang gsang sngags ci 29ltar bzlas/ /lha dang 'gron mchod pa dang las drug dang / /rgyal po dang ni me lha bsten pa dang / /bu yi don du 'gro bar bya ba dag /bram ze rnams kyi nges par 'grub 1pa yin/ /rgyal rigs rje'u rigs rnams kyang rang gi las/ /grub pas 'di la the tshom ma byed ces / /brdzun 2du smra ba sna tshogs skyon dag gis/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi sems 96wa 440

ni sreg 17par byed/ /yan lag brgyad lam gnas pas rtag tu ni/ /nyi ma phyed mtshams na tshun chad bslang daribar bya/ /bram ze'i dus ni phyi dro yin pas na/ /de phyir bram ze'i khyim du 'gro mi bya/ /dge dang mi dge 4shes pa 5ribazung na ni/ /bram ze dmangs 6)rigs dag la 975khyad par med/ /'on kyang 'gro ba'i blos ni bram ze dang / /'di ni dmangs 8rigs yin zhes brtags par zad/ /bden pa'i lam (9nodamigs dge ba'i rjes 'brang 1 na/ /dmangs 11rigs dag kyang skye 12shi med par 'gro/ /log pa'i lam zhugs nyes par spyod ldan na/ /bram ze gang yin sna mi bzad dmyal bar ltung / /lus can shin tu dri ma ldan pa dag /'di na gzhan gyis dag par mi 'gyur te/ /de ni sdig pa rnam par bsal ba dang / /bsod nams ma lus yongs su bzung bas 'dag1 /dper na rma ni gso dang bsal boba'i phyir/ /nad pa dag la sman ni sasbyin pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'dir yang bkres yo tshopa'i sdug bsngal dag /bsal phyir rgyal bas kha zas bza' bar gsungs / /la la lam gyis dub cing 'gro ba'i tshe/ /bkres skom 1 gdungs pas 19rang gi bu yi sha /za ba bzhin du rnal 'byor sems dman bzhin / /tshe dang rgyags phyir bza' bar mi bya'o/ /mang du blugs na rtsol med mtho ba na dang / /de bzhin nyung 22ngus sung ni dma' 'gyur 2 la/ /ran pas skad cig mnyam par 'gro ba ltar/ /lus can kha zas de ltar bza' bar bya/ /dper na khang rnying mi zhig bya ba'i phyir/ /mi yis 2 ka ba brtan po btsugs pa ltar/ /de bzhin lus kyi naga'akhrul 'khor gnas pa dang / /shing rta'i mig 27bsku bzhin du kha zas bza' / /'dod pa'i khams ni kha zas kyis gnas zhes / /rgyal bas chos gcig tu ni bka' stsal pas na/ /lus ni chu shing bzhin du rig byas te 9/ /96wa 441

sems ni bza' btung tshogs tshol chags mi bya/ /dbang po drug po yul la 'phro ba dgatshon /bde gshegs gsungs pa'i shes pas bsrung bar bya/ /lhung bzed de dag las ni gcig thogs nas/ /gnya' shing gang du lta zhing bsod snyoms spyad / /'dzum zhing 'gro la smra zhing zur mig ri )can/ /yan lag thams cad yid 'phrog byed pa'i gzugs/ /bud med gzugs ni mtshon cha 'jebs rige'adra bas / /skyes pa'i sems ni 5rimangon du 'phrog par byed/ /lcags kyi thong lcags rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /mig ni rnam par bkab pa ches sla yi(6)/ /nyis (chun dran pa nyams byed bud med kyi/ /dkyus ring (8)mig can bzhin ni ma mthong sla( / /gang du dga' bar 'gro zhing 'dzin med la/ /sems kyis sems ni rnam par 'dul bzhin du/ /rab dang 1 tsho'abring la sogs pa nyurtaspangs nas su/ /mi smra bar ni gzhan gyi khyim du 'gro/ /gang na ba bzhon 12be'u phrug /2chung ba dang / /gang na skyes bu chang ni 'thung ba dang / /gang na bu mo gzhon bsten rtse bob dang //de bzhin gang na gzhon nu rtse ba dang / /gang na khyi za tshadaga' ston tshebyed pa dang / /gang na skye bo mang po 'dus pa dang / /3 de bzhin gang na tsho//rol mo byed pa rnams/ /der ni skyes bu nam yang 'gro mi bya/ /bsod snyoms ci 1)snyed khyer te 'ongs nas kyang / /dang por ci 2 tsholtar bde bar bgo 61bar bya/ /rkang bkrus glo 2bur pa la byin nas su/ /lus bsrung rme /phyir ni kha zas bza' bar bya/ /dus su zos nas dus gsum khrus byas te/ /phreng ba mar me bdug pa bstod sachedang dri/ /sha chang med pa'i lha bshos phul nas su/ /ku sha'i khres 5la 'dug nas bzlas brjod bya/ /bdug pa byug spos la sogs ma rnyed na/ /dri zhim me tog sna tshogs dbul bar bya/ /spra 27ba arka bil ba bri /ha ti rte/ /ku sha dri 96wa 442

ngan yid du mi 'ong spang / /'greng ngam 'dug gam 1ma log nyal ba dang / /'gro 'phres dun)za klog dbazlas brjod byed pa na/ /rjes su dran drug so so'i yon tan dgas) /rig par bcas te rjes su dran par bya/ /'phags pa dpung bzang gis 55)zhus pa'i le'u 56)gnyis pa'o// //'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs tshogs 7ldan pa'i/ /sems ni 'khor ba yin par kun du brjod/ /nyon mongs rnam grol shel dang zla 'dra ba'i / /srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i mthar ni yongs su 9bsgrags/ /dper na dri med chu ni rdul tshogs 7kyis/ /skad cig du yang rnyog par byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin rnam dag dri ma med pa'i sems/ /'dod chags la sogs skyon gyis rnyogs 11par 'gyur/ / pu tra dzi 12dang dung shel ru rag sha /lung tang pad+ma'i snying po zha nye zangs/ /khar /2ba'i bgrang phreng brgya ni rtsa brgyad pa/ /de dag las ni bgrang phreng gcig sa/blangs te/ /de ni lag pa g.yas pas bzung 15ba 'am/ /lag pa g.yon pas bsgrims te mi 'khrul bzung tsha/ /tshar re phyin cing nor bu re re nas/ /sngags pa yis ni rim bzhin drang 1 bar bya/ /'dug nas dbang po yang dag bsdam 1 pa dang / /lus kyang drang zhing brtan par bzhag 19nas su/ /phyis ni ma mchu shin tu mdzes par ri )yang / /bsgul 21zhing gsang sngags ci dgar bzlas brjod bya/ /sems ni glog dang sprin dang rlung dang mtshungs/ /rgya mtsho chen po yi ni rlabs 22dang 'dra/ /sgyu can 'dod dgur yul la mngon dga' ba/ /g.yo zhing 'phyan pa nges par 'dul sa bar bya/ /gang tshe chos pa'i 2 /sems ni zhi ba la/ /bsten pas gnyid kyis dran pa rmongs gyur 25na/ /langs nas bcag cing phyogs su blta 2796—443

ba dang / /chu yis gdong yang yongs su bkru bar bya/ /las kyi dbang gyur 91)bdag po med pa dang / /mgon med skyabs tsho med tshe rabs gcig nas gcig /lus kyi kha brgyud rjes su rab 'gro ba/ /de yi rjes su dge dang mi dge 'brang / /tshol dang mdza' bshes dang ni rnam par bral/ /mi sdug pa dang phrad cing 'dod pas gdungs/ /ngan pa skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal can/ /yul rnams kun du song na'ang 4med pa min/ /sha sbrang tsha grang bkres dang ngal la sogs/ /gang du song yang sdug bsngal nyid yin pas/ /yul la mngon dga'i sems ni 'byung ba 5rin/ /rnam rtog de dag rnams kyis bzlog par bya/ /'dod chags shas che mi gtsang sha tshil dang / /pags 6pa keng 75rus lta 98rabs rnam par bzlog /byams dang snying rje'i chus gdab zhe sdang la/ /gti mug la ni rten 'brel lam gyis so/ /re zhig na ni 9dgra yang mdza' bor 'gyur/ /mdza' ngobo dag kyang dgrar ni 'gyur ba nyid/ /de bzhin kha cig kyang 11ni bar mar 'gyur/ /bar ma de nyid kyang ni dgra bor 'gyur/ /de ltar mdza' bshes 'gyur bar rig 12bya ste1na / /blo gros ldan pas nam yang chags mi bya/ /gnyen la dga' ba'i sems kyi 1 rtog pa 15dag /bzlog nas dge la ci bder tshagazhag 1 par bya/ /dang po bzlas 1 nas bzlas brjod 19zin bar du / /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs zhing pa dang / /bud med ma ning khye'u 21bu mo dang / /sngags 'chang nam yang smra bar mi bya'o/ /ci ste dgos pa yod na sngags g.yog dang / /bzlas brjod zin nas da cung zad smra bar bya/ /smras nas 25lud pa bshang gci 2 bor nas kyang 2ge/ /chu yi nang du zhugs nas khrus kyang bya/ /me tog dri snod 2 mar me phul ba dang / /tshul khrims brtson 'grus dka' thub byas pa yi/ /dge ba de kun na bla na med pa 96wa 444

yi / /sangs rgyas byang chub bla 1med mchog tu nabasngo/ /dper na chu klung rgya mtshor ri phyin pa na/ /lan tshwa'i ror ni gcig tu gyur pa bzhin/ /de ltar bla med byang chub bsngos pa yis4/ /bsod nams rgyal ba'i ror ni gcig tu 'gyur / /dper na skyes bu la la 5'bras bu'i phyir/ /sā 6lu bskyed kyis 7sog ma'i phyir min yang 8/ /sā /lu rnyed nas bsgrim 1 pa med par ni/ /sog ma'i phung po zhar la 'byung ba bzhin/ /de bzhin byang chub 'bras bu 'dod pa'i phyir/skye / /bsod nams bsgrub kyi 12longs spyod phyir min yang / /sog 1rima'i phung po dag dang mtshungs par ni/ /ma bsgrims bzhin du mi yi longs spyod 'grub / /tshe ring ba 'di legs par 'thob 1 pa dang / /chos bzhin sgrub 15pa'i yul dag rnyed pa 'am/ /skyo ba med par 'gyur zhing 'gro ba yi/ /bsam pa rnams ni rtag tu rdzogs par bya/ /grags dang ma grags rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang sdug bsngal de bzhin bstod tshesmad dag /sems kyis 'jig rten chos 1 rnams rab bcom ste/ /sdig pa'i gnas su gyur pa spang bar bya/ /dper na rgya mtsho skad cig nya tsam yang ni/ /mi yi ro dang lhan cig mi gnas ltar/ /de bzhin rnam rtog sems kyis sdig byas pa/ /sngags pas skad cig tsam yang gnas mi bya/ /dper na rlung med khang pa'i nang du ni/ /mar me btsugs 19pa mi g.yo 'bar ba ltar/ /rtse gcig sems kyis chos la mngon dga' ba'i/ /lus la chos kyang de bzhin 'bar bar 'gyur / /stangs dang mchod pa 21dang ni gar byed dang / /glu len rnga rdung 22skye bos snyedapyas 'gyur 2 dang / /lhag pa'i nga rgyal 'drid dang 'dod chen dang / /rgyan 25po dang ni 'dus la lta 'dod dang / /dus min phyoganyid dang mi 'grub smra ba dang / /bstan bcos ngan dang snyan ngag 796wa 445

klog 1'don dang / /chags dang 'tshig dang dregs dang rgyags pa dang / /zhe la na'adzin dang le lo g.yo sgyu 5spang / /sha chang ke'u dang btsong zhesidang sgog rdog dang / /'bru mar gtil dang la phug su ra na ri/ /'byung po'i zas dang lha bshos gtor ma dang / /gu lang mchod byas gtor ma mi bza'ol ngas ni sngags pa 8kha zas dkar gsum dang / /rtsa ba sdong bu 'bras bu tshod ma dang / /zho dang nas dang 'o ma mar dag dang / /'bru mar tshigs ma ngar 99༄ba 'ol kon ⑩ dang / /thug pa rnams 11ni bza' btung yin par gsungs/ /sha za srin po dag dang gnon po dang / /ro langs dang ni 'jigs /rtepa sgrub pa dang / /lha min bu mo'i 'khrul 'khor 'joms pa'i tshe/ /'bru mar tshigs ma'i bza' ba mchog tu bsngags/ /de ltar bzlas brjod byed (12pa'i sgrub skipa pos/ /nyin gcig lobazhin du byas nas bzlas pa ni/ /phul nas cho ga bzhin du gshegs su gsol / /nub mo ku sha bting nas nyal bar bya/ /byams pa snying rje dga' dang mibatang snyoms ldan pa dang / /bde gshegs chos dang dge 'dun bcas pa dran byas te1 / /shā 18ri'i bu dang nga la thal sbyar 19btud nas 9 )nyal/ /de ltar sngags pa 21sdig pa mtha' dag zad par bya/ /'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i le'u gsum pa'o// //sgrub na pa po yis na nges par bcang ba yi/ /rdo rje de dag gang yin bshad par bya/ /sor ribacu bcu gnyis bcu drug bcwa 'bargyad dang / /mchog gi tshad ni sor yang nyi shu pa'o / /gser gyi rdo rje rig 'dzin nyid dang ni/ /sa rnams thob par bya phyir rab tu shis/ /rgyal po'i don du dngul gyi zhushemachog yin te/ /96wa 446

zangs kyi rin chen 'byung ba'i klu bsgrubs la(1/ /lha min dbang po'i 'khrul 'khor gzhig pa dang / /phug tu 'gro la rdo yi nardo rje'o/ /don kun bsgrub pa la ni lcags gsum gyi/ /gsang ba'i sde gzhom pa la lcags kyi'o/ /gdon 4gzhan la ni seng ldeng dpal dang tshe/ /nad med nor rdzas la ni bil ba'o/ /gnod sbyin mo bsgrub pa 5 la ma du'i 6shing / /chos kyi don du 7a shwad 8las byas shis/ /gsal shing 597rtse mo'i dgra rnams gzhig pa la/ /mi rnams bsad pa la ni mi rus kyi/ /shel las byas pa mig 'phrul chen po la/ / dbye phyir nim 1 pa las byas rab tu shis/ /gsad 11cing bskam pa la ni ba ru'i 12shing / /sha za bsgrub 3 pa la yang rab 77tu shis/ /lha dang gnod sbyin dri za bsgrub 7pa la /sgron shing las ni byas pa'i rdo rje'o/ /ci ste klu ni dbang du labyed 'dod na/ tsho /de tshe klu shing rtsa ba las byas pa'o17/ /gzugs bsgyur ba la 18sa las byas pa ste/ /ro langs bsgrub 19pa la ni ka tam 7pa'o21/ /pun da 22ka dang ra dza arka dadang / /a shad 3 shing gi rdo rje nor gyi phyir/ /gla ba a mra shri bar rna 5ba yi/ /a rdzu la sogs pa las byas pa dag /mi rnams g.yul las rgyal bar bya phyir ro/ /yid du 'ong ba'i 'dod pa thob bya'i phyir/ /tsan+dan dkar po dang ni dmar po ste/ /dbyibs legs 'jam zhing ma nyams rma med pa'i/ /rdo rje rtse lnga sra ba bcang bar tsibya / /dang po zlos tshe de ni thogs nas su/ /bzlas brjod zin nas myur ba kho nar yang / / dad pa'i 2 sems kyis phyag byas dri sogs kyis/ /mchod nas rdo rje rgyal ba'i 38zhabs drung bzhag smyo /nga yi rigs kyi ri1gsang sngags sgrub pa pos/ /rdo rje med na 'grub 2par mi 'gyur ro/ /de las gcig kyang rnyed par ma gyur na / /khu tshur bcangs nas rtse gcig sems kyis bzlas/ /ldong ros gi'u ri wang 96wa 447

ral gri añdza 1na/ /spang 2ma ba bla zhags pa li khri ril btsag /mar dang shu dag 'khor lo rdo rje mdung / /pags 5pa go cha 6rimadung ni rtse gsum pa/ /rdzas du )ni bcu bdun bsgrubs 8pa de rnams kyis/ /grub pa rnam pa gsum rnams thob par byed / /rang sngags cho ga lhag 9par bshad pa ribogang / /der yang grub pa rnam pa gsum du mthong / /bgegs dang log 'dren grub par mi dga' ba/ /rig pa'i tshogs 11rnams kyi 1 ni mdun nas 12rgyu/ /rigs mi'adzin brtsen tshepa'i bdag nyid can dag la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs glags skabs tshol zhing rgyu/ /bgegs kyi rigs ni rnam pa bzhi yod de/ /sa steng 'di ⑩na 'khod pa'i bgegs 1 rnams ni/ /rnam par 'jig dang wa dang ne'u le dang / /de bzhin so gcig pa dang rigs rnam 1 bzhi/ /de dang de las 'phros pa mtha' yas so/ /sa steng 19'jig rten skyong 2 bzhi gang yin pa / /de dag g.yog 'khor mya ngan med pa yin/ / de yi 2 g.yog 'khor bye ba phrag bdun rnams/ /de dag gsang sngags sgrub la bgegs na byed do/ /wa yi rigs ni bye ba bcwa dgebargyad dag /dbang phyug chen po'i 'khor te de rnams kyi/ /sde dpon glang chen gdong ste stobs po che/ /sa steng 25mtha' dag kun du bgegs 27kyang byed/ /so gcig rigs kyi sde dpon gtsug 2 'phyang 2 ste/ /bye ba drug cu'i 27bgegs la dbang sgyur 0zhing / /tshangs dbang khyab 'jug nyi ma zla ba rlung / /de rnams kyis bshad sngags la bgegs ri byed do/ /ne'u le'i rigs gang yin pa rgya che ste/ / khri phrag nabye ba ther 'bum phrag stong dang / /de dag rnams ni /sde dpon gtsug nas phyung da / /nga 5yi rigs dang sngags la bgegs tsibyed do/ /dga' byed pad+ma 'dra bar dkyus ring mig /lngas rtsen sngags rgyud la 8ni bgegs 9kyang 96wa 448

byed / /nor spyod bu ni gang yin gang po pha1/ /rang gi gsang sngags nargyud la bgegs 75)kyang byed/ /sgrub pa po ni pa'abyor par mi dga' ba/ /brtse med rang rang rigs la bgegs kyang byed5/ /rang gi gsang sngags gzugs su rnam sprul nas / /phreng ba dang ni gtor ma mngon du len/ /lha yis 6log 'dren kyis byas de mthong nas/ /khros shing 'khrugs nas phyir yang phyogs par 'gyur/ /sngon chad sems ni 'jungs dang rmongs pa yis / /lha yis log 'dren bgegs kyi lugs na'adi gtong 9/ /lugs 'di lha dang klu dang grub pa dang / /sum cu 1 rtsa gsum lhas kyang bzlog mi nus/ /bgegs kyis 'jigs su rung ba byas 11pa dag /sngar bshad pas ni de dag bzlog 12par byed/ /bzlas brjod zin nas legs par bsrung 1 ba dang / /dkyil 'khor mang byas bsgrub la 'jug par bya/ /gzhan du mchod pa'i 1 cho ga med pa dang / /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg 15cho ga bral ba'am / /gang zhig rtag tu sems ni 'di ltar sems/ /rig pa gang zhig bdag gis bzlas par sabya/ /yul dang rgyal sogs 1 gtam la chags pa de'i/ /lus la thogs pa med par rab tu 'jug /'di ltar phan tshun du ni 'gro ba na/ /rig pa 'don 18pa'i sems ni 19g.yeng 2 bar byed/ /dper na chu nang grib ma snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin mi yi lus la 'jug par 'gyur/ /'khru tshe gzhan la chos 21pa na yang gzhan/ /nyal na gzhan yin me tog bdug pa dang / /mar me 'bul ba'i tshe na 22gzhan yin la/ /sbyin sreg dbyed pa na yang bgegs gzhan 'jug /dper na nyi zer me shel bab 25pa yi/ /rkyen gyis ma bsgribs 0me ni 'byung ba ltar/ /de bzhin bgegs 2 kyang lus 2 la zhugs gyur 29na/ /'dod chags me chen kun du skyed par byed/ /g.yo zhing 'gul ba zhes ni bya ba'i 96wa 449

bgegs / /chu nang skyes bu 'khru ba'i 1tshe na'ang na 'dzin/ /bkres shing lus la snyom zhing gnyid kyang che/ /de bzhin lus lci mchog tu khro bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin dri za zhes ni bya ba'i bgegs/ /de ni dri 'bul 4rab na lus la 'jug /yul dang rgyal po gnyen dang nor la sems/ /snyom zhing bud med la ni ri5chags par 'gyur/ /nag po gzugs can 'chis ni brtol nas su/ /bdug pa rab tu 'bul ba'i tshe na 'jug /'jungs dang g.yo sgyu byed cing mi srun la/ /'dod chen che la rab tu 7khya chu na'adzag /mar me gtsug phud (9gcig pa bgegs ⑩ byed de11/ /snying ga 12tsha zhing gzer thabs sems nyams byed/ /'greng 1 ba'i tshe na gtsug 'phyang 'jug 'gyur te/ /rims dang 'khru skyug mudrag pos 'debs par byed/ /me tog 'bul tshe me tog cher bkod pa/ /rang gi gnas skabs rnyed nas lus la 'jug /rims dang cham pa lus tshigs na ba dang / /grogs tshapo dag dang rnam par bral 7bar byed/ /bgegs kyis brlams 1 pa phyogs na lam min lam du mthong 18/ /spyod pa sna tshogs byed cing 'dod chags rnams kyis gdungs/ /blo 19bur smra zhing klog la don med kun du 'phyan/ /don du sgrub pa rnams la sems kyang yid gnyis 1byed/ /sems ni log par lta bas non pas na/ /gsang sngags med cing mtho 2ris lha yang med/ /bsod nams med cing sdig pa cung zad med/ /thar ba med cing 'ching 22ba'i rgyu yang med/ /skye bo don med nyon mongs dka' thub ches 5/ /sna tshogs 'khyal 27pa'i tshig 'di 2 rtag tu smra/ /sen mos rtsa 28gcod bong rngo 'jig 29pa dang / /mtshan mo so yang krig krig da 'cha' ba dang / /bu mo bdag kā'adod khyo ni mi rnyed cing / /skyes pa bdag 'dod 2chung ma gzhar ri mi rnyed/ /dgos pa'i don ni 4mi 'grub lha96wa 450

mi dgos 'grub/ /gar yang 'gro 'dod 1gnyid med mi yang brlamasan/ /de bzhin stag gzig seng ge khyi dang phag /bong bu rnga mo byi la sha za wa/ /bya rgod 'ug pa skya 4mo mi'u thung hrul5/ /gcer bu thal ris can dang mi nag po/ /khron skams thod 96pa rus gong phung po dang / /lcags dang rdo khung mi gtsang khang 7rul dang / /kha bzhin gyur cing naral gri mdung thogs pa/ /rmi lam 'di rnams rmis pa'i mi yang brlams/ /bgegs dang log 'dren rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi thab /sbyor drag shul thabs skalas 11sbyar/ /sngags pa de yi /lhagasang sngags ma 1 zhugs pa/ /bgegs dang log 'dren rnams kyis yongs mi tshugs/ /phyugs lhas shing gcig lha yi khang pa nga'am/ /lam gyi bzhi mdo tshakhang stong lanags tshal du/ /dkyil 'khor grwa 1 bzhi lham pa khru bzhi'i tshad/ /tshon 12rtsi rnam pa sna tshogs rnams kyis byi19/ /phyogs kyi lha rnams gnas ni yongs su bzung / /sgo bzhi pa la ku sha'i rtswa na yang bkram 2/ /bza' dang sha chang la phug la sogs bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po'i gtor ma sbyin/ /bum pa pad+ma dmar po'i mdog 'dra ba/ /nag po ra ri med cing rin chen bcas / /sman dang 'bru dang spos chus bkang ba bzhi/ /ldum bus kha brgyan na ras kyis mgul pa dkri rī/ /lus dmar po dang tī 20li tī 2 la dang / /'gro lding ba la sogs pas brgya 8bzlas te/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor 9yug tu ni gzhag par bya/ /de nas byug spos bdug spos la sogs dbul 1/ /bgegs kyis brlams pa 2shar phyogs kha bstan te/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ri dbus bde ba'i stan ril bzhag /bzlas brjod byed cing 'bum pa re res bkru / /'on tang 9log 'dren rnams las thar bar 'gyur/ /sgrub pa po yi mi ni 'ba' zhig 1la/ /96wa 451

bgegs rnams gzhig phyir phan par ma zad kyi/ /rgyal po'i 'khor dang bud med bu 1med dang / /bu mo dag dang rol mo mkhan rnams dang / /bud med phal dang tshong pa rnams kyang rung / /zhing pa rnams dang dbul zhing phongs pa dang / /gdon gyis zin cing rims kyis 2btab pa dang / /bus pa'i gdon dang me tog 'bras bu 'phrog /rmi lam smyo dang sems ni g.yengs pa nodang / /dug kyang sel te khrus 'dis cadag par byed/ /'phags pa dpung bzang gis 5)zhus pa'i le'u bzhi pa'o// //bgegs kyis 6bsod nams ma lus zad par byed/ /de bas mi yis 7gsang sngags 'grub mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar zla ba sprin las rnam grol ltar/ /de bzhin bgegs las grol ba rnam par gsal/ /dper na sa chu dus dang rnam 8bral ba'i9/ /snod gnas 'bras bu me tog myu gu med / /de dang ma bral myu gu lo ma dang / /sdong bu dag dang me tog 'bras bu skye/ /cho ga nyams shing yi ge gug skyed med/ /mchod pa med cing mi gtsang bzlas brjod byas/ /gug skyed yi ge lhag par gyur pa yis 1/ /gsang sngags dngos grub rgya chen mi ster ro/ /dper na dbyar gyi dus na char sprin dag /skye bo'i skal 1 bzhin char pa legs par 1 'bebs/ /de bzhin mi yi skal ba gzigs nas ni/ /'dod pa bzhin du gsang sngags dngos grub stsol/ /yul dang dus dang cho ga las rnams dang / /sdig pa sbyang 1 zhing bsod nams bsag sapa dang / /gus dang bzlas brjod kun la gzigs nas ni/ /de dag gsang sngags 'bras bu rnam par stsol/ /ji tsam sdig pa mang pos rab gang zhing / /ji tsam las dkar bsod nams ma bsags 96—452

dang / /ji srid cho ga med par bzlas byas pa1/ /de srid sngags pas dngos grub mi thob (55bo/ /cho ga nyams sam bar bcad sngags gzhan bzlas/ /bzlas pa btang ngam gzhan la byin 4gyur na/ /dus gsum mchod pa la ni brtson 5byas nas/ /slar yang 'bum zlas 6bsgrub la 'jug par bya/ /stong phrag bcu 'am brgyad dam bdun nam bzhi/ /bzlas mthar de la mar gyis 7sbyin sreg 87bya/ /yang na ma grugs nas sam til nag gam/ /yungs kur 9mar dang bcas hu pa'i sbyin sreg 11bya/ /'dzam bu ma 12du blag 1 sha pa la sha /u dum seng ldeng a shwad a pa mar/ /arga 1 a sho ka dang rardza ka /n+ya gro bil ba a mra sha mi 7yi/ /yam shing gzhon nu sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /btsal nas zho mar sbrang rtsi la btags nas/ /rtag tu me la sbyin sreg sabya bar bya/ /de ltar byas na dngos grub myur du thob1 / /gzhan gyi gsang sngags kyis ni gsang sngags gang / /bcad 18dam bcings sam mnan par gyur kyang rung / /de yi gzugs brnyan sa la 19byas nas su/ /nga yi zhabs drung mngon du phyogs bzhag ste/ /sngags pas tī li tī 21sogs snying po rnams / /mar dang 'o mas de yi 2rigazugs brnyan bkru / /de ltar zhag bdun byas pas gsang sngags dag /bcings 2 pa dang ni mnan las grol bar 'gyur/ /mchod pa la sogs cho gar 5ldan yang ni/ /ci ste gsang sngags 'bras bu mi ster na/ /de'i 2tshigazugs dug dang ske tshes byugs nas su/ /khri rna li 2 tī na la 'gro lding la sogs pas/ /sngags kyis de la yungs mar tsha da1sbyar bas/ /zhag bdun dus gsum sbyin sreg las byas na/ /gsang sngags 'ongs nas rmi lam dag tu ni/ / /cho ga nyams dang yi ge lhag chad ston/ /sngon gyi 5sngags lugs 'chang bas dzibastan mod kyi/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho dus las 96—453

mi 'da' bzhin1/ /sngags kyis gzhan gyi tshonagasang sngags mi bsnan 5)cing / /bcing dang gcad 4pa nam 5yang mi bya'o6/ /dper na byams pa'i mi yis mi gzhan la/ /che ge mo yi khyim 'dir phyin cad 7khyod/ /blta ba'i phyir yang 'gro bar mi bya 8 zhes/ /rigs 9pa'i tshig gis 1 rnam par bstan pa dang / /des kyang de yi 11tshig de mnyan nas su/ /khyim du smra dang blta phyir mi 'gro ba12/ /de bzhin 1 sngags pas 1 gang yang rung ba'i sngags/ /bzlas nas logazhan gyi tshegasang sngags bsnan 1 mi bya/ /gsang sngags gcad 18dang bcing ba mi bya zhing / /yi ge lhag chad gsang sngags mi sbyin no/ /las rnams spyad pa gzhan 19du bsgyur mi bya/ /gnas rnams gzir bar nam yang mi bya'o/ /dbab dang bcing dang brdeg dang rmongs bya dang / /yan lag mi gzhig rigs kyang mi brlag cing / /sngags pas klu dang gdon la sogs pa rnams/ /gzhan du bskrad par nam yang mi bya'o/ /dgar dang bskrad pa dang ni gsad 2 pa dang / /byis pa gdon stozin nam yang ri mi gso zhing / ci /rgya mo sa mda' rnyi na dang 'dzol na bu yis/ /sems can gnod pa nam 25yang mi bya'o/ /dngos grub phyir ni rnam pa bcur gsungs te/ /sngags pa dang ni rang sngags g.yog dang rdzas/ /brtson 'grus phyogs dang sa gzhi dus dang ni/ /yan lag rdzogs pa'i lha dang sems stobs so/ /gzhan dag kha cig rig 26'dzin grogs shes na zer/ /gzhan dag phyogs dang brtson 'grus dus rnams nyid/ /gzhan ni rdzas dang 2 lha dang sngags yin zer 9//kha cig sems stobs yin zhes rnam par smra/ /'grub phyir de ltar bcu dang brgyad dang lnga/ /de bzhin bzhi dang gsum dang gcig nyid ces/ /sngags rig da rang rang blo yis da rnam par 'chad/ /sangs rgyas rgyud la cho ga gnyis kyis 96wa 454

'grub / /sgrub po 1gang zhig rang gi yon tan rdzogs/ /brtson 'grus mchog dang yang dag ldan pa dang / /gzhan gyi 25rnyed pa dag la phrag dog med/ /'dod la ma chags lus kyi nyon mongs bzod/ /gug skyed klad kor 4tsheg 5tshang zur phyin la/ /gsang sngags dag cing shin tu cho gar bcas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bsten 6pa yi / /gnas su bzlas na yid 'ong dngos grub (8)thob/ /ci 9ltar ri dgas 7rgyal 11po bkres pa dag /mthu stobs chen pos 1rtaglang chen gsod pa dang / /de bzhin spyang ki 12phag dang ri dgas tshadang / /wa rnams kyang ni myur du gsod pa ltar/ /de bzhin sngags pa tshaseng ge'i tshul gyis su/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma'i las rnams la/ /brtson 'grus chen po dang ni ldan pa dang / /'bad pa tshamachog rnams kyis kyang bsten par bya/ /rdza rnga'i sgra dang dung dang rnga sgra dang ’ tsho/ /shin tu 'jigs byed skye bo'i sgra dag dang / /gad rgyangs bshugs 18gru dag dang glu gar dang / /gling bu pi wang sna rdza rnga chen po'i sgra/ /bya bran sna tshogs sgra dang chu sgra dang / /bud med rgyan gyi 2 sil 'khrol 21sgra rnams dang / /sha sbrang tsha grang rlung gi dganod pa yis/ /mi yi sems ni g.yeng zhing g.yo bar byed/ /bzlas brjod byed tshe mi myur mi dal zhing / /sgra cher mi dbyung ha cang chung ba'ang min/ /smra bzhin ma yin gzhan du g.yengs bzhin min/ /gug skyed klad na kor tsheg 5rnams nyams par min/ /ci jiltar chu klung nyin mtshan rtag tu ni/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab par 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin phyag bcas bzlas dang brtul zhugs kyis / /bsod nams lus can la ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /le lo 'dod chags mi dgar 2 ldan pa'i sems/ /gang dag 29gang du g.yo zhing rgyu ba dag /de dang de nas myur du 96wa 455

bzlog nas ni/ /gsang sngags yi ge mchog la legs par sbyar/ /sna rtser blta 1)zhing rnam par rtog pa spong / /nam zhig bskyod kyang rnam par mi g.yo ba/ /de tshe dmigs la gnas pa thob pa ste/ /sems ni las su rung bar 'gyur bar nges//rtse gcig sems dang ldan pa'i mi la ni/ /yid las byung ba'i dga' ba rab tu skyedan / /dga' bas lus ni shin tu sbyangs pa 'thob/ /lus sbyangs pas ni bde ba'i skal ldan 'gyur/ /lus bde rtse gcig sems dang ting 'dzin gyis/ /de tshe bzlas brjod thogs pa med par 'gyur/ /tshe rabs gzhan du gang dang gang byas pa'i/ /sdig pa ma lus bzlas brjod byas pas 'byang 4/ /bzlas pas sdig pa ma lus byang gyur nas5/ /dang ba'i yid kyis dngos grub thob par 6'gyur/ /de phyir bcom ldan rgyal ba'i dbang po yis/ /chos 'di kun gyi rtsa ba sems zhes gsungs/ /sems ni dang bas lha mi'i bde ba dang / /mtho ris dang ni byang grol thob par 'gyur/ /sems kyi skyon gyis dud 7'gror skye ba dang / /sems dmyal gnas shing 8mi sdug dbul por 'gyur/ /sems ni rab tu dang bar gyur pa'i mis/ /sa chu me rlung skye rga na 'chi sogs/ /bar dang tha ma 9gnod pa kun bral ba/ /rnam grol bde zhing zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags dngos grub kun dang thun mong ba1 / /bde ba chung zhing sdug bsngal brgya 11dang 'brel/ /nyon mongs dug bcas rnam par 'jig 'gyur ba12/ /dang ba'i 1risems kyis r+sāthob par 'gyur ba gluyin/ /'dod rgyal las las ma 7byung dus las min/ /rang bzhin dbang phyug las kyang byung 1 ba min/ /rgyu med can min skyes bus ma byas kyang / /las dang nyon mongs pa las sems can byung 18/ /gzugs ni 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang ldan/ /de ni bdag min bdag kyang 96—456

gzugs ma yin/ /gzugs la bdag med bdag la gzugs med de/ /gzugs ni stong pa'o phung bzhi'ang rig par gyis/ /gzugs ni dbu 1ba dag dang 'dra ba ste/ /tshor ba chu bur bzhin du rtag pa med/ /de ltar mthong ba lta ba bzang po yin/ /gang zhig gzhan 2gyur /de ni lta ngan gsungs / /de ltar zlos pa'i gsang sngags nye 5gyur na/ /mtshan mo nyal ni rmi lam 'di dag mthong //khang bzangs 6ston shing rgyal mtshan seng ge rta/ /ri bo shing rta sgra ldan sprin dang klu shā / /stag dang seng ge na glang chen khyu mchog la/ /rmi lam na ni dga' bas zhon 59༄pa dang / /me tog phreng ba gos 1 dang dri rnams dang / /sha chang nya dang 'bras bu glegs bam dang / /lha yi gzugs dang ut+pal dmar po dang / /shing rta gang ba'am ba bzhin 11be'u phrug can/ /gdugs dkar rnga yab lham dang ral gri dang / /bsil yab gser g.yu can dang phreng ba dang / /nor bu mu tig nya 12phyis dung dang dngul/ /bud med gzugs bzang yid 'ong bu mo dang / /rin chen sna tshogs rnams kyis spras pa'i rgyan12/ /mal stan 1 dkar po bting ba rnyed pa dang / /tho rangs khar ni chu bo chu klung dang / /'bab chu'am rgya mtsho dang ni rdzing bu dang / /lu ma la ni 'thung ngam rkyal rmi dang / /de bzhin khrag gis lus ni 15khrus byed dang sa/ /lha khang 1 mchod rten gdugs dang 1 rgyal ba'i gzugs / /byang chub sems dpa' mchog dang rang sangs rgyas/ /zag med dge 'dun dge slong dge slong ma19/ /dge bsnyen rnams dang sa bdag lha rnams dang / /mchod gnas bram ze yid 'ong skyes bu dang / /mi dang mi mchog phyug cing 'byor pa'i 2 bu/ /pha ma mdza' bshes gnyen dang gnod sbyin dang / /grub pa'i lha dang na chung tshogs dag 21dang / / ci ste nyi ma zla ba za ba dang / / sa 96wa 457

yi ci1nang 'gro sa bon 'thung ba dang / /me la rdzi zhing rdo sha ni za ba dang / /lus kyi nang du me ni zhugs pa mthong / /rmi lam bzang po 'di dag mthong ba dang di / /de dag ring por mi thogs 'grub (5)par 'gyur/ /zla ba gcig dang zla phyed nyin zhag dang / /skad cig gis kyang phyir dzi)phyir nye bar 'gyur/ /'phags pa dpung bzang gis 7༄zhus pa'i le'u 8)lnga pa'o// //dngos grub nye na zlos la dga' ba dang / /sems ni sdig la 3rinam yang tshadaga' mi 'gyur/ /bkres 11skom tsha grang rlung dang ngal ba yi/ /sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs 2kyang g.yo mi 'gyur/ /sbrang bu sha sbrang srin bu grog sbur dang / /sdig sbrul rkang brgya pa dang sbrul dang dred/ /sha za srul po rnams kyang de dag gi/ /lus dang grib ma la yang 1 mi 'gong ngo / /tshig ni gzung bobar 'os shing yid gzhungs skal/ /snyan dngags gludang ni dri 1 ba rnams la mkhas/ /chos la mngon dga' gter 18rnams mthong ba dang / /lus kyi nad dang dri ma med par 'gyur / / skyes bus 19mthong ngam thos par gyur kyang rung / /myur du mngon dga' yid du 'ong bar 'gyur/ /bud med 'dod lha'i mdas phog ci ༄pa rnams kyis / / 'dod la 21longs spyod phyir ni 'bod par 'gyur/ /gang tshe mkhas pas lha dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lha yi bu mo'i gzugs tsho dadang sgra/ /mis ni dga' ba'i yid kyis mthong thos na/ /de tshe shin tu nye bar gyur pa yin/ /lus ni dri med dag par rig pa dang / /gso sbyong sdom pa dang ni ldan pa yis/ /nyin zhag gcig gam gnyis sam gsum du 5ni/ /kha zas spangs shing smyung jibar gnas pa yis ri/ /nyin zhag de dag 'das par byas nas su/ /rang gi 96wa 458

'byor phyir bsgrub la 'jug par bya1/ /gsung de dpung bzang gis thos slar gsol pa/ /zas kyis mi 'dag ces ni 2sngar gsungs na / /mchod 'os khyod kyis lus dag bgyi phyir yang / /ci slad smyung ba mi bzad bgyi bar gsungs/ /srid pa'i 54)mthar phyin bde bar gshegs pa yis/ /shing rta'i mig bsku 5bza' ba'ang ci phyir gsungs/ /rdo rje can gyis dpung bzang tshig gsan nas/ /'brug sgra zab 'dra'i gsung gis snyobaka' stsal pa/ /bu gcig 7lus dag bya phyir smyung bya bar/ /bde gshegs 'di na nam yang mi gsung yang 8/ /lus 'di mi gtsang pags (9)pa sha khrag rkang 7/ /klad rgya rgyu 11ma mcher mchin mkhal ma zhag /mkhris pa bad kun khu ba phyi 12sa dang / /gcin snabs 1 ba spu skra dang rus pa dang / /mig dang rna ba sna dang kha dang ni/ /bshang 1 sgo mtshan dang bu ga dgu po yi/ /rma nas dri ma sna tshogs mi gtsang ba/ /'dzag pa'i rgyun ni rtag tu 'byung ba yinas/ /de ltar yan lag thams cad 'dus pa dang / /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams dang ldan/ /ci sabazhin las kyi rjes 'brang mi yi lus/ /thams cad ldan pa'i gzugs la gnas pa yi/ /bshang 1 gci snabs dang mchil ma bad kun dang / /'di dag zad par bya phyir smyung bar gsungs/ /dri ma zad nas mi yi lus dag na18/ /rang gi 'byor phyir bsgrub la bde bar 'jug /'dod chags kyis ni gdungs par gyur na yang / /lus kyi yan lag 'di dag thams cad la/ /dran pa rtse gcig mngon du byas nas ni/ /ye shes mig gis so sor rnam par brtag19 /de ltar rang gis nges par brtags pa na/ /lus dang srog la rjes su chags pa yi/ /'dod chags rtsa rtanas yong ye zhi 2'gyur te//nyi mas mun nag gtan nas bsal lhab bzhin/ /phan yon de yis gsang sngags 96wa 459

nye bsnyen 1nas/ /rang gi lus la nye bar rig pa dang / /yar gyi 27tshes brgyad dam ni bcu bzhi la / /yang na bco 5lnga la ni bzlas brjod bya/ /lha yi gnas kyi sa dag bstar ba'i phyir/ /sa dang phyi bar po bsres 7ril sogs pas byug /dad pas bde gshegs kun la phreng ba dang / /lha bshos me tog dri dang mar mes mchod/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'khor namachod/ /de nas gsang 9sngags lha la dbul 1 bar bya/ /bstod 'os sangs rgyas rnams la 11bstod nas su/ /phyir 12zhing byang chub sems kyang dran byas te/ /sems can skye rga na bas 1dgazir ba la/ /ci 1 ltar rigs par snying rje'ang bsgom par bya/ /'dus chen mdo sde bklag 15pa'am bkra shis kyi/ /tshigs su bcad pa'am chos kyi 'khor lo mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'am sgron ma che/ /gang yang rung ba gcig ni rim bzhin bklagal /de nas bla 'og phyogs rnams bcings nas su/ /lus la go cha bgo bar byas nas ni/ /gong du smos pa'i dkyil 'khor de rnams las / /gcig cig tshon rtsi rnams kyis bri bar bya/ /rdo rje me chu rlung dang mdung thung dag /rim bzhin dkyil 'khor 'dir ni bri bar bya/ /ra bar bris pas nya lha dang lha min dang / /snang 1 ba'i bdag nyid sems ni myos par 'gyur/ /seng ge'i gdan gyis mngon par bsngags 19pa'i stan / /de ni dkyil 'khor dbus su gzhag 1par bya/ /bdag nyid bsrung da ba byas te der 'dug nas/ /rdzas blangs myur dadu bzlas brjod byas nas ni/ /bdug pa'i sbyin sreg 2 stong yang sbyin sreg 25bya/ /de nas de ni dri chus bkrus phyinas su/ /bgegs mang rnams kyang rab tu bsal 2 byas nas/ /byang chub shing lo gsum gyi steng du bzhag /bzhi yis bkab nas ci 2 srid grub pa ni/ /rnam gsum mthong gi 96wa 460

bar du gsang sngags bzlas/ /dro 1dang dud 'thul me bzhin 'bar ba 'am/ /rim bzhin bzlog 3nas 'byung na'ang 'grub par gsungs/ /dro bas 'gro ba thams cad dbang 'gyur 94te/ /du 45ba 'thul 6bas lus ni mi snang 'gyur/ /'bar bas mkha' la shin (7tu 'gro 'gyur te/ /mi yi lus ni lha ltar gsal bar 'gyur / /ci 8ltar lus la grang ba 'jug pa dang / /ci 9ltar mngal du dri za 'jug pa dang / /nyi zer me shel zhugs nas me 'byung ltar/ /de bzhin dngos grub lus la 'jug par 'gyur/ /mar me mched cing shin tu 'bar ba dag /snum zhing dkyus ring gser gyi mdog ltar dang 1 / /'bru mar zad kyang 'bar bar gyur na ni/ /de tshe sngags pa 11dngos grub thob 'gyur te/ /de dag rdzas las byung ba'i dngos grub bo/ /mis ni 12ri mo'i sku gzugs 'gul ba 'am/ /phreng ba smin ma mig dang rnga yab bam/ /gal te rgyan rnams g.yo bar gyur pa 'am//mkha' las me tog char ram rdzi char 'bab/ /sa ni myur du g.yo bar gyur pa 'am//lus ni /lhami snang 14mkha' las tshig tu ni/ /bu gcig 15dam pa ci 'dod slongs shig cesapa/ /lha yi rnga sgras 1 lus kyi ba spu ldang / /rgyan gyi char chen rab tu 'bab pa 'am/ /ci 18ste mkha' la lha dang lha min dang / /gsang sngags gzugs ni mngon du mthong na 'grub19/ /ma nyams me tog dbyig dang chur 0bsres shing / /bstod dang bcas par mchod yon rgyun sbring 21nas/ /rtse gcig sems kyis 22mgo btud phyag byas te/ /dad dang 'bad pa'i rjes mthun rinamachog slang 2 ngo / /mchog thob nas ni dga' bas phyag byas te/ /dad pas bstod cing mchod yon phul nas su/ /gsang 5sngags brjod cing slar yang gshegs su gsol / /gsang sngags kun la tshul ni 'di yin no/ /gang zhig sems stobs 96wa 461

mchog dang 1ldan pa des / /'dir ni 'jigs dang bcas pa'i las kyang bya( ste/ /sems stobs chung ba'i mi la sha za yis/ /glags mthong nas ni phung 4)bar byed par 5'gyur/ /dpa' bos 6go bgos 7mtshon cha'i thabs mkhas pas/ /chas pa'i glang chen mchog zhon gzhu thogs ten/ /mda' 'phen mthu dang ldan pa gcig pus kyang / /dgra bo'i 9tshogs kun las ni rgyal bar nus/ /de bzhin sems stobs 7chen po'i tshul khrims kyi11/ /go bgos legs bsrungs glang 1 chen zhon nas su/ /gsang sngags gzhu thogs bzlas brjod mda' 'phen pas/ /'byung po la sogs mtshan mo rgyu las rgyal/ / sgur po 1 yan lag lhag chad thung ngu dang / /de bzhin ring po 7yang na sasbom po 'am/ /smad pa'i mngal nas 78skyes pa 1 ma ning ngam/ /rnam pa de 'dra'i ro dag spang bar bya18/ /ma zhu ba dang rims drag tshad pa dang / /'khru skyug bcings dang chu dang gsal shing dang / /sprul gyis 19gsad dam dug gis shi ba 'am/ /bad kun sbrul ci sogs mthong dmigs 22bsad pa la/ /yan lag tshang zhing kha bzhin rme lham smad pa/ /lus la rma med skyes pa'i ro mthong na / /ral gri be con lag na thogs pa yis/ /nyin par thog thag tu ni bsrung bar bya/ /dur khrod khang stong dang ni shing gcig dang / /bzhi mdo 25'bab chu dag gam chu klung ngam/ /mtsho 0'am rgya mtsho 'am ni ri bo la/ /skad cig gis kyang ro langs 'grub par 'gyur na/ /gang yang rung ba'i gnas gcig 9brtags nas ni/ /sa dang lci ba la sogs byug par bya / /gtsang ma der ni dkar nag dmar po 'am/ /tshon rtsi sna tshogs rnams kyis dam tshig sa bri/ /gong du smos pa'i dkyil 'khor de rnams las/ /bsams nas 'dod pa gang yang rung ba gcig /dad pa chen pos rigs kyi yum gyi 96—462

mchog /zlos shing rab tu bsgrims te bri bar bya/ /'jigs pa med pa'i g.yog gis 07de blangs nas/ /khyer nanas /chi'ongs te 4ku sha'i steng bzhag ste/ /skra dang kha spu rnams (5)kyang bregs nas su / /de yi mod la 'bru mar dag gis bsku//de nas bum pa zhabs mi gnag pa bzhi/ /gtsang ma'i chus bkang khrus rtsis sbyar te bkru/ /de nas gos dkar phrugs cig 7bskon nas su/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dbus su rtswa nastan 9ridang / /ma nyams me tog steng du ro bzhag cing / /ro yi mgo bo shar ram byang du bstan/ /dri yis byug cing 1 bdug 11pas bdug 15par bya/lha/ /phreng bas yogadags shing me tog sil mas gtor/ /sha dang nya sha mar khu til bsres pa'i/ /khur tshab la sogs ci sasnyed bungs bskyed lha de/ /'byung po klu dang sha za gnod sbyin dang / /'dre la bla 'og phyogs su sbyin par ’ bya / /grogs po mchog ldan bdag nyid bsrung bya ste/ /rtse gcig sems kyis gsang sngags bzlas brjod bya/ /ro ni ldang du nye ba'i tshe na ni/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can bgegs ni sna tshogs 'byung / /gtsug tor rgyal po'i 19sngags kyis thal ba 'am/ /ma grugs yungs kur 1sogs la bsngags 22nas su/ /gtor nas 2)phyogs bzhi dag nas 'ong ba'i 2 bgegs/ /gsang sngags mthu yis de dag 'byer bar 'gyur/ /de dag zhi bar bya phyir khro bo ni/ /bdud rtsi thab 25sbyor drag shul las can sbyar/ /bgegs rnams bcom pas de nas ro de yang 2dzi/ /gsang sngags mthu yis myur du ldang bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig gsang sngags cho ga zhib mo las/ /mthong ba de ni thogs med nges par 'grub / /gal te ro de langs par gyur pa las/ /de yi gsang sngags cho ga mi shes na'ang / /gsang sngags gzhan du bstan pa'i cho ga yis/ /langs pa de la rang gis 29dngos grub 96wa 463

blangs1 / /gter gyi phyogs dang na phug tu 'gro ba dang / /ral gri añdza ri rabazhon pa mngag gzhug dang / /'byung khung 4gser 'gyur rtsi dang bcud kyis len/ /mkha' la 'gro ba'i dngos grub rab tu ster/ /bsrung 55)ba'i stobs med sngags kyi stobs med dang / /dka' thub stobs med sems stobs med pa yi/ /blo zhan gang zhig ro langs dngos grub tshol/ /de ni mtshan mo rgyu ba rnams kyis bsad/ /'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i le'u drug pa'o// //mi gang mi yi sha ni 'tshong 'dod des/ /mar gyi ngo la dur khrod song nas su/ /shing rdo mtshon dang dug dang dbyug to sman/ /bgegs la sogs pas shi bar gyur pa yi/ /byin pa 6brla dang 7ske dang mgo bo dag58) /'jigs pa med pas mtshan mo blangs nas su/ / gtubs te kong 97bu'am gyo dum gsar pa dang 7/ /gtsang ma der ni mi nyung bzhag byas la11/ /lus la khrag gi 1 lag rjes bris nas su / /rgyu mas mgo dang mgrin pa dkri bar bya/ /lus la mi lpags sar pa bgos nas kyang / /lag g.yon shas bkang gyo mo 1 thogs nas sus/ /khrag gis bskus pa'i ral gri lag g.yas kyis15/ /rab tu bsgrims nas de ni thogs nas kyang / /sgra cher bod lacing tshig tu sha 'di dag /khyed cag su zhig nyo bar byed 'dod ces / /shar dang nub 1 dang lho dang byang 12phyogs su/ /myur du bskor cing 19shin tu brjod par bya/ /ci ste lus ni snang ngam mi snang bar/ /tshig gis khyod ni nor ram rig pa 'am/ /bcud kyis len pa'am grong ngam rgyal 2 srid dam/ /phug tu 'gro ba'am 21ci 'dod ces zer na/ /sngar ni gang zhig sems kyis bsams 22pa'i don/ /de nyid smra yi gzhan ni da smra mi bya/ /rig pa mang po 96wa 464

bsten 6)pa'i dur khrod 'dir/ /don 'di'i naphyir ni sdug bsngal drag po yis/ /bdag kyang gdungs bzhin 'ongs kyis ri 'di nyid na/ /yod na sha 'di lakhyer la bdag la byin/ /ci ste srang la bcal te (5ma gang na/ /rang gi sha yis de ni dgang bar bya/ /gal te dur khrod 'di ni stong pa ste/ /nor med bu khyod gzhan du song 6shig ces/ /mtshan mo rgyu bas de skad bsgo 7na ni/ /de la bdag ni gang du 'gro zhes dri/ /lan thob de nyid narang gis brtags nas su/ /sha de bor nas de nas 'gro bar bya/ /sha yi cho ga gang zhig 9ngas gsungs pas/ /gsang sngags ma bzlas pa yis 1lhabasten mi bya/ /rigs mchog gtsug tor 12stobs chen la sogs pas/ /dur khrod du ni bsrung 1 bar ngas gsungs so/ /gsang sngags drag po tshagang zhig sha za ba/ /de la dur khrod mi sha'i sbyin sreg 12bya / /ral gris tshasor gnyis sor gsum 1 tsam dag 18tu/ /gtubs 19nas me la sbyin sreg )stong du bya nya/ /me tog ma nyams 'bras yos sha khrag nya/ /chang dang 22sbrang rtsi bu ram chang dang til/ /bdug pa phreng ba byug pa na mar me chan / /lha bshos gtor ma dur khrod gtor bar bya/ /dbab dang 25bskrad dang gnyid 20kyis myos bya dang / /dmag gzhom grong na khyer phung bar bya ba dang na / /sha za ma mo drag mo ni srin mo'i tshogs/ /gnod sbyin rnams la mi sha'i sbyin sreg ri bya/ /mi yi sha ni rnyed par ma gyur na/ /ba glang 2sha yi sbyin sreg de bzhin shis/ /ma he'i sha 'am khyi sha mar bsres la/ /tshes grangs dag la smyung byas sbyin sreg dbya/ /gnod sbyin mo yi cho ga zhib mor ni/ /gsang ri sngags mnyes byas grub pa 'di rnams ster/ /ma dang sgyug mo sru mo grogs mo dang / /bu mo chung ma mna' rimar grub par 'gyur/ /ma dang sgyug mo sru 7mo gang yin de/ /yid bzhin rin chen 96wa 465

bzhin du grub pa mchog /yid 'ong grogs mo bu mo 1)grub pa 'bring / /chung ma mna' nam grub pa tha mar bsgrags/ /dus gsum du ni 5)me tog phreng ba dri/ /mar ram ca'abru mar mar me tsan+dan dang / /a kur 5nidri zhim bdug pas mchod pa dang / /gtor ma sna tshogs rtag tu mtshan mo sbyin/ /gnod sbyin mo ni dga' nas mngon phyogs nas/ /rnyed pa rnyed cing sa bon 'byung bar byed/ /'dod chags zil gyis non pa'i bud med dag6) /gnod pa (7byed pa nges par gnas par 'gyur/ / bsams na phung bar yang ni 'gyur ba nyid/ /tsho dbud med gnod pa byed tshe 9'gro mi bya/ /rnyed pa mang nyung la yang 'dod mi skyeda'i/ /sngags pas 11mtshan mo khu ba dgag byas nas/ge/ /brtson 'grus rab tu bskyed de bsgrub par bya/ /sems rmongs gang gis 12gzhan du brtsam 'byas na/ /gnod sbyin mos ni myur du phung bar byed/ /7sha za'i laganod sbyin ma la'ang de nyid de/ /de las cho ga lhag pa 'di rnams bya/ /sha chang la phug tshod ma cung peng dang / /nas chan ’ ma sha chan dang 'bras chan nya/ /gtor ma de dag kun 1rtedu bdug pa dbul19 / /gnas ni khang stong dag gam dur khrod shis/ /me tog shir sha kun dur na arka dang / /bil ba 'bri 25ha ku sha rardza 22ka /a gas ut+pal a ta ru sha ka /se'u can mya ngan tshang sogs me tog dbul/ /klu la bu ram 'o ma mar sbyar ba'i/ /bdug pa dri zhim a kur tsan+dan dri/ /phreng ba me tog dri zhim sna tshogs dang / /'bras chan 25zhe dang 'bras yos 'bras bu dbul tsho/ /ba dan sngon po bum pa sngon po dang / /gos kyang sngon po lha bshos gtor ma dri/ /phreng ba me tog byug pa 2 sngon po dag /ci 2 snyed brang sa gis 'gro ba rnams la dbul //mthe bong me long ral gri chu dang shel/ /mar me sa gzhi lcags dang nam mkha' 96wa 466

dang —/ /lhung bzed nor bu dag dang me 'bar ba/ /'di la gsal bar ston pa rtag tu 'byung / /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs da ltar byung 1/ /mtho ris sa steng ridus dang mi ldan yang / /lha ( byedang lha min dge dang mi dge ba'i/ /las rnams thams cad gsal bar ston par rtogs/ /cho ga nyams pa'am yang na phyed bzlas pa'am / /yi ge chad dam yi ge lhag pa ci'am/ /bzlas brjod ma byas dad pa med pa dang / /mchod pa med cing sa gzhi mi gtsang dang / /sprin gyi tshogs kyis nyi zer bsgribs pa dang / /byis pa yan lag nyams shing lhag pa dang / /de lta bu la mi yi gsal ston pa/ /'bab 5par mi 'gyur dgos pa yong 6mi ston//gsal ston dbab phyir sngon du cho ga bzhin/ /bzlas shing tshes grangs bzang la sngags pa yang / /smyung byas dgongs kur 7sa dang lci ba yis/ /ba ko tsam gyis sa gzhi 98)legs par byug /byug spos dang ni me tog bdug spos dang / /lha bshos mar me dag kyang phul nas su/ /byis pa gzhon nu sta gon gnas par bya/ /de nas nang 9)par cho ga 'di kun bya/ /khrus byas lus la gos dkar gtsang bgos 7te/ /shar phyogs kha bltas 11ku sha'i stan 12steng dulha / /'dug nas gsang sngags rjes su dran par bya/ /me long thal ba gtsang mas lan bdun nam/ /brgyad dam yang na bcur ni phyis nas su/ /rtse gcig sems kyis sagasang sngags zlos bzhin du/ /bus dpa gzhon nu nub tu kha bstan nasal/ /lha yi mig gis bltas na 'das pa dang / /da ltar dang ni ma 'ongs mthong bar 'gyur / /me long zhes bya'i cho ga mtha' dag ni/ /ral gri gsal bar ston la 1 sbyar bar bya/ /mthe bo (tshergya skyegs )khu bas bskus nyanas su/ /'bru mar dri zhim dag gis bsku bar ni bya/ /bum pa gtsang nam chus bkang mi g.yor bzhag /sa btsags 596—467

lhung bzed nor bu chu yis dgang 1/ /sku gzugs la ni byug (2spos /me tog dbul / /de nas bus 4pa gzhon nus blta bar bya/ /gsal bar ston dang 5mi lam la sogs pas/ /dngos grub brtags te de nas bzlas brjod bya/ /gal te yid sgroches par ni 7ma gyur na/ /de nas rig sngags mi gdug 587bzlas brjod bya / /nga yi 9gsang sngags dag pa gang yang rung / /gso sbyong byas nas nan tan bzung nas su/ /rgyal ba'i ring bsrel mchod rten drung du bzlasa'i/ /yang na sku gzugs ma nyams spyan sngar 11bzlas/ /lus dang (12ngag yid lag pa mig dang ni/ /smin mtshams yan lag rnam par g.yo ba dag /rab tu bsdams nas de la 15yid gzhol zhing / /byams la gnas shing ku sha'i khres la 'dug /ji srid du ni rtse gcig gnas 'gyur 7pa/ /de srid bar mdu 4'bum mam 1 nyis 'bum bzlas/ /nga yi 18gsang sngags hūm̐ zhes bya ba 'dis/ /shing la'ang 'bab na mi la smos ci dgos/ /de nas dbab pa'i snod rnams brtag par bya/ /bu mo gzhon nu lo bcu'am bcu gnyis pa/ /bcu 'am 19brgyad dam ribadun nam bzhi 'am gsum/ /yang na khye'u'ang rung ste gnyis sam lnga 1/ /tshigs rus rtsa mi mngon zhing 25gzugs bzang ba/ /yan lag rdzogs shing mig dkyus ring la dkar / /kha bzhin zla 'dra mche ba mnyam la rno/ /sor mo thags bzang mdzes la long bu nub/ /lte ba zab cing mdzes la nu mjing 2 legs/ /ba spu re re skra yang gnag la stug /lto ba mi rlo na gnyer ma gsum dang ldan/ /mdog kyang bzang zhing mnga' byad dang yang ldan/ /gang la yid dga' lta ba brtan par 'gyur / /lta 25bas kyang ni ngoms par mi 'gyur dang / /lha gzhan dag la mi phyogs dbab pa'i snod sha/ /tshes grangs bzang la nyin zhag gcig tu ni/ /96wa 468

smyung ba byas pas bdug 91)spos phreng ba dang / /tsan+dan me tog mar me narnams kyis mchod/ /bza' dang 'bras chan la sogs gtor ma mang / /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin rnams la sbyin/ /dbab pa'i snod rnams khrus byas gos dkar bskon / /shar phyogs kha bltas rgyan 4ni rnam par spangs5/ /byug spos me tog la sogs de la sbyin/ /bdug pas bdug cing gsang sngags bzlas 6brjod bya / /hūm̐ gi ( gsang sngags thog mar bzlas nas su/ /grihā na.ā 9be ’ sha zhes brjod par bya/ /mig ni gdangs shing 'dzums 11par mi byed na/ /rdzogs par gyur par shes par byas nas su/ /'jigs pa med par 1 de tshe dri bya ba ri /mchod yon bodang ni bdug pa phul nas su/ /rig pa mchog gi sagasang sngags dran byas nas/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni lha phyogs sagang yin dri/ /dus gsum dag gi 1 bdag gi dgos pa gang / /de ni legs par dgongs la 18bka' 465 cig /bde dang sdug bsngal dngos grub thob mi thob/ /shes nas de yang de bzhin bzung 19nas su/ /de ma thag tu slar yang gtang 2 bar bya/ /mi gdug 1sngags bzlas cho ga 'di rnams kyis/ /dbab pa'i snod la mi yis 2 phebs gyur gyi ri/ /gang zhig blun pas gzhan du brtsams na ni/ /de ni mi rnams kun gyis dpyas par 'gyur/ /zhi zhing gzhungs 25la rgya che 20dkyus kyang ring / /brtan zhing gzi chen 2 mdangs ldan dmar bar snang / /'dzums zhing 'byed med lha yi smyomig dang 'dra/ /dbab pa'i snod la lha babs de ltar 'gyur/ /mig ni rab tu dmar zhing zlum por 'dug /bgrad 1cing rab tu mi sdug 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /'dzums pa med cing 'jigs med blta dab na / /srin po lto 'phye gnod sbyin babs pa'i mig /gal te babs pa'i gisnod ni mi gtong na/ /96wa 469

shin tu bkra shis tshigs bcad 1brjod pa 'am/ /stobs po che'am dgod ma'am (2lcags kyu dbazlas/ /yang na rab tu 'dus pa'i mdo sde bklag /seng ge gdan gyi arka'am capa la sha'i/ /yam shing mar gyis bskus pa brgya yang bsreg(ge /ma grugs til ni sbrang 6rtsi 'am mar gyis bskus(ge/ /gtum pos sbyin sreg (8)nyi shu rtsa gcig bya/ /snga ma bzhin du gsang sngags cho ga dag /dam tshig ci nyu༄bzhin ma lus sbyar na 7ni/ /bdag gi 11yid dang mthun sna pa'i dngos grub thob/ /sngags pa yun ring nyon mongs mi 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i le'u bdun pa'o// //sangs rgyas kyis gsungs yan lag brgyad lam ni51ge/ /yang dag 'tsho midang las mtha' ting 'dzin dag /rtsol dang rtog dang dran dang lta ba rnamasa'i/ /so so so sor yang dag bsten par bya/ /lam 'di rnams kyis gsang sngags dngos grub cing / /de bzhin 'dis ni lothar pa myur du / thob/ /rgyal sras sngon gyi rgyal ba 'das pa dag /'di nas gshegs shing de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur/ /ngoms med sems kyis lus dang ngag yid kyis/ /gus par dge ba'i tsho/rtebasod nams gang 519bsags pa'ang / /bde gshegs gsungs pa'i bden pa'i lam dmigs na/ /dge ba'i lam de yang dag bskyed pa yin/ /yongs su 'dzin pa rnam par spangs nas su/ /chos gos dang ni bsod snyoms thumengan ngon dang / /sman na dang mal stan 2nangan ngon tsam gyis kyang / /chog pa'i sems dang ldan pas bsod nams thob / /bdag la bstod pa nams kyang 25mi bya zhing / /sems can gzhan la smad par mi bya'o/ /stag dang sbrul dang me 'drar 'jig rten dag /96wa 470

bsams nas spangs te dben la dga' bar bya/ /bud med mtshan nyid skyes pa'i 1mtshan nyid dang / /sman dang glang chen brtag pa'am skar ma'i dpyad/ /mtshon cha brtag pa'am rta dpyad rang bzo 'am/ /bstan nabacos ngan pa slob cing klog pa spang / /glang chen rta dang ba lang bya gag khyi/ /gong mo sreg pa 'ug pa skyes pa dang / /bud med bu mo byis pa ra lug sgyu sogs/ /thab 5mo 'gyed pa mi blta 6mi bya'o/ /yul sa'i gtam dang mi dbang bstan pa dang / /dmag dang gyad dang na chung gtam dag dang / /sgrung nasdebs 9dang ni sngon gyi lo rgyus gtam / /'dod chags dang ni smad 'tshong gtam mi bya/ /sngags pa 11gsang sngags bzlas pa mnos pa ni/ /grong dang grong khyer khyim dang gtsug lag khang / /mchod rten bsnyi gnas ri dang dka' thub gnas/ /kun dga' 12lu ma'am rdzing bur 'gro mi bya/ /sngar bshad pa yi gnas rnams ma rnyed na12/ /lha khang stong pa dag gam shing drung ngam/ /ri dang chu bo chu klung 'bab chu dang / /nags 'tshal stong pa dang ni 7yul stong dang / /gnas khogang rung bar sngags pas 1 gnas shing bzlas / /yang na gnas ni nges par ma byas na/ /zla ba brgyad po 'di yi 1 dus dag tu/ /gnas 'di gang yang rung ba zhig 19tu bsten/ /mtsho dang shing dang ri bo'am byedagon pa'i gnas/ /mtshe'u dang khang pa gnas sam chu ngogs su/ /dgun smodapyid zla ba rnams la gnas byas nas/ /sngags pas dbyar ni gcig tu gnas byas te/ /ci 22ltar rgyal bas dge slong dbyar zla gsum/ /tshul zhugs lhaganas gzhan mi 'gror gsungs pa bzhin/ /de bzhin bcom ldan 'das kyis bsngags 25pa yang / /zla ba gsum du gcig tu gnas par gsungs/ /sngags pas dbyar ni bsgrub 20la mi 'jug par/ /bzlas brjod kyis ni dus kyang 96—471

'das 1par bya/ /dbyar 'das dang tshonani gsang sngags gzi bskyed pas/ /bdag nyid bsrung byas bsgrub la 'jug par bya/ /me thab zlum po gru gsum gru bzhi dang / /pad+ma lta bur bya zhing cadabyibs legs shing / /'jam zhing shin tu mnyam par byas nas su/ /de dag sa dang lci bas legs par byug /zlum po 55cidabang thang 6bskyed dang nor dgug dang / /spyan drang zhi ba'i cho ga bya bar shis//gru gsum du ni dgar bskrad bsad 7pa dang / /gshed byed la sogs drag po'i las dkyang bya/ /gru bzhi par 9ni klu dang gsang 7ba pa'i/ /srog bskam 1)pa 'am yan lag gzhig par bya/ /pad+ma'i dbyibs su bud med bu mo'i grong / /yul 'khor 'thob 12pa'am don kun bsgrub par nyu shis/ /me thab lci ba gtsang mas byugs nas kyang / /tha ma thog tog saku sha dgram par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum dang phyag na rdo rje dang / /yum la'ang gedad pas saphreng ba bdug pa dang //dri dang ma nyams me tog ci 1 snyed pas/ /cho ga bzhin du legs par mchod par bya / /yam shing mang po thab kyi drung bzhag ste/ /rlung yab kyis ni me yang spar byas nas18/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag byas khro bo ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pas ma nyams pad+ma 'am/ /ma grugs til nag las ni bdun nam brgyad/ /bcu 'am nyi shur bsreg 1 blugs 2 me la bsreg 1 /ku sha bting ngam 2 khres sam rtswa stan 2 la/ /'dug nas shar phyogs kha bstan 2 rardzas rnams ni/ /mar dang srinasbrang rtsi 'o ma la btags nas smo/ /rang gi gsang sngags bsgrub phyir sbyin sreg 28bya / /me yi 29mtshan ma sdo nye bar brtag pa da ni/ /me stag du ba me lce sgra rnams las / / grub pa dang ni mi grub ra thams cad kyang / /sngags kyis byin brlabs lhame ni ston par byed/ /du ba med cing gser gyi mdog ltar dngas / /me lce 96—472

rab tu che la g.yas su 'khyil/ /kha dog 'ja' 51'dra yang na dkar nayang rung / /yang na byi kunararu bcag pa'i kha dog 'dra/ /shin tu snum la me lce sgab canas 'phro/ /rab tu 'bar ba nyi ma'i 'od zer 'dra/ /dbyibs ni bum pa rgyal mtshan gdugs kyang (ge'adra/ /dpal be'u dang ni 6pad+ma blugs gzar 7'dra/ /me lce tri shul 98)rdo rje ral gri 'dra/ /yang na shing rta mchog dang rnga yab 'dra/ /rdza rnga rnga chen dang ni gling bu'i sgra/ /du ba me lce dri zhim me stag bzang / /yang na ma spar bar ni (9)'bar 'gyur 1 na/ /de tshe dngos grub rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ / dud pa 37che zhing me stag rgod pa dang / /'bar bar dka' zhing cung zad cung zad 'bar/ /me lce rnam par chad cing gzi mdangs 15med/ / rtsub gnag 15sprin dang pa la sha yi mdog /gsal shing 'dra zhing zhib ma'i gzugs kyang 'dra/ / phyugs kyi tshamago 'dra skra 0yang rab tu rtsub/ /me lce 'phro bas sbyin sreg sa byed pa tshig /mi ro'i dri nga dngos grub med pa 1 ston/ / me lce'i 1 mtshan ma 'di 'dra 19mthong nas kyang 2 tsho/ /stobs po che yi 21mar gyis sbyin sreg 22bya/ /byin pa dag dang mchan 32khung spu rnams ni/ /lag pas kyang ni btog par mi bya zhing / /me yis mi bsreg spu gris brag 25mi bya/ /spu med bya phyir sman gyis mi byug go/ /ji ltar ral gri so la 20'dzin pa'i mis/ /legs par ma bzung lag pa chod pa ltar / /de bzhin sngags kyang legs par ma bzlas na/ /'bras bu med dam rnayang na phung bar 'gyur/ /mi ni tshul khrims gtsang sbra 9mi ldan yang / /gsang sngags lha ni de la ne riganod mi mdzad/ /lha yi 1'khor du gyur pa gang yin rnams//mi yi glags mthong nas ni phung bar byed/ /bsgrub pa kun la dang po kho nar ni / /lha bshos gtor ma phal cher dbul bar bya/ /sngags pa'i las grub nas 96wa 473
