kyang dus kun du/ /rang gi nyams kyis ci snyed 6)dbul bar bya/ /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang ( lus srul po / /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad g.yog 'khor tshogs dang bcas rnams la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas su/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis / /gnas rinas phan gdags phyir ni 'dir kyi spyon cig /'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu yi 7mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na lhag par gang gnas dang / /mtsho dang rdzing dang cilteng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' 9 richu sil ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas 7grong khyer stong pa 'am1 / /khang stong dang ni 12lha yi khang pa dang / /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas dag gam/ /dka' thub gnas sam 1geglang chen bres dag gamakha/ /rgyal po'i dkor 5khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang 'dun sa 7dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig dang / /dur khrod chen po'am nags tshal chen po dang 1 / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas sna dag dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog rnams na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu 19bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug pa dang / /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul 2 rib/ /'di dag 2stobazhes nas 22btung zhing bsnams da nas su/ /las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod//96—474

de ltar gdon la mchod pa byas nas su/ /de nas phyogs skyong rnams la mchod pa bya / /dbang bdag (1)'byung po'i bdag por nabacas pa yis/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje srin po chu bdag dadang / /rlung dang lus ngan 'byung po gdon dang bcas/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs 4pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang / /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams la/ /so so so sor gtor ma phul ba 5rnams/ /rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang / /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bu smad (neramadza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang / /nang mi dpung bcas dmag dang (7༄thabs cig (8)tu/ /me tog dri dang gtor ma byug par 9bcas 'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang / /bdag gi 1 las 'di'i 11'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /de ltar gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba la/ /gtor ma gtong ba'i las rnams byed pa de'i/ /dngos grub myur zhing shin tu bgegs kyang med / /yid du 'ong ba'i 'dod pa'ang thob par 'gyur/ /'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i le'u brgyad pa'o// //gang zhig dgra bcom pha ma gsod 12pa dang / /mthun nyanapa'i dge 'dun dbyen ni byed pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs la sasdang ba'i sems kyis su/ /nam zhig mi dag sku mtshal ge'abyin byed pas/ /shin tu mi bzad pa yi 1 las 'di hu rnams/ /rgyal bas mtshams med lnga po yin par bshad/ /gti mug can gyis sdig pa gcig byas kyang 36/ /phung po 'di la grub pa thob mi 'gyur/ /mchod rten 'jig 2 tshocing byang chub sems dpa' gsod/ /nyon mongs zad pa'i 96wa 475

ma 1ni sun 'byin dang / /slob pa gsod cing dge 'dun mnga' ba la/ /gang zhig 'dod pas mang nyung na rku 'phrog pa/ /mtshams med nye 557lngar de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /tshul nyams mi ni cagang zhig 55)'di byed pa/ /bskal pa'i bar du mnar med sdug bsngal myong / /gsang sngags dngos grub bsgrims kyang yong mi thob6/ /gang zhig bde gshegs gsung 7gi glegs bam dag /chud gson 8pa dang mes ni sreg 1 pa dang / /bsam pa ngan pas chur ni 'dor ba dang / /yang na chos kyi sku ni spong ba 'am/ /bslab tshig ma lus pas ni brgyan 1nyepa yi/ /dge slong dag 1nagam dge slong ma gsod dang 1lha/ /dge bsnyen skadang ni dge bsnyen 15ma gsod dang glu/ /ngan pa'i sems kyis lha khang bsregs nyu kyang rung / /mi yi yul na sdig pa 'di byas pa/ /dka' ba spyod par hu ldan yang grub mi thob/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa yi/ /bsam pas gnod pa cung 19zad byas kyang rung / /bdag nyid ngan pas dmyal bar btsos 2 rmepar 'gyur/ /de nas shi nas las kyi dbang gis yang 21/ /rigs ngan mi yi nang du skye ba 'thob/ /'di dag ngas ni khyod la mdor bshad do da/ /gang zhig byang chub sems ni blangs pa las/ /rmongs pas 'jig rten lha tshogs phyag byas na / /de dag de la mi dgar gyur nas su/ /de yi gsang sngags dngos grub nyams par byed/ /gang gi tshe na sems ni dang ba yis/ /mi yi yul na byang chub sems blangs pas ri/ /de ni phyin cad 27lha dang lha min dang / /'jig rten ma lus rnams kyis phyag byar 'os/ /mis 2 ni mngon par mtho ba ma lus pa'i/ /bslab pa mtha' dag blangs par gyur pa dang / /sems can kun la mi 'jigs sbyin pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum gyi rgyud du snying nas skyes // /gang zhig mi 96—476

bzad las byed thub pa gsod/ /rig sngags gcod dam gnod par 1byed pa'am / /bsam pa ngan pas gsang sngags tshogs mi mchodan/ /don med bzhin du sen mos rtswa (gugacod dang / /rkang pas rkang pa nyed par byed pa dang / /phyugs (4)la sogs pa'i (5)tshogs kyi 6sna 'bugs 7dang / / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la ni mi gus pa/ /(8)'byung por 9)byin pa'am 1 lha yi gtor ma 'am/ /sa la lhung ba (7sngags pas bza' mi bya/ /'dod chags zil gyis gnon pa'i 12dud 'gro dang / /bud med bgrod bya min par 'gro mi bya/ /glang chen mi gdul 1lhasbrul yang mi gzung yozhing / /rta rgyug glo rdebs lcag gis gzhu dmi bya/ /las de rnams dang ldan par gyur pa de'i/ /dngos grub nam yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro / /sems can nad kyis gdungs dang sdug bsngal la/ /rtag tu byams pa yang 7ni yid la bya/ /dper na nam mkha' mtha' 1 thug med pa la/ /'dom gyis gzhal bas sna mtha' rtogs mi nus ltar/ /de bzhin dkon mchog gsum la brten nas ni/ /phan dang 19gnod pa 2 byas pa'i 21mtha' mi rtogs/ /rgya dang rnyi 2 dang bong rgya 'dzol bu yis ri/ /khyi la sogs pas sems can gsod pa dang / /bya rog la sogs gzeb kyis bcing 25byas na tsi/ /'di dang pha rol du yang grub mi thob/ /bdud dgra'i me tog rnying pa bor ba rnams/ /rkang pas mi rdzi mgo la gdags mi bya/ /bkres 2pas gdungs 29kyang de dag rnams la ni/ /phul ba'i lha bshos rnams kyang bza' mi bya/ /'jigs kyang tshangs pa brgya byin khyab 'jug dang / /drag po rlung la ra sogs la phyag mi bya/ / de yis 1bshad pa'i chos la bsten mi bya t+t+waṃ/ /de dag dka' thub mi spyad rtags mi mchod/ /de rnams chos la'ang ngan sems mi bya zhing / /de yi 2spyod la nams kyang tshodaga' mi bya/ /96—477

de dag bstod pa mi gdon sngags mi bzlas/ /sbyin pa byin tshe zhi)snying rje bskyed (genas sbyin/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis brten (5)pa yi/ /gnas dang rgyal sras rnams la phyag bya'o/ /rang sangs rgyas dang rgyal ba'i nyan thos rnams/ /de dag rtag tu phyag bya'i gnas yin no/ /ji ltar zla ba tshes la mi rnams ni/ /phyag 'tshal nya la lus can phyag mi 'tshal/ /de bzhin dad pas rgyal ba'i thugs sras la/ /phyag bya'i cade ltar bde bar gshegs la min/ /'jig rten kun gyi mngon mthong bslab 5pa can/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i don du ni/ /skye ba len pa de la ci yi 6phyir/ /bu gcig 57)bdag nyid kun der (kyephyag mi bya/ /skyes bu bsam yas rmad byung rdzu 'phrul can/ /de la mi ngan gang zhig mi 'dud pa / /de la rgyal ba thams cad thugs nur nas/ /de yi gsang sngags dngos grub mi stsol lo9/ /dper na shing gi me tog dang por ni/ /yid 'ong phyi nas 'bras bur gyur pa 7ltar/ /sems can mchog rnams me tog 'dra bar k+ṣ-i/—1ltos/ /'bras bu bzhin du rgyal 12ba rig par gyis1 / /gang zhig rang bzhin chags dang ñdza rnam 5bral yang / /brtse sal snying rje 1 khro la khro ba dang / /'dod chags can la chags can ltar ston pa/ /byang chub tshul gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig las dang rnam smin mkhyen pa yis1she/ /'gro ba kun dang ci tu ltar mthun du )pa yi / /gsang sngags gzugs kyi rjes su 'jug mdzad pa/ /sngags kyi rnam nya'adren de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i le'u dgu pa'o/ / //lha dang lha min mi la phan gdags phyir/ /gsang sngags rig sngags rnam pa 96—478

sna tshogs dang 6)/ / 'bum phrag lnga dang bye ba phrag gsum dgas /rig 'dzin sde snod bshad par rgyal bas gsungs/ /ngas ni gsang ba pa rnams gzhom pa dang / /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor bcas shing phyag rgyar ldan pa yi/ /gsang sngags bye ba phrag bdun rab tu bshad/ /pho nya bcu dang rig pa'i rgyal po 47bdun/ /de bzhin phyag brnyan drug cu 5rtsa bzhi dang / /nga yi snying po dam pa brgyad rnams dang / /khro bo drag po bdud rtsi thab (6)sbyor dang / /rig pa mchog la sogs pa mthu bo che/ /rig pa'i bdag po gsang sngags rjes 'brang bcas/ /de snyed rdo rje'i rigs ni gang yin pa/ /der ni 'di dag nga yis rgya cher bshad/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis 7gsang sngags bye ba phrag /gsum dang de bzhin 'bum phrag lnga rnams bshad/ /de yi rig sngags bdag po rta mgrin nadang / / de yi 9ming can dkyil 'khor dam pa gsungs / /bcu gnyis phyag dang phyag drug pa dang ni/ /thor tshugs 11cod pan 'dod pa 'byor byed dang / /zhal bzhi don yod zhags 1 par bdun bstan 'di/lha / /sa steng mutshogasang sngags nyi ma bdun ltar 'bar/ /de rnams rta mgrin dkyil 'khor gsang sngags te/ /mi la mchog 7sbyin 'jig rten gsum gyis 'dud / /sgrol ma dkar mo gos dkar spyan tsham dang / /rnam gzigs ral pa gcig ma dkar sham dang / /grags ldan khro gnyer can dang 'di dag rnams/ /pad+mo'i rigs kyi nyu tshorig sngags rgyal mo mchog /de dag dkyil 'khor sna tshogs gzugs can dang / /phyag rgya rnam pa sna tshogs rnams dang ldan/ / rgyas pa'i gsang sngags rgyud du 'og pag 19can/ /rig 2 pa'i dbang phyug gsang sngags bdag por bsgom nya/ /de yi 22gsang sngags mi la grub mchog ster/ /de la lngas ri96wa 479

rtsen yang ni mngon par dga'/ /gnod sbyin dbang phyug de dag 0)rtag mthun (gepas / /de yi bka' yis gsang sngags tshogs (47rnams bshad/ /lngas rtsen gyis ni stong phrag nyi shu ste/ /de yi chung mas de yi phyed (5)bshad do55)/ /nor gyi bdag pos stong phrag sum cu 7ste/ /gang po 58)pha yis kyang ni 'bum bshad do/ /lha dang lha min la sogs rgyal ba la/ /dad pa rnams kyis gsang sngags mtha' yas bshad/ /kha cig nga yi rigs su gtogs pa ste/ /kha cig kyang ni pad+mo'i (9rigs su gtogs/ /kha cig nor gyi rigs su gtogs pa yin/ /gzhan yang kha cig gnas med rnam par 'khyam/ /nor spyod ces bya nor gyi rigs su gsungs / /nga 1 ni rdo rje'i 11rigs zhes 12rab tu bstan/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang pad+ma'i rigs yin te/ /rigs bzhi pa ni 'dir yang lngas nyu rtsen yin/ /gsang sngags mdo sder 1 ngas bshad gang yin tenyu5/ /bzhi po 'dir ni rnam par sbyar bar bya/ /gzhan yang 'di na 7kha cig gnas med par/ /bde bar gshegs la brten 1 cing yongs 'khyam pa18/ /mdo sde 'dir ni de dag thams cad kyang / /'byor pa 19'dod pa'i mis ni rnam par sbyar/ /lam 'di nyid du zhugs pa'i sngags pas ni/ /yid dang mthun zu pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur//srid gsum nang na rgyal ba dkon mchog ste/ /de yi 'og tu de las byung ba'i chos / /de yi dge 'dun skyes chen brgyad po ste/ /srid pa gsum na dkon mchog gsum po gtso/ /'di gsum bsod nams rnam 'phel rgyu yin pas/ /dngos grub 'dod pas gsang sngags mgo la gdon/ /bsod nams ched dang log 'dren rmongs bya'i 21phyir/ /phyag na rdo rje gtum mchog phyag 'tshal zhes/ /gsang sngags rnams kyi mgo la sbyar bya bar / /gnod sbyin mgon po na ngas ni 96wa 480

bshad pa yin/ /nor gyi rigs dang pad+ma'i rigs la yang / /rang gi gsang sngags bdag por ldan par bya/ /bde bar 1gshegs 2min nyan thos lam zhugs dang / /rang da rgyal rnams kyi lam la gnas pa dang / /dad pa med cing tshul 'chos (4)'jungs pa yis/ /nga yi rdo rje nam yang bcang 5mi bya/ /gang zhig theg pa mchog la sdang ba dang / /bdud kyis bshad pa yin zhes zer 6ba dang / /rmongs pa 97nong la gnod sbyin zhes smra dang / /byang chub sems dpa' la ni mi 'dud pa'i/ /dge slong dge slong ma dang dge bsnyen dang / /dge bsnyen ma dang 'jig rten pa rnams kyis/ /nga yi rigs kyi gsang sngags bzlas brjod na / /de dag rnams kyi 8lus ni myur du 'jig /gang zhig nga 9rigs rjes su 'brang ba'i gdon/ /'byung po gnod sbyin klu dang sha za yis/ /nga yi sngags brjod khordo rje thogs pa dag /mthong na 11khros nas phung bar byed par 'gyur/ /gang zhig theg mchog rgya chen klog pa dang / /de la dad cing de 12nyid 'chad par spro / /brtson 'grus che zhing byang chub sems brtan 1 pa/ /de la nga yi gsang sngags mchog sbyin mdzad/ /ngas ni 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas pa'i/ /gsang sngags yangs shing rgyas par bshad pa yin/ /de nas gzhan yang 'jig rten pa bsdus nas/ /zhar skal bshad pa 'di dag khyod kyis nyon/ /drag po yis ni bye ba phrag bcu bshad/ /nor lha'i bus ni stong phrag sum cu 7ste/ /tshangs pa yis ni stong phrag drug cu tshanyid/ /nyi mas kyang ni 'bum phrag gsum bshad do/ /nam mkha' lding gis 1 stong phrag bcwa 1 brgyad de/ /gtum 19byed mas ni stong phrag brgyad bshad do/ /me yis kyang ni brgya phrag bdun nyid de / /phur bu 21gsum pa yis ni stong bshad do/ / klu yi 2 rgyal po rnams kyis lnga stong ste/ /96wa 481

mtshan mo rgyu dbang 1stong phrag bcu gnyis bshad/ /'gro la phan phyir 'jig rten bdag po bzhis/ /'bum phrag bzhi ni rab tu bshad pa yin/ /lha min dbang pos 'bum phrag gnyis nyid de/ /lha yi dbang pos kyang ni 'bum phrag gsum/ /gsang sngags phyag rgya sna tshogs cho gar ldan/ /so so'i ( ragazhung gi dkyil 'khor rnams dang bcas/ /rang sngags mdo sde'i rjes 'brang ( skadad bskyed na/ /ma bsgrims bzhin du the tshom med par 'grub/ /de las bzlog na dngos grub mi thob la/ /sdug bsngal mang po yang ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i le'u bcu pa'o// //bcud kyis len dang gabyer dang phug 'gro dang / /nor bsgyur (4)'byung khung 55)sngags dang gser bsgyur 6rtsi/ /rin thang med pa'i rin chen nor sbyin te/ / brgyad po bstan 7pa yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /sngags dang phug (8)tu 'gro dang bcud kyis 9 len/ /sdig 9pa spong bar byed pas lho1mchog tu bstan/ /rin chen dang ni gter dang 'byung khung 12'bring / /gser bsgyur tsho rtsi dang nor bsgyur mutha ma'o/ /mi ni sems stobs ldan zhing chos la brtson/ /dka' skuthub kyis phyug dang por bstan pa'i snod/ /rdul geshas che ba la ni 'bring por gsungs / /tha ma la ni mun pa can gyis bsten/ / /gang zhig nyusnyemachog tu bstan pa bsten 19'dod pa/ /des ni tha mar bstan pa rnam par spang / /gal te nor la sred cing sdug bsngal gyis/ /gdungs 2 na 'bring po la ni bsten par stobya/ /lha yi bde ba 22dang ni 'byor pa dang / /tshe dang stobs gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang / /thos sa mang mdangs bzang gcig tu yid gzhungs dang / /dbang 96wa 482

thang che kun dka' thub stobs kyis 1)'thob/ /chags la narnam bral dge la dga' ba dang / /rtag tu dkon mchog gsum la sems gzhol dang / /sdig pa spangs shing bzlas brjod ldan pa yi/da/ /mi la lha rdzas dngos grub ring ba med/ /rdo rje mtshon me gnam lcags mthu 'dra ba'i ca/ /gsang sngags mi 5yi 'jig rten mchog sbyin mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol nyid na yang / /sdug bsngal sel cing sdig 'joms gzhan med do/ /gang zhig dpag bsam ljon pa'i 6shing lta bur(7/ /la lar dngos grub la lar bsod nams dang / /gzhan la gzugs stobs che dang bde ba dag /yid mthun na'abras bu 'dod pa'i mi la stsol/ /gsang sngags sna tshogs gzugs su rnam sprul nas/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal gang zhig 'jigs 6)skrag pa'am/ /rgyal po chom rkun thog gis 'jigs skrag pa'i/ /'gro ba'i tshogs chen mtha' dag skyob par mdzad/ /gang zhig yul dang khyim la bsten yikyang rung / /dka' thub ma nyams rtse gcig sems kyis ni/ /nyin gcig bzhin tunyedu cung zad sngags bzlas na/ /de yi gsang sngags dus shig na ni 'grub/ /cho ga bzhin du dang po 12'bum bzlas nas/ /de nas sngags pa bsgrub tunyel 'jug par bya/ / des na sadangos grub myur du 'thob bo'agyur la/ /gsang sngags cho gas yun ring nyon mi mongasal/ /lus la sa yis dril phyis 1 byas nas su/ /chu chen rnyog pa med par zhugs nas su18/ /ci 19tsam 'dod pa'i bar du khrus byas te/ /byung nas shar ram byang du kha bltas nas/ /chu yis lag pa rkang pa bkrus nas su/ /pus mo phyi rol du ni bstan byas te 1/ /bar du lag bzhag tsog tsog por 'dug nas/ /sgra med dbu ba med pas nye reg bya/ /lan gsum bar du chu ni 'thungs nas kyang / /mchu rnal lan gnyis yongs su phyi 96—483

bar bya/ /so la chags 1pa lce yis reg napa dang / /sbrid pa byung na kha yang bkru bar bya/ /rab byung skyes pa bud med gzhon nu dang / /gzhon nu ma dang rgan po bram ze 4rnams/ /de la nam yang 55sngags pas reg mi bya/ /sngags pas de dag rnams la mi bsam mo/ /brgya la de dag rnams kyis reg gyur tam/ /sgrub ri pos de dag rnams la reg gyur na/ /slar yang khrus dang 'thor 7)'thung byas nas su/ /de nas phyir yang bzlas la 'jug par bya/ /gtsang sbra la dang zlos dga' 8snying rje can/ /rtag tu len pa las ni log pa dang / /slong (9)mo'i zas za lha 7yi las brtson pa11/ /de yi sna lus la gsang sngags 'jug par 'gyur / /'ga' yis bud med gos dang nor rnams dang / /bzhon 1 pa rgyan dang byug pa bza' btung dang / /mal ngastan rnams ni zhumang nyung byin gyur na/ /de la bsgrub 17la gnas pas 1 mi blang ngo / /sa phung bshang sgor lnga ste mtshan la gsum / /g.yon la gsum ste 18lag pa gnyis la bdun/ /yang na sa dang chu yis ci 1 srid du/ /dri ma dri bral de srid bar du bya/ /sos ka na 7nags me 1mched pa'i me lce yis/ /ma bsgrims bzhin du tshang tshing kun bsregs 2ltar/ /bzlas brjod me la tshul khrims rlung gis sbar/ /brtson 'grus chen po'i ri lhame lces sdig pa sreg /ji ltar gangs la nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /gdungs na bzi 2 brjid mi bzod 'ju ba bzhin/ /tshul khrims nyi ma'i 'od zer bzlas brjod gekyis / /gdungs na sdig pa'i gangs kyang zad par 'gyur/ /mun nag dmag tsil mar me phyung ba yis/ /mun nag ma lus sel bar byed pa ltar/ /tshe rabs stong nas bsags pa'i sdig pa'i mun/ /bzlas brjod mar mes myur du sel bar byed/ / ci ste bzlas brjod pa ni sbyin sreg gisas / /gsang sngags 96—484

bsgrubs zhi kyang dngos grub ma thob na/ /'jim pa las ni mchod rten 'bum gdab pa'am/ /yang na chu 'gram bye ma nal yang gdab/ /des ni de yi sdig pa srid gzhan la/ /byas pa gang yin de ni zad gyur na/ /des ni gsang sngags mthu yis 'di nyid du/ /mthong ba'i chos la gsang sngags 5'bras bu 'thob96) / /sngags kyi rtsa ba dang po tshul khrims te/ /de nas brtson 'grus dang ni bzod pa dang / /rgyal ba la ni dad dang byang chub sems/ /gsang sngags dang ni le lo med pa'o/ /ci 7ltar mi dbang yan lag bdun ldan pa/ /skyo ba med par skye dgu 'dul bar byed/ /de bzhin sngags pa'ang 8yan lag 'di bdun dang / /ldan na dngos grub dam pa'ang thob par 'gyur9/ /dang po 1 bzlas brjod phal 11cher byas nas su/ /de yi 'og tu 'dir ni sbyin sreg 1 bya/ /sbyin sreg (snyedag gis gsang sngags mchog myur 465/ /yid du 'ong ba'i 'dod pa'ang sbyin pa (1 mdzad/ /gang gis dpag tshad brgya yi sapha rol nas/ /gsang sngags mthu yis bud med bkug kyang ni/ /bud med ma yin gnod sbyin bu mo ste/ /de gzugs cha byad kyis ni sngags pa bstanas/ /'dod pa'i don phyir bsgrub sna tshopa gang yin de18/ /grub na'ang gnod sbyin bu mos 19sbyin par byed/ /de ni bud med de yi lus su yang / /sprul nas mtshan mo 'dod pa bsten 2 par byed / /ci 21ltar mi dag 'dod phyir bud med la/ /bsten phyir mi yi 2 nor ni zad 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin mo 'am bran mo dag /gsang sngags mthus bkug bsten dpar byed pa'o/ /gzhan gyi chung mar yid la bzhag nas su / /gang zhig de la 'dod gdungs bsten 5byed pa/ /mi shes yid kyis gzhan gyi chung ma la/ /'dod pa spyad pas sdig pa mang po 'thob po/ /rgyal ba la dad 96wa 485

gzhan la phan brtson pa'i/ /lha klu lha min gnod sbyin dri za dang / /grub par bcas pa 1sngags bshad gang yin pa/ /de dag rgyal ba'i nyan thos rang sangs rgyas / /de bzhin gshegs dang byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /ma 'ongs sems can mgon skyabs med rnams la/ /rab tu gzigs nas byin gyis brlab (gepa mdzad / /de dag 'bras bu rab dang 5)'bring dang ni/ /tha mar dbye bas (gernam pa gsum du bstan5/ /mkha' la 'gro dang dpal ri gyi phug tu 'jug /'dod dgu'i 7gzugs can mi snang rnam pa dang / /gnod sbyin bu mo'i 58)khyo dang bcud kyis len/ /mig 9'phrul sgyu ma mtshan mo rgyu ba ste/ /de dag mchog yin 'bring ni sa bdag go/ /grong dang nor dang dbye dang dgug pa dang / /dgar dang bskrad pa dang ni gsad 7pa dang / /klu yi gdon gyis zin pa gso ba dang / /gang yang 'di lta bu dang mthun 11pa'i las/ /de ni mkhas pas phran tshegs yin par bstan12/ /bye brag 12tu ni klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /byis pa gdon gyis zin dang gang dag tu/ /lus can rnams la ngo mtshar sna tshogs dag /ston par byed pa 'phra mo'i 'iphran tshegs 7yin/ /byab dang khu tshur thal lcag skra drang dang / /rna bar bzlas dang dbab dang bskrad pa dang / /gsad tsho tshodang bcing la sogs pas tshar gcad ha dang / /bod dang rig pa'i gos dang sngags gos dang / /rdog pas bsnun 9dang rnam par bskyod pa dang / /mig tu dug song ltar ni gzhug pa dang / /khab kyi 2 gzugs dang khab cing skyug tsho tu gzhugacige /phu zhes bud dang yan lag gzhig 2 pa dang / /brang gis 2ste'agro ba dag kyang tsho dedagug pa dang / /phyir yang bcing dang mnan 27par bya ba dang / /rmongs dang 3 byad 28dang dug zar 29gzhug pa dang / /dug ni gzhan la spo 8 )bar bya ba dang / /96wa 486

lcags kyur ldan pas drang bar bya ba 'am/ /lus la zhen pa'i dug ni bslang ba 'am(1) / /zos par bza' dang zos pa bcad pa dang / /sa bcing ba dang pho nya gtang (gyib dang / /bskrad pa dang ni klu la bstan pa dang / /dung dang rdza rnga'i sgras ni bslang ba ste/ /rnam pa 'di dag dug gi rgyud du bshad/ / sa yi steng na (4)sbrul ni brgyad cu (5)dag /gzhan la gnod par 6byed cing rnam par 'khyam/ /de dag rnams las 57)nyi shu gdengs ka can/ /'khyil pa drug dang dug med bcu gnyis dang / /de bzhin sbrul ni khro bo bcu gsum ste/ /sum cu nagang yin rigs de'i nang du gtogs/ /sbal pa'i mgo dang sdig pa kha brgyad dang / /rnam par dbye na rab tu mang po yod/ /gcin rtug kha chu reg dang mthong ba dang / /mche ba btsugs pa las ni dug kyang gtong / /de las 9dug gi 1 rgyud la mkhas pa yis/ /rab 'bring tha ma gsum du rnam par 11dbye/ /dug mod 12khro ba'i 4snyedabang bsgyur bskrag pa dang / /de bzhin sngangs pa'am bkres pa'i zas phyir ram/ /sha khon tshayod pa'am gshin rjes bstan pa 'am/ /lus la brdzis na de dag za bar byed/ /zos pa de yang rnam pa bzhir 'gyur te/ /mche bas zin yodang sos bcad btab 1 pa'o/ /gang du mche ba gcig 1 gis khrag phyung rjes/ /de ni dug chung pas ni zin 19par bshad/ /gang du mche ba gnyis kyis btab nas su/ /khrag 2 tshodag byung bar gyur pa zos pa'o/ /gal te mche ba gsum gyis sha bcad na/ /de ni bcad par gyur pa yin zhes bstan/ /gang du mche ba bzhi yis btab nas su/ /sbrul gyis 21lus ni zos par gyur pa de/ /btab 2 nas zos pa yin zhes bshad pa ste/ /de ni sman rnams kyis kyang bzlog par dka'/ /me yi rang bzhin gnad 5rnams 'dral dziba'i dug /mtshon 96—487

chen po dang / /mchod rten phyag na rdo rje yi/ /mdun du sgrub 0)pa po yis ni/ /khro rgyal dkyil 'khor bgegs 'joms tshon)bri/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gnas ni bzang po gzhan du yang / /mkhas pa (kyiyis ni khyad par du / /thams cad bri bar bya ba yin/ /rab tu gnas sogs dkyil 'khor kun/ /mkhas pa yis ni khyad par du/ /pad+ma'i mtsho yi nye 'khor du/ /cho ga bzhin du bri bar bya/ /ri yi rtse mor mkhas pa yis/ /mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/ /rnam par gnon sogs dkyil 'khor kun/ /khyad par 'a)du ni bri bar bya/ /rnam par nges pa'i gnas 'di ni/ /khyad par du ni bstan pa yin/ /rab tu bsgrims te thams cad la/ /sa ni rnam gsum yongs su brtag(ge /khyad par phun sum ma ldan na/ /spyi yi las kyis bri bar bya/ /phun sum tshogs par kun bzang ba'i/ /tshogs pa dag ni rnyed par dka'/ /mdor na sa gzhi mnyam pa dang / /mdangs snum 6shar du gzhol ba bzhed( ra/ /chu mang ldan pa'i gnas dang ni/ /ljon shing bzang pos brgyan 5gepa dang / /bdag gi mig yid mgu ba dang / /'tshe med zug rngu spangs pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor gnas su shis pa ste/ /mi yi dngos grub kun thob byed/ /drang srong gnas dang ba glang thostelhas / /phug dang ri yi 7rtse mo dang / /sa gzhi gang na 'thas pa dang / /khang thog dang ni rdo leb dang / /mchod rten drung dang 'bab chu'i gling / /mtsho rnams kyi ni 'gram dag tu/ /sa gzhi 5sbyang zhing brtag pa /shedang / /nan tan du ni bya mi dgos/ /der ni zug rngu dbyung mi dgos/ /'thas par bcag kyang der mi dgos/ /mthon 5dman la sogs skyon rnams kyang ge/ /der ni dogs pa bskyed mi dgos/ /gnyug mar gnas pa'i sa gzhi la/ /byi dor legs par 96wa 512

byas nas su/ /lag pas bram zhing gsang sngags bzlas/ /de yi sbyang ba de yin no/ /zug rngu'i (1ninyes pa thams cad ni/ /gal te dbyung 5bar mi nus na/ /der ni gsang sngags kho nas ni/ /sbyangs pa legs par byas par 'gyur/ /brtan na par 'gyur ba'i las rnams dang / /gdon rnams tshar gcad la sogs dang / /drag shul spyod pa dag la yang / /sa ni brtag 5par bya mi dgos / /dkyil 'khor sa gzhi 6cho ga la/ /khro bo gī li tī 7la yis ba yi rnam lnga la rin)bzlas pa'i/ /bsang 9gtor byas na sbyangs par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyis mi thub la sogs pa/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug tor nyid kyis sbyang / /phyag na pad+ma'i yodakyil 'khor kun/ /sa gzhi 11sbyang bar bya ba ni/ /zhi ba 'dren pa zhes bya yis/ /dpal mos cho ga bzhin du sbyang / /phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /khyad par du ni khro bos sbyang / /las ’ su bya ba thams cad kyang —/ /cho ga bzhin du 'di yis bya/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug dang zhi ba'i 'dren/ /khro bo stobs chen zhes bya ba/ /'di dgasum rigs ni gsum car sagyis/ /las rnams kun la sbyar byas te/ /sa sbyang ba dang bsrung tshab dang / /slob ma sta gon gnas pa dang / /bgegs rnams bsal dang dri dag dang / /me tog mngon par bsngags pa dang / /de la sogs pa'i las kun la/ /bsgrims ’ te sbyang bar bya ba /8yin/ /so so'i rgyud la 19las dang ni/ /gsang sngags rab tu bsgrags pa gang / /ston zla 'bring po'i nya nas ni/ /dpyid zla tha chungs nya yi 21bar/ /'di yi nang du mkhas pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bri/ /bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor nang gcad 2dang / /de bzhin bsgrub dpa'i dkyil 'khor dag /dpyad mi dgos par dbyar yang ni/ /mkhas pas dus bzhin 96—513

bri bar bya/ /slob ma dbang bskur ched du ni/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su bsgrags gang dang / /gnang ba'i dkyil 'khor gang yin dang / /dam tshig dkyil 'khor gang yin dang / /'byor pa'i ched du bsgrub 6)pa dang / /chen po'i dkyil 'khor gang yin pa/ /de dag thams cad mkhas pa yis/ /zla ba bdun po dag la bya/ /yul dang dus dang slob ma dang / /bdog pa'i yon tan shes bya ste/ /mkhas pas dbyar yang dkyil 'khor gyi/ /las ni cho ga bzhin du bri / /dri dang me tog bdug spos dang / /lha bshos sbyin sreg (kyelas kyi rnams/ /phongs par gyur kyang mi dbri ste/ /phri na nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /tshes grangs ngan dang dus min dang / /gnas min cho ga mi ldan par/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor mi bri'o/ /bris na dogs pa med par 'chi/ /mkhas pas ji skad (gebashad pa yi/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo dag la/ /zla ba nya 'am bcu gsum mam kyi/ /tshes brgyad dag gam bcu bzhi 'am/ /tshes bcu dang ni bcu gcig gam/ /yang na yar gyi tshes gcig gam/ /tshes lnga'am yang na tshes bdun nam/ /yang na tshes grangs gsum la'ang rung / /nyi ma bcu po 'di dag la/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bsgrims te 5bri/ /mar gyi ngo yi dus mtshams la'ang ne/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba 'gal ba med/ /tshes lnga'am yang na tshes bdun nam/ /zla ba nya la khyad par du/ /phyag na pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga rnams ni bya bar shis/ /sa yi 'og gi dkyil 'khor dang / /drag shul gyi ni las rnams dang / /khro bo rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gang / /de dag mar ngo la yang bri/ /zla ba nya la khyad par du/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar shis/ /dpyid zla 'bring dang tha chungs 7la/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor chen po bri/ /gang tshe yo byad ldan pa 96—514

dang / /gang tshe dad pa bdo ba dang / /gang tshe las la brtson gyur pa/ /de yi tshe yang dkyil 'khor bri/ /gang tshe 'tsho ba kun mod cing / /me tog mod pa la sogs pa/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dus shes pa'i/ /de yi tshe yang dkyil 'khor bri / /gang tshe slob ma'i bsnyen bkur (11gyis/ /bla ma dag ni mgu tsho gyur pa/ /de tshe de la gnang bas na/ /dbang bskur ched du dkyil 'khor bri/ /nyi ma zla ba gzas zin dang / /ya mtshan che ltas byung ba dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la / /bsgrims te dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /snga dro rgyas pa bskyed dpa ste/ /nyi ma gung la drag shul spyad/ /dgongs kur zhi ba blo can gyis/ /cho ga bzhin du dkyil 'khor bri/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni ma lus pa/ /nyi ma tser tses nub nas brtsam54) / /nyi ma shar bar ma 5gyur par 3/ /mchod nas gshegs su gsol bar shis/ /khyad par can gyi cho ga ni/ /lha dus bya ba dus bzhin bshad/ /gzhan du cho ga nyams pa'i phyir/ /dngos grub 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /spyi yi dkyil 'khor blo ldan pas/ /nam yang nyin par mi bri'o/ /nyin par bris na de dag tu/ /sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ /dgongs mgo btsugs nas nam phyed na/ /drag shul spyod par gyur pa yin/ /mtshan mo dus las 'das pas na/ /nyes pa mang po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mtshan mo rab tu zhi ba'i phyir / /spyir na 'dod par bya ba yin/ /dam tshig dag la sogs pa'i las /de lta bas na mtshan mo brtsam/ /nyi ma nub na lha rnams ni/ /nges par byin gyi rlabs dkyis 'du/ /gzhan dag kyang ni khyad par du/ /byin gyis rlob par byed par 'gyur/ /cho gas spyan drangs gsang sngags dang / /lha yang nyi ma nub pa na / /phan par bzhed 9pas dkyil 'khor du/ /nges par byin gyis rlob par 96—515

mdzad / /yang dag zhi ba'i sems kyis ni/ /dus dang tshes grangs zhi ba la/ /sngags kyis 1spyan 'dren byed pa ni/ /bsams napa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur / /phur bu dang ni zla ba dang / /pa ba sangs dang nyi ma bzang (5/ /gzhan la rab tu drag po yi/ /las ni kun du brtsam ( par bya/ /rgyal dang skag dang sa ga dang / /me bzhi nag pa tha skar dang / /snron 55ril sogs gsum sa ga ni / /dkyil 'khor dag la rab tu 6shis/ /de la sogs pa'i zhi ba dang / /rgyu skar dag ni bzang po la/ /blo dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor bri/ /drag po la ni drag po bri/ /'bebs ldan rnam rgyal rgyal byed dang / /gsal dang dmar ldan ri nor can dang / /bzang mo chu lha tshangs nam dang / /des dang bkra shis khyab 'jug dang / /skye dgu'i bdag dang tha skar byams/ /tshig bzang pa ba sangs pa'o / /yud tsam rnams kyi rgyud 9kun gyi/ /bya ba'i cho ga rnams las shis/ /de dag la sogs bzang po dang / /byed pa bzang la rtag tu bri/ /mi bzang ba la brtsams pa'i las/ /gang du ci yang mi 'grub po/ /de lta bas na yud tsam dang / /tshes grangs rgyu skar byed pa dang 7/ /rmi lam bzang po brtag 1 par bya//bzang po dag la las brtsam ste/ /bzang po min la brtsam mi bya/ /bzang po min pa'i las rnams kyang / /bzang po nyid la brtsam par bya/ /ltas ni bzang dang mi bzang bas/ /grub pa dang ni mi grub ston/ /de lta bas na brtsams pa la / /mtshan ma narab tu 'bad de brtag /de nas gzhan yang sa dag ni/ /sbyang bar bya bar charab tu bshad/ /zhag bdun gyi ni nang logs su/ /ji ltar rigs pas bsrung dbyas te/ / 'jor gyis las 7ni bzlog byas shing / /de nas zug rngu dbyung bar bya/ /zug rngu bcas pa'i sa gzhi ni/ /las byas pa dag 96—516

'grub mi 'gyur/ /zug 1rngu nyes pa rus pa dang / / gyo mo nadang ni thal ba dang / /sdong dum dang ni tsher ma dag /rab tu bsgrims te ma lus dbyung / /de nas tho bas bong ba dag /bkrum nas zhib mor byas te bcag /de nas ba yi gcin gyis ni/ /yang nas yang du gdab bya zhing / /lag mthil lta bur mnyam byas shing / /ba yi lci ba chur sbyangs nas/ /shar phyogs nas ni mgo btsugs te/ /blo dang ldan pas legs par byug /de nas de yi dbus su ni / /khung bu cung zhig brkos nas der/ /'bru rnams dang ni rin chen kun/ /sngags kyis btab ste ri gzhug par bya/ /de ltar sbyangs shing dbyig dag gi / /dbyig dang ldan par byas nas ni/ /blo dang ldan pas ci rigs par/ /sa gzhi 8yongs su gzung 9bya ba/ /yang dag bsdams pas zhag gsum na/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags dang / /gang gi bodakyil 'khor gang yin pa/ /de dag gis ni yongs gzung 11bya/ /gcig gis dri yi chu yis ni/ /dngos su bsang 12gtor bya ba ste/ /cig 1 shos kyi ni lag pa yis/ /sa la bram ste mngon par bsngags / /blo yis yongs su gzung byas na/ /gnas ni yongs su bzung 5ba yin / /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /de nas slob ma yongs su gzung ོ/ /bu mo gzhon nus bkal ba'i skud/ /blangs nas bzhi bcu rtsa dgu ha bzlas / /slob ma rnams ni blos bsams ’ nas/ /mnyam par gzhag 19ste mdud pa bor/ /de nas slob mas yongs bzung nas/ /las 1la bgegs ni med par 'gyur/ /sang 2ni dkyil 'khor bri ba'i 5tshe/ /do nub lta bu sta gon gnas / /thog ma nyi ma shar ba'i tshe/ /sa phyogs kyi ni cha dag brtag /de nas dkyil 'khor dgod pa dag /yid kyis legs par yongs su brtag /sngags 96wa 517

rgyud dag las 'byung ba'i zas/ /bzang la gtsang zhing snum bag can/ /rjes su mthun 1zhing yid 'ong ba/ /slob mar bcas pas (miran par bza' de nas nub kur khrus byas shing / /gtsang la gos ni dkar po bgos/ /bla ma slob ma dang bcas par/ /dkyil 'khor drung du dong ( ribar bya/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sa gzhi cani/ /byi dor legs byas legs byugs la/ /khro bo chen po (5)bzlas pa yi / /spos chus bsang 7gtor byas pa la/ /dbus su sta gon gnas pa dag /rigs rnams kyi ni snying po bzlasagu/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po'i gsang sngags kyis/ /las rnams thams cad bya ba spyodabashad/ / sa gzhi 'osteng du byug spos kyis/ /dkyil 'khor sor grangs bcu gnyis bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni rig 11sngags kyis/ /lag pas dbram 12zhing lan bdun bzlas/ /de nas gtso bo lha rnams ni/ /ming gis yid la bsams nas su/ /byug spos me tog la sogs pas / /snying pos ci rigs mchod par bya/ /lha bshos dag kyang dbul bar bya/ /bdug spos mngon par bsngags pa'ang dbulas/ /de nas tsan+dan sbyar ba yi/ /chu la mngon par bsngags skubya zhing / /de la me tog gis gtor nas / /cho ga bzhin du bdug pas bdug /so shing u dum bā ra 9'am/ /a shwat+tha 1 ni rma med pa/ /ha cang mi sbom mi phra ba'i/ /sor grangs bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ /spos kyi chus ni legs par bkrus19/ /skud pa dag gis rnam par dkrisas / /spos kyis byugs shing bdug pas bdug /lag pas bram zhing 2 rigs kyi 2 ni/ /snying po lan grangs mang po 'am/ /yang na lan bdun bzlas brjod bya/ /slob ri ma rnams kyi grangs las ni/ /so shing la sogs gsog 24par bya/ /so shing mgo zhabs bsnyams 25byas la/ /thor to gcig ni mgor byas nas/ /rtse mo nas ni 96—518

bca' bar bya/ /de nas mkhas pas gnas dang ni/ /bdag dang slob ma brtan bsrungs nas/ /lha rnams thams cad legs mchod de/ /dang por bgegs ni zhi ba'i phyir/ /mar las btags ti pa'i yam (5shing dang / /mar dang sbyar ba'i til dag dang / /mar gyi sreg blugs risbyin sreg dzo bya/ /'bras chan zhor sbyar ( sbyin sreg (6)bya/ /de yi 'og tu snying po ste/ /de nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ridzhani/ /zhi ba'i rig (87sngags nyid kyis bya/ /de nas slob ma legs brtags te/ /sta gon gnas pa tshul bzhin bya/ /slob ma rigs btsun gtsang sbra can/ /snying stobs che zhing chos lhur len/ /dad pa che zhing bzod dang ldan//dran she)dang ldan zhing mkhas pa ste/ /drang chorkan che la mdongs gsol 1 can/ /brtan zhing dul la snyan par smra/ /smra mkhas pa la zlo tshabaskyel can/ /yang dag shes shing byas pa gzos/ /blo dang ldan zhing spobs pa che/ /chen por 'dod cing nga rgyal med/ /mdog dang gzugs dang na tshod bzang / /bstan bcos dag la goms par byas/ /ha cang skami ring mi thung tshal/ /de la sogs pa'i yon tan dang / /ldan pa'i blo can slob mar shis/ /rang bzhin ngan gtum sagayon can dang / /snying rje med cing ngan pas 'tsho/ /yan lag nyams dang yan lag lhag /ha cang dzisgom dang skem dang snar18/ /mig dmar 19gdong ni khro gnyer can/ /kha dog 'byes shing yan lag rnams/ /mtshan dang ldan pa ma yin dang 2 —/ /de 'dra'i slob ma skyon mang ba/ /slob dpon gyis ni spang bar bya//sha tshugs ma legs yon tan med/ /rigs dman zhing ni ngan pas 'tsho/ /nad bu can dang dad med pa'i/ /slob ma rnams ni yongs su spang / /bdag nyid ngan pa'i mi gang dag /smad 'tshong ma la rab gdung zhing / /chang stodad 96wa 519

can dang rgyan la sred1/ /de dag rtag tu yongs su spang / /dkon mchog gsum la sems dad cing / /tshul khrims kyi ni sdom pas bsdams/ /theg pa che la lhag namos pa'i/ /slob ma yongs su gzung dbar shis/ /slob ma yan lag ma nyams dang / /lhag par layon tan ldan pa dang / /nad med rigs ni btsun pa dang / /dad cing brtul zhugs 5brtan par cadakon/ /dkon mchog gsum la gang dad cing / /theg pa chen po'i lugs la dga'/ /bsod nams 'dod pa'i sems can ni/ /chen po de dag mdor gzung 7)ngo / /bder 8)gshegs gsang sngags bsgrub 9pa la/ /don gnyer brtson pa'i slob ma ni/ /gzugs ngan yon tan mi ldan yang / /blo dang ldan pas gzhug 7par bya/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'khor bzhi po / /theg pa che la dga' ba'i bdag /rang gi bslab pa la brtson pa/ /kun gyi cho ga yin par bshad/ /kha cig gsang sngags bsgrub bya'i 1 phyir/ /de las gzhan pa bsod nams 'dod/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol don/ /'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ /'jig rten pha rol ched du ni/ /dad pa chen po bskyed byas nas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'di'i 6'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /'jig rten pha rol don du ni/ /skyes bu tshe 'di 'bras rgyas pa/ /de ltar tshe 'di 'dod pa yi/ /'jig rten pha rol rgyas mi 'gyur/ /mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /lnga 'am yang na bdun dag gam/ /nyi shu dag ni lnga yi bar/ /zung du ma gyur slob ma gzung 5/ /de las lhag pa'i slob ma dag /yongs su gzung labar mi shes so/ /mdor na slob ma phan tshun du/ /nang mi gshin 7pa mi bzung ngo / /gcig la gcig ni sems gzung ha zhing / /zhi dul bla ma la phan pa/ /'phags 96—520

pa'i yul dang rigs skyes pa'i/ /slob ma mdor na gzung 1bar bya/ /de dag bsreg par bya ba yisasgyu / /zas ni za gcig bza' bar bya/ /de yi nub mo ci nus par/ /de bzhin sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug /gtsang ma gos dkar bgos pa yi/ /slob ma de lta bu dag gi/ /shar phyogs kha bltas 'khod pa la/ /sta gon gnas pa brtsam par bya/ /dang po gsum la skyabs su btang / /de nas bla mas byang chub sems/ /ma bskyed pa ni bskyed par bya/ /bskyed pa dag kyang dran par bya/ /de nas khro bo 4bzlas pa yis5/ /spos chu mgo la gtor bya zhing //mgo la brams phyogate mnyam bzhag 7nas/ /lan bdun du yang bzlas brjod bya/ /byug spos dag gis bskus pa yi/ /lag pas mgo la bzhag nabazhin du/ /mkhas pas rig 59pa'i rgyal po yi7/ /snying po yang ni lan bdun bzlas/ /rgyal ba'i rigs la rig tsho/ཿsngags rgyal/ /'khor los sgyur 12ba'i yi ge gcig /pad+ma'i rigs la rig 12sngags rgyal/ /rta mgrin 7yi ge bcu pa'o/ /rdo rje rigs la rig glusngags rgyal/ /de bzhin gnod mdzes mthu bo che/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni bzhi dang ldan/ /las rnams kun la rab tu drag /khro bo bdud rtsi thab 7sbyor ni/ /rigs gsum dag gi tshospyi la yang / /bgegs rnams thams cad gzhom pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba pa yi bdag pos 18bshad/ /de nas las kun byed pa yi/ /sngags kyis 19spyi bor bram 2rtazhing bzlas/ /de nyid kyis ni bsang 1gtor bya/ /bdug spos dag gis rab tu bdug /dbang bskur ba yi bum pa ni/ /'bru la sogs pa kun ldan pa//chu ni cung zad blugs nas su/ /rig 2pa'i rgyal pos mngon bsngags 2te/ / spos chu'i mchod yon phul nas ni/ /cho ga bzhin du sta gon bya/ /me tog dag kyang blugs nas su/ /bdug spos dag gis bdug par bya/ /phyi de nyin par 96—521

dus gsum du/ /mkhas pas bzlas brjod legs par bya/ /dkyil 'khor du yang bzlas nas ni/ /de yis mngon par dbang bskur ro/ /slob ma mthun 1)par tshogs pa rnams/ /byang gi phyogs su kha bltas shing / /thal mo sbyar te 'khod pa la/ /so shing go rims bzhin du sbyin/ /slob ma shar du kha bltas te/ /mi smra bar ni so shing bca'/ /bca' ba zin nas mi dgos sbyo shing / /phan tshun du yang mi dor ro/ /so shing mdun du drang por dor/ /de tshe mdun du lta ①ba dang / /de tshe gyen du 'greng 'gyur na/ /de ni dngos grub mchog ces bya/ /de bzhin shar du kha bltas na/ /de ni dngos grub 'bring du bshad/ /mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na/ /'jig rten pa yi dngos grub 'grub/ /so shing bor ba brgya lam na/ /gal te thur 4༄du kha bltas na/ /de ni nges par sa 'og gi / /dngos grub de la the tshom 55med/ /slob ma nye reg byas nas ni/ /snga ma bzhin du 'khod pa la/ /re re la yang btung tsho raba'i phyir/ /bla mas las kun byed pa yi/ /gsang sngags dag gi 7༄spos kyi chus/ /khyor (kyebar blugs pas lan bdun blud/ /der ni 'thungs 9༄te langs nas su/ /phyi rol du ni kha bkru bya / /de nas khomachod pa yang byas nas/ /bdug spos lag tu thogs nas su/ /blo gros can gyis lha rnams la/ /gus par gsol ba gdab par bya/ /gang gi dkyil 'khor yin pa'i sngags/ /de la thog mar gdas r+shastepar gsol/ /go rims de yi tshul gyis ni/ /lha rnams kun la gdas 57par gsol/ /'di zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sna sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni brtse bar gyur nas su/ /slob ma rnams la brtse geb dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor 'dri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag 896—522

ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang ba 0)mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang su lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i sems can bstan la dga' ba na rnams/ /bdag la dgongs pa mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sang gi dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming / /'di zhes bgyi ba ci nus kyis/ /cho ga bzhin du 'dri lags na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum smras nas ni/ /bsam pa dag pas phyag byas te/ /bstod pa'i tshig kyang brjod nas su/ /de nas slar yang gshegs su gsol/ /'dod chags bral dang ldan pa'i chos/ /slob ma rnams la bshad nas ni/ /ku sha bting ba'i sa gzhi la/ /shar phyogs sngas ltas nyal du gzhug /de nas nang par nam langs nas / /rmi lam ci mthong dri (4)bar bya/ /thos nas bzang ngam mi bzang ba/ /the tshom (5)med par bshad par bya/ /rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong na ni/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin/ /mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong / /de la mchod pa rtsom pa dang / /dge slong dag la chos nyan tam/ /yang na gzhan la nyan kyang rung / /chos ni rnam par spyod pa dang / /de bzhin glegs bam klog pa dang / /rmi lam dge 'dun mthong ba dang / /yang na dge slong gcig po mthong / /de dang 'grogs shing gtam zer dang / /yang na dge slong dngos por gyur/ /gtsug lag khang dag mthong ba dang / /de bzhin dge slong ma dag 96—523

mthong / /rgyal ba'i sras dag mthong ba dang / /de bzhin pha ma bla ma dang / /mdza' bo rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ /rmi lam du ni mthong na shis/ /rig 51)sngags dang ni dngos grub thob/ /de bzhin bslab (gupa 'dzin pa dang / /kun dga' rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /'bab chu rnams dang rgya mtsho dang / /ri dang glang po che dag kyang / /mthong na yang ni bzang snebar bsgrags/ /rgyal po dag ni mthong na shis/ /bder gshegs spyod pa 55tshomathun 65pa yi/ /dka' thub can dang bram ze dang / /phyug po skyes bu dam pa dang / /ba dang rta dang ngang pa dang / /seng ge dang ni ri dgas 7rnams/ /rmi lam du ni mthong na shis / /bkra shes pa yi bya rnams dang / /gser dag dang ni gter rnams dang / /rin po che dang dngul dag dang / /nor ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /mdor na 'byung khungs rnam napa tshogs/ /mtshon (9 cha rnams dang 'bru rnams dang / /'bras bu rnams dang me tog dang / /rgyan ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /kha zas dang ni gos rnams dang / /byis pa dang ni gzhon nu dang / /bud med gzugs ni bzang mo dag /rmi lam du ni mthong na bzang 'i/ /yang na thob cing reg smra dang / /rmi lam du ni dbang bskur dang / /rgyal por gyur pa'i 'byor pa dang / /dmag dpon du ni gyur pa dang / /g.yul las rgyal dang dgra gsod dang / /gnyen dang lhan cig 'grogs pa dang / /lha rnams dag ni mthong ba dang / /theg pa dang ni shing rta zhon/ /de bzhin ri dang khang thog 11'dzeg /ngo mtshar rnam pa sna tshogs dang 12/ /rmi lam du ni mthong na dge/ /yam shing me la sbyin sreg dbyed/ /bya ba bzang po dag la 'jug /chu las rkyal te rong las rgal/ /rkun 1 po dag ni tshar gcod pa/ /stobs 'gyed pa las 96—524

rgyal ba dang / /gyad stobs rdeb cing 'gying ba dang / /rtsed mo sna tshogs rmi ba dang ske/ /de bzhin rtsal spungs byed pa dang / /bkra shis dag ni thams cad kyang / /mthong na rab tu dge bar bshad/ /gsang sngags cho ga nyan pa dang / /dga' ston dge ba mthong ba dang / /bsgrub 1pa bzang po rtsom pa dang / /sgrub pa po dag mthong ba dang / /de la sogs pa'i lha 2rnams ni/ /dge ba rnam pa du ma dag /blo yis rnam par dpyad bya zhing / /de las bzlog pa spang bar bya'o457 / /dge ba rnams ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /mi dge rnams ni mi 'grub po/ /mi dge ba dag shes nas su/ /de dag mkhas pas spang bar bya/ /dge ba yi ni ltas rnams ni/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma las/ /gsang sngags dngos grub rnam yigasum po/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma 'grub/ /mi dge ba la zhi ba yi/ /sbyin sreg 7)zhi ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /ba yi mar la brgya rtsa brgyad/ /cho ga bzhin du zhi bar bya / /de nas slob ma sdig bral zhing / /rnam par dag pa de dag la/ /rjes su brtse bar bya ba'i phyir/ /ci 'dod par ni gzung bar bya /dkyil 'khor gyi ni gsang sngags kun/ /nang par rjes su dran byas nas/ /gos dkar bgos ༷94shing ma yengs par/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 7ni drung du 'gro/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /thog ma nyid du bsang 11gtor bya/ /tshon sna lnga yi srad bu la/ /de dag nyid kyis brgyar 12bzlas te/ /bzang po'i 1lhaltas dang sbyar nas ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig gdab po/ /thig skud kyi ni tshon sna lnga/ /dkar dang dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /sngo dang lnga pa sanag po ste/ /tshon rtsi rnams kyang de dang 'dra/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod bya zhing / /lha rnams gnas la'ang phyag byas nas/ /mkhas pas srad bu bri tshabar 96—525

bya / /nang par nyi ma shar ba'i tshe/ /blo yis phyogs cha legs brtags la/ /dang por 17shar nas bsnyams nate gzung / /slob dpon byang du kha bltas ①te/ /srad bu 'dzin pa de la bltari / /de nas g.yas phyogs bskor nas ni/ /bdag nyid nub phyogs kha bltas 55te/ /de nas srad bu nub phyogs su/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bre 6chibar bya/ /de yi 'og tu byang phyogs su/ /mkhas pas slad bu bre ⑦ bar bya/ /dang por bdag nyid me phyogs su/ /'dug nas phyogs gnyis brtag par bya/ /de yi 'og tu rlung phyogs su/ /phyogs (sheganyis nas ni 5)srad bu bre'o/ /bden bral dbang ldan grwa gnyis nas/ /srad bu 'dzin pa blta (1bar bya/ /gru bzhi 12lham par bsnyams 1 nas su/ / rgya gram du ni srad bu bre/ /yirgya gram thams cad mnyam par bsnyamasang/ /de ltar srad bus gtan la dbab/ /bsnyams dzinas de yi dkyil du ni/ /phur bu gcig kyang gdab par bya de nas de yi 1 'og tu yang / /grwa bzhir phur bu bzhi gdab bo/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa legs par grwa dag nas/ /che chung dag kyang rim 18pa bzhin/ /yongs su brtsam par nyu9bya bar bshad/ /rim gyis phyed phyed dbri bar bya/ /de las gzhan pa'i 'khor gyi ni/ /dkyil 'khor bshad pa gang yin pa/ /de kun phye ma dkar po yis/ /chig rkyang du ni bri bar bshad/ /dkyil 'khor nyis 2 rim sum rim mam( sgro/ /bzhi 'am mang por bya ba las / /phyi rim gang yin de la ni/ /sgo gcig pa dang rgya cher bya/ /gzhan ni phyogs kyi cha bzhin du/ /sgo bzhi sgo khyud bcas par bya/ /yang na thams cad dogs med (rtepar / /sgo re re bzhi 2 bya ba yin/ /snying po dkyil 'khor nges par ni/ /rab tu bzang po sgo bzhir bya/ /nub phyogs sgo 'am yang na ni/ /gang las ji sa:skad 96—526

bshad par dbye5)/ /lhag ma rnams ni dkar po yi/ /phye mas gcad dpar bya ba yin / /dkyil 'khor rnam gsum dgod pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu mang bshad kyang (5)/ /de (45ni dkyil 'khor mang po dag /rnam par dgod pa bshad pa gang / /de dag rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rnam par dbye ba yin par grags / /lha yi gtso bor gyur pa rnams/ /rtag tu dkyil du dgod par bya/ /de yi lhag ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gnyis pa dag tu dgod par bya/ /'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa bsdu bar bshad/ /de las gzhan rnams ji skad du/ /bshad pa de bzhin kho nar dgod/ /dkyil 'khor thig gdab thig skud ni/ /kha bsgyur gtsang ma sra zhing phra/ /de bzhin bu mo gzhon nus bkal/ /sar pa shin tu gtsang ma dang / /mdzes shing shin tu ran 5pa yidag /dri zhim reg na bde ba dang / /legs par bkal dang sra ba dang / /sbom ri riphra la sogs bkal legs dang / /'jur mdud med par gyur pa yi/ /thig skud me tog spos 8mchod pas/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab bo/ /mchod sbyin shing gi phur bu dag /thur 9du rtse bstan mngon bsngags 7pa/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i cho ga la/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu gdab par bya/ /ltas ngan byung na dngos mi 'grub11/ /srad bu chad na bla ma 'chi/2/ /ring 12thung khyer na nad kyis 'debs/ /phyogs 'khrul slob ma myos par 'gyur/ /de bas thams cad nan tan du/ /mkhas pas legs par thig gdab bo/ /khyim sa'i dpyad las ci byung ba'i/ /sa yi sanges pa tshade dang 'dra/ /de nas bla mas ci 'byor pas / /'phags pa'i dge 'dun chos ston gsol/ /yang na bla mas bsgos pa yi / /slob ma rnams kyis chos ston gsol/ /gal te mi 'byor dge 'dun gyis/ /96—527

bskos (1 pa'i dge slong chos ston sbyin/ /yang na sangs rgyas mchod pa 'am/ /dge 'dun dag la yon yang dbulas/ /bla ma slob ma dang bcas par/ /khro bo rgyal po rjes dran zhing / /skyu ru ra la sogs pa yis/ / phyi dro (da tshul bzhin khrus bya'o / /khrus byas gtsang zhing gos dkar bgos(4ra/ /yo byad rnam pa kun dang ldan / /byams pa'i sems ni nyer bzhag 5)nas/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni drung du 'dong / /bla mas tshogs rnams kun bsags shing / /lta ba ngan pa thams cad spangs / /dkyil 'khor bri ba thams cad la/ /bla mas mkhas pa dag tu bya/ /dang por dkyil 'khor sa gzhi 6la/ /ba yi gcin dang bsres pa yi(7) ba yi lci bas bsku bya zhing / /de nas spos chus bsang gtor bya/ /sa gzhi nasakho ra khor yug tu/ /chag chag gdab cing phyag dar 9)bya/ /yid ni mos par bya ba'i phyir/ /me tog sil ma gtor bar bya/ /srad bu dag gis yongs su bskor/ /rgyal mtshan rta babs dag gis mtshan/ /brgyus 9pa'i phreng ba rnams bre zhing / /bkra shis cho gar bstan par bya/ /de nas byang gi phyogs gcig tunyam/ /yo byad thams cad gsog 1 par bya/ /khro bo'i 1 rgyal pos bsrungs nas su/ /blo dang ldan pas dgod par bya/ /gnas ni bsang gtor bya ba dang / /bgegs rnams bsal bar byas nas ni/ /bdag dang dkyil 'khor dag kyang ni/ /dang por kun nas bsrung 1 bya ste/ /bkra shis ltas dang sbyar nas ni/ /mos pa'i sems ni bskyed bya zhing / /mtshams kyi dus su bab pa yi/ /srod kyi dus la brtsam par bya/ /ltas dang mi ldan gyur na yang / /sems ni zhum par mi bya bar / /rigs gsum dag la phyag byas nas/ /dal gyis legs par brtsam par bya / /ltas ngan dag ni yang dang yang / /bstud 'amar byung bar gyur na ni/ /96—528

de na 0)dngos grub med gyur gyis/ /de tshe brtsam (gepar mi bya yi no/ /yang na de ni zhi ba'i phyir/ /yam shing me 54)ni 'bar ba la/ /ba yi mar las brgya rtsa brgyad / /zhi ba'i phyir ni sbyin sreg (5bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyis zhi bar bya/ /pad+ma'i rigs la grags ldan ma/ /rdo rje'i rigs la mā ma khri(yi/ /rigs gsum dag gi spyi la yang / /rig (7)sngags chen mo mā ma khrin/ /blo dang ldan pas las kun la/ /de bas des ni zhi bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po cho ga bzhin/ /de nas mchod yon dbul bar bya/ /snod ni gser dang tsho dngul dag dang / /zangs la 7byas pa'am dung yang rung / /shing la nyu1byas pa'am rdo dag gam/ /kham pa sar pa'i gtsang ma'ang rung / /der ni me tog dkar po blugs/ /bdug spos kyis kyang bdug par bya/ /de nas dri zhim chu blugs nas/ /blo ldan lag gi bram 12bya zhing / /bdug spos kyis ni bdug bzhin du/ /yid kyis rab tu bzlas brjod sna bya/ /de nas blo dang ldan pa yis / /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags zlos byed cing / /sa yi tshadabus kyi phyogs su ni/ /pus mo gnyis btsugs mchod yon dbul/ /yang na dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi/ /las la mchod yon don du ni/ /me tog dkar po'am bdug spos ni/ /bzang po'am dri zhim byug spos dbulas/ /bdug spos dag dang byug spos ni/ /srog chags yan lag 1 bcas pa spang / /las su bya ba thams cad la / /chu ni gtsang ma btsag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu tshig rkyang 18ba'i/ /byug spos dag gam bdug spos dag /me tog skam las 19skyes pa ni/ /dri zhim pa dang dkar po shis/ /de nas slob ma bsogs 2 nas ni/ /spos kyi chu yis bsang gtor bya/ /tshogs pa bsrung 2lhab byas pa rnams/ /phyogs gcig tu ni 96—529

bkod 1nas su/ /shes rab pha rol phyin bklags nasate/ /gus par yang ni phyag byas nas/ /'phags pa'i tshogs kun bsams ( nonas su/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bri cabar bya/ /mkhas pas lcags ni rnam lnga 'am/ /phye ma dkar po la sogs pa'am/ /dad cing yon tan ldan pa yi/ /slob mas rin chen phye mas bri(5ri / /rin chen lcags rnams ma 'byor na/ /sā neralu btags pa'i phye mas bya/ /tshon rtsi lngar bshad zhib mo dang / /'byung khungs nas byung phye ma dang / /rdo yi khams ni sna tshogs dag /phye ma'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /de ltar rnam pa bzhi po dag /phye ma'i rgyur ni bsgrags pa yin/ /lcags rnams kun dang rin chen dang / /'byung khungs sa dang 'bras btags 7)pa/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi las rnams la/ /phye ma'i don du sbyar bar bya/ /yang na las kyi cho ga la/ /phye ma dmar po naso phag bsregs9/ /nag po thal ba dkar po ni/ /nas dang gro las byas pa gnang / /bya ba rings pa 'byung ba dang / /bgegs rnams tshar gcad tshebya ba dang / /drag shul spyad 11pa'i las dag gi12/ / dkyil 'khor las la thal ba gnang / /1 dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga la/ /phye gema'i rgyu ni sngar bshad pa/ /kun kyang rung ste khyad par du/ /dang po la sogs rim skabazhin shis/ /dam tshig las la lcags kyi bzang / /rin chen las byung dbang bskur la/ /sā tshelu'i phye ma zhi ba la/ /'byung khungs las byung rgyas pa la/ /drag shul spyod la khyad par du/ /thal ba la sogs bya bar shis/ /de ni phye ma'i cho ga'i rim/ /khyad par dang bcas bstan pa yin/ /byang shar mtshams nas brtsams nas su/ /rdo rje khu tshur sbyor 3 ba 'am/ /yang na lcags kyu'i 1/phyag rgya 'am/ /lhung bzed rgya yi sbyor ba 'am/ /yang na rig byed lag pas bri/ /dkar po dang por dgye 96—530

bar bya/ /de yi 'og tu dmar po dgye/ /de nas ser po dgye bar bya/ /de yi 'og tu ljang gu (1)dgye/ /sngags pas kun gyi phyi rol du/ /tshon rtsi nag po dgye bar bya(gu/ /g.yas su bskor zhing rgyun mi bcad(5)/ /thams cad mnyam zhing bar chad med/ /ngan pa dang ni nyams pa dang / /ma snyoms pa dang bar chad na / /gnod pa mang po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan cher byas te/ /mkhas pas phye ma dgye bar bya/ /phyogs rnams kun du mkhas pa yis/ /dbus su sgo ni gdod par bya/ /ngos gnyis su ni cha dag kyang / /bzhi bzhi dag ni dor bar bya/ /chab sgo chen po stegs bur bcas/ /chung 4zad gcig ni lhag par bya/ /chab sgo gzhan rnams bcad 5)par ni/ /phye ma dkar po dag gis ni/ /sgo yi dbus kyi cha dag tu/ /ri mo phra mo bri bar bya/ /yang na sgo yi phyag rgya 'am/ /sgo srungs ku6)ji ltar 'dod par bri/ /dang po tshon rtsi sna lngas bri/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa sna gsum gyis/ /gsum pa phye ma dkar po yis/ /gcig rkyang 7du ni bri bar bya/ /gzhan yang kha cig gang bshad pa/ /de yi ri mo gcig narkyang nyid / /thal phyer bshad pa gang yin pa/ /de dag thams cad ri mo gcig /de ltar dkyil 'khor bris nas su/ /cha gsum du ni legs brtags 9la/ /chu zheng tshedag ni cha gnyis kyang / /shin tu legs par nges par bya/ /rnam par dbye ba 'di dag ni/ /rigs gsum dag gi spyir bstan no11/ /yang na so so rgyud rnams las/ /go rims 12ji skad bshad bzhin bya/ /lha yi gnas kyi sa gzhi 12rnams/ /ba glang thuphyi bas bsku bar bya/ /de yi 'og tu khyad par du/ /ba yi rnam lnga'i chu yis bsku'i/ /thams cad spos kyi tshachus gtor nas/ /de yi 'og tu phye ma dgye/ / /rig sngags rgyal pos mngon bsngags 18pa'i/ /spos kyi chu 96—531

yis gtor bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag gi cho ga ni/ /rnam pa gsum po ma lus la / /lha rnams thams cad dgod pa ni/ /rnam pa gsum du rab tu bshad/ /dang po gzugs su bri bar bshad/ /gnyis pa dag ni phyag rgya bri/ /gsum pa stan dang gnas dag tu/ /bri ba'i cho ga yongs su bsgrags/ /blo dang ldan pas gzugs kyi tshul/ /bri ba de la mkhas par bya/ /gtsang 0nims bsgrims te rang gi nitshon/ /ngo bo ji skad bshad bzhin bri/ /gzugs dang 'tsham par yan lag gdags / /gsal zhing rnam par 'byes par bri/ /gzugs kyang dkyil 'khor rnams kyi ni/ /tshad dang sbyar zhing bya bar bsgrags/ /rang gi lung las kha dog gzugs / /'byung ba bzhin du gzugs bris te/ /ci nas yan lag ma nyams shing / /rang bzhin zhi ba'i gzugs su bri/ /gsang sngags cho ga shes pa yis/ /cho ga 'di yis dkyil 'khor bri/ /blo dang ldan pa ri nom bslabs 5pas/ /phyag rgya rnams su dgod 6par bya/ /bslabs ri nopas kyang ni phye ma yis/ /yan lag rdzogs par rab tu dka'/ /yan lag rdzogs shing rgyas bya na/ /cho ga'i las la ring du thogs/ /gzugs rnams legs par bsgrubs na ni/ /mang po rnams ni zin mi 'gyur/ /yan lag nyams na byin mi rlob/ /dngos mi 'grub par rab tu bshad/ /de lta bas na mkhas pa yis/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs su lha rnams dgod / /yang na rigs gsum bdag po rnams/ /ci 'dod par ni gzugs su dgod / /de las sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyi/ /phyag rgya gtsug tor nasago rims bzhin / /yid la de yi sngags zlos shing 9/ /phye ma dkar pos bri bar bya/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /phyag rgya pad+mar rab tu bsgrags/ /phyag na rdo rje'i 11phyag rgya ni/ /rdo rje rnon po rtse gsum 'bar/ /lha rnams gzhan 96—532

gyi phyag rgya ni/ /lung las ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /yang na rigs kyi bdag po'i rgya/ /de dang der ni spyi yi yin/ /lha rnams gang dang gang dag gi51/ /mtshan ma gang dang gang yin pa/ /de dang de dag de yi rgya/ /'di ni ma nor mdor bshad bya/ /drag po'i phyag rgya rtse gsum rno/ / dka' zlog na phyag na rtse gsum gdengs/ /khyab 'jug gi ni 'khor lo rno/ /sde chen gyi ni mdung thung daniyin / /tshangs pa'i pad+ma yin par bshad/ /brgya byin gyi ni rdo rjer gsungs/ /me lha'i phyag rgya zhugs thab yin/ /gshin rje'i phyag rgya be con yin/ /bden bral gyi ni ral gri yin/ /chu bdag gi ni zhags par bshad/ /rlung gi phyag rgya rgyal mtshan yin/ /ku be ra yi dbyug to ste/ /dbang bdag gi ni rtse gsum gsungs / /'di brgyad phyogs kyi lha brgyad kyi'o/ /sa yi phyag rgya bum pa yin/ /nyi zla'i phyag rgya zlum por bya/ /lha rnams so so'i bye brag las/ /swa sti ka 4la sogs pa'i rgya/ /mkhas pas ji skad bshad bzhin bri/ /yang na kun gyi zlum por bri/ /gang du lha rnams gzugs dag tu/ /dgod pa bshad pa der 5yang ni / /phyag rgya dag gam yang na ni/ /stan du dgod pa rnam 0par bshad/ /de la sogs pa'i phyag rgya rnams/ /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu ma smos kyang / /cho ga bzhin du bri bar bshad/ /de ltar phyag rgya dgod pa 'dis/ /dgod pa gnyis par bshad pa yin/ /stan du dgod pa'i cho ga ni/ /'di las gzhan pa gsum par bshad/ /dkyil 'khor dag gi nang du ni/ /tshon rtsi phye ma'i thig ler bri/ /dkyil 'khor dag gi tshad las ni/ /kho ra khor yug rgya cher bskor/ /rigs kyi bdag po'i lha rnams ni/ /go rims bzhin du de ltar bri/ /lha rnams gzhan ni gdan rnams kyi/ /spyi yi cho ga 96—533

bshad pa yin/ /zlum po'am yang na gru bzhi rung / /thog ma stan ni dgod par bya / /yid la de yi sngags zlos shing / /de yi steng du mkhas pas dgod/ /phyi rol du ni thig le la/ /mkhas pas lha rnams ming gis dgod/ /thams cad thig ler gnas byas nas/ /spyan drang bar ni brtsam par bya/ /'di dag stan du dgod pa ste/ /gsum pa yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /rings sam yang na mi nus na/ /stan du dgod pa'i 1dkyil 'khor bya/ /yang na cho ga shes pa yis / /gsum po 'di yi cho ga ni/ /re re'am gnyis sam gsum char (geram /bsres nas dkyil 'khor legs par bri/ /rigs kyi bdag po gsum rnams kyi/ /gsang sngags thog mar bkod nas su/ /dkyil 'khor nang du mkhas pa yis/ /lhag ma rnams kyi phyag rgya bri/ /phyi rol du ni stan rnams bri/ /'di ni spyi yi ri cho ga ste/ /dkyil 'khor dag la khyad par du/ /bar ma rab tu bsngags pa yin/ /gzugs rnams legs par ma rdzogs na/ /nyes pa sngar (geni bshad pa bzhin(ge/ /gnas rnams stong par 'gyur bas na/ /cho ga tha ma mi shes so/ /phyag rgya rnam gsum gang bkod pa/ /bar ma rab tu bsgrags pa yinayi/ /khyad par du ni de bsngags te/ /de la byin gyis rlob par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya bri na bde ba ste/ /phyag rgya gang yin de nyid lha/ /de bas mkhas pas nan tan du/ / dkyil 'khor dag gi phyag rgya bri/ /7dkyil 'khor ma lus pa rnams su/ /ma bshad kyang ni dogs med pas/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'og logs su/ /gzhan gyis mi thub lha mo bri/ /dbus kyi stong pa gang yin pa/ /der yang sgyu dbum pa'i steng du ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa gzhag9 /der yang mchod cing bklag 7par bya/ /la la dag tu ma gsungs kyang / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /drung 96—534

du blo dang ldan pa yis/ /gos dkar can ni rtag tu bri/ /phyag na rdo rje'i drung du ni/ /bdud rtsi thab zhi sbyor kun du bri/ /brtson 'grus chen mo mā ma tī/ /phyag rgya chen mo bri bar bya/ /cho ga shes (5)pas sgo drung du/ /dga' bo de dang bsnyen dga' bri/ /mkhas pas ji skad bshad pa yis(5)/ /'phrog ma de bzhin mdun du bri/ /sgo rnams kun du rdo rje bri/ /phyogs skyong phyag rgya'ang lugs bzhin du/ /so so so sor drag po'i gzugs/ /so so'i 5)phyogs kyi gnas su bri / /gnod sbyin nor bu bzang la sogs/ /bstan pa la ni gang dga' ba/ /sgo yi byang gi phyi rol gyi/ /phyi rol du yang de dgod do/ /gang dag tu yang ma bshad kyang / /shar du sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /de bzhin chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gus par dkyil 'khor byas nas mchod/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / /rgyal sras mthu chen thob pa dang / /nam mkha'i snying po don grub dang / /dri ma med pa'i blo gros dang / /de la sogs pa'i sems dpa' che/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni phyi rol dgod/ /bskal pa bzang po'i grogs po ni/ /byams pa la sogs thams cad dgod/ /rdo rje sde dang lag bzangs nedang / /de bzhin bgegs kyi sde dpon dang / /dbang phyug chen po chung mar bcas / /tshangs pa chen po mes po bri/ /rig tsho77sngags 'chang gi rgyal po yang / /glang po che zhes bya ba dang / /yan lag bkram 'byin rtse bran can/ /g.yon phyogs cod pan mi bzad dang / /sna tshogs 'od dang legs par 'grub sna/ /rig sngags 'chang bdun bdag po ste/ /bdun po 'di dag rigs kyi gtso/ /dngos grub pa 9ste mthu can rnams/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad kyi/ /lho yi phyogs su legs par dgod/ /ma mo rnams dang sna yon dang / /de 96—535

bzhin gza' 71rnams sna tshogs dang / /sgra gcan stobs can rab sim dang / /rnam par snang byed la sogs dang / /nor rgyas la sogs klu rnams dang / /de dag nub kyi phyogs su dgod/ /shar du rdo rje phyag rgya ni/ /brgya byin lha dang bcas pa dang / /de bzhin gnas gtsang lha rnams kyang / /gus par po yang ni mchod par bya/ /nyi zla gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /dkar dang dmar ba'i bye 8brag gis/ /shar dang nub tu bris nas ni/ /de nas de gnyis mkhas pas mchod / /me yi phyogs su zhugs thab rgya/ /me lha drang srong 'khor bcas bri/ /lho phyogs be con phyag rgya ni/ /gshin rje yi dgas rigisal sogs bcas/ /bden bral phyogs su ral gri'i 5rgya/ /bden bral ba ni srin por bcas/ /chu lha'i phyogs su zhags pa'i 6rgya/ /chu lha klu dang lhan cig tu/ /rlung gi phyogs su rgyal mtshan rgya/ /rlung gi lha ni rlung dang bcas/ /byang du dbyug to'i dzo niphyag rgya yang //ku be ra yang gnod sbyin bcas/ /dbang ldan phyogs su rtse gsum rgya/ /dbang ldan tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /'og tu bum pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /sa yi lha mo lha min bcas/ /phyogs skyong rnams ni go rims bzhin/ /de ltar gnas su dgod byas nas/ /byug spos me tog la sogs pas/ /mkhas pas so sor nasa'akhor bcas mchod9/ /mdzod spu khodang ni mdung thung dang / /'khor los sgyur 11ba cher 'byung bcas/ /rig 12sngags chen mo spyan dang ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i 1 rgyal mtshan dang / /mngag gzhug brtson 'grus chen po dang / /de bzhin gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dag gis/ /dkyil 'khor kun la dgod par bya/ /grags ldan ma dang dkar chen mo/ /de bzhin gos dkar can dang ni/ /rta mgrin dang ni ral pa gcig /sgrol ma dkar 96—536

sham dpal mo che/ /'dod pa 'byor byed gsang sngags dag /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi6)/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus pa rnams su/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du dgod(gyi/ /rdo rje lcags kyu khu tshur dang / /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag rgyar bcas/ /khro bo chen po thab rin)sbyor dang / /gom pa dor ri thob nyid dang ni/ /rdo rje lug rgyud be con dang / /khro bo 'chol pa zhes bya dag /phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ma smos kyang ni de dag dgod/ /dkyil 'khor dang po'i nang du 55)ni/ /ji skad smos pa'i lha bkod nas/ /de nas mkhas pas dkyil 'khor ni/ /gnyis par rim pa ji bzhin du/ /ma smos pa dang 'dod pa yi/ /gsang sngags rnams kyang dgod bya zhing / /'khrul pa med par gsum pa (tshoyang / /bye brag tu ni dgod par bya/ /phyogs bzhir chos klog bzhi bzhag nas//de la shar gyi phyogs su ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa bzhag /byang gi phyogs su bzhag pa ni/ /gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde yin/ /nub kyi phyogs su bzhag pa ni / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i mdo/ /theg pa chen po sdong pos bshad / /lho yi phyogs su bzhag nas su/ /gus par 7de dag mchod par bya/ /rgyud kun gyi ni bas/nga sngags bdag /yongs su mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor phyi rol du/ /spyi yi cho ga gzhan 'di'ang bya/ /byang dang lho dang shar phyogs kyi/ /phyogs gsum du ni stegs bu gsum/ /byas te rigs gsum bsams nas su/ /spyan drang ba yi cho ga byan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnams kyi9/ /gsang sngags kun la dbul 1 lo zhes/ /me tog spos chus bkang ba yi/ /mchod yon dag ni dbul bar bya /sangs rgyas pa la shar phyogs su/ /pad+ma 'dzin la byang phyogs su/ /gsang 11ba'i bdag 96—537

pos bshad pa yi1ri/ /gsang sngags rnams la lho phyogs su/ /de ltar byas na rigs gsum gyi/ /gsang sngags 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /mchod pa byas pa 'di ru ni/ /dgyes par gyur pa gdon mi za/ /cho ga 'di yis nub phyogs su/ /'jig rten pa yi nalha rnams ni/ /kun la dbul (7lo zhes brjod cing / /phyi rol stegs bu steng du mchod/ /zhi ba dag gi cho ga la/ /byang chub sems dpa' dkon mchog gsum/ /gtsang ma'i gnas na 'khod pa yi/ /lha rnams kyang ni dgod par bya/ /rgyas pa la ni khyad par du/ /rig cirasngags gsang sngags thams cad dang / /bstan pa la ni dga' ba yi/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyang dgod ⑤par bya/ /drag shul spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /khro bo rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ /drag shul chen po'i rnam dag dang / /mngag gzhug pho mo mang po dgod/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad la'ang / /las rnams gsum du shes par bya/ /de bas cho ga 'di rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum du brtags(phyir/ /dkyil 'khor dag gi dbus dag na sku/ /sa stong 8)gar yang ma gtogs pa/ /gang na yod pa de ru ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa bzhag /yang na sgo yi g.yas rol du/ /slob ma bzang po'i steng du bzhag9ni /g.yon gyi phyogs su sbyin sreg 9phyir/ /me ni yam sreg 11shing gis sbar/ /yang na shar lho mtshams tshadag tu / /me ni rab tu sbar 1 bar bya/ /yang na las kyi rjes mthun 〉par/ /phyogs kyi go rims bobazhin ladu bzhag1 /dri gtsang khang ngam gnas khang ngam/ /phug gam yang na go skabs dag /dog pa bzhin du byed na ni/ /der ni ji ltar 'dod par bya/ /go skabs dog pa dag tu ni/ /bsgrubs sna pa'i dkyil 'khor ma gtogs pa/ /slob dpon gyis ni gzhan mi bri/ /bris na 37mod la 'chi bar 96—538

'gyur / /dkyil 'khor dag ni ma lus par/ /go skabs yangs pa'i phyogs su shis6)spyo/ /khang bzangs (snyedag gam khyams su yang / /goms pa yis ni ci bder bri / /rad rod dag gam sdong (5)dum dag /ljon shing dag dang rdo ba ni/ /rab tu bsgrims nas dbyung bya ste/ /de dag zug rngu yin par bshad/ /mkhas pas de dbyung thabs med na/ /zhi ba'i cho ga byas te bzhag(4) /snying po'i dkyil 'khor du ni de/ /bag med nam yang mi bzhag 5)go/ /rad rod la sogs bye brag dag /dkyil 'khor dbu ma ma gtogs par/ /gnas khang la sogs nyes med de/ /de dag de na rang bzhin gnas/ /khang bzangs 6dag la sogs par 7ni / /bsang gtor byas pas dag par bshad/ /ri la sa gzhi 8mnyam pa dang / /rdo pa'i zug rngu brtag mi dgos/ /gal te gnas kyi dbang gis su 97/ /lha rnams phyogs logs bo'agod byed na/ /mkhas pas zhi ba byas te gzhag11 /snying por nam yang mi bya'o/ /bya ba'i dbang gis de la sogs/ /'gal ba gang dang gang byed pa/ /de dang der ni mkhas pa yis/ /thams cad zhi ba'i las kyis 12bsal / /blo dang ldan pas cho ga 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bris nas ni / /yid ni legs par mnyam bzhag 1lhanas/ /de yi 'og tu yang brtags te / /brgya la 'ga' 7zhig ma legs na/ /de ni phyir yang bcos par bya /mkhas pas rang gi gsang sngags sam/ /slob ma'i sngags kyang 'dod na dgod/ /slob ma brtags pa la la zhig /gal te dbang ni bskur 'dod na/ /dbang bskur don du 8dkyil 'khor ni/ /phye ma dkar pos bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag dang rjes mthun 8par/ /stegs bu gru bzhi byas nas su/ /de yi dbus su tshon 7sna lngas/ /pad+ma yongs su rdzogs par bri/ /bkra shis la sogs mtshan 96—539

ma rnams/ /de ni ji ltar 'dod pa bri/ /bkra shis phyir ni gang bstan pa/ /yang na de ni dngos su dgod/ /mkhas pas g.yos 1rnams gang bzhag na)pa'i/ /sa ris rnams kyang phye mas bcad / /g.yos su byas pa'i rnam pa kun/ /bsogs nas der ni dgod par bya/ /bum pa dag dang rgyal mtshan dang 45/ /rta babs bzhag pa'i sa ris dang / /phyi rol mdzes par bya ba yang / /ji ltar 'dod pa phye mas bya/ /de nas gzhan yang lha rnams ni/ /spyan drang ba yi cho ga dang 6/ /mchod pa 7go rims 8ji bzhin du/ /yang dag mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bris nas/ /nye reg byas shing gtsang bar bya/ /lha rnams la yang phyag byas nas/ /bzang ngam mi bzang brtag 9par bya/ /phyi rol shar phyogs kha bltas nas/ /yid la dkyil 'khor bdag po yi/ /snying po'am gsang sngags kun zlos shing / /mtshan ma dag ni brtag par bya/ /ji srid ltas ni bzang po dag /'ga' zhig 'byung bar 'gyur gyi bar/ /de nyid bsgrims te yid gcig tu/ /bzlas brjod byed la 'bad cing bsdad/ /de mthong blo ldan rangs 'gyur bas/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags sam/ /bdag gis gang zhig bzlas pa yis/ /bsrung tshab legs par sbyar bar bya/ /yang na rgyud rnams kun gyi spyir/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bzlog pa la/ /rdo rje be con brtson 'grus che/ /khro bo bdud rtsi thab 11sbyor dang / /mgo la rdo rje smos pa yis/ /phur bu ra ba dra ba gsum/ /blo dang ldan pas lnga po dag /cho ga bzhin du sbyar bar bya/ /bsrung 12ba rtsa ba'i gsang sngags sam/ /yang na de yi snying pos bya/ /slob ma rnams la yid kyis su/ /bsrung 1 ba snga chom bzhin du bya/ /bsrung skab byas nas de 'og tu/ /mkhas pas 96—540

dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya/ /zhugs nas mchod yon snod thogs te/ /mchod yon dag kyang dbul bar bya/ /mchod yon snod ni gser dngul lam/ /zangs sam shel lam nor bu 'am/ /mching 1bu dkar po las byas pa/ /shing ngam de bzhin rdo las byas/ /dung ngam lo ma skyongs bu 95'am/ /nya phyis dag gam kham phor ni/ /sar pa yan lag ma nyams pa/ /dag par byas la ( blang bar bya/ /der ni khro rgyal bzlas pa yi/ /me tog dag kyang bcug canas su/ /mnyam par bzhag ste dkyil 'khor gyi/ /gsang sngags lan bdun bzlas nas ni/ /snga ma bzhin du dri chu yis/ /mchod yon gus par dbul bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbu 5mar phul nas ni/ /lhag ma rnams la gtor bar bshad/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bsang tshigator byas/ /de nas cho ga 'di bya'o/ /bum pa nag po ra ri med/ /gzugs bzang kha dog rab tu dmar/ /gsar la ma chag ma gas pa//yang dag dbyibs ni legs shing zlum/ /bzlas brjod dag kyang lan bdun byas//spos chu dag gis bkang ba la/ /'bru rnams kun dang ldan byas shing / /sman rnams dang yang ldan pa dang / /rin chen kun dang rab tu ldan/ /mgul par ras sar rangs pas dkris/ /me tog phreng bas rnam par brgyan / /kha rgyan 8ldum bu bzang pos bya/ /shing tog bkra shis khar blugs pa/ /'bras bu me tog sil mar ldan/ /spos kyis byug cing bdug 9pas bdug /thams cad bkra shis dang ldan pa/ /bzlas brjod lan bdun byas pa dag /bkra shis don du gnyer ba yinas/ /phyogs dang mtshams rnams dag tu dgod/ /yon tan kun dang ldan pa yi/ /bum pa 'di kun ma 'byor na/ /dbang bskur phyir ni 'bring po gcig /nan tan bskyed de legs par gzhag11 /grwa dang sgor ni ma 96—541

lus par/ /bum pa dag kyang bzhag nas ni/ /bar sgo chen po gnyis gnyis shig /khyad par du ni gzhag 91par bya/ /bum pa gcig ni phyi sgo yi/ /drung du mngon par gzhag dpar bya/ /mang po tshod 'byor par ma gyur na/ /brgyad dam yang na bzhi bzhag go/ /nyung ngu rnams ni khyad par du/ /pha (perol dag tu dgod bya ste/ /sgo yi drung du gcig bzhag 55)pa/ /de ni nges par bya dgos so / /'bras kyi so ba mon sran gre'u / /nas 57)dang gro dang til dang lnga/ /'bru rnams kun zhes bya ba ni/ /las rnams kun la 'di dag gzung / /sing gh+ri byā gh+ri kur ṇi 8ka /ha sa ha sa de ba ste/ /sman rnams kun ces bya ba la/ /lnga po 'di dag shes par bya/ /byi 9ru gser gyi sa le sbram/ /dung dang mu tig nor bu ste/ /rin chen kun ces 1 bya ba la/ /lnga po 'di dag shes par bya/ /rgyal mtshan sar 11pa sna tshogs dang / /brgyad ni kho ra khor yug tul/ /yu ba drang po ring po la/ /dpyangs 1snyenas nye bar bzung sabyas te/ /dkar po shar gyi phyogs su gzugs/ /shar lho mtshams su le brgan gzugs/ /lho yi phyogs su nag po gzugs / /lho nub mtshams su dud kha mgazugs/ /nub kyi phyogs su dmar po gzugs / /nub byang mtshams su khra bo gzugs/ /byang gi phyogs su ser po gzugs / /byang shar mtshams su ljang ser gzugs/ /de ltar rgyal mtshan brgyad po rnams/ /go rims 7bzhin du gzugs par bya/ /rgyal mtshan rnams kyi rtse mo la/ /tog ni rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan / /rgyal mtshan rnams ni ma rnyed na/ /thams cad thal kur gcig pu 1)'am/ /yang na de bas mang yang rung / /shar gyi phyogs su gzugs par bya/ /pog 19phor kham pa las byas pa /so ma btang ba dkar po bcu/ /byas nas phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ni snye/ /96—542

rgyab dang de bzhin mdun du dgod/ /pog phor dag tu ma 'byor na/ /kham pa'i phor bu'i nang nas dbul/ /de dag kyang ni ma 'byor na/ /gcig cig sgor ni bzhag nas dbul/ /me tog phreng bas brgyan 15pa yi/ /rta babs dag kyang phyogs bzhir bya/ /nas dang gro dang 'bru rnams kyi/ /myu gu legs par bskyed pa dgod/ /dril bu gdugs dang rnga nam dang / /srad bu dag kyang phyogs bzhir ni/ /rta babs sogs las phyi rol tu/ /mdzes par ri bya phyir mkhas pas gdags/ /'bras yos 'bru dang bcas pa yis/ /me tog sil ma rab tu dgram/ /dkyil 'khor dag gi phyi rol tu/ /phye ci mas dkyil 'khor sdug gu bri/ /'jig rten 'di na grags pa yi/ /bkra shis la sogs gang yin rnams / /dkyil 'khor dag gi phyi rol tu/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu mkhas pas dgod / /de ltar rgyas dang mdor bsdus la tsho/ /ci nus su ni sbyar ba dag /cho ga bzhin du byas nas su/ /de nas spyan drang brtsam par bya/ /mchod yon cho ga snga ma bzhin/ /ma yengs par ni sbyar nas su/ /so so sngags kyis ci rigs par / /mkhas pas spyan ni drang bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po'i gsang sngags sam/ /yang na thams cad snying pos 4bya/ /sngags rgyud las ni ci bshad pa / /de bzhin du ni spyan drang ba'o/ /mkhas pas de bzhin gshegs rigs la/ /'khor los sgyur (7ribs spyan drang ngo / /yang na spyan drang cho ga ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyis byar yang rung / /phyag na pad+mo'i rigs kun la/ /rig pa'i rgyal pos spyan drang bya/ /yang na spyan drang cho ga la/ /dpal mos 8las kun byed pas bya/ /mkhas pas rdo rje 'dzin rigs la/ /gnod mdzes zhes 9bya'i gsang sngags sam/ /ma yengs par ni mā ma kyis1 / /spyan drang ba yi cho ga bya/ /96—543

sngags rgyud bdag po'i sngags gang yin/ /de 'am de yi snying po yis/ /lha rnams kyi ni ming smos te/ /mkhas pas spyan drang cho ga bya/ /yang zhi)na rang gi rigs kyi sngags/ /gang yin de 'am de snying ngam/ /cho ga ji skad gsungs pas kyang / /spyan drang ba ni mkhas pas bya/ / yang na cho ga ci gsungs pas/ /(snyeyang na phyi 'am nang dag gi/ /rang gi gsang sngags gang yin pa/ /de dag gis ni spyan drang ba'am/ /ji ltar lobs par byar yang rung / /mchod yon gyi ni cho ga bzhin/ /de ltar spyan drang byas nas ni/ /mchod yon nyid kyis lan re zhing / /de nas zhabs bkru'i cho ga bya/ /bde bar gshegs zhes bya la sogs/ /phyag kyang gus par 'tshal ba dag /go rims ri bzhin du byas nas ni/ /mkhas pas de dag camachod pa brtsam/ /dang po byug spos 5dedabul byas te/ /de yi 'og tu me tog dbul/ /de nas legs par mnyam bzhag (6)nas/ /bdug spos lha bshos dag kyang dbul/ /tsan+dan a shar gur gum ri nodang / /ut+pal rgya spos pri yang ku/ /li shi shing tsha spang spos smrig /nā 58rig put+pa gā nām 9dbu/ /gran te tsosug smel pa tra 11dang / /la ni sbre'u ne ra sar ldan/ /rdo dreg sha ta put+pa nyu dang / /sna ma'i lo ma tsa rong dang / / ko'u na ci1 tim 'du bori ka tsodang / /rgyan n+ya ka tso la sogs bzang / /'bras bu thang chu'i tshogs rnams ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 'di sbyar nasal/ /mkhas pa blo dang ldan pa yis/ /phyi dang nang gi lha kun la / /go rims 1 bzhin du gsang sngags kyis/ /mngon par bsngags snananas byug spos 'bul19/ /srog chags yan lag sbyar mi rung / /rgya skyegs chang sogs sbyar mi rung / /rdzas ngan dag dang sbyar mi rung / /rtsabs dang sbyar ba'ang mi rung ngo / /sangs rgyas la ni khyad par du/ /byug spos gur gum rdu ril byas pa'am /96wa 544

a kur nag po dri zhim pa/ /dri zhim gyis bsgos (1)dbul bar bya/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /tsan+dan dkar po rab tu dbul/ /phyag na rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ /tsan+dan dmar po dbul bar bya/ /lhag ma rnams la byug spos dag /ji ltar rigs pas spyir phul nas/ /me tog skam las skyes pa dang (57/ /chu las suskyes pas (4nomachod par bya/ /ma li ba pa/kun kun da (ne dang / /mi la ki na ri ma li kunaci /tsam pa kā 9sho pu na ka /pri yang yu ni u ra na/ /ge sar sa la ti la 7ka /shing gi ut+pal 11kar ṇi 12ka /ta kur 1 ka ra bī ngar dang / /a dzi dog pa ka dam dang / /bin ti ri bodang ka ta ra/ /kun tsa na dang pa ta la/ /shi ta gan ti ku ra ba/ /ba na dang ni ging tshashu nyid/ /cho ga shes pas de la sogs/ /skam las 1 skyes pa go rims 18bzhin/ /nan tan du ni dbul bya zhing / /ngan pa dag ni rnam par spangs/ /gan dang ku ya shig mu dang / /pu 19sha pa ti mug ta 1ka /a gol drang ka ni pa dang / /ke ta ka dang ma na yan/ /ku ran ta dang 'da' ma ka /ku ti 22ba la ma li ka /de la sogs pa mi shis pa/ /drag shul spyod la sbyar bar bya/ /pad+ma dkar dang pad+ma dmar / /ut+pal rigs ni sna tshogs dang / /ku mu da dasogs chu skyes rnams/ /dkyil 'khor las la sbyar bya ste/ /de yang ku mu da 2 7dmar dang / /de bzhin se'u 25gan ti dkar 25dang / /dri mi zhim pa gzhan dag kyang / /drag shul spyod la sbyar bar bya/ /ge sar kra 2 ni ka ra dang / /ma la ti dang me tog dkar/ /dri zhim pa dag khyad par du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la dbul/ /pad+ma la sogs chu skyes rnams/ /mkhas pas pad+ma'i rigs la dbul/ /a 22sho ku ti rteti la ka /de bzhin na pa ma li ka /pri yang ku dang ta pa ra/ /ka ra bī ra 96wa 545

trag (1)tra ka /ut+pal sngon po nyid dag kyang / /rdo rje'i rigs la dbul bar bya / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la yang / /tsan+dan a gar bdug spos dbul / /mkhas pas shi ri bi da sta sogs sta/ /thang chu pad+ma'i rigs la dbul/ /a gar nag po gu gul gyi/ /bdug spos rdo rje'i rigs dgyes so/ /bdug spos dag ni spyir bshad na/ /srog chags yan lag spangs pa'i rdzas/ /tsan+dan ga pur a gar dang / / tu ruska dang pog dkar (5)dang / /shi ri be sta (5)sra rtsi pogaci ri /ra sa gu gul shal l+ya ki/ /u shi ra dang la ba ka /spang spos gla sgang ga pur dang / /de ba da ru thang shing dang / /de la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /ji snyed pa dag bsdu byas nas/ /blo dang ldan pas bu ram chosadang / /lhan cig tu ni sbyar bar bya/ /de lta bu yi bdug spos ni/ /lha la go rims (1)bzhin du dbul / /de dag gang yang rung ba dang / /gzhan yang dri zhim bshad pa gang / /rdzas mang dag dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug spos dkyil 'khor dag la dbul/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga bzhin/ /rab dang sems kyis ci 'byor pa/ /bdug spos me tog la sogs pa/ /bya ba dag ni legs par bya/ /me tog de dag brgyud 7mkhan gyis/ /brgyus pa zhig na ngan pa ni/ /nyung shas yod na mi 'gal te/ /de mang na ni rnam par spangasanyuge/ /mi shes gepa yi byug spos dag /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor dbul mi bya/ /srog chags yan lag gis gtugs pa/ /de yis gzhan dag bdug mi bya/ /rgya skyegs 12la sogs bdug spos ni/ /dge ba'i las la dbul mi bya/ /de 'dra'i cho ga 'di shes nas/ /cho ga'i las la 'bad par bya/ /phyi rol bzhag pa'i pog phor nang / /kham phor nang du bsgrags pa gang / /de dag tu ni ci 'dod par/ /srog chags yan lag sbyar 96wa 546

ba'ang bzhag /dkyil 'khor phyi rol 'jig rten pa'i/ /lha ni gang dag 'dri byed pa/ /de yang mkhas pas de bzhin du/ /bdug spos byug spos ci dgar dbul / /rigs kyi bdag po rnams la ni/ /mchod pa khyad par can du bya/ /de yi 'og tu lha kun la/ /gral rim 51thobazhin du mchod par bya/ /rigs kyi bdag po rnams la ni/ /bdug spos snod kyang rnam gsum gzhag(gu /dbus su bdug spos snod gcig ni/ /bdug spos 'thul ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa re re la/ /bdug spos snod ni re re bzhag /de nyid nas ni thams cad du/ /rtag par bdug spos dbul bar bya/ /yang na thams cad spyi la ni/ /bdug spos snod ni gcig bzhag ste/ /bsang gtor yang dang yang byas nas/ /de nas bdug spos dbul bar bya/ /de yi 'og tu dkyil 'khor du//lha rnams kun la mchod yon dbul/ /de nas yid la sngags zlos shing / /lha bshos dbul ba legs par bya/ /lha bshos dbul dab 'byor pa dang / /gtsang zhing cha yang mnyam pa ru/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni go rims 4bzhin/ /mkhas pas nan tan bskyed de bya/ /rigs kyi bdag po rnams la ni/ /dbul ba khyad par can du bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni bdag po la/ /lha bshos dag ni nyis 'gyur dbul / /'og ma rnams la go rims 5bzhin/ /mkhas pas de bas chung (67ngu dbul / /lha bshos dbul ba bar bar du/ /ci dgar khyad par can gyis bya/ /mchod pa'i bshos ni bzang po dag /gtsang zhing rab tu rgya che zhing / /dkyil 'khor dag tu lha rnams kun/ /rab tu mnyes shing 'go bar 'gyur/ /dbul bar bya ba rnams la ni/ /bar du kha cig chad 'gyur na/ /de las gzhan pa dag la ni/ /mkhas pas lha bshos lhags te dbul/ /'bul 7ba ha cang 896—547
