u 91)lo pu pa rnams/ /rigs gsum la ni rim ribazhin dbul/ /lhag ma'ang gzhan la ci rigs par/ /gzhi bting nas ni dbul bar bya/ /sā lu dang ni bcu drug pa/ /ju tse dang ni khre dag dang / /'o thug legs par btsos pa yi/ /chan dag ri der ni dbul bar bya/ /sran tshod la sogs sna tshogs pa/ /dri zhim yid du 'ong ba dang / /legs par yongs su byas pa yis5/ /tshod ma 6dag kyang dbul bar bya/ /nas dang nas mngar 7'bras chan nadag /gtso bo la ni yongs su bsgrags/ /gang gzhan cung zad dman pa dang / /'bring la sā 7lu bcu drug pa/ /gtso bo zhi ba'i las yin te/ /'bring po dag ni rgyas pa'o/ /dman pa drag shul gsungs pa la/ /lha bshos rim pa bzhin du sbyar/ /las ci 'dra bar rigs de shes/ /rigs ci 'dra bar dngos grub ste/ /gsang sngags dbye ba'i rim pa yis/ /'dir ni cho ga thams cad spyad/ /zhi ba la ni dang por bsngagasal/ /rgyas pa la ni mngar skyur te11/ /kha dang tsha 1 dang bska 1dasogs kyi/ /tshod ma drag po'i las la'o/ /zhi ba la 7ni 'o thug gsungs/ /kṛ skras ra ni drag spyod la/ /zho dang 'bras thug la sogs pa/ /gzhan rnams thams cad rgyas la 7shis/ /bza' ba'i rigs ni sna tshogs pa/ /phal cher grong dang dgon pa yi/ /cung zad cig ni 'dir bshad de/ /ma lus pa dang rgyas par ni / /gzhan dag las kyang shes par bya/ /'jig rten dag na gang bzang dang //bdag nyid srid 1 pa gang yin pa/ /de dag thams cad sangs rgyas la/ /blo dang ldan pas thog mar dbul/ /gsang sngags rnams kyi bza' ba dang / /zas nyid gang dang gang gsungs 1 pa/ /blo dang ldan pas de nyid dbul/ /gzhan du byas na grub mi thob/ /gang dag 'gal dang ma smos dang / /gang dag 96—613

cung zad ngan pa'i rnams/ /de dag thams cad drag spyod la/ /khyad par du ni dbul bar gsungs/ /dri dang bdug spos mar me dang / /me tog dang ni lha bshos dang 1/ /thams cad cho ga 'di nyid kyi95)/ /zhi ba la yang bshad pa yin/ /gsang sngags rnams kyi 4 rang bzhin dang / /mthu dang las don rig byas nas//de yi bshos dang kha zas rnams/ /ji ltar rigs tsho ripar dbul tshibar bya/ /swa ri stasnyi ka dang u lo pa'i/ /bza' ba ci 'byor bu ram can/ /lag pan rtsa ba'i 'bras bu dang / /'o thug dag ni 'dod pa yin/ /thams cad 'dod ces bya ba yi / /gtor ma don kun sgrub byed pa/ /gsang sngags kun la shes par bya/ /drag shul spyod la ma yin no/ /de dag nyid las ci 'byor pa/ /kha dog sna tshogs pa zhes bya/ /gang gzhan cung zad kyis glags pa/ /gtor ma sna tshogs pa zhes bya/ /dang po de dag gnyis las ni/ /sna re las kyang ma byas pa/ /gzhan yang ci nasnyed pa bsnan pa/ /gtor ma rgya chen zhes su gsungs/ /'bras chan zho dang 'o ma mar/ /ming ni dkar gsum pa zhes gsungs/ /'bras chan 'o ma sbrang rtsi mar/ /ldan pa'i gtor ma mngar gsum yin/ /sa ya 9)yi dang ling ka la/ /sran can til gyi pi sta ka /lag pan rtsa ba 'bras bu dang / /cung zad cung zad kyis bsnan nas/ /me tog 'bras yos chu dang bcas/ /'dab mar bcas pa'i gtor ma ni/ /gsang sngags kun gyi gtor ma ste/ /de ming 'byung po thams cad pa'o/ /'o thug kho'abras yos swa /1sti ka /mar dang sbrang rtsi nas 'o thug /pi dza 1 pū 1 ra de dag rnams/ /rtag par zhi ba'i lha bshos so/ /zho dang lag pan 'bras thug dang / /bu ram la du u lo ngapo'i /shri be sasta la sogs pa'i zas/ /rtag par rgyas pa'i lha bshos so/ /'bras mar 96—614

chan gyo)dang ko tra ba/ / bza' ba til chan pu bar bcas/ /(5)sran chan dzo dang ni kri (bas ra/ /de dag rtag par drag spyod la'o/ /'bras bu rtsa ba sā 5lu can/ /btung ba mngar ba sbrang rtsi dang / /bza' ba mang po bu ram can/ /de dag gnod sbyin gtor 56)ma la'o/ /tshod mar bcas pa'i zas rnams dang / /skom dang pur+ṇa ṣ+ṭṛ sta (7)ka /'bras bu sna tshogs ldan pa yis / /lha bshos rig sngags kun la shis/ /gang yang mang pos bsngags pa dang / /zhim zhing kun srid phal che ba/ /de dag bsgrub 99pa mchog dag dang / /dam pa rnams la dbul bar 7bya / /don rnams mang po phye 11ba ni/ /cho ga bstan pa 'di dag las/ /rigs don dngos grub bye brag la/ /zlos pa ci rigs shes par bya/ /thog mar 'dab ma gtsang ma 'am/ /lo ma bkrus pa'i gzhi bting 12nas/ /cho ga'i bye brag shes pa yis/ /phyi nas lha bshos dbul bar bya/ /pad+ma'i lo ma'am 1 pa la sha /'o ma can shing las skyes pa'am/ /yang na paras ni sar pa'ang rung / /zhi ba'i gding bar bsngags dpa yin/ /chu skyes 'dab ma thams cad dang / /ljon shing lo ma gtsang ma 'am/ /khur skya las la bting ba dang / /chu shing lo ma rgyas pa la'o / /arga bha la ta ka dang / /ljon shing kha bo'i lo ma 'am/ /mkhas pas gang yang rung ba dag /drag po'i don du gding bar bya/ /lo 'dab mo yi ming can rnams/ /rig sngags rnams kyis gding bar bya/ /mngag gzhug rnams la 1 rtswa 18dag dgram/ /'dab 19ma sngon po sa la dgram/ /slob pa pos kyang cho ga 'dis / /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma la/ /sa gzhi bskus shing bstan 21nas su//ci rigs su ni bya bar bshad/ /nye reg khyad par du byas nas/ /lha bshos las rnams mo 2brtsam 22par bya/ /lha bshos las la thog mar ni/ /swa 2 snyi ka dag brim 96wa 615

par bya/ /rtsa ba rdo gu 'bras bu dang / /de yi 'og tu btung ba rnams/ /de nas bza' ba mang po ste/ /de'i 1'og zas rnams dbul bar bsgrags/ /tha mar zho dang 'o ma ste/ /'di dag lha bshos cho gar bshad/ /cho ga 'dis 5)ni ma smos pa'i/ /lhag ma'ang khong du chud par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag dang sgrub pa la / /lha bshos nan tan bskyed de bya/ / des na rnamakhas pas lha bshos dag /mi ngan pa dang rgya cher bya/ /bsnyen pa'i dus na ci nus dang / /ci 5skad bstan dang 6 ci snyed 7pa'i/ /gtor ma'i nalas ni bya bar bstan/ /dus tshigs dag la bzang por bya/ /gang dag bsreg bya'i rdzas rnams dang / /bdag gi kha zas gang yin las/ /thog mar de yi phud dbul te/ /cho ga shes pas bzlas brjod bya/ /ji skad bstan pa'i lha bshos dang / /rdzas kyi rigs rnams ci 'byor pa/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 9phul nas kyang / /nyin gcig bzhin du bzlas brjod bya/ /lha bshos dbul ba gsang sngags kyi/ /zhal zas yin par bshad pas na/ /des ni rtag tu kha zas sbyin/ /de phyir zlos 1 pa dag gis dbul/ /rtsa ba rdo gu 11'bras bu dang / /lha bshos cung zad ci snyed 12pa/ /dus gsum du yang k+ṇi gsang sngags la/ /phul khanas bodangos grub thob par 'gyur / /gal te zlos pas gsang sngags la/ /mchod pa'i bshos rnams ma phul na / /de tshe rtsub cing mdog ngan la/ /bkres pa dag gis gdungs par 'gyur/ /lha bshos med na de yi sems/ /rtog pa dag kyang mang por 'gyur/ /lha rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing / /bgegs rnams kyis kyang zil gyis gnon/ /de bas nan tan cher bskyed de/ /gsang sngags 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /dus tshigs dag la ci 'byor ba'i/ /lha bshos legs par dbul bar bya/ /bsnyen 96wa 616

pa'i dus na zlos pa pos/ /khang pa'i phyi rol khor yug tu/ /lha rnams kun la 'byung po yi(1)/ /gtor ma gus par dbul bar bya/ /gang nadag 'gal dang mi shis dang / /gang dag ngan cing smad pa dang / /gzhan dag mi gtsang gyur pa'i rdzas / /lha bshos phyir ni thams cad spang / /thams cad dang ni las kun la/ /lag pan /brgya chen dbul bar bya/ /lha rnams kun la dbul ba'i bshos/ /gsang sngags kyis ni mngon par bsngags / /sman rnams bcud ni yi gar 5'ong / /sngags kyi zas kyi bcud 'di dag /bdag gi 6dad pas 'bul 7lags kyis ri/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ā /ha ra ā 1 ha ra/sarba bit+yā dha ra pū dzi 11te swā hā/ sgrub pos dang por sngags 'di dang / /rang gi sngags kyis yongs bzlas nas/ /bsangs pa'i lha bshos lha rnams la/ /cho ga bzhin du dbul bar bya/ /gzhan gyi lha bshos gzhan dag la/ /gang tshe ma 'byor nas dbul ba/ /de 15tshe rang rig gsang sngags kyis/ /de la yang ni mngon par bsngags1 / /gtor ma'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /de bzhin drag shul spyod pa ste/ /mdor na las ni rnam gsum du/ /gsang sngags kun la bsgrags 1 pa yin/ /las ni rnam pa gsum char gyi/ /dngos grub gang gis 12myur ba dang / /nges par 'grub par 'gyur ba yi/ /cho ga de dag 'dir bshad do/ /byams pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag tshanas/ /dkon mchog gsum la gcig tu gzhol/ /zhi bar gyur pas zhi ba yi/ /bzlas 1 pa'am yang na sbyin sreg 1 bya/ /zla ba yar gyi tshes gcig nas/ /las rnams rab tu brtsam par bya/ /bye brag tu ni srod la ste/ /de ni zhi ba'i 96—617

las kyi dus/ /gnas gtsang ma yi lha rnams dag /de na kun du gzigs pas na / /las rnams myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bas der ni kun brtsam mo/ /dkar po'i gos ni bgos nas su/ /ku sha'i khres kyi stan 'dug nas1)/ /byang phyogs kha bltas gtsang zhi bas/ /zhi ba'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /ba yi lngi ba ma lhung bas/ /dus gsum dag tu der bskus la/ /me tog dkar po nanosil ma dag /bkram pa byas na rab tu shis/ /nas dang 'o thug zho dag dang / /'bras yos dag gam til dag gam/ /drur 4)ba'am ku sha sngon po 'am/ /pri yang ku yi me tog gam/ /sā 5lu'i chan nam ge sar ram/ /yang na me tog dkar po 'am / /sha ma'i yam sreg shing dag gam/ /yang na dri zhim thang nechu'ang rung / /mchod 7sbyin dag gi nanoljon shing ngam/ /'o mar bcas shing lo ma can / /yam shing rtse mo las skyes rlon/ /sbrang rtsi'am yang na mar yang rung / /rtog pa las gsungs cho ga ni/ /de dang de la sogs pa spyad/ /zhi ba'i las la blo can gyis/ /ljon shing 'o ma can gyi me9/ /rgyun bzhag me la blangs nas su/ /me ni cho ga bzhin byas te/ /zhi ba'i las la bsreg 7byin na/ /dngos grub rab tu ster bar 'gyur/ /'o ma can gyi yam shing gi/ /me la yam shing mtho gang tsam / /'o ma sbrang rtsi mar btags skyo te/ /zhi ba'i las la sbyin sreg 1 bya/ /dgon 1 pa'i ba lang lci ba dang / /de bzhin sha ma'i bud shing bzang / /yang na ljon shing dri zhim pa'i/ /bud shing zhi ba'i las la shis/ /sa gzhi dkar la brkos 1 pa yisa'i/ /zhugs thab kun du zlum po la/ /khru gang tsam gyi tshad du bya/ /zabs su sor ni bcu gnyis pal/ /de yi steng du kha ran ni/ /rab mnyam sor bzhi'i tshad tsam gdags1 / /de yi zhabs su 'khor lo bzhag /de yang 'phang 96—618

du sor gcig pa'o/ /pad+ma'i skyil krung du tsho1'dug sten/ /blo yis bsgom pa byas nas su/ /mchod pa la sogs legs byas te/ /de nas zhi ba'i las bya'o/ /dang por ston pa thub chen dang / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa dang / /nyan thos 'dod chags bral rnams dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod/ /byams me de bzhin gshegs mdzod spu/ /rig sngags gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /dga' bo zhes bya klu rgyal gnyis/ /gnas gtsang rigs kyi lha rnams dang / /'di dag las la dgod bya zhing / /zhi la 5rtag tu mchod par bya/ /de nas me tog dri la sogs/ /legs par bzhag ste las rnams bya/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / / yams kyi dzind dang gnod pa dang / /de bzhin bgegs dang nad 'go rnams/ /zhi bar byed pas zhi zhes bya/ /rang gi sems ni mnyam gzhag 7)ste/ /yid la dga' ba 8bskyed nas su/ /rgyas pa dag gis 9rgyas pa yi / /bzlas pa'am yang na sbyin sreg 1 bya/ /zla ba nya la kun brtsam ste11/ /phyi ma'i nya yi bar du bya/ /rgyas pa'i cho ga bstan pa yis/ /de srid bar du las bya'o / /rgyas pa dag gi /rtalas rnams la/ /bye brag tu ni snga dro shis/ /las de grub pa'i lha rnams ni/ /de ni byin gyis rlob par mdzad/ /lha rnams ma lus pa dag kyang / /de yi dus 1 su rgyu bas na/ /las su bya ba thams cad ni/ /dus de skokho nar borab tu shis/ /nang par dus na lha rnams ni/ /yid dgar gyur na mchog sbyin mdzad/ /de lta bas na mkhas pa yis/ /lhag par lade tshe brtsam par bya/ /gos dkar zung gcig 1 bgos nas su/ /bkra shis skyil mo krung byas te/ /shar phyogs kha bltas dga' bzhin du/ /rgyas pa'i cho ga bsgrims te spyad / /sa gzhi byug pa spos zhim bcas/ /dus gsum du ni 19bsku bar bya/ /96—619

me tog sil ma sna tshogs kyis/ /der ni rab tu dgram 1)par bshad/ /zas mchog dag gi gong bu ni/ /mngar gsum dag dang ldan pa 'am/ /sbrang rtsi mar dang zho sbyar ba'i/ /til nag dag gam mar dang zho/ /sha ta put+pa 2bil ba dang / /sā lu yi ni 'bras dag dang / /nā ga ge sar pad+ma dang / /kurnyi 4ka ra mar dang bcas/ /lag pan dang ni 'bru kun dang / /de bzhin mchod sbyin yam sreg 5shing / /de dag la sogs rdzas rnams kyis/ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ne tshul bzhin bya/ /rgyal rigs khyim nas blangs pa'i me'am/ /yang na 7rgyal po'i khyim nas blangs / /dgon pa'i me 'am me chen po/ /rgyas pa'i cho ga dag la shis / /yam shing sboms su chag 9gang pa/ /srid du khru gang tsam gyi tshad/ /zho mar 'o ma las btags nas/ /rgyas pa'i cho ga dag la bsreg1 /yam sreg 11shing 12du gang bstan pa/ /de dag nyid las me bud do/ /yang na me tog 'bras bu shing / /bud shing phyir ni rab tu shis/ /zhugs thab sa gzhi dmar po la/ /rgyar ni khru do tsam gyi tshad/ /gru bzhi pa la kha ran can/ /zabs su khru gang tsam du bya/ /kha ran mtho gang tshad tsam la/ /kha dog dmar po'i sas kyang bsku/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya mdzub gang ba/ /'phang du sor bzhi yod pa 'bya/ /dgos pa'i don ni gang yin pa/ /de nyid yid la lhur bsams te/ /cho ga thog mar bshad pa dag /byas nas rgyas pa'i las bya'o/ /phyag na pad+ma'i mthu chen dang / /don grub pa yang mchod pa bya/ /rig sngags 'chang dang gnod sbyin dang / /dpal gyi lha mo thams cad dang / /tshangs dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rig pa'i bdag mo mthu chen 15dang / /'phrog ma skorig sngags chen mo dag /rgyas pa'i las la mchod pa bya/ /de la sogs pa 1 blo can gyis/ /cho ga bzhin du 96—620

mchod nas kyang / /bdag nyid mngon par dbang bskur te/ /rgyas pa'i las rnams brtsam par bya/ /gang zhig tshe dang lang tsho dang / /byin dang mthu stobs 'phel byed dang / /yon tan dag dang 'dod don gang / /sgrub byed de ni rgyas zhes bya/ /mchog dang khro ba la gnas te/ /de nas 'dun 1pa brtan po yis/ /gsang sngags drag po 2bzlas pa'am/ /sbyin sreg bya bas dgra bo gzhom/ /tshes grangs dag dang rgyu skar dang / /smyung bar gnas par bya mi dgos/ /khros pa brtan par byas nas ni/ /mod 5la drag shul spyod pa brtsam/ /khyad par du ni mar ngo 'am/ /mar gyi dus tshigs dag gis ni/ /nyi ma'i gung ngam nam phyed na/ /drag shul spyod pa brtsam par bya/ /gang gi phyir ni yi dgas nedang / /sha za 'byung po srin po'i tshogs/ /drag po rnams kyis byin rlob pa/ /de phyir des 7na las rnams 'grub/ /dus de nan ni drag po'i las/ /'grub par 'gyur phyir rab tu shis/ /yang na gang tshe khros gyur pa/ /de tshe nyid na las brtsam mo/ /gang phyir gsang sngags drag po'i lhas/ /khros pa nyid na byin rlob pa/ /de phyir khro ba bskyed nas su/ /drag shul spyod pa'i las bya'o/ /rab tu drag po'i las rnams la/ /dmar po'i gos ni bgo ba 'am/ /sngon po'am yang na chus brlan pa/ /khrag gis sbags pa dag kyang bshad/ /de ni mig bgrad khro gnyer bsnyer9/ /so yang shin tu gtsigs nas ni/ /rkang pas rkang pa mnan nas su/ /lho phyogs kha bltas 'dug par bya/ /rang gi lus dang ngag dang ni/ /yid rnams kyis kyang sran btsugs te/ /gsang sngags mngon sum bzhin bsgoms nas/ /drag shul spyod pa'i las bya'o/ /der ni dus gsum dag tu yang / /nag po'i 1 sa yis bsku ba 'am/ /bong 11bu rnga mo la sogs pa'i/ /96—621

rtug pa'am dur khrod thal bas bsku/ /me tog dri nga'i sil ma 'am/ /yang na dri med pa dag dgram/ /me tog sngon po 1dmar po 'am/ /'bru 'am yang na phub mas dgram/ / yungs kur 2'bru tsam tsha ba 'am/ /rang gi khrag gam lan tshwa (87'am / /skye tshe nim pa'i lo ma 'am/ /rkang rjes sa 'am thal ba 'am bong bu la sogs rtug pa 'am/ /skra 5gtubs pa 'am bya rtug gam/ /khra la sogs pa'i sgro 'am tshil/ /gcin nam yang na tsher ma 'am/ /gyo mo'i dum bu'am rus phye 'am / /de bzhin sha chen la sogs pa'am/ /ka pid da ra'am nim pa 'am/ /yang na dur khrod mgal dum mam46/ /tsher ma can gyi shing rnams dang / /seng ldeng gi ni yam sreg 7shing / /cho ga bzhin du blo can gyis/ /drag shul spyad phyir sbyin sreg 8bya/ /dgra yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /dug can kun dang lan tshwa 59kun / /khrag dang ldan par sbyar byas te/ /drag shul spyod pa'i sbyin sreg 7bya/ /dur khrod dag na 'bar ba'i me'am11/ /yang na gdol pa'i khyim nas blang / /rus pa'am rdo las phyung 1 ba dag /drag shul spyod pa'i las la shes/ /gdug sna pa bshags 1 pa'i yam sreg 7shing / /rtse gnyis rnon por byas pa la/ /dug khrag yungs mar gyis bskus pa/ /sor bcu pa yi tshad du byas4/ /bud shing kha dang tsha 1 ba dang / /dri zhim pa yi skam shing ngam/ /yang na drag po'i las rnams la/ /dur khrod nas phyung ci yang rung / /kha dog nag po'i sa dag la/ /zhugs thab gru gsum phar bltas pa/ /sor ni nyi shu'i tshad du bya/ /zabs su khru phyed tshad du gsungs1 / /kha ran sor ni gsum pa la/ /thal ba dag gis 19bsku bar bya/ /zhabs su rdo rje sor brgyad pa/ /'phang du sor gcig yod pa na bzhag /thal ba sol ba phub ma sogs/ /yang na lan tshwa skye 21tshe sogs na/ /sbyin sreg nadag gi 96—622

rdzas rnams la/ /dgra bo dag gi gzugs byas la/ /gzugs de 1rang gi ming smos nas/ /gtub nacing gtub cing sbyin sreg 4bya/ /yang na de yi 5snying ga 6ru / /mnan nas sbyin sreg 7las rnams brtsam/ /sbyin sreg 8bzhin du bzlas brjod la'ang / /drag po'i gzugs brnyan mnan te bya/ /yang na rtog pa las gsungs pa'i/ /cho ga'i las bzhin bsgrub 9par bshad/ /gang zhig yid la bsams tshapa'i don/ /de la bstan nas brtsam bya ste/ /thams cad cho ga'i rjes mthun 11par/ /cho ga byas nas 12drag shul spyad/ /phyag na rdo rje rab gtum dang / /khro bo rnams ni gang 'dod pa/ /g.yog 'khor dag ni thams cad kyang / /drag po 1lhagazi brjid 'phags pa dang / /rig pa'i 7rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /khro bo rdo rje thog thog dang / /'chi med tshe dang mig brgya pa/ /klu dang grul bum srin po dang / /de la sogs pa blo can gyis15/ /drag shul spyod pa'i las dag la / /cho ga bzhin du sngar mchod de/ /bsrung lab byas nas brtsam par bya /las gang yan lag nyams byed dang / /gang yang bskrad par bya ba dang / /dbye bar bya ba gang yang rung / /nad kyis 1 'debs byed gang yin dang / /phung bar bya dang gdung bya dang / /mi dgar 'gyur ba gang yang rung / /yang na gsad 18pa'i las gang yin/ /de dag drag shul spyod par bshad/ /de ltar de'i las mkhas pa yis/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' smod dang / /rang bzhin ngan dang sdang 19ba dang / /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang / /log par lta dang sdig can dang / /tshul khrims 'chal dang rgol ba dang / /bla ma la 'khu 21de dag la/ /phan phyir khro ba bskyed de bya/ /rtog pa mang po las gsungs pa'i / /lus dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba dang / /khro bo mngag gzhug pho nya mo/ /96—623

drag po'i tshogs kyis drag shul spyod1/ /sems can 'phongs (gel zhi ba ( stebya/ /bde bar gnas la rgyas pa ste / /gang dag drag shul spyod pa'i las/ /de dag dgra la spyad par bya/ /mkhas pas sa bla'i (5)gsang sngags kyis/ /drag shul spyod pa spyad par bya/ /cho ga zhib mo 6ribartsam bya ste/ /sdang dang g.yo sgyu can la spyad / /nges par myong 'gyur las mang po/ /bdag gis dang du blang dgos zhes / /de yis nyes pa byas pa kun/ /tshe 'di nyid la smin par bya/ /de ltar gsang sngags lha rnams kyang / /ngan spyod rnams 77skal brtse ba'i phyir/ /de la sogs pa'i thabs rnams kyis/ /ngan song dag las 'byin par mdzad/ /dgra la gnod pa bya ba yang / /nyes dang 'tsham par bya dgos pa58ni/ /nyes pa chung ngu byas pa la/ /'chi bar 'gyur ba 9mi brtsam mo/ /khros pa'i dbang gis byas pa yi / /snying tshim nas ni mod la yang / /zhi bar bya phyir zhi ba yi/ /sngags kyis khozhi ba'i cho ga bya11/ /yang na de yi 12me nyid la/ /gsang sngags de nyid kho na yi/ /bskul 1 tshig yongs su brjod nas su/ /'o mas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 14bya/ /mkhas pas bde gshegs chos nyid dang / /byang chub sems ni dran bya ste/ /gzu lums sacan dang sdig can la/ /de ma thag tu zhi ba sabya/ /zhi ba mchod rten ring bsrel can/ /pad+ma'i rdzing bur rgyas pa ste/ /zlos pa pos nyu ni khyad par du/ /dur khrod dag tu drag shul spyad/ /zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang drag shul spyod pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //gang dag steng du 'gro ba'i las/ /de kun rab tu shes par bya/ /gang gzhan cung zad mi snang ba/ /de dag 'bring gi cho gar bshad/ /gang dag 'di 96wa 624

nas sa pa'i las(1)/ /de dag thams cad tha mar bshad/ /de bas rab 'bring tha ma yi/ /las rnams kyi ni bye brag dbye/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma yi/ /dngos grub las kyi dbye ba las/ /steng dang bar snang sa pa dag /gnas ni rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /rig sngags 'chang dang nam mkhar na'agro/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyi dngos grub dang / /de bzhin mngon shes mthong ba dang / /zhi ba'i blo dang ye shes thob/ /bstan bcos kun shes blo dag dang / /smra mkhas thos pa 'dzin pa dang / /ro langs grub dang mngon phyogs dang / /gnod sbyin mo la sogs grub cadang / /sa stengs gargyal srid yid bzhin nor/ /gter chen dag ni gnyis 6pa ste/ /de dag la sogs bstan pa 7rnams/ /rig sngags dngos grub rab yin no/ /mi snang stobs dang brtson 'grus dang / /phug gi dngos grub bcud kyis 8len/ /mngag gzhug lha min dngos grub dang / /sha za sa la bhañdzi 9ka /mang du thos pa'i shes thob dang / /rkang mgyogs pa yi dngos grub dang / /de dag la sogs dngos grub rnams/ /'bring po'i nang nas rab tu bstan/ /'gro 1 ba thams cad dga' ba 11dang / /'jig rten pa rnams dbang bskur dang / /drag shul spyod pa'i cho ga ni/ /bskrad pa la sogs thams cad dang / /gang gzhan cung zad phal gyi rnams/ /mkhas pas tha mar rig par bya/ /rdzas 'bar ba las rab tu 'gyur/ /du ba nyid las 'bring du 'gyur//drod las dngos grub tha mar 'gyur/ /de ltar dngos grub 1 rnam gsum po/ /'phags gsungs gsang sngags mthu chen gyis/ /dngos grub rab ni 'grub par grags / /lha yi sngags kyis 1 'bring po grub/ /sa blas tha ma 'grub par gsungs / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rig 1 pa yi/ /sngags kyis gludangos grub chen 96—625

po 'thob/ /pad+ma 'dzin pas gsang sngags kyis/ /dngos grub 'bring po thob par bshad/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs pa yis/ /dngos grub tha ma 'grub par bsgrags/ /rab kyi tha ma gang yin pa/ /de dang tha ma'i rab mi mnyam/ /dngos grub lhag ma gnyis pa yang / /cho ga'i rim pa de nyid do/ /'bras bu'i yon tan bstan pa yi/ /che ba'i bye brag rnam 6)gsum las/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma yi/ /bye brag de dag rab tu bsgrags/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nayis/ /gsungs pa'i gsang sngags gang yin pa/ /de las dngos grub rab 'byung ba/ /tha ma dag la yod par 'gyur/ /rgyas par gsungs pa'i gsang sngags las/ /kha cig las gcig byed pa'ang yod/ /de dag gi ni las de yang / /rab dang 'bring dang tha mar bshad/ /kha cig de ltar rim med par / /dngos grub rnams ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /'dam las pad+ma skye ba dang / /tsan+dan shing las me 'byung bzhin/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma la lus kyi dngos grub rab yin no/ /rdzas las grub pa 'bring yin te/ /longs spyod dngos grub tha ma'o/ /tha ma'i gsang sngags chos pa ni/ /la las rab tu bsnyen byas na/ /dngos grub gzhan las blangs nas ni/ /mchog kyang rab tu ster bar 'gyur/ /rab la'ang la la zhig gis ni/ /ma bsgrims par yang bsnyen byas na / /sngags kyi 5dngos grub tha ma stsol/ /de bas bsnyen pa rab tu gces / /lha rnams la yang dbul po yod/ /yi dgas ri la yang mthu chen yod/ /de bzhin dngos grub dag la yang / /rnam pa sna tshogs yod par 'gyur/ /rab 'bring tha ma re re la'ang / /dngos grub rnam pa gsum du dbye/ /gsang sngags rnams kyi mthu shes nas/ /bsnyen pa las 57)ni dngos grub brtsamatshonas/ /dngos 96—626

grub dbye ba'i mtshan nyid rim par phye ba'o// // zlos pas (1)dang po lha khang du/ /zhugs te mnyam par bzhag rinanas ni/ /lha la mngon du phyogs 'dug ste/ /thal mo sbyar bas phyag 'tshal ( nas/ /rjes su mthun gopa'i me tog dang / /spos kyi chu ni gtsang ma yis/ /mchod yon go rims (5)bzhin bshams nas/ /bdug spos kyis kyang rab bdugs tsite/ /lan bdun bzlas (7)nas (8)mchod yon des/ /lha rnams dag ni spyan drang ngo / /gsang sngags spyan ni drangs nas kyang / /de yi 'og tu mchod pa bya/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs ma dang / /rdo ba dang ni shing gi 'am/ /kham pa'am dung ngam nya phyis sam/ /de bzhin lo ma skyongs pa'ang rung / /zhi dang rgyas dang drag spyod dang / /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma yi9/ /las dang dngos grub rnams la ni / /rigs pa'i snod rnams sbyar bar bya/ /kha dog yon tan bshad pa las/ /gzhan dang gzhan yang ci rigs pa'i/ /snod rnams ci 7ltar 'dod pa ni/ /'dod yon phyir ni rab tu sbyar11/ /zhi ba'i mchod yon nas dang bcas/ /til dang bcas pa rgyas pa la/ /thams cad dang ni 'gal ba'i phyir/ /ko tra par bcas drag spyod la/ /zhi ba'i mchod yon 'o ma can/ /rgyas pa la ni zho can no/ /ba yi gcin nam yang na khrag /drag shul spyod pa'i don du shis/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma yi/ /las rnams kun la 'bras yos shis/ /spos dang me tog ku sha til/ /chu rnams bye brag med par bzang / /mchod yon phyir ni zangs kyi snod / /las rnams kun la rab tu shis/ /'di 12ma 'byor gyis bdag la ni/ /bzod mdzod ci 'byor bas kyang bya/ /sngags rgyud las gsungs 12thams cad 96—627

kyang / /rig pa'i rgyal pos rim bzhin du/ /spyan drang cho ga bya bar bshad/ /yang na gang rjes gang 'brang ba'i/ /sngags rgyud bdag po gang yin dang / /rig sngags rgyal mo gang yin pa/ /de gnyis kyis ni yongs bzlas na tsho/ /de nas de yis mngon par bsngagasan/ /rigs gsum la yang de bzhin du/ /thams cad spyan ni drang bar bya/ /gang dag rang rgyud las gsungs pa/ /de dag la ni de nyid bshad/ / bzhud cig zhes ni bdag po'i bka'/ /zlos sa)pas rab tu bsgrags nas bzhud/ /spyan yang drangs ma thag tu ni/ /gsang sngags dgyes nas 'byon 5par 'gyur/ /la la 6cho ga gang yin las/ /spyan drangs slar gshegs bshad pa dag /de dag gsol ba'i las byas nas/ /rab tu dgyes nas de bzhin mdzad/ / rig sngags rgyal mos rig sngags rnams/ /spyan drang ba yi cho ga bya/ /7rig sngags rgyal pos gsang sngags rnams/ /gzhan rnams la 8ni gnyis kus so/ /lan cig 9bzlas sam lan gsum bzlas/ /yang na lan bdun mngon par bsngags1 / /gsang sngags bye brag 11rnams shes nas / /nyi shu rtsa gcig tu yang bzlas/ /mchod yon cho ga bzhin bzlas nas/ /bdug spos dag gis rab tu bdug /gus pas pus mo gnyis btsugs nas/ /las byed bcas pa'i lag pas dbul/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'dir/ /bdag gi 12mchod yon de bzhes la/ /mchod pas 1 bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /gsang sngags gang dag gcig pu la//drag cing gtum la pha rol gnon/ /de ni rang gi sngags nyid kyis/ /spyan drang ba yi cho ga bya/ / gang yang phal pa kha cig dang / /logang yang 'khor du gyur pa dag /de dag rang gi sngags nyid kyis/ /spyan drang cho ga bya bar bshad/ /96—628

rig sngags rgyal 1dang gsang sngags rnams/ /mdor na so so'i gsang sngags sam / /thams cad la yang snying po yis/ /spyan drang ba ni mchog tu bshad/ /mdor na mkhas pas mchod yon dang / /spyi 2yi rigs kyi snying po yis/ /tshur gshegs zhes ni spyan drang ba/ /'di ni gsang bar rab tu bsgrags/ /rab tu dad pas phyag bya ste/ /gsol ba yang dang yang byas nas/ /gsang sngags rnams dang rig sngags dag /mkhas pas gus pas spyan drang ngo / /zlos pas mnyam gzhag calag pa gnyis/ /spyi bor bzhag pa'i mchod yon dag /gsang sngags mchog la phul na 5ni/ /'on tang 6spyan ni drang bar 'gyur/ /bar ma dag la brang kha nas/ /phal pa rnams la lte ba nas/ /mchod yon tshul bzhin bzlas dbul ba/ /spyan drang cho ga rig par bya/ /mchod yon sngags kyi bzlas pa yis/ /ri mo'am yang na gzugs dag la/ /gsang sngags gang dag 'greng snang ba/ /de la 'greng ste spyan drang ba/ /'dug pa la ni 'dug nas so/ /bzur ba la ni bzur nas so/ /spyan drang phyir ni mchod yon dag /cho ga bzhin du dbul bar bgyi/ /gsang sngags la la'i gnas dag ni/ /gang dang gang gi phyogs yin pa/ /phyogs der thog mar bltas nas ni/ /mchod yon bzlas 7te der phyogs la/ /las de phyogs su bltas nas ni/ /de nas mchod yon dbul bar bya/ /'di ni spyan drang cho ga gzhan/ /gsang ba'i dam pa bshad pa yin/ /thal sbyar mchod yon me tog dang / /yid kyis sam ni chus kyang rung / /mkhas pas spyan drang cho ga ni/ /gang du'ang rung bar mdun du byas / /gsang sngags kun gyi cho ga 'dir/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan pa yis / /spyan 9drang cho gar gsungs pa dag1 /'di ni kun gyi spyi yin no/ /96—629

sgrub pos 1sngon 9bdu bsnyen pa dang / /mchod pa la sogs las rnams dang / /las kyi cho ga byed pas na/ /spyan drang ba ni yid kyis bya/ /ji ltar mthun (kyepa'i cho ga bzhin/ /spyan drang cho ga bshad pa ni/ /thams cad don byed phyir gsungs te/ /phran tshegs dag la phal gyis bya/ /zlos pas spyan ni drangs nas kyang / /cho ga bzhin du mnyes byas nas/ /gsang sngags kyi ni lha rnams kyang (pe//phan 'dogs la sogs thams cad mdzad/ /spyan drang ba'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o / / //sgrub pa pos ni las kun la/ /lha rnams spyan drangs (5)byas nas ni/ /gsang sngags rim par phye ba bzhin/ /cho ga shes pas mchod pa brtsam/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod pa bzhes nas kyang / /thugs kyis thugs dpag mdzad (6)du gsol / /bdag ni gus dang ldan no zhes/ /lha la yang dang yang gsol nas/ /gsang sngags sgrub pas dus gsum du/ /cho ga 'dis ni mchod pa (7)bya/ /sngon gyi sngags rgyud lung gis ni/ /thog mar dri rnams dbul bar bya/ /de nas me tog rjes mthun pa'o58ri/ /de nas bdug spos rab tu bsgrags/ /de nas lha bshos rjes mthun 95pa'o/ /mar me tha mar rab tu sbyar/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos bsangs pa'i lardzas/ /gtsang 31zhing ngan pa ma yin pa/ /rjes su mthun 3)zhing yon tan can/ /blo dang ldan pas gus pas dbul/ / /so so yi ni gsang sngags kyis/ /re re la yang mngon bsngags rmenasam/ /mchod pa'i yan lag ci dgar dbul/ /so so so sor mchod yon dbul/ /che ge mo 'di bzhes shig 96wa 630

ces / /rdzas kyi ming nas phyung ste dbul/ /ma 'byor na yang gzugs brnyan rnams / /byas nas mchod yon dbul bar bya/ /gus dang mchod yon phul ba yis / /cho ga thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur/ /thal sbyar mchod yon blos 1mchod dang / /cho ga'i yan lag nyid dang gzhi'ormon/ /mchod pa'i cho ga thams cad la/ /ji ltar rigs par (55sbyar bar bya/ /rnam pa kun las camakhas pa ni/ /rtag tu ci nus pas kyang rung / /chos kyi thog mar yid pa'agro zhes/ /thub pa chen pos bka' stsal pas(6)/ /yid kyi mchod pa khyad par can/ /legs pa nyid du brtsam par bya/ /tshemachod pa'i rim par naphye ba'o// //yid ni rab tu mnyam bzhag 9nas/ /cho ga lhag ma bya bar bshad/ /sgrub pa pos ni thog ma ru/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos bskrad par bya/ /yang na rig 7sngags so so yi/ /las kun byed pa'i rig sngags kyis/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 11pa ta ye/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā 12ya/ /o hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ 1 te ngartsu phaṭa swā hā / o traṃ bad+dha swā hā/ na mo ma hā shri skayis/ oṃ sha 1 me sa ma ye sau me sidhi 1 sidhi sā 1/dha ya shi be shi baṃ ka ri/ ā 2 ba ha sarba sarba sā da dha ni swā hā/ rigs gsum gyi las thams cad byed pa'i gsang 22sngags so/ /khro bo'i gsang sngags rgyar du )bcas pas su/ /me tog la sogs rnam par bsang / /lag pa g.yon par bzhag pa'i chus/ /thog ma nyid du bsang gtor bya/ /bdag po'i sngags kyis bya ba 'am/ /yang na rigs kyi snying pos bya/ /mdor na gsang sngags thams cad kyang / /phyag rgyar bcas pas bsang bar bya/ /bdag nyid rnam par sbyang 2596—631

ba'i phyir/ /spos chus 1lag mthil blugs pa la/ /blta zhing de yi nasnying po bzlas / /rang gi spyi bor bsang gtor bya/ /stan yang rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags sam/ /yang na khro bo'i rgyal po yis/ /spos kyi chus ni bsang gtor bya/ /lan bdun bzlas brjod byas pa'i chus/ /sa phyogs kun du bsang gtor bya/ /bsang ba dang ni sbyang ba dag /gsang sngags 'dis ni byas par 'gyur/ /oṃ tī li tī cal/ brdzu brdzu rabhur 56chibarnya brnya hūṃ phaṭa/de nas steng du blo can gyis/ /rig pa'i rgyal po 'di 'don cing / /bdug pas lha rnams bsang ba dang / /bcing ba dang ni sbyang bar bya/ /oṃ su sirnyi 7 ka ra dz+wa la hi a nan+ta mūrta ye / dz+wa la dz+wa la/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/thams cad spyi'i'o9/ /oṃ dz+wa la hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'o/ /oṃ pad+ma ni 1 bha ga ba 11ti/ mo ha 12ya/ dza gad mo ha ni swā hā/ pad+ma'i rigs la'o / /de nas blo dang ldan pa yis/ /rigs kyi snying po yongs bzlas pa'i/ /spos chus kho ra khor yug tu/ /thams cad du ni phyogs bcing ba'o/ /rig 1snyesngags rgyal po'i snying po 'am/ /bdag gi rig sngags rgyal po 'am rang gi gsang sngags mngag gzhug pas/ /phyogs bcing ba ni gus par bya/ /bh+rūṃ 7o a mṛ 5tod+dha lob hūm̐ phaṭa/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa 1 badz+ra pā ṇa 18yi19 ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 2 pa ta ye/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ griṇ+ḍa griṇ+ḍa 1rtsu/ grohā 22pa ya grihā pa ya hūm̐/ ā 2 na ya ho bha ga ban 22bit+yā 26rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rigs gsum gyi rig pa'i rgyal po'i sngags so/ /de dag nyid kyi snying po yis ra ba rnams kyang rab tu sbyar/ /rigs kyi rig sngags rnams kyis ni/ /lha rnams yongs su bsrung bar bya/ /las rnams kun la thams cad du/ /bgegs la 96—632

sogs pa bsal ba las/ /rnam par rtog pa'i cho ga yis/ /bdud rtsi thal 1sbyor rab tu sbyar/ /khang pa'i kho ra khor yug tu/ /dra ba ra ba phur bu dag /tī li tī la bdud rtsi zhes/ /khro bo gnyis ni rtag tu sbyar/ /bsrung ldeba'i gsang sngags tha dad pa/ /cho ga las bstan gang yin pa/ /de nyid 'dir ni sbyar bar bya / /yang na gang la dad pa'ang rung / /bcom ldan spyan ni gang yin dang / /gos dkar can ma gang yin dang / /rig sngags mā ma khri gang layin/ /de dag thog mar yongs su bzlas/ /des 5ni bdag dang lha yang bsrung 6/ /sdig pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur/ /bgegs rnams sma 7yang 'bebs pa dang / /bsams pa'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur/ /rig sngags mā ma tī nagacig pu/ /rgyal dang pad+ma'i rigs la yang / /blo can bdag gi gzungs su 'dod/ /thams cad la yang rab tu sbyar/ /cho ga las bshad gsang sngags kyis/ /bsrung 99)ba'i las rnams brtsam du'ang rung / /yang na dpa' bo gcig pu yis/ /thams cad cho ga bzhin du bya/ /de ltar gsang sngags thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor las bshad cho ga bzhin/ /bsnyen pa'i tshe yang zlos pa pos/ /ma lus pa las shes par bya/ /gang yang rigs bdag gsang sngags sam/ /rigs kyi snying po gang yin pa'am/ /gsang sngags kun gyi rgyal po'am/ /gang yang sngags rgyud rgyal po 'am/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /gsum ga 1 la yang de dag gis/ /rang rigs las la bye brag tu/ /zlos pa pos 11ni bya bar rigs/ /bsrung 12dang spyan drang sbyang ba dang / /bcing dang phyir bzlog mnan pa dang / /dgang dang gzhil bar bya ba dang / /tshar gcad 1 pa dang bskul ba dang / /de la sogs pa'i las rnams kun/ /rigs gsum dag ni thams cad dang / /96—633

dngos grub dag la de dag gis/ /sgrub 1pa pos ni thams cad bya/ /bdag gi '-igasang sngags bdag nyid kyang / /snying po de dag nyid kyis bsrung zhu)/ /gtsug phud cagos dang bsang 5byed la/ /mdud pa bor te bdun gsum bzlas/ /snying gar6 mthe bo 7rtse btsugs 8te/ /bdag nyid bsrung kyi)ba'i phyir bzlas so/ /yang na thal ba'am yungs kur 7chus/ /bdag nyid bsrung bar spyad par bya/ /drag po yi ni las rnams la/ /bdag po'i sngags kyis bsrung ba /dzostebya/ /sgrub k+ṣ-i/gepa pos ni zhi ba la'ang / /gsang sngags drag pos nan tan bya/ /lha rnams byin gyis rlob pa yang / /bdag gi sngags kyis mdzad par 'gyur/ /bdag gi sngags la 'jigs dogs na/ /bsrung ba bdag pos bya bar bshad/ /sgrub pa po ni blo can gyis/ /gnyis gar rtag par las rnams la/ /bdag nyid bsrung tu lheba'i cho ga dag /gtsang mas lhag par legs par bya/ /lha yi khang pa'i phyi rol du / /gcig pu ci dgar spyod pa na/ /lha rnams yongs su bsrung ba'i phyir/ /bdag nyid bzhin du kun du spyad/ /phyi rol chags la sogs pa dang / /nam yang gang dag mi gtsang bar/ /khro bo 'chol cingapa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /de tshe bsrung bar 15bya bar bshad/ /na mo badzā ya/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha lapa tsa bi dh+wa 1 na sa ya u:zla kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ khrus byed tshe na bgegs kyi nyusnyedagras / /bsrung ba rtag tu bya bar bshad/ /zan za'i tshe na bdag pos bsrung 19/ /nyal tshe rigs kyi rig sngags kyis/ /rigs gsum la yang rtag par ni / /bgegs rnams kun gyis glags gyur la/ /rig sngags rgyal po zhes bya ba/ /des ni bsrung ba bya bar bshad/ /bsrung 2 ba'i rim par phye ba'o// //96—634

o e ka dz+wa la badz+ra pā 91〉ṇi hūm̐/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de la sogs pa ma lus pa/ /de ltar rinabasrung dab byas nas cani/ /bdag gi 5yid ni mnyam bzhag (6)ste/ /bzlas brjod bya ba kun du brtsam/ /ku sha sngon po'i rtswa 7stan ni/ /'phang du sor bzhi yod pa la/ /mnyam zhing zheng du mtho gang ba/ /srid du sor ni bcu drug bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i bzlas brjod tshe/ /de dag thams chod bya bar gsungs/ /de dag ma 'byor ku sha'i rtswa'am / /yang na 'jag ma sngon po'ang rung / /las kyi bye brag ji lta bar/ /shing las byas pa'i stan yang rung po)/ /de yi tshad du legs bzhogs pa'i/ /shing gi 1 khri'u 'ang rab tu shis/ /'dab /lham gtsang ma de dang de/ /khyad par du ni las kun la/ /man ngag bstan pa de yis ni/ /lo ma'i stan yang bshad pa yin/ /mchog la sogs pa'i bye brag gis/ /spyi yi las rnams thams cad dang / / skyil krung 12bkra shis bzang po ste/ /de dag 'dug thabs gsum yin no/ /mkhas pas der yang 'dug nas ni/ /mchod pa'i cho ga legs byas nas/ /blo yis gus pa rab bskyed de/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa bstod/ /de nas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /de nas spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /de nas rig pa'i rgyal po che/ /rdo rje 'chang ba bstod par bya/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i 1 zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pas 'dod chags bral bar 'gyur/ /dge bas ngan song las grol ba/ /gcig 7tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam thob pa/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gnas/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 96—635

'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun bsags pa/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes 1mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag (5par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs po che la drag shul can/ /rig sngags rgyal po dge ba dag /gdul dka' ba dag 'dul ba porin/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar gus par thal sbyar nas/ /rgyal sras gzhan yang bstod pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzhung gis bstod/ /de nas sdig pa so sor bshags/ /'jig rten dag gi 4phyogs kun na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs dang / /dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dag /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /tshe rabs gang yang rung ba na/ /bdag gis 5sdig pa gang 6bgyis dang / /sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan dag dang / /tshe rabs 'di dang 'khor ba na/ /'dod chags dbang dang blun pa dang / /khro ba dag gis 'khrugs gyur te/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nam/ /bla ma dag dang pha ma dang / /dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sbyin gnas gang yang rung ba dang / /de la 7rigazhan pa'i sems can dag /yon tan ldan dang mi ldan la/ /sdig pa'i las rnams gang bgyis dang / /gang yang bgyid du stsal 8ba dang / /gang yang cung zad yi 9rang ba/ /bag med pas ni phra mo yang / /lus ngag yid kyis bgyis pa rnams/ /de dag ma lus blos 1 bsdus nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras bcas pa/ /bdag gis da 11ni mngon sum bzhin/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal mo skyo ba'i yid du gyur pa yis/ /thal mo sbyar te nongs pa'i 12rnams/ /yang dang yang du so sor bshags/ /bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa'i 1 rnams/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen pa bzhin/ /de ltar bdag gis so sor bshags/ /slan 96—636

chad de ltar yong mi bgyid/ /srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid ji srid 'tsho bar du/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gus par 1yang dag skyabs su mchin/ /de yi yon tan gus bsgrags te/ /sa la mgo bos gtugs ri4)nas ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la blo can gyis/ /de ltar gus pas skyabs su 'gro/ /de nas mchog gi sa bon gang / /thar pa bdud rtsi 'bras bu sbyin / /shin tu bsgoms nas mchog gyur pa/ /dngos grub phyir ni de bskyed do/ /sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i/ /sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang / /ngan 'gro rnams las bsgral ba dang / /nyon mongs rnams las dgrol ba'i phyir/ /srid pa mi bde dog pa na/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs ci mchis pa/ /de ltas 5yongs su bskyab 6pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can phongs pa thams cad kyi/ /skyabs su bdag nyid rtag tu shog /bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ /rten med rnams kyi rten du bdag /skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs 'gyur zhing / /sdug bsngal bde bar byed pa dang / /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed par shog /dge ba'i las rnams gang dang gang / /'di dang gzhan du bsags pa 7rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes zhes bya ba'i/ /tshogs ni rnam pa gnyis su shog /pha rol phyin pa drug sgo nas/ /bdag gis brtson 'grus gang brtsams pa/ /de yang sems can ma lus pa/ /thams cad la ni phan par shog / tshe yi namatha' klas byed pa dang / /gang yang cung zad byed 'gyur ba/ /mdor na sems can thams cad kyi / /nyon mongs thams cad zhi ba dang / /grol bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad cing / /byang chub rab tu dga' brtson no/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /cho 96—637

ga bzhin du kun du bskyed/ /sems can kun la snying rje dang / /byams pa nye bar gnas par bya/ /sems ni legs par sbyang ba'i phyir/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 1rjes dran drug /nang gi bdag nyid zhi ba yis/ /bsam pa gcig tu bsgom par bya/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis(2)/ /smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang dge ba'i sems kyis su/ /de bzhin du ni smon lam 'debs / /chos kyi longs spyod sna tshogs la/ /mnyam par bzhag gestenas yi (༄rang ngo / /sems can thams cad bde ba dang / /zhi zhing nad kyang med par shog /bdag ni bya ba kun nus shing / /yon tan dang yang ldan par shog /nor ldan gtong phod shes rab can/ /bzod ldan dge la dad pa dang / /sems can tshe rabs thams cad du/ /skye ba dran zhing brtser ldan shog /de nas thal mo mnyam sbyar nasar/ /bla ma la ni phyag 'tshal 6nas/ /rig sngags rgyal po dran byas te/ /mkhas pas cho ga 'di dag bya/ /sngags kyi nor bu blangs nas ni/ /lag pa'i snyim par bcug nas su/ /rig sngags rgyal po lan cig (7༄bsam / /de nas gsang sngags 'di bzlas so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa 8ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā ri9)pa ta ye / o ki ri ki ri ro dri hu1ni swā hā / rdo rje'i rigs la'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ad+dha hu te bi dza ya sidhi sidha 1 sar te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā 1 ba lo ki te 15sha rā laya/ bo dhi 1 satā 18ya/ oṃ a mi nyu7ta ri snag mes1/ shri ye shri 2ya lhani li swā hā/ pad+ma'i rigs la'o/ /mthe bong dang zhu ni srin lag gis / /las rnams kun la nor bu dang / /mkhas pas drag po'i las rnams la//mdzub 5mos drang bar 27rab tu bsgrags/ /rgyal ba'i rigs la bo de tse rme/ /96wa 638

sngags kyi nor bur rab tu bsgrags/ /pad+ma'i rigs la pad+ma'i snying / /rdo rje'i rigs la ru druk+ṣa0)/ /rigs gsum dag ni thams cad la/ /nor bu de dag rab tu bsgrags/ /bzlas brjod byed pa'i las kun la/ /de dag dge zhing mchog tu bshad/ /lung tang ta la'i 'bras bu dang / /dung dang kham pa las byung dang / /shel dang mu tig ba so dang / /de bzhin byi 2ru nor bu dang / /sa bon rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /lbu nam dag gi phreng ba'ang rung / /sngags kyi nor bu de dag rnams/ /cho ga 'di las rab tu bsgrags/ /rigs dang 4bye brag la sogs (5)las/ /gces shing kha dog ci 6lta bar/ /mkhas pas 'di ltar rig par bya/ /drag shul spyod la khyad par du/ /rus pa sna tshogs shis pa yin/ /de nas gsang sngags gzhan gyis kyang / /dngos grub 'dod pas mngon par bsngags(7) / /gcig ni sbyang ba'i gsang sngags te/ /gnyis pa 'grub phyir shes par bya/ /o 58na mo bha ga ba te/ sidhe sā (dha ya sā khodha ya/ sin+tarba 11swā hā/de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'o/ /o ba 1 su ma ti shri 1 ye swā hā/ pad+ma'i rigs la'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a tsi tañdza saye swā hā/ rdo rje'i rigs la'o/ /sngags kyi nor bu'i rig zhisngags rnams so/ /phyag rgya sngags kyi nor bu dag /cho ga bzhin du blangs nas ni/ /nor bu snying gar tshabazung nas su/ /bzlas brjod rab tu brtsam par bya/ /gus pas dkon mchog gsum po dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ /rig sngags tshogs ni mtha' dag la/ /phyag byas de 'og bzlas brjod brtsam/ /yid kyis gsang sngags lha rnams ni/ /yang nas yang du mngon bsams te/ /rtog pa ngan pa rnams 1 bsal nas/ /mkhas pas bzlas brjod brtsam par bya/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa la1 / /o dang bcas shing 19 96—639

phyag dang bcas/ /lhag par zhi ba'i sems kyis ni/ /blo yis bzlas brjod dal bus bya1/ /drag shul can gyi sems kyis ni/ /hūm̐ dang bcas shing phaṭa dang bcas/ /bzlas brjod gzhan gyis thos bya ba/ /drag shul spyod pa rab tu shis / /mkhas pas gsang sngags yi ge rnamasanas/ /bcwa ri skulnga man chad grangs rnams la/ /spyir ni yi ge du yod pa/ /de snyed 'bum phrag bzlas brjod bya/ /yi ge sum cu 4rtsa gnyis la/ /bzlas brjod sum 'bum bya bar bshad/ /de bas yi ge mang ba sgrul/ /sngon du bsnyen pa khri bya'o/ /rigs dang las dang gsang sngags dag /mkhas pas legs par shes byas nas/ /rjes su mthun 56pa'i brtson pa yis/ /sngon du bsnyen 7pa brtsam par bya/ /shin tu mchog gi las rnams ni/ /bzlas brjod khyad par can gyis 'grub/ /sngon du bsnyen pa med par yang / /las rnams phal ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags dag ni thams cad kyi/ /dngos grub rnams ni thams cad la/ /thog mar bzlas brjod bcu cha bya/ /de nas de la sta gon gnas/ /de ltar sta gon gnas byas pas / /lha yang sta gon mdzad gyur na/ /de tshe chos pas cho ga bzhin/ /de yi 'og tu bzlas brjod brtsam/ /gang zhig mtshan ma'am tshig gis ni/ /bzlas brjod byed pa mi bzhed na/ /bsnyen pa yang dang yang byas nas / /lan gsum bar du sta gon gnas/ /rig sngags bsnyen pas mnyes gyur na/ /zlos pa po la dgongs nas su/ /gang gis dang por bka' stsal pa/ /de dag myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /chos pa blo dang ldan pa yis/ /lan gsum sta gon gnas byas kyang / /gang dag dgongs pa mi 'dzin pa'i/ /lha de nam yang mi bzlas so / /gtsang ma'i gnas su gtsang sbra can/ /mnyam par bzhag 7ste legs 96wa 640

'dug nas/ /ci 6)srid yid (5)ni mi skyo bar/ /de srid bar du bzlas brjod bya/ /cho ga bshad pa thams cad la/ /lus kyi gtsang sbra byas nas su/ /snga dro mel tshe thun gcig dang / /phyi dro mel tshe thun gcig bzlas/ /nyi ma'i gung la thun phyed ri byedam/ /yang na thun gyi sum cha bzlas/ /yang na thun gyi bzhi cha 'am/ /yang na mkhas pas cung zad bzlas/ /mtshan mo srod dang tho rangs la mel tshe thun ni phyed phyed du/ /gang zhig mkhas pas bzlas byas pa/ /de ni lhag par mchod par 'gyur/ /drag shul spyod pa'i las kun dang / /mi snang ba la sogs pa dang / /dur khrod dag gi las rnams la/ /rtag tu mtshan mo bzlas pa bzang / /nyin par bzlas brjod gang bshad pa/ /de dag sbyin sreg 5mtshan mo bya / /mtshan mo bzlas brjod gang bshad pa/ /de dag sbyin sreg 6nyin par bya/ /gang zhig bzlas pa'i mjug tu ni/ /sbyin sreg 7byed pa de mchog go/ /gsang sngags kun la dang por ram/ /bsreg bya yod na gnyis kur 8bya/ /mkhas pas gang zhig nyin re zhing / /zas kyi phud 9la sreg byed pa/ /des ni tha ma'am bar dag tu/ /khyad par med par bya bar bshad/ /de ltar byas na rig sngags rnams / /phal cher yongs su dgyes par 'gyur/ /cho ga 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /sbyin sreg 7byed pa'i bzlas brjod bshad/ /bzlas brjod byed pas khro mi bya/ /yul gyi bdag nyid dga' mi 11bya/ /zhum dang mi dga' 'jigs pa dang / /'dzums 12dang nga rgyal yongs su spang / /zlos tshe ci yang mi smra zhing / /yan lag 'gyur bar mi bya'o/ /kun rtog rlung gis bskyod nas ni/ /ci yang rung ba mi bsam mo/ /zlos po 1lhabazlas brjod byed pa'i tshe/ /rig sngags lha ni ma gtogs pa / /bsgom 7pa mchog tu gyur pa dang / /rnam rtog bzung 15nas mi bsam mo/ /96—641

zlos pos 1bzlas brjod zin pa dang / /rigs kyi bdag po'i gsang sngags sam / /rigs kyi lha mo gang yin pa/ /de dag bzlas te bsrung ba (5)bya/ /bzlas brjod grangs bzhin byas pa 'am/ /yang na lhag par byas kyang rung / /gsol ba gdab pa'i tshul gyis su/ /de ni gus par dbul bar bya/ /mkhas pas rig sngags zlos pa'i tshe/ /sbrid pa lud pa la sogs byung / /nye reg byas te phyag 'tshal sate/ /gzhi nas kun du brtsam par bya/ /bzlas brjod kyi ④ni bgegs rnams dang / /mkhas pas bzlas brjod skyon rnams la/ /slar yang grangs kyi thog ma nas/ /kun du brtsam par bya bar bshad/ /sngags kyi nor bu'i thog ma dang / /tha mar rtag tu sgrub pa pos/ /gus par gsang sngags lha dag la/ /blo dang ldan pas phyag bya'o/ /sngags kyi nor bu rdzogs pa'i tshe ri mo'i gzugs sam sku gzugs sam/ /mchod rten dag gam de'i gdan rnams/ /mig gis kun du blta bar bya/ /bzlas pas ngal na yang dang yang / /bsam gtan lam gyi man ngag dang / /thabs ni 5rnam pa tha dad pas/ /blo can sems ni spro ba bskyed/ /blo la skyon med byas nas ni/ /gsang sngags yi ge dag pa la/ /mnyam par bzhag neriste rtse gcig tu/ /bzlas brjod dus gsum dag tu bya / /mkhas pas dus gsum kho nar yang / /khrus byas nas ni bzlas brjod bya//mchod pa la sogs cho ga kun/ /dus gsum dag tu bya bar bshad/ /dus gsum dag tu sngags 7pa yis/ /gos ni rnam pa gsum po dag /bkru ba'am bdug 8par bya ba 'am/ /yang na bsang 9gtor dag kyang bya/ /nyal dang khrus byed ma gtogs par/ /sngags pas mthang 1 tshogos mi spang zhing / /dkar la shin tu 'jam po de/ /nyin re 1 bzhin du bkru bar bya/ /lha la dgos pa'i snod ge96—642

rnams kyang / /nyin re lan re bkru bar bya/ /me tog rnying pa dus gsum du/ /rtag par yang ni phyag par bya/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sogs kyi/ /glegs bam mjug tu bklag (1)pa dang / /mchod rten dag dang dkyil 'khor yang / /dus gsum dag tu de bzhin bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i bzlas brjod dgan /dang por grangs bzhin tshang ba las/ /mi nus na ni dus gcig gam/ /dus gnyis su ni cho ga bsgom(57/ /gang yang bgegs kyis brlams 4pa dang / /nad rnams kyis ni gzir ba 'am/ /lhod pa dang ni bag med pa'am/ /lus dang sems ni skyo ba 'am/ /cho ga ci (5)skad bshad pa dag /bshad pa'i dus 6las 'das pa dang / /ma bsdams pa dang mi gtsang bas/ /gang dag bzlas brjod byed pa ni//bzlas pa'i grangs ni bshad pa la/ /mkhas pas de dag mi sbyar gyi/ /cho ga bzhin du bzlas pa dang / /mnyam gzhag 7bzlas brjod de dang sbyar/ /sbyin sreg 58)las kyi grangs rnams dang / /spyan drang ba yi cho ga la/ /sngags kyi nor bu ma rdzogs pari9)/ /bzlas brjod grangs su mi gzhug go/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu cho ga bzhin/ /gang gis gsang sngags stong bzlas dang / /nyi ma zla ba gzas zin tshe / /bsnyen pa de ni the tshom med/ /gtsug tor can gyi gnas kun dang / /mchod rten chen po dag dang ni/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i zla phyed la/ /bzlas pa de ni mchog tu bshad/ /bla ma mgu bar gyur pa las/ /rig sngags bzlas pa gang thob dang / /gang yang nyid kyis bka' stsal pa/ /de dag myur du 'grub par 'gyur / /gang yang gnas yul yon tan can/ /mchod 1 tshosogs khyad par can dag dang / /rang gi sems ni dang ba las/ /rig pa myur du bka' stsol te1lha/ /myur du 'grub 12kyang mi thogs par/ /nges par nyams par 'gyur zhes gsungs//96—643

de bas bsnyen 1pa rdzogs byas nas/ /dngos grub phyir ni 'bad par bya/ /bsnyen pa'i tshe ni ci rigs par/ /dngos grub phyir ni lha rnams la/ /lha khang gi ni phyi rol du/ /dus mtshams 2dag la mchod pa bya/ /dus mtshams ri nodag la rig sngags rnams/ /bye brag tu ni mchod par (4bya/ /rtag tu dge ba'i phyogs rnams dang / /de bzhin du ni sdom pa gzung 5/ /bum pa bkra shis ldan pa la/ /spos kyi chu la sogs pas bkang 6/ /rdo rje khro bos mngon bsngags (7༄te/ /dbang bskur don du sbyar bar bya/ /de ma 'byor na mchod yon snod/ /me tog rnams dang chus bkang ste/ /bgegs rnams rnam par bsal ba'i phyir/ /dbang bskur na de ni nye bar sbyar/ /bye brag tu ni lha bshos dbul(9ri/ /bye brag tu ni misbyin sreg 11bya/ /mar me'i cho ga bye brag tu/ /sa yi byi dor de bzhin bya/ /gal te zlos 12tshe glo 1 bur du/ /sna tshogs pa yi 'od byung na/ /de tshe dngos grub myur bar nges/ /bkres pas cung zhig nad las thar/ /shes pa sakhyad par can yang 'byung / /lhag par gzi mdangs che bstan 15pa/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /mtshan mo rmi lam dge ba dang / /bden pa rnams ni mthong ba dang / /bzlas brjod byed la dga' ba ni/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /ngal ba chung zhing dri zhim dang / /gtong phod yon tan lhur len cing / /lha la lhag par gus pa ni/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid yin / /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i rjes la yang / /bye brag tu ni mchod pa bya/ /lha rnams la ni ci rigs par/ /sbyin sreg gludag kyang brtsam par bya/ /bsnyen pa tshul bzhin rdzogs byas nas/ /rig sngags bsgrub 1 par bya ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pas ji ltar mthong ba bzhin/ /sta gon gnas pa rab tu bya/ /gnas 96wa 644

gcig tu ni phyed bzlas nas/ /gang zhig gzhan la bzlas byas pa/ /bzlas pa thams cad rdzogs gyur kyang / /de dag thams cad don med 'gyur/ /de lta'i glags 17la cho ga bzhin/ /tshig 'bum lhag par bzlas brjod bya/ /bdag pos stong du bzlas bya 'am/ /yang na bsnyen pa slar brtsam mo/ /bag med pas ni lan 'ga' zhig /gsang sngags lha gzhan nabazlas byas na / /yid kyis gsol ba gus byas nas/ /bzlas brjod slar yang brtsam par bya/ /mi gtsang cho ga mi ldan pas/ /rig sngags bag med bzlas gyur na/ /de la rig sngags bdag po'i sngags/ /lan bdun yongs su bzlas 4brjod byar/ /zlos pos 6zla ba phyed phyed cing / /nyin zhag gcig tu smyung 7byas nas/ /zla phyed mtshams su ba yi lnga/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas pa btung 8/ /des ni gsang sngags zlos pa po//zla phyed dag tu dga' 'gyur 9zhing / /bza' ba min sogs gang zos pa/ /de dag thams cad rnam par spang 1 / /na mo bha ga ba te usnri ṣā 11ya/ oṃ bi shurnye bi ra dze shi be shārnyi 12ka ri swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'o/ /o ya sho dze swā hā/ pad+ma'i rigs la'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā 1 ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa 1 badz+ra pā ṇa yam / ma hā yak+ṣa se nā tshapa ta ye/ oṃ shi khi shi khi nir ma le pra bhe/ pra bha sā 1 re / te dze /nyate dzo ba ti 19su hā/ rdo rje'i rigs la'o/ /dmar ser ba yi 'o ma dang / / ba yi zho dang ba yi mar/ /2 ba gcin ba yi lci ba rnams/ /so sor mngon par bsngags 21pa dang / /ku sha lan brgyar bsngags na pa yi/ /ku sha'i chun dang ldan byas te/ /shar bltas 2 mi smra tsog tsog por/ /'dug nas 'bring la srang gsum tsam/ /ba la sha yi lo mar btung / /yang na mchod yon snod bshad pa/ /gang yang rung ba cig 2 tu btung / /de ni de yi 25cho gar bstan/ /96wa 645

chos tshe gal te blo 517bur dunas/ /cung zad bya 'am (ci )mi bya 'am/ /lha nyid (4)kyis ni bka' stsal na/ /blo dang ldan pas de dag brtag /bsrung (geb byas te brtags nas su/ /bya ba min pa de mi bya/ /bka' lung rigs par gang stsal pa / /de dag dngos grub 'dod pas bya/ /zlos pa rmi lam ngan mthong na/ /rigs kyi bdagi/ po brgya 96bzlas so/ /de yi nyin par de ma bzlas/ /bzlas brjod grangs su mi gzhug 7go/ /grangs kyi bzlas brjod thams cad la/ /lhag par gyur la 58nyes pa med/ /der ni de yis mi 'grub la/ /grangs skongs 6)pa la mi phan no/ /mdor na zlos 9pa po rnams kyis/ /bzlas brjod cho ga gang gsungs pa/ /cho ga de dag nyid kyis tsho7ni/ /rig sngags bsnyen turtenas 'grub par 'gyur/ /bzlas brjod kyi cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //de nas gzhan yang chos 1 pa po'i/ /gsang sngags lha ni gang zhig gis/ /myur du mnyes par 'gyur ba yi/ /tshim par bya ba'i cho ga bshad/ /dus mtshams chodag gam tshes gzhan la/ /khrus rdzing bzang pos khyad par du/ /mgo la sogs pa bkrus nas su/ /dang po mchod pa'i cho ga bya/ /yid la gsang sngags brjod nas su/ /sna ma'i me tog brgya la ni/ /re re la yang mngon bsngags 7te/ /blo dang ldan pas rigs gsum mchod/ /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /yang na lan bdun rim yobazhin du/ /gsang sngags yi ge rjes mthun 1 par/ /lha rnams la ni mngon par mchod/ /de nas dri la sogs pa dang / /dri zhim bsgos 1 pa'i bdug spos gsol/ /lha bshos ci //skad bstan pa dbul / /zho dang bu ram bye brag tu'o/ /tshul bzhin sbyin sreg 2 las byas te/ /96wa 646

yam sreg 1)shing gis ②me (5)bus la/ /mchod sbyin gyis ri ni yam sreg 5shing / /mar la btags 6)pa dang por brgya/ /de nas til dang zho dang mar/ /sbrang rtsi bsres (7 )pa brgya lhag dbul/ /de nas mar dang zho na sbyar ba'i/ /sā 97lu'i 'bras chan sreg blugs chabargya/ / ba yi 1lha'o ma zas mchog dang / /mar bcas sreg blugs nyu brgya phul te/ /mjug tu mchod yon bkang nas su/ /lan brgyar bzlas te dbul bar bya/ /cho ga de ltar nyin gcig gam/ /bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /yang na nyin gsum dus gsum du/ /yang na nyi ma lngar 1ribyas nasasko/ /rig sngags bcad tshadam phral ba 'am/ /bgag tshapa'am phur bus btab pa 'am/ /bri tsho ba dang ni lhag pa'ang rung / /bgag 18pa'am phur bus btab pa 'am/ /gzir ba lhag par tshim par 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg 16yan lag de rnams las/ /gcig gis nyin mtshams bsreg 2 byin na/ /zhag gsum gyis ni tshim 'gyur te/ /lha rnams rab tu dgyes par 'gyur/ /spos la 2rtagazugs brnyan legs byas te/ /me tog ma 22ta li yis mchod/ /dus gsum bzlas brjod brgya byas te/ /mjug tu shing gi thang chus bdug /pad+ma la sogs 'o ma la / /bzhag ste mtshan mo rab mchod de lha/ /nang par mchod cing bzlas brjod nas / /chu klung chen por bskur bar bya/ /cho ga 'di dag byas pa yis/ /lha rnams yongs su dgyes par 'gyur/ /dgyes par gyur nas dngos grub ni/ /chen po myar du stsol bar mdzad / /lha tshim par bya ba'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o//༄ //gser ram dngul lam zangs kyi 'am/ /kham pa'i bum pa sar pa la me 96—647

tog rin chen 'bras bu rtswa/ /'bru dang spos kyi chus bkang nas/ /mgul par ras ni sar pas bcing / /ldum bu sar pas kha brgyan ri1te/ /rang gi rig sngags bdag po 'am/ /yang na rigs kyi rig sngags kyis/ /lan brgyar bzlas nas dang po des2/ /lha nyid mngon par dbang bskur ro/ /gser la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan la/ /rgyan phreng na bza' legs brgyan te/ /rig ri )sngags khri la bzhag nas su/ /dbang bskur phyir ni mchod pa bya/ /me tog sogs pas mchod byas te/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg cadag gis mchod/ /cho ga 'dis ni rig sngags dag /mthu ni rab tu che bar 'gyur/ /rig sngags mthu dang ldan gyur na/ /dngos grub chen po myur du stsol/ /dus mtshams 55nodag la rig sngags rnams / /spyan drang snyomachod pa byas nas ni/ /mchod yon mngon par bsngags pa yis/ /dbang bskur ba yang bya bar bshad/ /nyin re khrus byed tshe na yang / /dbang bskur phyir ni gus pa ru/ /blo dang ldan pas snyim pa'i chu/ /bdun nam yang na gsum gyis bya/ /mar dang 'o ma la sogs pas/ /dbang bskur phyir ni legs bkrus nas/ /rig sngags gzir ba rgyas gyur cing 7ri/ /'dis ni lhag par tshim par 'gyur/ /lha dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rim par phye she ba'o// //dus mtshams 9dag la smyung 7byas nas/ /nub gcig gam ni nub gsum du//gtsang zhing gos dkar gsar bgos te/ /zlos pa sta gon gnas par bya/ /dus mtshams 11min yang dgos yod na/ /yar gyi ngo yi tshes bzang la zhi ba'i mchog gi gsang sngags kyis/ /sta gon gnas par 12rab tu bya/ /skyu 1 ru ra sogs khrus rtsi dang / /dri zhim spos chus khrus byas te/ /nye r+sāreg byas nas srod 96—648

la ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan drang (1rimachod pa bya/ /de nas lhag par mngon bsngags pa'i / /mchod yon cho ga bzhin du dbul/ /de nas tsan+dan dkar po dang / /sna ma'i me tog kha 'bus dang / /ma la ta yi phreng ba la/ /bdug pas bdugs la mchod pa bya/ /gtor ma mang zhing bzang ba dang / /zho dang bcas pa dbul bar bya/ /de nas mar gyi sbyin sreg na ni/ /tshul bzhin brgya rirtsa brgyad byas te/ /gsang sngags las dang rjes mthun 4)par/ /sa rdza ra sa'i sreg blugs 5dbul/ /bu mos bkal (7ba'i skud pa la/ /mdud (7)pa bdun bor lan bdun bsngags / /dpung pa g.yon pa la bcings la/ /ku sha'i lo ma bting ba la/ /de nyid kyis ni glo phab ste/ /bka' lung 99rigasol ba btab 1 tshonas ni/ /rang gi lha yi tshul 'dra bar/ /sems kyis 67legs par bsam byas te/ /yid la gsang sngags 'don bzhin du/ /ku sha sar pa khres kyi sngas/ /me tog mang pos bklubs 1 pa lam/ /ci 32ltar bde bar nyal bar bya/ /gal te gnyid log rmi lam na/ /bstan par gtogs tshapa'i lha mthong ngam/ /so sor rig pa'i gzugs dag gam//yang na rig sngags bdag po'ang rung / /dkon mchog gsum las gcig tsam mamaski / /de dag la ni mchod la sogs/ /rgyal sras rdzu 'phrul chen po 'am/ /'khor ni rnam pa bzhi rnams sam/ /bdag nyid cho ga spyod pa 'am/ /yang na gos kyis khaspud pa dag /mthong na dngos grub nyer 'gyur bar/ /sgrub pa pos ni shes nya 7par bya/ /ri dang glang po 'bab chu dang / /rgya mtsho dang ni 'bras bu shing / /ngang mo la sogs bya rnams dang / /seng ge la sogs ri dgas 1 sogs//khyu mchog bkra shis rta la sogs/ /bu mo bzang mo brgyan pa dang / / bum pa 19la sogs bkra shis pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs g.yas na'o/ /nor dang gos rnams 96wa 649

rnyed pa dang / /de la sogs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /rmi lam bzang po mthong na ni/ /blo can 'grub par shes par bya/ /zho dang 'o ma 'bras yos mar/ /me tog 'bras bu rtsa ba dang / /yang na grub 1pa'i rdzas kyang rung / /rmi lam dag na rnyed pa 'am/ /de 'dra'i rnam pa mthong gyur na/ /rig sngags 'grub par gsungs pas na/ /de nas blo dang ldan pa yis/ /bsnyen pa'am sgrub pa'i las rnams brtsam/ /gal te sngags kyi nor bu 'am/ /sgrub sbyon pa'i rdzas rnams thob na ni / /de nas bsnyen pa'am sgrub pa yi/ /las rnams myur du brtsam par bya/ /gos dang khrus dang rgyan dag gis/ /bdag nyid brgyan 55)pa mthong na ni/ /de tshe bsnyen pa'am sgrub pa yi / /las rnams rab tu brtsam par bya rang gi rig sngags tshul bzhin du/ /mchod pa byas nas rigs yum gyis/ /sna ma'i me tog brgya dag dang / /ras zung dag gis mchod par bya/ /tsan+dan gyi ni bdug spos kyis/ /lan brgyad nyin 5du bdugs nerinas ni/ /de nas lha nyid rmi lam du / /ci rigs par ni bka' lan stsol/ /u shi ra yi ri gzugs brnyan ni/ /grog namakhar sa yi 9snod du bzhag /mchod cing yongs su tshim byas nas/ /lan brgyad dag tu mngon par bsngags7/ /de ni 'o ma'i nang du 'am/sto/ /yang na sbrang rtsi'i nang du gzhug12 /dus gsum dag tu legs mchod nas/ /srod la yang ni gsol ba gdab/ /rnam pa 'di dag nyid kyis kyang / /yongs su dgyes pa skyes 1 gyur nas/ /de ltar bya 'am sami bya ba/ /lha nyid bka' lan gsol bar skamadzad/ /smyung sabyas 'dod pa'i dus mtshams 1 la/ /rig sngags cho ga bzhin mchod la1 / /thang chu rnam pa bdun dag dang / /shing gi snying po rnam pa lngas / /sbyin sreg 19brgya rtsa brgyad bya ba/ /yang na bzlas brjod grangs dag 96wa 650

gis / /byas na rig sngags 15nyid kyis (5)ni/ /myur ba nyid du bka' stsol to/ /de ltar rig pa sta gon gnas/ /nges shing myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sta gon gnas pa'i cho (5nag 'di/ /rgyas par (4rirab tu bsgrags pa yin/ /sta gon gnas pa'i cho ga rab tu gsang ba'i rim par phye ba'o// //slob mas dkyil 'khor phyag byas nas/ /khyad par du ni yon phul te/ /bla ma'i kha nas mngon sum du/ /rig sngags yongs su gzung bar bya/ /snyim pa me tog gis bkang nas/ /gus shing rim gro bskyed byas te/ /bla mas thog mar lan gsum bzlas/ /rang gis lan gsum bzlas te gdon/ /de nas yi ge mang po'i sngags/ /gi wang dag gis shog shog la/ /ji skad bstan bzhin mngon bris te/ /de nas ci bder kha ton bslab/ /bla ma yongs su mgu ba las / /dus mtshams (3)dag gam tshes gzhan la/ /rig sngags brtags nas byin pa dag /cho ga bzhin du gus par mnod phyi/ /slob mas legs par mnod smyo pa de/ /ring por mi thogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /ma bsnyen par yang de la de/ /rtag tu 'go zhing nye bar gnas/ /yang na gser la sogs pa yi/ /bum pa gsar zhing gtsang la bzang / /skyon kun rnam par spangs pa la/ /bkra shis ngo mtshar dag kyang byas/ /de la spos chu 'ba' zhig named/ /khyad par du ni bsham 9dbyas nas/ /gtsang mar byas te nub gcig gam/ /nub gsum du ni smyung bobyas te/lha/ /srod la rab tu brtsam byas nas12/ /cho ga 'di dag spyad par bya / /gsang sngags rig sngags gdams pa dag /gro ga la sogs shog shog la/ /gi wang dag gis mnyam bris te/ /shog shog rnams ni lhan 1 cig gzhug /rig 96—651

sngags rgyal pos 1legs par ni/ /dri dang me tog bdug mchog dang / /de bzhin lha bshos mar me dang / /sbyin sreg 2las kyis mchod pa ri kyibya/ /de ni cho ga 'di dag gis/ /nub gsum sta gon gnas pa la/ /bden pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /khyad par du ni gsol ba gdab/ /lan brgyar bsngags ri rinas yang dang yang / /bdug spos dag gis rab bdugs te/ /dri zhim khrus byas gtsang byas nas/ /phyag byas yid la bsams nas su/ /bsang byed bcas pa'i lag pa yis/ /de las gcig ni dbyung bar bya/ /de shes nas ni phyag 'tshal te/ /gus par spyi bo'i steng du bzhag5 /shes rab can gyis 6sngags de bsgrubatsuno/ /de nyid de la myur du 'grub/ /shes rab can gyis gzhan mi sgrub/ /bsgrubs rin na yang ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig bsgrubs 59nas byin pa dag /cho ga bzhin du de mnos na/ /sgrub pa po yi lha yin te/ /de la de ni 'grub par shes//rig sngags yid kyis gsol btab nas/ /lan brgyar yongs su bzlas brjod de1 / /'di ni khyer cig khyer cig ces/ /me tog dri zhim dag gis sbyin/ /bcom ldan 'di la bsnyen pa dang / /'di la rab tu 'go 11bar mdzod/ /bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzod ces bya/ /slob dpon dang ni slob ma yis/ /rig sngags sbyin zhing yongs bzung ba'i/ /cho ga 'di ltar byas na ni/ /lha nyid rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /mkhas pas rig sngags 'grub pa kun/ /grub pa nyid du shes par bya/ /rnam pa de ltar rdzas dag dang / /tshul bzhin thob pas bsnyen mi dgos/ /zlos pa sgrub pa po dag gis / /rig sngags tshul bzhin bzlas pa yis/ /bsnyen pa tshad byas gang byin pa / /de yang ma bsnyen 'grub par 'gyur/ /dngos grub phyir ni gsang sngags 96—652

yon / /me tog 'bras bu rtsa ba dang / /gdu bu gos dang gser dang zho/ /'bru dang nor bu bu mo dang / /mal cha rnams dang lham dag dang / /rgyan gyi rnam pa thams cad dang / /sgrub pa'i yo byad rnams dang ni/ /glang po ba lang rta la sogs / /bkur sti rnam pa du ma dang / /bdag gi bdog pa mtha' dag dbul//gus par phyag byas thal sbyar nas/ /bdag nyid kyang ni dbul bar bya/ /de ltar cho ga shes pa yis/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ci rigs par/ /bla ma la ni yon phul nas/ /de nas gsang sngags nod 71par bya/ /rig sngags yongs su gzung 2ba'i rim par phye ba'o// //sgrub pa pos ni cho ga 'dis/ /lhag dang chad pa shes byas nas/ /mthong dang ma mthong las dag gis/ /rig sngags yongs su bkang dbar bya/ /gsang sngags yan lag lhag chad gang / /rmi lam dag tu mthong na ni/ /de dag bkang ba'i cho ga 'di/ /gsang sngags zlos pa dag gis bya/ /gal te 'dir yang la la zhig /yi ge lhag gam chad pa yi/ /dogs pa skyes na mkhas pa yis5/ /gsang sngags bkang ne ba'i cho ga bya/ /shog shog dag la gi wang gis/ /gsang sngags yi ge tshang bar bri/ /cho ga bzhin du mchod byas te/ /rig sngags rgyal po mngon par bsngags / /rig sngags rgyal por bcas pa yis/ /mchod sbyin yam sreg 8shing me la/ /sngags kyis 9mar gyi sreg 1 blugs ni/ / cig car 11lan brgyar 1 bsreg par bya/ /rig sngags khri la bzhag nas su/ /gsol ba btab ste mngon par mchod/ /rig sngags kyi ni bdag po dang / /rig sngags yid dbang phyug ma dang / /bde gshegs sras bcas phyag byas 1 te/ /bkang 1 ba'i phyir ni 96—653

gsol btab tsho1 nas/ /rig sngags dran bzhin ku sha yi/ /stan nyal shar phyogs kha bltas nyal/ /rig sngags ri rgyal pos 547de nyid kyi/ /mtshan mo dag ni nges par yang / /yi ge gsal ba de dag dang / /smyu gu yang ni de nyid dang / /gi wang dag kyang de nyid kyis/ /shog shog kyang ni de nyid la/ /gsang sngags chad pa rab tu skong 5/ /lhag 6pa dag kyang mnyam par mdzad/ /gsang sngags ma nyams mnyam pa dag /'ba' zhig 'dri bar mi mdzad la/ /gsang sngags rig sngags ma tshang ba/ /nges par 'di yis skong bar mdzad na/ /yang na yig 8'bru ma tshang 9ba/ /rmi lam dag tu ston par mdzad/ /gsang sngags zlos pa po dag gis / /bsrung ba'i cho ga byas te bya/ /rig sngags yongs su bkang skruba'i rim par phye ba'o// //rig sngags dag ni thams cad kyang / /sbyin sreg /lhalas kyis gzi byin bskyed / /sbrang rtsi 'o thug mar dag gam/ /yang na til dang mar bsres pa'am/ /mar btags me tog sbyin sreg nyu2gam/ /sardza ra sa'i sbyin sreg 1nyidang / /mar dang thang chu'i sbyin sreg 1 gis/ /gsang sngags gzi byin che bar 'gyur/ /ba yi rnam lnga zos nas su/ /ri yi rtse mor ci rigs par/ /me tog 'bum dag dbul byas nas/ /des ni lha nyid gzi byin skye/ /nyin gsum du ni dus gsum du/ /dri zhim dri dang bdug spos dang / /me tog dag kyang phul na ni/ /gsang sngags gzi byin che bar 'gyur/ /shing gi snying po'i sgron ma dag /sbar zhing zhag bdun dus gsum du/ /bzlas brjod byas na gsang sngags rnams/ /gzi byin che ba'i tshamachog tu 'gyur/ /de ltar bzlas dang sbyin sreg tshadang / /mchod pa 96wa 654

dag dang lha bshos kyang / /'dod pa pos ni khyad par du/ /lha rnams thams cad gzi chen 'gyur/ /lha gzi byin bskyed pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o / / //gang zhig gsang sngags zlos 17pa dag /dngos grub chen po myur thob pa'i/ /sbyin sreg ( cho ga ma lus pa/ /de dag ci bzhin spyad par bya/ /lha yi gnas kyi phyi rol du/ /de yi (4skumadun du mi ring bar/ /ci 5ltar rigs pas yongs brtags la/ /cho ga 'di dag kun du spyad/ /dbus su me yi thab brko ba/ /gru bzhi lham pa kha khyer can/ /khru gang zabs su khru byed 6pa/ /yang na thab khung zlum por bya/ /de nas yam shing la sogs pas/ /yo byad dgos pa thams cad dag /g.yas phyogs su ni gzhag tsho par bya/ /g.yon du chu yi nasnod bzhag go/ /de nas las kun byed pa yi/ /sngags kyis de dag bsang gtor te/ /'dug nas mkhas pas gsang sngags rnams/ /yid la bsams te spyan yang drang / /mchod yon yongs su bzlas pa yang / /de dag rnams la phul nas su/ /me tog gcig gis rig sngags de9tsho/ /de nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /de nas me ni bsang ba'i phyir/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos bsang gtor nas/ /cho ga las smos shing dag gis/ /thab bcug shes rab can gyis sbar/ /me 'bar rig nas dang por ni/ /gsang sngags dag gis gnyer bar bya/ /tshur byon 1 tshur byon 11'byung po che/ / lha yi 12drang srong bram ze'i mchog /sreg 1 blugs zhal zas bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ asna 7ye ha 'bya ka tshabya bā /3ha nā 18ya swā hā/ de ltar dang por me 19gnyer nas/ /sreg 2 blugs 96wa 655

gsum yang bsreg par bya/ /oṃ asna 1 ye ha nasabya ka bya/ ba 4)ha snyen yā dī bya rinadi pā 7ya swā hā/ de nas mkhas pas g.yas phyogs nas/ /bskor cing (8)bsangs nas rang gi ni/ /sngags kyis mar la sogs pa las/ /sreg 9 blugs gsum yang bsreg par bya/ /sgrub pas khosbyin sreg /1thams cad la/ /khro bo tī li khri la gang / /de yi phyag rgyas 1 sbyin sreg mil/ /me la sogs skopa bsang labar 1 bya / /oṃ gī li tī li badz+ra dhī 1 ma ro dri 19pa tri ta/ ma hā kro dha bi dza ya ni kṛn+ta 2 hūm̐ phaṭa brnya ban+dha swā hā/ de nas yam sreg 21shing dag bsreg ge /de nas yam shing me la mar/ /de nas til dang 'bras chan nate/ /cho ga de dag mdor bsdus pa'o/ /ba la sha dang n+ya gro dha / /blak+ṣa 25seng ldeng arga dang / /be'u sa gang ka dang a mra dang / /kum 2 ri dang sha mi dang / /a pa marga las byung dang / /u dum a shwazir bcas pa/ /yam shing bcu gnyis dag tu bstan/ /sar pa dag las mdzub 0gang tsam/ /las rnams kun la bsreg bya ste/ /las rnams kun la thor to gnyis/ /brtags nas rtse mos bsreg par bya/ /bzang la drang zhing gsar pa la/ /spos chus bsang gtor byas pa la/ /zhi ba'i bsreg bya cung zad gang / /rgyas pa'ang gang dag yin pa dang / /bdag zas cung zad gang yin pa/ /de dag las rnams kun la bsregaci 2 /nyin re'am yam sreg nilhashing dag la/ /bdag gi zas kyang rtag tu bsreg lha /sngags dang ji ltar rjes mthun dzipar/ /sbyin sreg byas nas kha 8zas 9bza'/ /bzlas brjod cho ga ji ltar gsungs/ /sbyin sreg 1la yang de ltar bsgrags 2/ /lag pas pus mo'i nang rol nas/ /sbyin sreg ridag ni brtsam par bya/ /rig sngags thams cad gzi bskyed phyir/ /du rus 'bru mar sbyar ba la/ /btags pa'i a kur 4dum rig96wa 656

bu ni/ /sor bzhi bsregs pas bsang bar 1bshad/ /yang na rtag tu gu gul ni / /mar sbyar sbyin sreg narab tu shis/ /yang na gsang sngags bye brag la/ /sa la thang chu'i bye brag shis / /sngags 'grub cho ga shes pa yis/ /sbyin sreg 4cho ga thams cad la/ /dang por bdag po bzhugs gsol nas/ /de yi 'og tu sbyin sreg (5brtsam/ /sngags 'grub cho ga shes pa yis/ /sbyin sreg 6cho ga thams cad la/ /dang por rigs kyi rig sngags kyis/ /bsrung 7ba byas te las rnams brtsam / /sngags 'grub cho ga shes pa yis/ /sbyin sreg nacho ga thams cad la/ /las mthar rigs kyi snying po yis/ /gzi byin bskyed pa brtsam par bya/ /sngags 'grub cho ga shes pa yis/ /sbyin sreg 9cho ga thams cad la/ /thog ma dang ni tha mar yang / /mar gyi dgang blugs 1 rtag tu bsreg11 /sngags 'grub cho ga shes pa yis/ /sbyin sreg 12cho ga thams cad la/ /rigs bdag rig sngags snying po bzlas/ /tha mar mchod yon dbul bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag la sbyin sreg 1 gilo/ /cho ga ma lus bsgrags 15pa yis/ /cho ga de yis 'dir yang ni/ /sbyin sreg tshalas rnams bya bar bshad/ /lag mthil chu la bzlas pas ni / /lan gsum du yang 'thor 'thung bya/ /sbyin sreg 1 byas pa'i tha mar ni/ /rang gi rig sngags nyid kyis kyang / /bsang gtor lan gsum bya bar bshad/ /de 'og me la kun bsregs nas/ /spyan drang rig sngags de nyid kyis/ /bzhud cig bzhud cig ces byas te/ /de yi 'og tu slar btang 1 ngo / /gsang sngags yi ge'i rjes mthun 19par/ /mjug tu bzlas brjod brtsam par bya/ /de ltar sbyin sreg na thams cad kyi/ /cho ga 21mdor bsdus bshad pa yin/ /sbyin sreg 2 gi cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //96—657

de nas gzhan yang gang dag gis/ /bsdus nas rig sngags thams cad kyi/ /gsang sngags cho ga rtsom 'gyur ba'i/ /cho ga yan lag bsdu ba bshad/ /dgos (1)pa'i yo byad thams cad ni/ /thog ma nyid du kun bsdus te/ /de nas bsnyen pa'am sgrub pa dag /blo dang ldan pas gebartsam par bya/ /dri zhim de ni de dang de / /de bzhin bdug spos rnam pa dang / /snying po thang chu rigs rnams dag /khyad par du ni gsog par bya/ / yungs kur brasardza ra sa dang / /dug (5)dang lan tshwa ske 6)tshe dang / /til dang 'bru mar ba mar dang / /bum pa dang ni zangs kyi snod/ /'bru dang rin chen sna lnga dang / /sman rnams dang ni sbrang rtsi dang / /de bzhin bu mos bkal smyo rib yi/ /tshon sna lnga yi srad bu dang / /mar me'i don du kong bu dang / /shing bal mar me'i snying po dang / /kham phor dang ni tshon rtsi'i rdzas/ /de bzhin seng ldeng phur bu dang / /mchod sbyin gyi ni yam shing dang / /nim pa'i dgang gzar /blugs gzar dang / /gi wang dang ni ur mo'i lcags/ /tsan+dan dmar po nyid dang ni/ /gos dang gsang 59risrel srad bu dang / /ri dgas 7nag po'i pags 17pa gsar/mi/ /nas dang 'bras yos pri yang ku/ /tsan+dan dkar dang shing gi lham/ /muñdza / ku sha sha ta pus/ /me tog snod ni shis pa dang / /mchod pa'i yo byad mchog dang ni/ /de bzhin bgrang phreng la sogs dang / /de dag la sogs blo can gyis/ /nor dang sgrub pa'i yan lag rnams/ /thams cad thog mar yongs bsdus nas/ /de yi 'og tu las rnams brtsam/ /sgrub pa'i yan lag gsog 7pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //96—658

de nas sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams kyi/ /mtshan nyid gang dag gsungs pa kun/ /sngags zlos pa yi dngos grub phyir/ /de dag mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang / /nor gyi ri1char 'bab na/gser chen dang / /'khor lo ldong ros ral gri ste/ /'di dag dngos grub bdun yin no/ /phal cher spyi yin khyad par 'phags/ /che la mchog gi mchog yin te/ /de yi bsod nams phung chen dang (5)/ /rgyal srid dag kyang thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang dngos grub dam pa ni(4)/ /gtsug tor 5 pad+ma rdo rje gsum/ /rigs dang rigs kyi bye brag las/ /phal cher yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /gsang sngags gang yang rung ba yis/ /gang yang rung ba'i dngos grub kyang / /mngon par shes pa lhag rtog pa/ /gtso bo yin par yongs su bsgrags/ /gser dang dngul la sogs pa 57las/ /yu ba khru gang tsam byas la/ /de steng rin chen chen po ni/ /gcig pu bzhag pa'am nor bu ni/ /pad+ma rā 7ga dag pa 'am/ /yang na shel las byung (8)ba'ang rung / /khri'u'i 9steng du legs bzhag khonas/ /sgrub pa pos ni mtshan mo bsgrub/nya/ /gsang sngags sta gon cho ga dang / /bdag nyid dbang bskur gang bshad pa/ /de yi rang bzhin cho ga des/ /bum pa bzang po 12bsgrub 12par gsungs/ /gser dag dang ni dngul dag dang / /rin chen sna tshogs la sogs pa/ /dpag tshad lnga yi khor yug tu/ /nor ni char bzhin 'bab par gsungs/ /mi zad pa yi gter chen ni/ /gser la sogs pas gang ba ste/ /sbyin dang longs spyod la sogs pa/ /spyad cing phyung yang 1 mi zad pa'o / /ur mo'i lcags kyi 'khor lo ni/ /mdzub skagang tsam la rtsibs drug pa/ /96wa 659

shin tu gzugs legs 1rto bdar ba/ /myur du 'grub cing chen por 'gyur/ /nyi ma 'char ga'i gzugs 'dra zhing / /gser ni btso nama'i mdog lta bu/ /ka ra bī ra'i mdog 'dra zhing / /ldong ros dag ni mchog tu bshad/ /ral gri mthe'u chung mtho do ba/ /'phan camed zheng du sor bzhi tshad/ /bdar ba tsa sha'i 'dab sdom 'dra/ /'grub phyir ba so'i dngo can no/ /phyag rgya bri ba'i cho ga bzhin / /gtsug tor phyag rgya gser las byas/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i yu ba byas / /che la bzhag ste bsgrub 6par bya/ /pad+ma tsan+dan las byas pa'i/ /de bzhin gser sogs las byas pa/ /mtho gang ba las sdong bu dngul/ /'dab 7brgyad snying po mdzes par bya/ /rdo rje ur mo'i lcags byas pa'am/ /yang na tsan+dan dmar po'ang rung / /lcags gsum las byas sor bcu drug /gnyis ka rtse mo gsum par bya/ /ba bla 8yon tan 'phags pa dag /gser gyi gyim phag 'dra ba yi/ /sul gyis gang zhig ljid che ba/ /kha dog bzang po 'grub phyir mchog /ser skya dag la sa byung 9ba yi/ /gi wang kha dog ser po'o/ /btsag 1 ni yug snam gser mdangs can/ /me tog brtu'i mdog 'dra ba'o/ /grog mkhar brtsegs pa 'dra ba la/ /btsag na ut+pal sngon po'i mdog /shin tu 'jam po 'di 'dra ba/ /chu rgyun las byung añdza 11na'o/ /ras phran gtsang ma 'jam po ni/ /kho lag che la gur gum btsos12/ /dgon pa'i phyugs kyi lci ba yi//thal ba ga bur gyis bsgos 1 pa'o/ /mchod phyir thogs kyi srad bu dkar/ /phra zhing sum bsgril 1 legs bkal ba'am/ /yang na gser gyi skud pa ni/ /legs bstod 15sum bsgril yon tan can/ /sna ma'i me tog phreng ba ni/ /bu mos bkal 7skud las brgyus pa'o/ /shi pa ṇa yis 1 shing gi lham/ /yam shing legs 96wa 660

bzhigs mtheb 1rten can/ /rma bya'i gdugs ni smyug nam yi/ /yu ba ring po gser la btags/ /mdung cartse gsum dang dbyug tho thogs5/ /thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid ldan/ /bsgrubs tsin myur du 'grub pa'i phyir/ /mtshon cha rnams ni rab tu shis/ /'di ni rbo ga las gsungs pa'i/ /bsgrub 7bya'i rdzas rigs gang yin pa/ /de dag mtshan nyid 'jig rten las/ /khyad par du ni nye bar brtag /de bzhin dngos grub mang po yis/ /bsgrub 8bya'i rdzas ni sna tshogs pa/ /de bas 9de dag bdag blo dang / /gtsug lag blo yis yongs su brtag10 /nad med mdangs bzang lus ma nyams/ /gzugs bzang rma med dar la bab/ /bdag nyid shi bar gyur pa'i ro/ /ro langs dngos grub phyir ni mchog /yang na las kyi bye brag las/ /rigs ngan dag kyang rab tu shis/ /ro langs bsgrub 11pa dag la ni/ /'jigs med mchog ste des nges so/ /rdzas kyi mtshan nyid kyi cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //yo byad kun dang ldan pa yis/ /ci rigs par ni mchod byas nas/ /bsgrub 12pa'i rdzas rnams yongs gzung ba/ /dus mtshams lha dag la snga dro bya/ /gsang sngags nye bar gyur nas ni/ /gang tshe bka' lung gsal shes pa/ /de tshe bsgrub 7pa'i rdzas gzung ba/ /mkhas pa dag gis legs par bya/ /khrus byas gtsang zhing smyung 5byas te/ /bkra shis ngo mtshar dag byas nas/ /blo dang ldan pas bdag nyid kyis/ /bsgrub 7pa'i rdzas rnams yongs su gzung / /'byung khung dag nas ci mthong ba/ /lan cig 1 smra ba 'jigs lha med pas/ /kha thabs bzhin du nyos 19pa yi / /bsgrub 1pa'i rdzas ni yongs su gzung / /gang tshe sgrub 96—661

pa'i dus dag tu/ /gsang sngags nye bar gyur shes pa/ /de tshe blo dang ldan pa yis / /bsgrub (1dpa'i rdzas rnams yongs su gzung (2)/ /yang na mkhas pas rdzas dag ni/ /rnam mang gzugs dang ldan pa dag /lung gis dag par rnam shes pa / /de dag cho ga bzhin du gzung / /rdzas bzang gang yang rung ba dag /cho ga bzhin du yongs bzung ( nonas/ /de ma thag tu rab bsgrims te/ /blo dang ldan pas sgrub pa brtsam/ /rdzas yongs su gzung maba'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //de nas bsgrub cir pa'i rdzas rnams kun/ /ci rigs par ni rnam par sbyang / /brtag 6)par bya ba sra ba 57)rnams/ /ba yi sna lngas 8)sbyang bar bsgrags/ /ba yi rnam lnga cha mnyam pas/ /ldong ros dag ni btag par bya/ /'o ma gtsang ma mang po yis/ / ba bla 9nilegs par btag par bya/ /ba gcin mang pos li khri ste/ /mar mang rnams kyis gi wang ngo / /'o ma kha dog ldan pa'i rdzas/ /añdza chon ni 'ba' zhig go/ /ral gri 'khor lo la sogs rdzas/ /ba yi lci ba chu mang tshonyabs /shing dang sems can la sogs rdzas/ /thams cad ba yi 4gegacin dang chus/ /ri dgas 1 nag po'i pags sal sogs/ /ba yi gcin dang bska brabs bkru/ /de ltar rdzas rnams bkrus nas ni/ /spos chu dag gis bshal bar bya/ /ba yi gcin dang bcas pa yi/ /til dang casachu yis ma lus bshal/ /rdzas dang mthun sna rmepa'i sbyang ba ni18/ /'jig 19rten na ni gang grags pa/ /de dag gis ni ri dardzas sbyang ba'am/ /yang na thams cad spos chus bya/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags sam/ /rigs dang rigs kyi snying po yi/ /gsang sngags rdzas dang mthun 2196wa 662

pa yis/ /thams cad (1)sbyang bar bya bar grags/ /thams cad rigs kyi rig nasngags kyis/ /bsang gtor byas na dag par bshad/ /dang po ba yi rnam lngas bya / /de yi tsho )rjes la til gyi chus/ /thams cad rab tu sbyang bar bya/ /rdzas sbyang ba'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //rgyan dang mtshon cha gos la sogs/ /rdzas kyi rigs su gtogs pa kun/ /phal cher 'jig rten grags pa yi/ /tshad kyang grags pa nyid du zad/ /ldong ros dag ni btags pa las/ /dngos grub phyir ni srang lnga'o/ /'bring po la ni srang gsum ste/ /tha ma dag la srang gcig go/ /gi 4wang dag ni gsung gcig tshad / / ba bla (6)dag ni srang gnyis so/ /añdza (7na ni zho drug ste/ /ba mar la ni srang 58)bdun no/ /thal ba la 9 ni srang lnga ste/ /gur gum ldong ros dag dang mnyam / /mi snang ba la bshad pa yi/ / ril bu skasna tshogs yang byas te/ /bye brag tu ni grangs bdun nam/ /nyi shu gcig gi bar du shis/ /yang na dgos pa'i dbang gis su/ /rdzas rnams tshad nas 11lhag gyur kyang / /blo dang ldan pas sgrub pa la/ /de yi tshad du rdzas rnams gzung / /sngags rgyud gzhan las ci gsungs dang / / rang gi cho ga las gsungs dang / /12'jig rten dag na gang shis pa/ /de dang de dag yongs su gzung / /sngon du bsnyen pa'i tshad dang ni/ /grogs po rnams kyi tshad dag dang / /rig sngags kyi 1 ni snang ba las/ /rdzas kyi tshad kyang shes par bya/ /rab dang 'bring po 7tha ma yibo/ /dngos grub dag gi tshabye brag las/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma yi/ /rdzas kyi tshad kyang bshad 1 pa yin/8 / /rdzas kyi tshad kyi cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //96—663
