de nas gzhan yang gang zhig gis/ /dngos grub myur du thob 'gyur ba'i/ /rdzas sgrub pa yi cho ga dag /gsang chen rgyas par bshad par bya/ /sgrub pa'i phyir ni dgos pa rnams/ /thog mar yid la legs bsams te/ /blo dang ldan pas yo byad ni/ /thams cad legs par bsog 1par bya/ /sbyin sreg 2las kyi cho ga yis/ /gsang sngags yongs su tshim byas te/ /dbang bskur cho ga gsungs pa'ang bya/ /de nas bsgrub pa brtsam par bya/ /dang por dkyil 'khor bris nas su/ /cho ga bzhin du legs mchod de/ /der ni bdag nyid tshul bzhin du/ /dbang bskur nas ni las rnams brtsam/ /de nas gzhan yang chos pa dag /dngos grub phyir ni dbang bskur ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor las rnams kun byed pa/ /gang dag rab tu bsgrags bshad pa/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga gang dag sngar bstan pa 4/ /des ni sa gzhi sbyang la sogs/ /thams cad de bzhin kho nar bya/ /khru lnga'am bdun nam brgyad pa la / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /grwa bzhi ldan par rnam brtags pa/ /nub tu sgo gtod rasgo khyud can/ /de yi tshad kyi phyed kyi chas/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim bskor ba dag /tshon rtsi sna lnga'i 'phye ma yis/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bri bar bya / /mkhas pas de yi nub phyogs su/ /gru 7bzhi yis ni bar bcad nas/ /khru lnga'am bzhi 'am gsum pa la/ /grwa 8bzhi shar du sgo yang gdod9ri/ /cho ga bzang po kun la yang 10/ /sgrub pos mngon par dbang bskur phyir/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor tshad dag gi/ /phyed kyi tshad du dkyil 'khor bya/ /sa gzhi shar du gzhol ba la / /nub bam byang du sgo gtod 1 do/ /kun kyang byang du gzhol na 96wa 664

ni / /nub tu sgo yang gtod 1par gsungs/ /kun du thig 2ni btab nas kyang / /tshon sna gcig gis bri bya ste/ /phyi rol gyi ni grwa bzhi ru/ /rdo rje rtse mo gsum du nopa bri/ /gsang sngags kun la thog mar ni/ /dbus su pad+ma'i snying por bcas / / 'dab ma brgyad capa bris nas kyang / /de nas bkra shis rnams kyis brgyan(5ri / /sgo rnams kun du rdo rje dang / /grwa 6rnams su ni bum pa dgod/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor dag la yang / /cho ga de bzhin bya bar bshad/ /dbang bskur ba yi dkyil 'khor du/ /bum pa gang ba bzhi rnams ni/ /grwa yi ri mo'i 7nang rol du/ /nges pa nyid du gzhag 8par bya/ /dbus su gsang sngags zlos pa po'i/ /rig sngags rgyal po gang yin pa/ /de yi phyag rgya bris nas su/ /de yi steng du bum pa bzhag /ji ltar rigs la rnam bstan pa'i/ /phyag rgya gtsug tor pad+ma dang / /rdo rje 'di gsum rim bzhin du/ /rab tu gsang ba'i dam pa yin / /phyag rgya rnams la ma goms na/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags sam/ /yang na lha rnams kun gyi phyir/ /yungs kur 9steng du bum pa bzhag /snam bu'i cha ni legs phye nas/ /shar du bcom ldan phyag rgya bzhag / de yi 1 g.yon du snying po'o/ /g.yas su rigs kyi yum bzhag go/ /de bzhin byang du cho ga bzhin//pad+ma 'chang ba gzhag 11par bya/ /lhor ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ /nub tu tshangs pa drag po'o/ /grwa gnyis kyi ni ngos dag tu/ /kun dga' bo dang rab 'byor dang / /mdung thung dang ni mche ba dang / /rig sngags gsang sngags tshogs rnams dgod/ /grwa gnyis kyi ni ngos dag tu/ /don grub pa dang mthu chen dang / /dpal mo dang ni gos dkar can/ /rig sngags gsang sngags tshogs rnams dgod/ /grwa gnyis kyi ni ngos dag tu/ /rdo rje rdo rje 1 dbyug pa dang / /96—665

rdo rje khu tshur gnam lcags ma/ /rig sngags gsang sngags tshogs rnams dgod/ /grwa gnyis kyi ni ngos dag tu/ /drag po'i glor ni drag mo dang / /tshangs pa'i glor ni dpal chen dang / /sna tshogs lha yi 17tshogs rnams bri/ /sngon bzhin phyi rol dkyil 'khor du/ /phyogs mtshams skyong ba'i lha la sogs/ /phyogs skyong go rims 2bzhin du dgodari / /lhag ma ma casmos 55pa yang dgod/ /klu rgyal dga' bo bsnyen dga' bo/ /sgo yi ngos su gzhag 6par bya/ /mdzes dga' nye mdzes phyi rol sgor/ /mdun du bdud rtsi thab 7)sbyor bzhag /dkyil 'khor snga 58)ma'i cho sa bzhin/ /mchod sogs cho ga gang yin pa/ /de dag byas nas sbyin sreg lho)las / /rnam gsum tshul bzhin legs par brtsam/ /bgegs rnams gzhom ⑩phyir drag shul spyod/ /rang gi 'byor phyir rgyas par 17bya/ /zhi ba'i ched 7tu zhi ba ste/ /ji ltar mthong bzhin bya bar gsungs/ /rigs tsho gsum dag gi spyi la yang / /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags sam/ /yang na thab 0sbyor byed pa yi15 / /bgegs rnams la ni drag shul spyadas/ /snying po nyid kyis rgyas pa ste/ /zhi ba'i rigs kyi rig sngags kyis/ /yang na kun la las kun pa'am/ /so so yi 4 ni cho gas bya/ /dkyil 'khor bshad pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /mkhas pas sgo yi 4shegayas rol du/ /mar sogs sbyin sreg //rdzas dag las/ /sbyin sreg zhu tshogi ni las bya'o / /las rnams gsum po dag la yang / /mkhas pas gsang sngags rnam gsum gyis/ /rim pa bzhin du brgya brgya 'am/ /yang na lhag par sbyin sreg (2bya / /rig sngags bdag por bcas pa 2rnams/ /tshim par bya phyir sgrub pa pos / /rigs dang rigs la sbyin sreg brgya'am lha/ /yang na riso sor bdun bdun bya/ /sgrub pa'i rig sngags gang yin de/ /rang gi bdag po'i mdun du 96wa 666

bzhag /'phrog ma dang ni ri mkhar ma/ /dung can ma dang lha mo drag /ral pa gcig ma'am phyogs bzhin du/ /mchod par 'dod pas mchod pa bya/ /lha rnams thams cad legs mchod de/ /sbyin sreg 1ci dgar byas nas ni/ /sngar bkod pa yi bum pa la/ /rang gi sngags kyis mngon par bsngagasanas/ /lha yi mdun na gang 'dug pa/ /gcig ni rang gi sngags kyis bzlas/ /dkyil 'khor dbus na gang 'dug pa/ /rig pa'i rgyal pos bzlas brjod bya/ /sgo yi drung na gang 'dug pa/ /rdo rje khro bos bzlas brjod bya/ /snying po'i rigs kyi rig sngags kyis/ /shar gyi grwa gnyis bzlas brjod bya/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags dang / /de bzhin gsang sngags gzhan kun gyis/ /nub kyi grwa gnyis 'dug pa yi/ /bum pa la ni tshul bzhin bzlas/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha rnams kun / /bzlas shing tshul bzhin sbyin sreg nas/ /ci nus par ni legs mchod de / /de nas rab tu bskor bar bya/ /dbang bskur ched du cho ga gang / /dkyil 'khor dag tu kun bshad pa/ /bkra shis la 4sogs de dag ni/ /'dir yang (5nyenan tan bskyed de bya/ /bum pa bzang po rin chen bcas/ /'bru dang bcas shing sman dang bcas/ /me tog 'bras bu lo mar bcas/ /chur bcas mgul (6 chings phreng ba can/ /de yi las rnams thams cad la/ /dang por dbang ni bskur bar gsungs/ /zlos pa po yi 7grogs po ni/ /smyung 8bar gnas pa 59 dbang bskur ro/ /yang na rang gi bla ma ni/ /lung la lhag par mkhas pas bya/ /yon tan ldan zhing dka' 7thub can/ /mkhas pas las 'di byed du gzhug /dang po bgegs rnams bsal ba'i phyir/ /dbang bskur ba ni rab tu sbyar/ /bar du bar ma dag gis ni/ /mjug tu rang gis bzlas par 96—667

bya / /yungs kur 1bzlas brjod byas pa dang / /gi wang dri dang bdug spos sogs / /srad bu gdu bu gos rnams kyang / /'dir ni kun du bcang bar na)bya//dbang bskur zin nas bdag nyid kyis/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tsho las byas nas/ /dogs 4pa med par cho ga bzhin/ /slar yang gshegs su gsol bar bya yang na sa phyogs mnyam bzang bar/ /stegs bu khru do gru bzhi la/ /tshon 5 sna gcig gis rgyas pa dang / /chung 'jur legs par bri bar bya/ /phyag rgya gsum po phyogs bzhin du/ /de bzhin nub tu mdung rtse gsum/ /de yi dbus kyi bum pa yis / /dbang bskur phyir ni sngon bzhin bya/ /mdor bsdus cho ga 'di yis kyang / /bdag nyid dbang bskur byas par 'gyur/ /de ltar byas na bgegs med pa/ /'di ni zlos pa'i gsang chen yin/ /lha rnams byin gyis rlob pa dang / /bgegs rnams rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /tshe dang bsod nams mngon par 'phel/ /sdig pa rnam par byang bar 'gyur/ /de phyir zlos pa tshul shes pas / /cho ga rgyas pa shes byas nas/ /bsgrub 8pa'i phyir ni dbang bskur ba/ /gsang ba 'di ni kun du spyad/ /dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 9nirim par phye ba'o// //de nas gzhan yang sngags sgrub pas/ /nyin re zhing yang 1 dus gsum du/ /sngags dang rjes su mthun 1 pa yi/ /sbyin sreg 1 las ni gsungs pa brtsam cho ga bzhin du til nag dang / /zho dang sbrang rtsi mar sbyar ram1 / /lag pan gyi ni sbyin sreg 1 bya/ /zhag grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /zhag bdun yang na zla gcig tu/ /gsang sngags dngos grub rjes mthun dpar/ /cho ga 'di ni bya bar bstan / /de la bdug 7cing bsang gtor bya/ /yid la bzlas shing blta bar 96—668

bya / /bsang byed bcas pa'i lag pa yis/ /gsang sngags bzlas shing brim 1par bya/ /gi wang chu dang yungs kur 2gyis / /bye brag tu yang bsang gtor bya / /rdzas la dus tshigs dus tshigs su/ /ji ltar rigs par mchod par bya/ /yar gyi ngo la sgrub 'os pa/ /mkhas pas zla ba nya la bya/ /mar gyi ngo la sgrub 'os pa / /mar gyi ngo yi bcu bzhi la/ /mkhas pas rigs kyi rig 4sngags kyis/ /rdzas rnams byin ni bskyed par bya/ /dri dang bdug spos phreng sogs kyis/ /khyad par du ni mchod par 5bya/ /lag ngar gdu bu btags pa yis/ /lag mthil dri yis bskus pa yis/ /lag pas mtshan gcig thal byung du/ /nyi ma shar gyi bar du bzlas/ /de nyid kyi ni nub mo yang / /so so'i rigs kyi gsang sngags ni/ /rdzas rnams byin skyed 'byed pa 'dis/ /dus gsum du ni brgya brgya bzlas / /de ltar blo dang ldan pa yis/ /rdzas de yongs su bzung 7ba nas/ /ma grub bar du dus gsum bzlas/ /de ltar byas na 'grub par 'gyur/ /o te dza te dza sa ni sirnyi sā dha 8ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'o/ /oṃ dī pya 9dī pya/ dī pa 1 ya ā 11bi sha 12ma hā shri 1 ye swā hā/ pad+ma'i rigs la'o/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dz+wa 1 la ya brtu 15ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje'i rigs la'o/ /ka ra bī sar dmar po 'am/ /me tog ma la ti yang rung / /yang na yungs kur 17dag gis bya / /rdzas la legs par 'phang bar bya/ /thog ma bar ram mtha' 1 mar ram/ /mtshan ma byung ba'i tshe na yang / /sgrub pa rtsom 19pa'i bar bar du/ /'phangs na rdzas kyi byin bskyed 'gyur/ /dus de rnams su cho ga bzhin/ /spos chu bzlas brjod byas pa 'am/ /mar la sogs pas ci rigs su/ /bsang gtor byas pas byin bskyed do/ /gal te rdzas rnams ma grub na/ /cho ga de nyid bya bar 96wa 669

bshad / /yang na dkyil 'khor 'di bris nas/ /cho ga shes pas byin bskyed do/ /tshon rtsi sna lnga'i phye ma yis/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin du bri0)/ /gru (2bzhi pa la sgo gcig pa/ /khru bzhi pa yi tshad du bya/ /dang por shar du 'khor lo dang / /ngos su chos gos lhung bzed 4)bzhag /de nas byang du pad+ma dang / /ril ba spyi blugs dbyug pa bzhag /de bzhin lhor ni 'khor lo dang / /ngos su dbyug to bum pa bzhag /phyag rgya thams cad stegs bu la/ /bzhag cing kha dog dkar por bya/ /rang gi phyag rgya bkod nas su/ /rdzas ni snod dang bcas pa bzhag /de steng bzhag pa'i rdzas la ni/ /sngags 5kyis sngon bzhin byin bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdung thung 'dang / /rig sngags grub (7)pa'i spyan dang ni/ /gsang sngags dbang phyug gzi brjid gter/ /de bzhin gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /phyag drug pa dang rta mgrin dang / /sgrol ma lha mo zla ba dang / /rdo rje lcags kyu khu tshur dang / /ngos su ki li gnod mdzes dang / /rig sngags chen mo mā ma khrin / /gos dkar can ma gang yin dang / /rig sngags gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /de dag nub kyi phyogs su dgod/ /bgegs rnams thams cad sel byed pa/ /bdud rtsi thab smyosbyor gzhag 1 par bya/ /sgo yi phyogs su rang gi rgya/ /snga ma bzhin du cho gas mchod/ /phyogs cha'i dbye ba shes pa yis/ /go rims 41bzhin du grwa kun du/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags dang / /lus ngan po yang rim bzhin du/ /rdzas kyi khri yi shar phyogs su/ /bsgrub 1 par bya ba'i lha nyid gzhag1 /rigs dang rigs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /sna tshogs ci 'dod pa yang gzhags /so so yi ni gsang sngags kyis/ /cho ga bzhin du spyan drangs nas/ /mchod pa'i cho ga thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor sngar bstan bzhin du bya/ /96—670

rig sngags so sor ji lta bar/ /gsang sngags gsungs pa'am rig sngags kyis/ /khyad par du ni sbyin sreg (17bya/ /de nas cho ga 'di dag bya/ /dang po sbyin sreg nalas dag gis/ /rdzas rnams legs par byin yang bskyed/ /kun la rigs kyi rig sngags kyis/ /bsngags (8)shing mjug tu bsang 4gtor bya/ /mā ma tī yi 5snying po dang / /rigs dbang yi ge bzhi bcas pa/ /de dag gis ni bye brag tu/ /byin bskyed cho ga bya bar bshad/ /na mo lo ka pidha tra ye 7/ na maḥsho ka re/shārnyi (8)ka re/ ghuṣ+ṭa lhus ghar+bhe 59rini'i/ ghaṣ+ṭa 11ye/ lhuṭi 12ni swā hā/ mā ma tī yi rig sngags so/ /oṃ ku lan+dha ri brnya ban+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ mā ma khri'i 1 snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ dha/ rig pa'i dbang po'i 'o/ /oṃ khadz+wa la dzā la tsha'i/ rgyal ba rnams kyi'o / /sidhi sā dha ya/ bar ma rnams kyi'o/ /dī pya dī pa ltas/ gsang sngags bar ma rnams kyi yin te/ rdzas gzengs bstod pa'o/ /phaṭa 1 ces bya ba ni thams cad la'o/ /gzi brjid ldan pas rdzas nang du/ /phyi bshol ma mdzad bzhugs nas su/ /kun gyi gzi brjid spel ba dang / /byin rlabs 1 can du mdzad du gsol/ /de la sogs pa'i tshig gi rnams/ /zlos bu 19dang ni ma 'dres dang / /bsnor ba yis kyang ci 'dod pa/ /mkhas pas rdzas kyi byin bskyed do/ /ka ra bī na ra'i me tog ni/ /dmar po dag dang yungs kur 1dang //de nas sna ma'i me tog gis/ /rim pa bzhin du rdzas 2byin bskyed/ /thog mar 2 dri yis byug par bya/ /de nas me tog yungs kur 2 gyi phu/ /bdug spos kyis kyang rnam par bdug /spos chu yis kyang bsang gtor bya/ /dus gsum du ni spos kyi 25chus/ /rang sngags bdag po'i gsang sngags kyis / /bsang gtor bya zhing rang sngags kyis 8/ /skabs skabs su ni bzlas brjod bya/ /nyi ma shar gyi bar 96—671

du yang 1/ /byin bskyed pa yi cho ga bya/ /cho ga 'dis nani rig sngags rnams/ /zlos pa po la myur du 'grub/ /de ltar byin ni bskyed pa'i rdzas/ /brtan /rizhing myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas ni nyung ngus kyang / /dngos grub chen po ster bar 'gyur/ /mngon par 'phel zhing gzi byin cadang / /rnam par dag pa mngon du 'gyur/ /cho ga 'di yis rdzas rnams la/ /rtag tu byin yang bskyed par bya/ /bsgrub 5par bya ba'i las rnams kun/ / yongs su bzung ba byas nas kyang / /0cho ga gsang 7bar bstan pa 'dis/ /rdzas rnams kun gyi byin yang bskyed/ /rtag tu dus dang dus mtshams 9la/ /de lta bur 9ni byin bskyed de/ /de nas phyis ni mtshan gcig tu/ /bsgrub 11la 12legs par brtsam par bya/ /rdzas byin bskyed pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //de nas gzhan yang ci mthong ba'i/ /dus bzang yon tan ldan pa la/ /bsgrub 1 pa'i phyir ni mkhas pa yis/ /cho ga bzhin du brtsam par bya/ /dgun zla tha chungs 1 ston zla 'bring / /dpyid zla ra dang 'bring po dang / /dbyar zla ra ba nya dag la/ /sgrub pa chen po brtsam par bya/ /dbyar zla ra ba rtag tu 'bab/ /dpyid zla 'bring po rlung gi 15'khor/ /dpyid zla ra ba sna tshogs bgegs/ /dgun zla ra ba bgegs med do/ /ston zla 'bring po glog 'gyu 7zhing / /sgra chen rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bgegs ni 'grub pa'i mtshan ma bas/ /de ltar de dag brtag 1 par bya/ /zla ba lnga po de dag la/ /dngos grub rab ni 'grub par bya/ /zhi ba yi ni las rnams kyang / /de dag nyid la legs par brtsam / /lnga po mar gyi zla phyed kyi/ /dus tshigs rnams su gang bsgrags pa/ /96—672

de la 'bring dang tha ma yi/ /dngos grub bsgrub 1par rab tu shis/ /zla ba gza' yis (mizin pa'i tshe/ /rdzas kyi dam pa bsgrub par bya/ /nyi ma gzas zin tshe na yang / /mkhas pas las rnams bsgrub 4par bya/ /tshes lnga dang ni tshes bdun dang / /tshes gcig dang ni tshes gsum dang / /tshes grangs bcu gsum dag la yang / /las rnams thams cad bya bar shis/ /tshes grangs skar ma dang ldan na/ /mchog tu 'gyur bar shes par bya/ /phal 5dag la ni 6bye brag tu/ /skar ma rgyal ni kun la shis/ /gza' dang yud tsam byed pa dang / /drag po drag po'i las la'o/ /rang gi cho gas gsungs pa 'am/ /lha rnams kyis 7ni bskul ba'ang rung / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla phyed la/ /las rnams thams cad rab tu shis/ /bka' lung stsal ba'i tshes grangs sam/ /tshes grangs bcu gsum pa yang rung / /zhi ba phal cher ston ngo 8la/ /de bzhin rgyas pa dgun 9'o la/ / dpyid smad tshadag shul cho ga bzhin/ /bsgrub 11pa dag ni rab tu shis/ /dpyid 12stod las rnams thams cad bya/ /dbyar gyi ngo la las rnams bya/ /ston dang dgun dang dpyid smad ni/ /'bring dang rab dang tha ma'o/ /gsum du phye ba de la yang / /gsum gsum dag tu dbye bar bshad/ /dus gsum dag gi 1 dngos grub kyang / /phal cher rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /dang po srod kyi dus las tekhi/ /'bring po nam gyi phyed na'o/ /rab kyi dus ni nang par te/ /der ni dngos grub rim bzhin 'gyur/ /zhi dang drag shul rgyas pa yis/ /dus kyang de dag yin par bsgrags/ /tha ma 'bring dang rab rnams kyil/ /cho ga'i rim pa de dag nyid/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma yi/ /dngos grub rnams kyi mtshan ma la/ /rim pa ci 1 ltar mthong ba bzhin/ /bye brag rnam gsum shes par 1 bya/ /96—673

nyi ma zla ba gzas zin la/ /dus ni gang yang nges pa med/ /drag shul spyod pa khyad par du/ /gzas zin tshe ni bya bar bzang (1/ /rab la sogs pa'i bye brag las / /zhag gsum yang na zhag gnyis sam/ /yang na zhag gcig (2)tu yang rung / /smyung bar 8)bya ba 4norab tu bshad/ /sgrub pa'i dus rim par phye ba'o// //de nas gzhan yang rtog pa las/ /ji skad bstan pa'i cho ga bya/ /ngal bar thal ba'i gaskyon yod pas/ /smyung bar bya ba mi shis 6)so/ /de yi bar du sgrub 7ripa pos/ /bsnyen pa dang ni mchod pa dang / /sbyin sreg nasacho ga bstod pa dang / /dge ba dag la brtson par bya/ /lan brgyar 59)mngon par bsngags gepa yi bu mos bkal ba'i skud pa ni/ /mang du bsgril cing spos bskus nyu1pa/ /mdud pa bdun ni bor ba la/ /sgrub pa pos ni gsang sngags 'dis/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas brjod nas/ /srod la rked 12par bcings na ni/ /khu chu dgag pa sna byas par 'gyur/ /oṃ dza ye 7ku mā 5ri shu kra ban+dha ni saswā hā/ oṃ rak+ṣa ku ru ku raṃ gi na swā hā/ oṃ ku lan+dha ri ban+dha brnya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ / bde gshegs sngags pa gzhon 1 nu mas19/ /pad+ma 'dzin la ku rung gis/ /rdo rje'i rigs la mā ma khris / /cho ga bzhin du khu chu dgag /tshur spyon tshur spyon brtul zhugs bzang / /bdag gi 1lus la myur zhugs nas/ /rkang gi bar du 22gnas nas su / /'dir ni yun ring rgyu bar mdzod/ /rig sngags bshad pa 'di gsum ni/ /thams cad kyi ni spyir yin no/ /kha cig tu ni rtog pa las/ /gsungs pa'i sngags kyis cho ga bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni 'dri ba dang / /bsnyen pa dang ni 96—674

dus tshigs dang / /byin bskyed la sogs cho ga yang / /nyi ma re re bcing bar bya / /thog mar lan brgya bsngags (1)pa yi/ /mig nasman gyis ni gnyid kyang bsal / /bsgrub (5)pa'i tshe yang (4)mig sman de/ /legs par bsku bar bya bar bsgrags / /sug smel ga pur sro tan tsa/ /shing tsha ta kur 5)pi pi ling / /kha ra ta yi kha chur 56)sbyar/ /gnyid dang snyom 97 dang 'jigs pa sel/ /'thor 'thung yang dang yang byas te/ /kha gdong bkrus nas mig bkru'o/ /mig sman bskus pa'i mig des ni/ /bsgrub 8pa'i tshe na bgegs 9kyang mthong / /o dz+wa la lo tsa ni swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'o/ /oṃ bi 7lo ki na 11swā hā/pad+ma'i tsho rigs la'o/ /oṃ brtu ni ri dhi ba te swā hā/ rdo rje'i rigs la'o/ /rigs gsum gyi mig sman bsku ba'i rig sngags so/ /ngal dang rmya ba bsal ba'i phyir / /spos kyi chu ni khyor gang tsam12/ /dri zhim bdun bdun bzlas pa dag /khyor ba nyid kyis btung bar bya/ /de nas nye reg 'byas nas ni/ /blo dang ldan pas mtshan ma brtag /mtshan ma bzang po mthong nas ni/ /bsgrub 7pa gus pas tshabartsam par bya/ /'khor lo dung dang lcags kyu nya/ /g.yung drung pad+ma rgyal mtshan dang / /bkra shes bum pa gang ba dang / /dpal be'u rdo rje phreng ba dang //bu mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /sbrum ma'am pang 1 na bu thogs dang 18/ /na chung dga' zhing rgyags pa dag /gang zhig de yis 'grub par ston/ /bram ze gos dkar gyon pa dang / /shing rta glang po rta dag dang / /rtsa 19rdog 'bras bu sna tshogs dang / /ngo mtshar che zhing mthong ba dag /'brug gi sgra ni grag 2 pa dang / /rig byed dbyangs dang rgyal ba'i sgra/ /dung dang rnga 21dang rdza rnga yi/ /sgra rnams 'grub phyir rab tu shis/ /rma bya khrung khrung ngang 22mo dang / /ne tsho tshal 96—675

sogs bya rnams kyi/ /sgra snyan rnams ni kun thos nas/ /dngos grub sbyin pa'i las brtsam mo/ /smon lam bkra shis thams cad dang / /bsod nams dga' dang bde legs tshig91 /yid du 'ong ba'i tshig gi rnams/ /thos nas 'grub pa ༷nashes par bya/ /glog dang sprin dang char 'bab dang / /ser tsho )bu me tog char 'bab dang / /'ja' cadang dri ni zhim po ste/ /mtshan ma 'di dag lha yi yin/ /bar snang las byung mtshan ma ni/ /thams cad 'bring por 5)shes par bya sa las byung ba'i mtshan ma dag /de dag sa pa'i yin par bshad/ /lha dag gis ni dngos grub rab/ /bar snang dag gi 6'bring por 'gyur/ /sa pa dag gi 47)dngos grub phalan/ /gsum la'ang gsum gsum dag tu dbye/ /de dag la sogs mtshan ma rnams/ /dngos grub phyir ni rab tu bsgrags/ /mdor na gsang sngags thams cad la/ /de las bzlog pas 95mi 'grub bo/ /dang por mtshan ma bzung nas ni/ /sems kyang rab tu dga' byas te/ /yongs su mgu ba'i bsam 1 pa yis/ /de nas bsgrub 1 pa brtsam par bya/ /bsgrub 12pa'i mtshan ma rim par phye ba'o// //dkyil 'khor gyi ni rgyud kun dang / /yang na bsgrub 1 pa dag la'ang rung / /tshes grangs yud tsam byed pa dang / /mtshan ma'ang rgyas par shes byas nas/ /mi bzang ba la mar dag gi1 / /rigs kyi rig pas sbyin sreg dbya/ /de nas las rnams brtsam 7byas nas/ /'on tam nyu dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /gnas gang dag tu rim pa bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni mngon bri zhing / /de nyid du ni sgrub pa yi/ /de yi rim pa bshad pa yin/ /ri la sogs pa'i gnas 96—676

rnams su/ /dngos grub chen po thob par bsgrags/ /mtsho la sogs par 'bring rnams 'thob/ /gzhan dag tu ni phal rnams so/ /sngags dang rjes su mthun 1nas su/ /bzlas brjod tsho byed pas rilas rnams brtsam/ /gzhan du bsgrub 4par byas na ni/ /dngos grub myur du mi 'thob bo/ /ring bsrel can gyi mchod rten kun/ /bde 5cigashegs kun gyi phyogasang sngags 'grub/ /mchod rten chen po nyams dga' ba/ /byang chub chen po grub gnas dang / /de bzhin bltam la sogs pa brgyad/ /de na bgegs ni yod ma yin/ /las kyi cho ga thams cad dang / /mthun 57༄pa dag kyang de na yod/ /der ni bdud kyis bgegs bya bar/ /nam yang nus pa ma yin no/ /de bas gsang sngags thams cad kyang / /der ni nges par 'grub par gsungs/ /'dir ni drag shul spyod pa'i las/ /dur khrod dag tu bya bar shis/ /yang na shing gcig pa dag gaman/ /khang stong mtshan ma gcig pa'ang rung / /'bab chu'i 'gram ni thams cad du/ /rig sngags bsgrubs 9)na 'grub par gsungs/ / skyed mos 1 tshal du gnod sbyin mo/ /klu yi bdag po mtsho 11rnams su/ /khang stong du ni longs spyod phyir/ /mngag gzhug grong srang la sogs par/ /phug gi gsang sngags phug rnams su/ /bsgrubs 1 na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngags rnams myur du 'grub pa'i phyir/ /cho ga gsang ba 'di gsungs so/ /man ngag bstan pa 'di nyid kyis/ /gnas rnams gtan la dbab par bya/ /gang yang rung ba'i gnas gcig tu/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga gsungs pa 'am/ /bzlas brjod sa yi cho ga yis/ /dang por sa ni sbyang bar bya/ /lha yi gnas ni rnam dag par/ /byin gyis rlob cing bzhugs 'gyur bas / /bsgrub 1 pa la ni bye brag tu/ /cho ga gzhan yang 'di dag bshad/ /96—677

tsan+dan dmar pos bskus pa yi/ /seng ldeng phur bu mdzub 6)gang pa/ /rnon por byas pa bzhi rinadag la/ /skud pa dmar po dag gis dkris/ /rdo rje phur bus lan grangs brgyar/ /mngon par bzlas brjod byas pa dag /gnas sam khyim dag tu yang rung / /khu tshur gyis ni phyogs bzhir gdab/ /dang por las kun byed sngags sam/ /yang na bgegs kyi /nodagras (4)kyang rung / /yungs kur (5nidag la sogs pa yis56)/ /legs par kun du bsal (3)bar bya/ /ba dan dkar po gcig la ni/ /rig sngags rgyal pos mngon bsngags te/ /smyug ma ring po'i yu ba la/ /btags rinasate dang po shar du gzugs/ /rdo rje ra bas bsngags pa yi//lcags kyu'i phye mas ra ba 59)bya/ /rdo rje dra 7ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /lan brgyar bsngags 11pa'i phye ma yis/ /khor yug 12tu ni rdo rje phreng / /bris na rdo rje dra bar 'gyur / /dkyil 'khor nang gi dang po 12yi/ /sgo kur bdud rtsi thab tsosbyor gyis//rdo rje'i phyag rgya mabasrung tshab 'am/ /yang na gzhan gyis mi thub pas/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa bsrung nyu ba ni/ /'phrog ma sogs pas bya bar 'dod/ /rigs 3shegasum dag gi spyi la yang / /cho ga 'di ni rab tu bsgrags/ /cho ga gsum po 'di dag ni/ /thub dka' bar yang yongs su bsgrags/ /re re'am yang na kun gyis kyang / /bsgrub 19pa'i tshe na bgegs kun sel/ /rdzas bsgrub spe )pa na bsrung 1ba'i phyir/ /cho ga gsang ba 'di gsungs 5 2te/ /mdor bsdus pa la don yang che/ /rim pa bzhin du rab tu gcesas / /mkhas pas rin chen la sogs pas/ /sa gzhi snying po can du bya/ /thab khung la yang ci rigs par/ /rdzas bzhag pa yi 'og tu'ang rung / /dri gtsang khang ngam khang bzangs suri ge/ /bsang 27gtor byas pa dag gsungs pas/ /der ni sa brko mi dgos kyi/ ci/cho 96wa 678

ga de ltar phyi rol du'o/ /bdag nyid kyis ni cho ga bzhin/ /brtags shing byas pa'i khang par ni/ /bye brag tu ni las brtsams na/ /der ni myur du 'grub par 'gyur / /khung dag tu ni bsgrub tsho1 pa min/ /sa phyogs dog par mi bya'o/ /khang rul du yang blo can gyis/ /bsgrub 5pa brtsam par mi bya'o/ /de nas dad pa'i 5yid kyis su/ /srod 4)la gsang sngags lha yi rnams/ /mthong ba bzhin du gus byas te/ /sta gon gnas pa legs par bya/ /rigs zigasum gyi dzini rig sngags lha / /bdag por ri dbacas 8pa gang bzhugs dang / /sngags rgyud 'di la lha rnams ni/ /gang dag yongs su bsgrags pa dang / /gsang sngags lha ni gang dag cig6) /bdag nyid nyon mongs chen po yis / /cho ga 'di bzhin bsnyen pa dang / /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg 11gis mnyes pa/ /zhag bdun na ni sgrub pa'i tshe/ /byin gyis rlob cing gshegs su gsol/ /'di na 12lha dang 'byung po dang / /'khor rnams dang ni bcas pa dag /ci nus par ni mchod byas pas/ /mchod pa la ni phan 'dogs rnams/ /yongs su mnyes shing kun 'dus nas/ /bdag la dngos grub myur gnas mdzod/ /de ltar gus par nyin re zhing / /tshig gis kyang ni phyogs bzhir brjod/ /nyin re'am zhag re bri 1 byas pas/ /gsang sngags sta gon gnas par 'bya/ /mchod yon dag dang me tog dang / /bdug pa dri zhim dag kyang dbul/ /sgrub pa pos ni cho ga 'dis/ /srod kyi dus su bya bar bshad/ /sgrub pa po yi skacho ga 'dis/ /rdzas kyang sta gon gnas par bya / /lag pas legs par brim pa dang / /bdug pa dag gis legs par bdugs /yang na gza' skar byed pa dag /bzang po la ni smyung byas te/ /dkyil 'khor bris nas 1 rdzas kyi rnams/ /sta gon gnas pa'i cho ga bya/ /sa ni 96—679

sgrub par byed pa 'am/ /gsang sngags sgrub pas zhag gsum na/ /yo lang chung ngu dag gis bya/ /bzlas brjod 1byed pas dkyil 'khor brin/ /phye ma sna tshogs nyid kyis kyang / /dkyil 'khor sna tshogs zlum po la/ /phyi rol rim pa gnyis pas 3bskor/ /sgo gcig btod 4pa bri bar bya/ /de yi dbus su khru do pa'i55kyi/ /pad+ma 'dab dzim brgyad pa bri/ /dkyil 'khor lhag ma tshad dag ni/ /ci 7)ltar dga' ba nyid du bya/ /der ni bdag po gsum dag dang / /nub tu bdud rtsi thab /sbyor bzhag /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i nub phyogs su/ /dbang phyug chen po chung mar bcas/ /gcig tu gzi brjid phung po ste/ /gcig tu yang na posgrub pa'i spyan/ /gcig tu dpa' mo chen mo ste/ /phyag drug ma yang gcig tu bri / /gcig tu rig sngags mā ma khri1 / /rig sngags rgyal snying gcig tu bri/ /khro bo gī 11li gcig tu ste/ /gcig tu rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /de ltar bstan pa de dag kun/ /snying po'i 12dkyil 'khor dag tu dgod/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags rnams/ /phyi rol phyogs su rim pa bzhin/ /de ltar bkod nas phyi rol sgor1 / /gzhan gyis mi thub pa yang bri/ /de nas phyogs mtshams laskyong ba dang / /'dod pa'i lha rnams bri bar bya/ /de nas so so'i gsang sngags kyis / /rim pa bzhin du spyan yang drang / /bdag po rnams ni snying po yis /de yi 'og tu mchod par dbya/ /pad+ma'i dbus su rang sngags kyis/ /rdzas ni legs par bzhag ste mchod/ /bum pa gang ba de steng du/ /cho ga bzhin du rdzas bzhag go/ /yang na gab tshe'am kham phor dag /me tog la sogs blugs pa bzhag /de nas lag pas brim bya zhing / /rang gi rig sngags yongs bzlas pa'i / /me tog brgya 'am stong dag gis/ /de yi 'og tu 'phang bar bya de 96—680

nas gu gul bdug spos ni/ /mar dang sbyar bas bdug par bya/ /spos chus bzlas brjod byas pa yi1ri/ /de nas dal bus bsang gtor bya/ /de nas rang gi gsang sngags dang / /dkyil 'khor du bshad thams cad kyis/ /re res so sor bzlas pa dag /sbyin sreg ci naskad bstan dpa'ang bya/ /sbyin sreg bya ba'i mar dag gam/ /yang na ba yi 'o mas bya/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi til sbyar dang / /lag pan 5gyis ni mjug 6tu bya/ /de nas gsang sngags thams cad kyis(7) / /mkhas pas rdzas la bsang gtor bya/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bri ba dang / /rjes su mthun 8par byin bskyed do/ /yid la yongs su zlos byed cing //cho ga shes pas zlos bzhin du/ /rdzas la mig gis blta bar bya/ /de byas sta 9gon gnas byas 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg 1 cho ga gtor ma'i rim/ /mchod sogs gang yin de dag kun/ /bzlas brjod byed pas rgyas par 'dir/ /rgyud las bshad pa bzhin du bya/ /'di ni rdzas la sta gon du/ /gnas pa'i cho ga yin par bsgrags/ /sta gon gnas pa'i rdzas de ni/ /myur du 'grub pa nyid du 'gyur / /cho ga'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /yongs su gzung ba dag kyang bya/ / dngos grub gzung ba dag kyang bya/ /11rdzas kyi byin yang 12bskyed pa dang / /cho ga 'di dag nyid kyis kyang / /dkyil 'khor 'di yi 1 dbus su ni/ /rdzas rnams sgrub pa dag kyang bya/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di nyid du/ /bshegs kyang myur du zhi bar 'gyur/ /rdzas rnams sbyang bar bya ba dang / /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga yis/ /sgrub pa po rnams dbang bskur ba'ang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni rab tu bya/ /las kun byed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dirang/ /gsang chen gsang ba'i bdag pos gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni bri byas nas/ /dngos 96—681

grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /rdzas sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o / / //rdzas ni yongs su bzung 1)byas nas/ /sgrub pa pos ni dus gsum du/ /khrus dang mchod pa sbyin sreg nanodang / /lag pa yis kyang brim par bya/ /gos ni lan gsum brje ba dang / /dus mtshams dag la smyung byas te/ /mchod dang lha bshos cho ga dag /khyad par du ni legs par bya/ /dus gsum dag tu sdig pa bshags/ /bsod nams rjes su yi rang dang / /dus gsum dag tu (4)smon lam gdabaci5)/ /glegs bam dus gsum lan gsum bklag(6) /dkyil 'khor lan gsum dag tu bya/ /lan gsum du yang sdom pa bzung (7༄/ /dus gsum du yang bsrung ba bya/ /de ltar byas na nges par 'grub/ /gang tshe bag med gyur pa yis / /dus gsum dag gi las nyams na/ /de tshe rang gi rig sngags de(8) / /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bya/ /de ltar nyin re dus gsum du/ /mkhas pa dag gis 9rirtag tu bya/ /de nyams na ni brlag 'gyur zhing / /dngos grub dag kyang nyams par 'gyur/ /las kyi klags lco la 'bum bzlas pa'am/ /yang na dkyil 'khor 'di bris pas/ /gsang 11ba'i cho ga de byas te/ /de nas las rnams brtsam 12par bya/ /sngon bzhin legs par thig btab nas/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor gyis bskor ba/ /cho ga bzhin du legs par bri/ /dbus su 'khor lo bris nas de'i/ /shar du 'khor los sgyur nyunyeb dang / /gzi brjid phung po gtsug tor dkar/ /rgyal dang rmad du byung geb dgod / /mkhas pas ngos gnyis dag tu yang / /bde gshegs mdzod spu mdung 96—682

thung dang / /sangs rgyas byams ma 515spyan du bcas/ /kun dga' bo dang rab 'byor dang / /de bzhin lhung bzed khar gsil shunadang / /sgo kur las kun byed pa (dbyedagod/ /rim bzhin sgor ni 'phrog ma dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub pa yang dgod/ /'khor lo'i dbus su rdzas rnams ni/ /yang na gsang sngags lha bzhag ste/ /de nas mchod pa'i cho ga bya/ /sbyin sreg 4thams cad bya bar gsungs / /dkyil 'khor 'di ni phyag rgya'am/ /gtan du dgod par rab tu bsgrags / /so so'i cho gas spyan drang ba'am/ /spyi yi snying pos byar yang rung / /der ni rang gi rig sngags kyis/ /snga ma bzhin du me sbar te/ /de nas mar dang sbrang rtsi las/ /sbyin sreg 5brgya ni rtsa brgyad bya/ /de nas zho dang 'bras chan dang / /til gyi sbyin sreg 6brgya brgya bya/ /mkhas pas mjug tu brgya bzlas pas/ /'di ni cho ga gsang chen yin/ /dri zhim me tog dri sogs kyis/ /'dir ni mchod pa bya bar gsungs/ /zho dang bu ram legs sbyar ba'i/ /gtor ma rgya chen dbul bar bya/ /cho ga 'di yis lha rnams ni/ /myur du legs par tshim par 'gyur/ /dgyes nas ring por 7mi thogs par/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol(4)/ /zla ba re re'am zla phyed dam/ /nyi ma re re'am dus mtshams 6)la/ /dbul pos kyang ni ci nus parang/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni bri 11bar bya/ /cho ga de ltar bya ba kun/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la'ang shes par bya/ /ci (2ltar dga' ba'i tshad tsam du/ /kun du zlum por rab tu bya/ /de dbus pad+ma bris nas su/ /rig sngags rgyal dang rta mgrin dang / /sna tshogs gzugs dang spyan gsum pa/ /phyag bzhi phyag drug bcu gnyis phyag /de bzhin 'dod pa 'byor byed dang / /grags dang ldan pa dpal mo che/ /sgrol ma lha mo zla ba 96—683

dgod / /sgo yi phyogs su dkar mo dang / /gos dkar can ma gzhag nyu)bya zhing //sgo kur las kun byed bzhag 24pa/ /'grub phyir pad+ma 'chang ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di gsungs so/ /ci ltar 'dod par 54dkyil 'khor ni/ /gru bzhi par yang legs bris te/ /sngon bzhin snying po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rig sngags rgyal po gzhag 5par bya/ /rig pa chen mo mā ma khriri ri/ /khro bo bdud rtsi thab 7sbyor dang / /rig pa chen po 8lcags kyu ma/ /dbyug pa dang ni stobs po che / /rdo rje khu 9tshur rig rgyal mo/ /gnod mdzes go rims tshobazhin du bzhag /khro chen lha yi yan lag dang / /gom pa 'dor ba nyid dang ni/ /khro mo me rnams ngos gnyis su/ /blo dang ldan pas gzhag 11par bya/ /sgo yi phyogs kyi nang rol du/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed mig dang ni/ /rdo rje gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /sgo kur 12las kun byed pa bzhag /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa mchod pa yang / /cho ga snga ma bzhin du bya/ /lha rnams dga' bar 'gyur ba ni/ /phyag na rdo rjes rab tu bshad/ /de nas nang par nam langs nas/ /rmi lam bzang po rnams dpyad 15de/ /gtsang zhing khrus byas gos dkar 1 bgos/ /sbyin sreg 12las tsheni brtsam 1 par bya/ /lha rnams cho ga bzhin mchod de/ /bkra shis ngo mtshar dag kyang bya/ /cho ga bzhin du me sbar nas/ /ci 18skad gsungs pa'i sbyin sreg 19bya/ /ba lang lci bas byugs nas su/ /'bras yos ku sha sngon po dang / /me tog dkar po dri zhim pas/ /gnas de khyad par can du bsham/ /de yi g.yas kyi phyogs su ni/ /bud shing zho dang ku sha dang / /mar dang sbrang rtsi 'bras chan 2 til / /bsreg bya cung zad ci 'byor dgod/ /g.yon du legs par brtags pa yi / /mchod yon snod ni gzhag 21par bya/ /dbus su dgang gzar blugs 96—684

gzar dang / /legs par bzhus pa'i mar dag bzhag /bzhag nas mkhas pas las kun pa'i/ /gsang sngags kyis/ ni bsang gtor bya/ /sngon bzhin gsang sngags bdag po ni/ /mdun du bzhag ste mchod byas nas/ /de nas rang rigs spyan drang ste/ /mchod yon bzlas pas 1bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mdun du mar gyi snod/ /dag par byas pa gzhag 2par bya mar dang me yi bar dag tu/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i rdzas bzhag go/ /bdag cadang mar dang bsgrub 55bya'i rdzas/ /me dang gsang sngags bdag por 6bcas lnga po 'di dag go rims ri bzhin/ /blo dang ldan pas legs par dgod/ /g.yon du rig sngags byin bskyed ma/ /g.yas su las kun byed pa ste/ /gnas der snga ma bzhin du yang / /bsrung 8ba thams cad rab tu sbyar/ /de nas ku sha sar pa yi / /gding ba dag kyang bkram nas su/ /lha bshos 'bras yos bkra shis can/ /sā /lu'i 'bras chan 1 zhor bcas dbul/ /de nas bdug spos dri zhim pas/ /kun nas rab tu bdug par bya/ /de 'og ci 1 ltar bstan pa yi/ /sbyin sreg 12las ni ci dgar bya/ /gser dang dngul zangs rdo ba 'am/ /dung dang mu tig shing dag gam/ /grog mkhar sa las byas pa yi/ /snod du rdzas ni gzhag 1 par bya / /byang chub shing gi lo ma dag /de yi gding bar shis 1 pa yinas/ /'o ma can gyi shing gi 'am/ /yang na arga'i lo ma'ang rung / /chu shing pad+ma'i 'dab lam 'am/ /yang na ras dkar 'jam po 'am/ /dri zhim shing las skyes pa yi/ /gding ba lnga po 'dod pa yin/ /phye ma khu ba gos sogs dang / /ci rigs par ni g.yogs nas kyang / /cho ga shes pas mnyam bzhag 1 ste/ /rdzas la legs par bdug 1 par bya/ /yid kyis rdzas kyi byin bskyed 19cing / /mar gyi sreg 96—685

blugs 17rgyun du bsregan /legs par blta rizhing cho ga 'dis/ /mkhas pas rdzas la bdug capar bya/ /rdzas la ribazlas shing bsang gtor nas/ /blugs gzar chang bas bzung nas ni/ /dal bus mar gyis legs bkang ste/ /rdzas kyi steng du de bzlas shing / /sreg blugs 6༄zlos 7)pa me 'bar ba/ /swā hā zhes ni brjod bya zhing / /hā 8yi dbyangs kyi rgyun bsrings te59ri/ /blugs gzar rtse mor de bdug 7cing 1 / /stong ngam yang na lan grangs brgyar/ /rdzas rnams la ni bdug par bya/ /de ltar rdzas la yang dang yang / /cho ga 'di ni bya bar gsungs / /gsang sngags kyi ni rang bzhin dang / /dngos grub che chung shes bya ste / /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig kyang / /grangs kyi cho ga yin par bzhed/ /rdzas ni zad pa ma grub na/ /mkhas pas de la nyung zad cig /rig sngags bzlas shing bsang gtor de1 / /bzhag nyusnyenas mchod cing blta bar bya/ /rab la sogs pa'i dbye ba dang / / las kyi 1 dbye ba bsgrags pa dag /dkyil 'khor du gsungs cho ga bzhin/ /'bar na 'grub pa'i mtshan ma yinam/ /shin tu chen po'i lardzas kyi rnams/ /de yi g.yas su bzhag pa 'am/ /g.yon du 'os pa g.yon du bzhag /der ni de la gtug cing bya/ /sems can kun gyi mgo bo la / /yang na rang ’ gi mgo bo nyid/ /mod las bsgrub sna rdzas ci yang rung / /mkhas pas bdug pa bsngos te bya/ /bdug pa'i cho ga 'di yis su/ /sngon bzhin phye la mar dag gis/ /la la'i phyir bsngo kha cig la/ /blta 19zhing sbyin sreg 2 rab tu bya/ /gal te mar dag ma 'byor na/ /cho ga bzhin du 'o mas bya/ /yang na 'o ma mar dang ni/ /mkhas pas mngar gsum dag gis bya/ /zhi ba la sogs khyad par gyis/ /21kha cig la ni zho yang rung / /yang na bsreg bya'i rdzas 96—686

bsten pas/ /ci 0)ltar rigs par bdug (25par bya/ /mtshon cha rnams la 'bru mar gyis/ /dri zhim thang chu e daradza na/ /du ru ska 4sogs 'bru mar gyis/ /bdug pa'i cho ga bya bar gsungs/ /rdzas la sogs pa'i bye brag las/ /rdzas ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /dri zhim las byung 'bras bu yis/ /bdug pa'i cho ga dag kyang bya/ /sha chen la sogs rdzas rnams la/ /tshil bu dag gis bya bar bsgrags / /de yi gzugs brnyan byas nas kyang / /so so'i sha dang tshil gyis bya//cho ga bstan pa 'di yis sam/ /yang na sngar gsungs cho ga yis/ /dngos grub myur bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bdug pa'i cho ga rgyas par bstan/ /cho ga 'di yis rdzas dag la/ /bdugs (5nas de la dbang yang bskur/ /dbang bskur nas ni lha gnas su/ /bzhag ste legs par mchod par 6bya/ /de nas cho ga las gsungs pa/ /thob (7)par bya phyir gtor ma bsog /bdag nyid rgyas par khrus byas nas/ /cho ga 'di ni brtsam par bya/ /dri zhim rnams kyis dril byas nas/ /de bzhin khrus rtsi skyu naru ras/ /khrus bya nyi ma phyed mtshams 9nas/ /mkhas pas rdzas la yongs su bzlas/ /skud pa gdu bu gos rnams dang / /thal ba yungs kur bochu dag la/ /bsrung 11ba'i phyir ni rdzas 'di la/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /de dag thog mar bzlas brjod de/ /cho ga 'di ni myur du bya/ /de phyir de tshe dgos pa kun/ /thog ma nyid du bsngags 12par bya /me tog la sogs ci 'byor pa/ /yongs su bsdu ba byas nas ni/ /ci rigs pa yi gnas bzhag ste/ /sgrub pa'i sar ni gnas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor las gsungs cho ga yis/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bris nas kyang 12/ /ci rigs par ni mchod byas te/ /rdzas rnams bsgrub sapa brtsam par bya/ /las kun byed 96—687

pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /tshon sna lnga yi tsho1chisrad bu la/ /lan brgyar bsngags (5rinas dang por des/ /phur bu rnams la bre bar bya/ /mkhas pas thab ②sbyor bzlas pa yis/ /sgo drung gi 4 ni bum pa la/ /srad bu lhod par btags 95)nas su / /de nas der ni gzhag 6par bya/ /thab 75sbyor bgegs rnams sel byed pa'i / /khro bo yid la dran 8bzhin du/ /srad bu'i 'og nas 'byung ba dang / /'jug par bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /yang na mkhas pas khro bo des/ /srad bu la ni bsngags 9pa 'am/ /bsrung 1 ba'i don du gang dga' ba'i/ /rig nyustosngags gzhan gyis bzlas kyang rung / /bskrad pa la sogs cho ga dag /sngar gsungs pa yang shes bya zhing / /dkyil 'khor gyi 1 ni nye 'khor du/ /cho ga 'di dag bya bar gsungs/ /phyogs dang phyogs skyong ci sna snyed dang / /so so'i rigs kyi lha yi 1 rnams/ /phyogs dang go rims 5ci salta bar/ /de kun phyi rol dag tu mchod / /bum par rdo rje bzhag pa 'am/ /yang na lo mas kha brgyan pa/ /de la srad bu btags nas su/ /sgo yi phyogs su gzhag 1 par bya/ /rigs dang rigs rnams so so yi18/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i snying po 'am/ /yang na ci 19ltar rigs pa yis/ /rdzas sgrub tshe na kun nas bsrung 2 / /yang na rigs kyi rig sngags dang / /so so/'i rigs kyi phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bsgrub tshe 'dir ni thams cad bsrung 2 / /phur bu rdo rje rtse 'dra 'am/ /yang na rtse gcig sbom po la/ /rdo rje phur bus lan brgya 25ru/ /mngon par bsngags 3 pa byas pa dag /lha yi gnas kyi phyi rol du/ /grwa bzhi kun du gdags par bya/ /yang na dkyil 'khor phyi rol du/ /btab nas las rnams rab tu bya/ /rdo rje phur bu'i cho ga 'di/ /las kun byed par shes par bya/ /bsgrub ru5tshe 'dir 96—688

bgegs 'tshe med cing / /sgrub pa po yis dngos grub thob/ /dri zhim phye ma'am por dag gis/ /sna tshogs tshon gyi 'de (1)gu yis/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bris nas su/ /de nas cho ga 'di dag dang / /so so'i phyogs kyi ri mo'i mthar/ /rdo rje rtse gsum bya bar gsungs/ /dbus kyi ngos rnams dag tu yang / /rdo rje bsgrengs pa'i tsho skuphreng ba bya/ /rdo rje ra ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /cho ga de ni bya bar bstan/ /de yi nadabus su bzhugs nas su/ /rdzas rnams rab tu bsgrub capar bya/ /cho ga 'di yis phyi nang du/ /rdo rje'i lte ba'i dra ba bya/ /rdo rje dra ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /shin tu thub par dka' 5bar 'gyur/ /sgo khyud dag ni thams cad dang / /sgo rnams kyi ni mdun dag tu/ /mkhas pas rdo rje bris nas su / /de nas las rnams bya bar bsgrags/ /yo lang chung dus thang bu la/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bri 6bar bya/ /mdor bsdus cho ga bris nas su/ /rdzas rnams bsgrub pa 57brtsam 8par bya/ /khru lnga'am bdun nam brgyad pa la/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /gsang sngags dngos grub rjes mthun 9par/ /yang na lhag par byas kyang rung / /sgo rnams kun du rdo rje dang / /grwa rnams su ni bum pa dgod/ /las kun byed pa'i bum pa dag /sgo drung du ni gzhag 7par bya/ /dbus su chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /thog ma rgyal po lnga rnams dgod/ /ngos su mche 11ba mdung thung dang / /spyan dang rgyal ba'i mdzod spu'o/ /bde gshegs phyag rgya thams cad dang / /sgor ni gzhan gyis mi thub ma'o12/ /rab 'byor dang ni kun dga' bo/ /snying po'i 1 dkyil 'khor lha rnams ni/ /phyogs cha bstan pa bzhin du dgodang/ /phyi rol du ni ci dga' ba'i/ /lha rnams dgod pa bya bar gsungs/ /don grub pa dang mthu chen dang / /'jam dpal dang ni 96—689

glang po che/ /dpal ldan tshangs pa mes 91)po dang / /de bzhin du ni brgya byin dang / /bcom ldan mngag gzhug sangs rgyas pa'i/ /lha ni de dang de dag dang / /phyogs skyong rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor dag tu bri//de nas dbus su gsang sngags sam/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor rdzas bzhag ste/ /mchod pa'i cho ga thams cad dang / /sbyin sreg dusalas ni bya bar bsgrags/ /mdor na bsrung ri riba'i las kyi rnams/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu gsungs pa bzhin//bsgrub 4pa'i tshe na de dag kun/ /khyad par du ni sbyar bar (pebya/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bstan pa 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyis gsungs/ /'dis ni rdzas rnams bsgrub ri byas nas/ /chos pa po la myur du 'grub/ /der ni zhugs pa tsam gyis kyang / /bgegs rnams med par gyur pa dang / /lha rnams khyad par dag tu yang / /byin gyis rlob 7pa mdzad par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rdzas bsgrub na pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //tshon rtsi sna ni lnga po 9yis/ /sngon bzhin dkyil 'khor thams cad byi7/ /dbus su pad+ma bris nas kyang / /dang por shar gyi phyogs su ni/ /'dod pa sbyor byed dgod par bya/ /de nas gsang sngags rgyal po drug /de yi 'og tu gos dkar can/ /sgrol ma bdun dang dpa' mo bdun/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo grags ldan ma/ /sgo kur rig sngags ral pa gcig11 /rta mgrin yang ni dgod par bya / /las kun byed pa'i bum pa yang / /sgo drung du ni gzhag 12par bya/ /sgo yi grwar 1 ni rdo rje bri/ /phyi rol tshangs dang lha yi spyan/ /dbang phyug chen po lha yi bu / /rgyal sras dri ma med pa dang / /'od zer phreng bas brgyan thub dang / /96wa 690

klu yi 6)rgyal po mtha' yas dang / /stobs chen mdzes pa zhes dga' dang / /rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po ni/ /brtson 'grus chen po dung can dang / /sngon bzhin phyogs mtshams 9 skyong ba dang / /'dir yang rig pa'i lha rnams dgod/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma'i cho ga bzhin/ /'dir yang thams cad bya bar grags/ /bshad pa 'di la brten (3rin ni/ /bgegs rnams kun gyis thub par tsho dka'/ /pad+ma rigs kyi rdzas sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshor/cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //gru bzhi par ni thig btab nas/ /dang por dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dbus su rdo rje bris nas kyang / /shar du rig sngags rgyal po ni/ /legs par 'grub byed thog mar dgod/ /de nas de yi 6)ngos gnyis su/ /rig sngags rgyal mo gnyis bris nas57 / /rin chen rdo rje gnam lcags dang / /g.yon du rdo rje khu tshur ro/ /bkod nas de yi rinangos gnyis su/ /tī 9li dang ni gnod mdzes dgod / /rdo rje rdo rje dbyug pa dang / /tho ba dang ni lu gu rgyud/ /rin chen rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /mā ma tī 9yang yongs su dgod/ /rgyal po blon sogs 11pho nya mo / /rdo rje blo gros la sogs dang / /dbang phyug chen po 12chung mar bcas/ /nor bdag gnod sbyin lhan cig tu/ /las kun byed pa'i phyi rol du'o/ /phyi rol phyag na rdo rje'i rigs/ /'khrungs 'dod pa yi rig sngags dang / /'byung po srin po sha za dang / /grub pa gnod sbyin lto 'phye che/ /phyogs mtshams 1 skyong ba'i lha rnams dag /thams cad go rims 'bazhin du dgod/ /de nas mchod pa'i cho ga dang / /gang yang bsrung skab la sogs kun/ /sbyin sreg khobastan pa bzhin byas te/ /ci 3 skad bstan pa'i las rnams bya/ /zlos pa pos ni dkyil 96—691

'khor du/ /spyan drang ba 1ril sogs pa'i las/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i snying po 'am / /yang na rnam par phye ste bya/ /bum pa dgang ba thams cad ni/ /sgrub par gsungs na pa'i cho ga dang / /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du bstan pa/ /cho ga 'dra 4bar gsungs pa yin/ /dbang chen grags pa'i sems can kun/ /dam tshig las ni mi 'da' bas/ /bsrung 5bar bya ba ma byas kyang / /dkyil 'khor dag tu bsgrub 56 par bya/ /rig 7 sngags kyi rin)ni lha yi rnams/ /dam tshig gis ni dkyil 'khor du/ /lhag par byin gyis rlob pa dag /khyad par du ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu gus pas mnyes bya ba'i/ /cho ga 'dis ni dgongs 'gyur zhing / /sgrub pa po dag 'dod pa yi/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol bar mdzad/ /'dir ni rigs kyi snying po dang / /rigs kyi yum dang rgyal po dang / /spyi yi bsrung 9ba'i gsang sngags kyang / /dngos grub myur du stsol bar mdzad/ /dkyil 'khor gsum po 'di dag ni/ /gsang mchen yin par yongs su bsgrags/ /rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya 11rdzas sgrub 12pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //de nas gzhan yang dkyil 'khor 'di/ /gsang chen snying por gyur pa ste/ /tshul bzhin rdo rjes mtshan pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bri bar bya/ /dbus su rigs kyi rgya bris nas/ /de la rig sngags gzhag 12par bya/ yang na bum pa gang ba ni/ /bkra shis sngon bzhin bshad pa bzhag /de steng kham phor la sogs pa/ /kha sbyor nang du rdzas kyang bzhag /shar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /byang du spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /lhor ni bcom ldan rdo rje 96—692

'dzin / /nub tu drag po nor bdag go/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i tshul du ni/ /thams cad phyag rgya'i steng du dgod/ /rigs kyi rig 1sngags g.yas phyogs su/ /g.yon du las rnams kun byed pan/ /nub phyogs kyi ni ngos gnyis su/ /dkar sham ma dang dpal mo bzhag /lhung bzed dang ni chos gos kyang / /shar gyi grwa ni gnyis su bri/ /byang phyogs phyag na pad+ma yi/ /dbyug pa dang ni guṇ+ḍi dbri/ /lho phyogs rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /rdo rje dang ni tho ba bri/ /nub phyogs kyi ni grwa gnyis su/ /rtse gsum nor gyi bum pa bri/ /sgo kur gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /shar gyi phyogs su 'phrog ma bzhag /lho yi phyogs su ri mkhar ma/ /byang du ral pa gcig ma (5)bri/ /phyi rol lha rnams dgod pa ni/ /mdor na ci ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /gsang sngags mchod pa'i cho ga kun/ /snga ma bzhin du yongs su bsgrags/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu gsang ba 'di/ /sgrub pa'i tshe na bgegs med bshad/ /rdzas rnams kun dang las rnams ni/ /gsang sngags bdag (6)gis ci dgar 'grub/ /bcug nas 'byung ba nyid kyis kyang / /bgegs bya bar ni mi nus so/ /dri dang me tog bsung 7zhim dang / /bdug spos mar me gsal ba dang / /bshos kyang rnam pa sna tshogs kyisan/ /de nas mchod pa legs par brtsam9/ /bzlas brjod cho ga las gsungs dang / /dkyil 'khor dag tu ci bstan pa/ /de bzhin khang pa'am dkyil 'khor du/ /mchod pa yi ni cho ga bya/ /rig sngags rgyal la lha bshos ni/ /snying por gyur pa sna tshogs dang / /mchod pa sna tshogs gang yin pa/ /cho ga bzhin du bya bar gsungs / /mar gyi mar me gsal ba dang / /snying po dag kyang gsal bar dbul / /'go bar bya ba'i ched du ni/ /rang rig sngags la mchod yon dbul/ /96—693

de nas rig sngags rgyal po yis/ /yungs kur 0)dag la bsngags (snyenas su/ /nad rims ri nodag rigeni thams cad du/ /gsang ba'i bsrung ba rab tu bya/ /las kun byed pa'i rig sngags sam/ /yang na bsrung (5)ba gzhan yang rung / /yungs kur 56 yongs su bzlas pa dag /rdzas kyi drung du gzhag 4༄par bya/ /de yis kun du gtor ba yis/ /bgegs rnams las ni bsrung (8)bar 'gyur/ /g.yon du rang gi phyag 59)rgya bzhag pa'am/ /ral gri mngon par bsngags ⑩pa'ang rung / /phyogs skyong phyogs su bzhag byas te/ /de'i mod smyung 6glezhing bsrung tugeb byas/ /sems stobs che zhing gtsang sbra can/ /gos kyang de yi kha dog ldan/ /lus dang stobs dang lang 512tsho tshadang / /gzugs dang ldan pa'i skyes bu zhig /dpal la bzlas pa'i ral gri 'dzin/ /mgul nas 7phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang / /yungs kur tshadag ni thu bar blugs/ /bgegs rnams blta la mkhas pa ste/ /phreng ba dang ni yungs kur sna dag /bgegs la rab tu 'phen par nus/ /bgegs rnams kun nas 'byung ba 'am/ /yang na 'jigs pa chen po la/ /'jigs pa med par ral gris bsdigs18/ /gal te nye bar 'ongs nas 'debs/ /yungs kur 19dag dang phreng ba spos/ /bgegs rnams nye bar zhi bar 'gyur/ /yang na rang gi gnas dag na/ /legs par gnas pa'i ral gris sum̐ )bya/ / bskor ba'i zhusteganas rnams bor na ni/ /skabs dang glags ni rnyed 'gyur zhing / /de la bgegs kyang 'jug par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan bskyed de bsrung zhurte/ /de dag sgrub pa'i cho ga las da/ /bsrung ba'i las ni mdor bsdus dgepa'o/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i yon tan can/ /phyogs skyong rnams ni ma rnyed na/ /lcags mda'a'am yang na mda' can dag /bzlas nas phyogs su gzugs par bya/ /96wa 694

gsang sngags bzlas shing (1ridaka' 92thub can/ /rgyud 'dzin shes par ldan pa zhig /gsang sngags sgrub pa'i grogs mchog ste/ /bzlas brjod dbyed cing sgo kur bzhag /des ni bgegs ri ni bzlog pa dang / /las rnams kun la 'jug par bya/ /rgyud rgyud dag las rang gi 5rgya/ /bsrung 6ba cis kyang mi tshugs gang / /de dag bzlas shing mchod byas nas/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bcang 7bar bya / /bgegs chen drag po rnams la ni/ /de dag gis ni bzlas 8bya 'am/ /yang na 'dod pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /bsngags 9pa'i yungs kur khodag gis bya / /lha yi dkyil 'khor phyi rol du/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ci rigs par/ /rab tu dang zhing bzang ba 'am/ /yang na 'byung po kun la bya/ /bskrad pa dang ni 'og bcing dang / /steng yang bcing zhing khor yug tu/ /mtshams bcad phyogs kyang bcing bya zhing / /rdo rje dra ba ra ba bya/ /rgyud dang slob dpon lung dag gis / /rdzas dang bdag dang lha yang bsrung 11/ /gsang sngags dag gis phyi nang du / /bgegs rnams thams cad bzlog par bya/ /cho ga de dag thams cad ni/ /phyi dro'i dus su bya bar bshad/ /nyi ma nub par gyur nas ni/ /rdzas rnams bsgrub pa brtsam 12par bya/ /blo dang ldan pa phyir byung nas/ /nye reg yang dang yang byas te/ /bdud rtsi thab 1 sbyor bzlas byas pa'i/ /spos chu khyor gang btung bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po'i snying po yis/ /bzlas pa'i mar ni cung zad btung / /ngal dang snyom pa la sogs pa'i/ /gnod pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur / /stang sazil sbrang rtsi pi pi ling / /sangs rgyas spyan gyis bzlas pa 'am/ /snga mas bskus na myur bar ni/ /bgegs las byung ba'i gnyid sel lo/ /bsdams tsheshing shar du kha bstan 'dug /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal tshanas/ /96wa 695

kun la yid kyis gsol btab ste/ /de nas sgrub la 'jug par bya/ /mtshan ma bzang po rnam pa gsum/ /bzlas brjod byed pas bzung 51rinas ni/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sems kyis ni/ /de nas sgrub rnal 'jug par bya/ /mtshan ma dag ni ci 'dra las/ /dngos grub dag kyang de 'drar gsungs/ /de nas zlos dpa'i mtshan ma yis/ /dngos grub bstan pa 'dod par bya/ /legs par grub byed ces bya bca/ /rig 55pa'i rgyal po'i blo 6bsams nas/ /bum pa sgo gar bzhag pa la/ /bskor ba dag kyang gus par bya/ /lha yi gnas su zhugs nas ni/ /de yi 'og tu phyag byas nas/ /'go bar bya phyir thams cad la/ /mchod yon gyi ni bya ba bya/ /rig sngags rgyal po'am rgyal mo 'am/ /yang na spyi yi 57risnying po 'am/ /rang rang sngags kyis ci rigs par/ /spyan drang ba yi cho ga bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu bya ba bzhin/ /rang gi phyag rgya legs par bstan/ /de ltar byas na rig sngags dang / /gsang sngags mthu chen byin gyis rlob/ /rdzas ni kha cig rnam brtags pa/ /lag pa'i snyim pa'i nang du gzhug /kha cig tshonastamachod yon snod 9)du gzhug /kha cig bum pa'i steng du'o/ /grog mkhar sa yi 1 rmekham phor ram/ /yang na lo ma bting bar bzhag /bsgrub 11bya stegs bu 12la bzhag pa/ /gi wang bskus pa'i snod bcug ste/ /bzlas pa'i gnas su bzhag nas su/ /yungs kur 1 dag gis mngon bsrung ste1 / /blo can cho ga shes pa yisam/ /me tog ta ma li yis mchod/ /brtan lopar bya dang bsrung 1 ba dang / /byin bskyed pa ni gang bshad pa/ /ci 1 ltar rigs par rdzas la'o/ /ma stongs 19par ni bya ba'i rigs//lha dang rdzas kyi bar dag tu/ /ci yang gzhag 2 par mi bya'o/ /rdzas kyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su ni/ /bsrung 1ba'i rgya 22dang yungs kur ribazhag /bdug spos 96wa 696

mchod yon gtor ma dang / /zho dang mar me tsho1la sogs dang / /bsgrub bya'i rdzas ni bzhag nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor blta dab gzhag par bya/ /rdzas la mig gam lag pa yis/ /blta 'am yang na brim par bya/ /g.yo ba'i yid ni mnyam bzhag 54)ste/ /blo dang ldan pas shub bur bzlas/ /'dir yang byin bskyed 55)cho ga dag /sngon bzhin skabs skabs dag tu bya/ /de yi mtshan mo thog thag ni/ /de bzhin rgyun mi 'chad par bzlas/ /mchod yon la sogs cho ga kun / /dus gsum du yang bya bar bshad/ /'thor 'thung la sogs dgos pa la / /de tshe rjes su bsgrub 6pa 7bzhag /sgrub pa pos 8ni bsgrub 9pa na/ /rtag tu nye bar gnas par bya/ /sgrub pa po bzhin cho ga yi/ /lhag ma sgrub 1 tshogrogs mchog gis bya/ /bgegs chen rnams ni zlog 11pa la/ /rjes su bsgrub 12pa dag gis bya/ /des ma nus na bdag nyid kyis/ /yungs kur 15la sogs bzlas pas bya/ /shar phyogs nas ni char chen 'bab/ /'jigs su rung ba'i 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /me yi phyogs su glo bur du/ /mtshams 1 kyi snang ba nam langs bzhin/ /gshin rje'i phyogs nas 15'ong ba ni/ /'chi bdag gzugs can 'jigs 'jigs bltas/ /ral gri thogs shing sgra chen 'byin/ /sna chad lo ma mi thod du/ / mi yi 1 khrag ni 'thung bar byed/ /mgo skra gyen du brdzes shing 'bar / /gcin rgyang char bzhin 'bab pa yi/ /bsrung 1 ba'i las rnams 'jig 197par byed/ /bden bral phyogs nas sems can mang / /'jigs pa'i gzugs can tha dad pa'o/ /chu lha'i phyogs nas lha yi bdag /sprin dang bcas par 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /rlung gi phyogs nas tshub chen 'byung / /gnod 2 sbyin pho mo byang phyogs nas/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas tshogs kyi gzugs/ /steng nas 96—697

mthu chen lha rnams 'byung / /'og na dzo1sa 'gas tshonagayo bar byed/ /rdzas kyi dngos grub chen po la/ /de la sogs pa bgegs kyi rnams/ /nam gyi phyed na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dngos grub chen po rnams la ni/ /bgegs kyang chen po nyid du 'gyur/ /phal la rjes su mthun ripa yi/ /bgegs ni rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung / /dus gsum dag gi cadangos grub ni/ /tha ma 'bring dang rab tu bshad / /dus bzhin byung na rab tu shis/ /de la zlos (5)pa mi shis so/ /dro dang dud 'thul 'bar ba dag /'grub pa'i mtshan mar bstan pa yin/ /'bar ba las ni sum 65char bshad/ /du ba la ni rim bzhin gnyis/ /drod las ri dngos grub gcig pu ste/ /de ni tha ma yin par bshad/ /kha cig gsang sngags mthu dag rinalas/ /myur du 'bab par gyur pa 'am/ /gal te bsgrub lho )tshe thog mar ni/ /dngos grub kha cig 'od byung nas/ /de tshe rang rig borig sngags kyis/ /dngos grub mnan pa brtsam tshospepar bya/ /mis ni rig sngags rgyal ba yi mi / /snying pos 1 ba yi gi sawang ngam12/ /lag pas brim tshan dngos grub ni/ /mnan 1 par 'gyur zhing brtan 18par 'gyur/ /mar ram yang na me tog gam/ /rdzas kyi rigs la bzlas kyang rung / /de ltar mnan na rdzas hu rnams ni/ /spyad na yon tan thob par 'gyur/ /dang por grub par gyur na ni/ /thog mar gnas par byas nas su/ /de nas mtshan mo'i lhag ma la/ /blo can bzlas brjod ci 'dod bya/ /dngos grub 'bring po dag la yang / /cho ga de bzhin bya bar bshad/ /nam phyed dag na grub pa ni/ /spyad pa'ang de yi dus su bshad/ /dang po pa ni srod la ste/ /'bring po dag ni nam phyed na tsho/ /dngos grub rab ninyadag spyad pa ni/ /skya rengs 22'char ma'i dus su'o/ /dang po pa ni nang par 96wa 698

te6) / /lhag ma gnyis la nges pa med/ /'bring po mtshan mo spyad bya ba/ /nang par spyad par mi bya'o/ /dngos grub tha mar gyur pa dag /nang par spyad par dgag pa med/ /dus las 'das pa'i nges pa 'am/ /rim pa gzhan yang mi shes so/ /gang zhig nang par mi spyad la/ /gal te gnas pa'ang ma byas na/ /de ni dman ma bzhin bor ba/ /spyad zin pa zhes bya bar 'gyur/ /bsgrub rinapas bskul ba'i rdzas dag la/ /gsang sngags gzi brjid kun zhugs pa/ /dus las (mi'adas pa'i nyes pa yis/ /phal cher yongs su spong bar 'gyur/ /mnan smyo pa dag ni phyi nas yang 5)/ /grub kyi bar du rung bar 'gyur/ /mnan 6te bzhag pa'i rdzas dag ni/ /ci 7)ltar 'dod pa spyad par bya/ /gal te grub pa'i rdzas dag ni/ /nam yang spyad par ma byas na/ /de las gzhan pa'i dus mtshams (kyil/ /bzlas pa yang byas spyad par bya/ /ma grub pa yi rdzas dag la/ /cho ga de nyid rab tu bsgrags/ /dus tshigs dus tshigs dag la yang / /byin bskyed la sogs cho gas bsgrub(9ra/ /lo gsum gyis ni gang ma grub/ /de ni nams kyang mi 'grub 7bo/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i rdzas rnams la/ /cho ga 'di ni yongs su bsgrags/ /zla ba drug gis 'bring po rnams/ /dngos grub nye bar 'thob tunyepar 'gyur/ /chung ngu rnams la dus dag ni12/ /gang yang nges pa med par bshad/ /ri mo yi ni lha rnams la'ang / /cho ga 'di nyid bshad pa yin/ /yongs su gzung 6geb la sogs pa'i/ /cho ga'ang de las gzhan pa'ang bya/ /rdzas bsgrub ④pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //sems can snang dang mi snang las/ /grub sapa'i rdzas ma grub pa'i tshe/ /96wa 699

gal te phrogs 1par gyur nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni bri bar bya/ /tshes grangs mi dgos rgyu skar min/ /smyung 2bar bya ba'ang med par ritshogasungs/ /mchog tu khro 4rib la gnas te/ /mod la dur khrod thal ba yis/ /gru gsum nub tu sgo gtod ri pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni bri bar bya/ /de ltar bris nas phyi rol bskor / /sgrub pa'i rig sngags gzhag 575par bya/ /de nas shar du bcom ldan 'das/ /legs par grub dbyed ces bya ba/ /drag po gnod sbyin sde dpon ni / /mthu 9richen rig sngags rgyal po dang 1 / /rdo rje khro bo rdo rje dbyug /rdo rje khu tshur lcags kyu ma/ /rdo rje tī 11li 'jigs nyu2byed gzugs/ /ser skya dang ni thog thog gzugs/ /lug rgyud rnam rgyal nag po dang / /de bzhin sgor ni dga' byed dgod/ /rdo rje sde dang dpung bzang nyu nodang ñtsa/ /khro bo chen por grags pa rnams/ /de dag rim 15bzhin bkod nas su/ /mkhas pas mchod pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /me tog dmar la sogs pas mchod/ /gtor ma khrag dang bcas par gsungs/ /drag shul spyod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /sngon du bstan pa kun kyang bya/ /mkhas pas rang gi rig sngags lha/ /sgo gar mngon du phyogs bzhag la / /dri zhim me tog dag gis kyang / /cho ga bzhin du mchod par bya/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor ci dga' bar/ /de dang rjes su mthun 7bya ste/ /lha ni drag po gang 'dod pa/ /mchod pa dag la sogs pa bya/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /drag shul spyod pa'i las kyi thab/ /gru gsum kha ran can byas te / /sbyin sreg 1 las ni brtsam 1 par bya19/ /me 'bar yam shing seng ldeng 2 )ngo //nim pa'am dur khrod nas skyes pa/ /rang gi khrag las btags 21pa dang / /dur khrod thal ba sar pa 'am/ /dug khrag yungs kur 22bsres pa dang / /de 96wa 700

nas ske (1)tshe sreg (5)blugs dbul/ /rdzas 'phrog pa yi naphyir bsngos te/ /gzugs brnyan steng du gnas tsho ripa 'am/ /yang na gzugs brnyan gtub gtub 5cing / /mjug (67tu sbyin sreg 7dag kyang bya/ /khro bo'i cho ga shes pa yis/ /cho ga 'di ni bya bar gsungs/ /gsang sngags zlos 8pas skrag gyur nas/ /rdzas 'phrog pa ni rings par yang / /'phrogs 9pa'i rdzas ni khyer nas su/ /mngon 1 du 'ongs te sbyin par byed/ /byed na de la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /zhi ba ci dgar rab tu bya/ /gal te zhi ba ma byas na/ /de tshe mod la 'chi bar 'gyur/ /yang na mi snang ba yi rnams/ /dkyil 'khor sgor ni rdzas kyang 'jog /yang na zlos par 'dod pa'i rnams/ /rdzas dag lhag par ster bar 'gyur/ /rdzas 'phrog pa 11mod la dgug pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //rdzas phrogs nas ni ring lon nas/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni bri bar bya/ /rigs gsum rnams kyi spyi yin te/ /dngos grub phyir ni las kun byed/ /thams cad du yang rig sngags rgyal/ /legs par grub byed ces bya ba/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /phyag rgya bris te dgod par bya/ /rdo rje khro bo khro chen dang / /mā ma tī 12dang lcags kyu ma/ /rdo rje khu tshur rdo rje'i tog /rdo rje dbyug pa tho ba dang / /'jigs byed lug rgyud gī 15li dang / /rdo rje blo gros mi thub ma/ /gsang sngags khro bo pho nya mo/ /rmad byung pha rol gnon gang dang / /'dod pa 'byor byed rta mgrin dang / /phyag na zhal ras phal chen dang / /bcom ldan sna tshogs gzugs can dag /snying po'i dkyil 'khor dag tu dgod/ /grags ldan ma dang dpal mo che/ /dkar mo dang ni gos dkar 1 canas/ /sgrol ma zla ba dpal mo gang / /rmad byung pha rol gnon rnams dang / /'khor los 96—701

sgyur —1sogs gtsug tor dang / /mdzod spu dang ni bde gshegs spyan/ /mche ba mdung thung byams ma che/ /rmad byung pha rol gnon gang dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub la sogs pa/ /rigs kyi rig sngags bstan pa dang / /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags dang / /phyag rgya chen por grags pa dang / /phyi rol bsrung 92ba'i sgo ba dang / /cho gar gtogs pa gang yin pa'i/ /so so'i rigs kyi mngag gzhug na pa/ /brtson 'grus chen po dgod par bya/ /phyi rol 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /tshangs pa mes po chen po dang / /dbang phyug chen po chung mar bcas/ /tshogs spyan tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /ma mo rnams dang klu bdun dang / /de bzhin lha min bdag po dang / /bstan pa la ni gang dga' ba/ /rmad byung pha rol gnon kun cadang / /dkyil 'khor snga mar gsungs pa yi/ /lha ni gang dang gang yin dang / /gsang sngags cho gar gang bstan pa/ /de kun phyi rol mchod par gsungs/ /de nas de yi 'og tu ni/ /cho gas 5)sngon bzhin me sbar te / /rdzas 'phrog gzugs brnyan spra tshil las/ /byas te slob ma'i steng bzhag nas / /sbyin sreg 6cho ga bya bar gsungs/ /der ni glor yang bzhag 57)nas su/ /mtshon cha yis ni gtub gtub cing 8/ /mjug tu tshul bzhin bsreg par bya/ /sngon bzhin mchod pa'i cho ga dang / /gtor ma yi ni las kyang bsgrags/ /phyag na rdo rje'i rigs de yi/ /cho ga kun gyi 9ridrag shul spyad/ /de bzhin rang gi tsharig sngags kyis/ /cho ga drag shul bya bar gsungs/ /nyi shu brgyad la ma thob na / /rdzas phyir dgra la drag shul spyod/ /mar gyi ngo yi 11tshes lnga la/ /cho ga byas pa de mchog go/ /lcug 12lcag gis ni dgra gzhu 1 zhing / /de bzhin mes kyang gdung bar bya/ /sna tshogs tshig gis brgyan ngapa dang / /mda' yi tsher ma rnon 96—702

pos dbug6) /ske tshe lan tshwa (nabyugs nas su/ /ci dga' bar ni yan lag gtub / /dgra bo la ni cher khros pa/ /ci na ltar 'dod pas chad pas gcad/ /dar ras (8)dmar pos dkris ku5)nas su/ /skud pa dmar pos bcing bar bya/ /me tog dmar pos mchod bya zhing / /ji ne/srid 'dug gi bar du ni7)/ /rdzas kyi phyir ni bskul bya zhing / / nyin gcig 8bzhin du bzhu bar bya/ /gal te des ni de byin na(9)/ /de tshe chad pas gcad 7pa bshol/ /rdzas ni bstan pa 'di dag gis/ /nam tsho gyi phyed na sbyin sreg 515bya/ /ko bi da ri'i 1 yam sreg sashing / /'bru mar bstegs 0pa me la bsregs /rang gi khrag dang dug dang bcas/ /yungs mar lan tshur 1 bcas pa dang / /ske tshe de la bstegs 18pa yi/ /sbyin sreg 6)brgya ni rtsa brgyad rku 7bya/ /rdzas 'phrog pa yi ming dang ni/ /rang bzhin dag ni smos nas surukā/ /khrag dang sbyar ba'i lan tshwa yis/ /lhag par sbyin sreg 2bya bar gsungs/ /gal te rdzas ni ma 2 ster na/ /bdag nyid ngan pa 'dir brtag 2 cing / /de tshe 'chi bar gyur pa'i rilas/ /ma lus pas ni sbyin sreg 0bya/ /gang tshe rdzas ni sbyin gyur tam/ /yang na skyin 2 pa gzhan yang rung / /sgrub pa po la 'chags shu)byed na/ /de tshe mkhas pas zhi bar bya/ /gal te chud ni gsan pa 'am/ /bag med pas ni spyad gyur pa rte/ /de tshe skrag pa de la ni/ /sgrub pas myur du dad par gyis/ /'phags pa rdo rje rnam 'joms sam/ /myur du khro bo chen po 'am/ /yang na mnol 1ba med pa yis/ /sbyin sreg 2las mthar lhamyur du bskul/ /mkhas pas rigs gsum dag gis kyang rī/ /'phrogs 0pa slar ni dgug pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni cho ga bzhin/ /gsang sngags 'di ni sngon bzhin bya/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā 96wa 703

yak+ṣa se nā 91pa rinasata ye/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma (5)tha ma (getha badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra / ha na ha na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/dhā 5ra ya dhā 96)ra ya badz+ra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa 7)badz+ra/ dā ra ya bi dā ra ya badz+ra/sbyin sbyin badz+ra/ bhin+da bhin+da 58ribadz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ zlos pas gal te rdzas rnyed dam/ /yang na gzhan dag thub kyang rung / /de ni sngon bzhin (9)dus mtshams la/ /bsrung bar bya ste sbyar bar bya/ /gzhan yang dngos grub 'bring dag dang / /tha ma cung zad tsam la yang / /cho ga shes pas ci rigs par/ /de yi mod la sbyar bar gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku skal 7du/ /rdzas kyi cha gcig 11thog mar dbul/ /blo dang ldan pas bla ma la/ /phyag byas nas ni gnyis pa dbul/ /gsum pa sngar grub pa rnams la/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol dag tu dbul/ /bzhi pa grogs po rnams la sbyin 2/ /lnga pa bdag nyid spyad par bya/ /de la'ang skal ba phyed phyed du/ /bgos nas bdag gis phyed bskur ba/ /brtag par bya ba'i rdzas rnams la/ /cho ga 'di dag bshad pa yin/ /bcom ldan sku skal bdag nyid kyis/ /mchod yon phul nas bskur 1 bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams la slu rnyiba'i phyir/ /mchod pa'i cho ga la sogs bshad/ / bla ma med par gyur na ni/ /bobla ma'i skal 17ba bdag gis blang 17/ /de la lhag par gus bya ba/ /de ni de yi slu 18ba yin/ /sgrub pa po yis phyi rol du/ /mchod yon dbul zhing grub pa khyed//nyid kyi 1 rdzas skal 'di bzhes zhes/ /tshig ni lan gsum bsgrag 3 tshopar bya/ /sngags grub pa rnams med na ni/ /de yi skal 21bas sngags tsho nazlos pas/ /dogs ri gemed pa yi 2 sems kyis ni/ /grogs po rnams la sbyin par bya/ /gsang sngags zlos pa'i grogs rnams ni/ /gus shing rtag par don du gnyer/ /dka' thub 96—704

dag dang grogs byed pas/ /thog ma nyid nas grub pa yin/ /de bas de yis sbyin pa ni/ /rdzas ni blang bar 'os pas na/ /bdag cag sngon nas grub pa zhes / /mthun 1)par smra zhing blang bar bya/ /grub pa'i rdzas rnams de lta bur/ /bgo ②bar rab tu bsgrags pas na/ /bdag rang nyid kyis de rnams la/ /rdzas ni rnam par bgo bar bya/ /grub (5)pa'i rdzas rnams kha cig ni/ /ci ran tsam du bgo ste dzobadaper/ /añdza (2na ni thams cad dang / /gi wang nel sogs bzhin du bshad/ /cho ga shes (7)pas la la ni/ /yid kyis 8bgos ri9pa byas te dper/ /ral gri la sogs mthong ba bzhin/ /de la phan gdags bsam 1 par bya/ /grub pa'i rdzas rnams kha cig ni/ /gcig pus spyad par bya ste 11dper/ /ras la sogs pa mthong ba bzhin/ /de la phan gdags bsam par bya/ /grub pa'i rdzas kyi bye brag las/ /kha cig mnyam par bgo ste 12dper/ / ril bu 1 la sogs mthong ba bzhin/ /de la phyed du bgo ba med/ /rdzas rnams la yang k+ṣaphal cher yang / /gcig pus mang du bskur bebar gsungs/ /skal labar nor ram man ngag bstan/ /rgyud las gsungs pas yid ches bya/ /'di dag khyod kyis nyu byos shig ce'am/ /bdag gi nor 'di khyod kyi'o zhes/ /bzlas brjod 1snyebyed pas grogs po la/ /bgo /9ba dag ni de ltar bya/ /grub par gyur na cho ga bzhin / /mkhas pa dag gis 2 tshophan 'dogs pa/ /bdag nyid kyis ni ci rigs par lha / /gang yang rung bas rab tu bya/ /dngos grub rnam pa mang po dag /grub pas rnam par bgo ba ni/ /bye brag tu ni bdag nyid kyis/ /dri med blo yis shes par bya/ /skal du 2ba dbang ba mchog gnas su/ /zlos pas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /bka' lung grub par shes par bya/ /de yi 'og tu bgo bar 96—705

gsungs / /de ltar kun la ci rigs par/ /legs par bgo bar bya bar gsungs / /dngos grub 1dag ni phal nal yang / /mdor na cho ga de bzhin bya/ /gus shing nor dang mchod pa bya/ /bka' bzhin byed par phan 'dogs pas/ /rdzas grub bla ma'i skal la sogs/ /slu dab dag ni de ltar bshad/ /rang gi mchod yon phul nas su/ /rdzas rnams legs par lung bzhin (4)bgo/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag byas nas/ /rig rgyal mo la'ang gus byas te/ /blo yis gsang sngags lha rnams la/ /gus par bsam ste 5spyad par bya/ /blo can grub nas nam mkha' la/ /ci bde bar ni 'gro bar bya/ /'on tam grub pa rnams dang ni/ /lhan cig 'dug kyang cis mi tshugs/ /rtag tu rang gi lha nyid ni/ /yid la yongs su bzlas pa dang / /bdag gi grub pa'i rdzas rnams la/ /rtag tu blta 6zhing dran byas na / /pha rol gnod pa byed pa ni/ /sdang 8ba rnams kyis yongs mi tshugs/ /mkhas pas rig sngags brgya bzlas nas/ /grub pa rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur/ /rigs kyi rig sngags bzlas na ni/ /sgrub po 'jigs pa kun las thar/ /gcig la gcig ni mthong ba na/ /mkhas pas legs par smra bar bya/ /legs par 'ongs sam bde 'am zhes/ /mthong nas dang por mngon par brjod/ /dam tshig rigs kyi phyag rgya dang / /grub pa'i rdzas kyang bstan par bya/ /gang nas 'ongs zhes zer na yang / /dris pa'i lan yang gdab par bya/ /lha yi gnas ni thams cad dang / /shing gcig lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / /dka' thub gnas dang byin can dang / /mchod sbyin pa dang bram ze'i gnas/ /mu stegs la sogs grub pa dang / /nam yang 'da' bar mi bya'o//nga rgyal gyis ni 'das gyur na/ /'khrugs nas mod la ltung bar 'gyur/ /bag 96—706

med dam tshig nyams (15pa yis/ /ltung ngam ltung bar gyur kyang rung / /rig rgyal nyid kyis bzlas na ni/ /de nas mod la ldang na bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' gzugs med pa la yang ri/ /rab tu grub pa lha mig can/ /rang gi las rnams rig 94)'gyur te/ /rnal 'byor can rnams 'gro ba bzhin/ /de bas sngon chad sprul pa yis 5ni/ /lam nas 'gro dang 'ong bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams dbang gis gnas kyi phyir/ /khyim yang ci 6ltar 'dod pa 'byung / /kun nas ljon shing mang pos brgyan4sgyu/ /sna tshogs bya rnams 'phur zhing lding / /lha yi bu mo rgyu ba yi/ /rgyan gyi sgra ni sil khrol can/ /de yi glu gar sil snyan gyis/ /mngon par dga' ba'i yon tan gsal/ /me tog bzang po gsum gyis khyab/ /mar me'i 'od ni rab tu gsal/ /gang dang gang du kun brtags pa/ /der yang dpag bsam ljon shing che/ /'dod pa thams cad 'byor pa yi/ /rmad du byung ba'i mtshan nyid 'byung / /rin chen rdo leb nangal bso'i phyir/ /nor bu'i gzhi 9las 'bab chu can/ /sa gzhi ne'u gsing 1 gis brgyan pa/ /thams cad du yang mngon par 'byung / /rgyan rnams dang ni gos rnams dang / /rtsed mo rnams kyi cha byad 31dang / /bdud rtsi la sogs 'bras ldan pa'i/ /dpal gyi shing yang de las byung 12/ /de ltar grub pa 1na'adod pa rnams/ /ci 1 ltar 'dod pa thams cad 'grub/ /grub par gyur nas de nas ni/ /bsrung ba'i phyir ni 'bad par bya/ /dben pa'i skyed dmos tshal dag gam/ /ri rnams kyi ni rtse mo 'amatsha / /rgya mtsho yi ni 1 gling dag gam/ /mtsho chen dag gi gling ma'ang rung / /rang 'phrul sprul pa las byung ba/ /grub par dga' phyir spyod par byed/ /grub pa gzhan dang lhan 18cig tu/ /sngon grub pa yi 19gnas su'ang rung / /de ltar 96—707

grub pa byas na yang / /gal te grub par ma gyur na/ /rdzas des bsrungs te bzhag pa 'am/ /cho ga bzhin du gnas par bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa ci las gsungs / /lhag 91)par yang ni byas nas su/ /mkhas pas rdzas de snga ma bzhin/ /slar yang bzlas te bsgrub nasapar bya/ /'on kyang gal te rdzas de ni/ /brgya nasal grub par ma gyur na/ /brtson 'grus brtan tsho ripar bskyed nas ni/ /der ni phyir yang bsgrub 55 par bya/ /gal te lan bdun bar du rdzas/ / bsgrub ste (6)'on kyang ma grub na/ /gang gi 7cho ga 'di byas pa/ /des 58ni nges par 'grub par 'gyur / /bsod snyoms zas la za zhing gnas/ /sgrub ri9)po bzlas brjod byed la brtson / /sangs rgyas rnams la dad pa yis/ /mchod rten che la phyag bya'o / /gus pas 1 shes rab pha rol phyin/ /bdun nam yang na lan brgyar bklagatshe /yang na yon ni khyad par can/ /dge 'dun rnams la dbul bar bya rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i gling ma 'am/ /yang na rgya mcho3re gling ma la/ /mchod rten dag ni khru gang ba/ /mkhas pas gus pas brgya byas te/ /re re'i mdun nas 'dug nas ni/ /bzlas brjod dag kyang stong byas nas/ /mchod rten tha ma 'bar gyur pa/ /mthong nas 3 nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /mtshams med lnga ni byas pas kyang / /stong dag legs par byas nas ni/ /mchod rten nges par 'bar 'gyur zhing / /gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /kun la'ang bye bar bzlas na ni/ /nges par 'grub par rnam par bstan/ /nyes pa chen po byas pa yang / /lo bcu gnyis kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /cho ga bzhin du ma bsnyen pas/ /rig sngags dngos grub mi ster na/ /tshim par bya phyir bshad pa yi / /sbyin sreg 'de ni brtsam dpar bya/ /yang na las dang don rnams kun/ /96—708

sgrub 1)par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /bris nas de yi nang nyid du/ /sbyin sreg (snyernam pa bzhi bya'o/ /ri yi rtse mo'am phyugs lhas sam/ /yang na gang gā'i ri gling ma 'am/ /yang na sa gzhi (4mnyam byas par5ci/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po sngon bzhin bya/ /'di ni blo dang ldan pa yis/ /khru ni brgya rtsa brgyad par bya/ /de dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yis/ /kho ra khor yug nye bar brgyan/ /rta babs bzang po bzhi dag kyang / /sgo sgo dag tu yongs su gzugs/ /khor yug rnam par rgyal ba yi(6ri/ /ba dan sna tshogs rnams kyis brgyan / /rta babs dag kyang rgyal mtshan dang / /lo ma sar pa dag gis brgyan/ /phreng ba brgyus pa gshibs pa dag /blo dang ldan pas gcad 98par bya/ /phyi rol kho ra khor yug tu/ /mar gyi mar me gsal bya zhing / /bdug 9sgos rigs ni sna tshogs pas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bdug par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa khor yug tu/ /khru bdun dag dang ldan pa dang kho/ /gsum pa khru ni gsum pa ste/ /cho ga de ltar yongs su gzung 1sto/ /mchod sogs cho ga gang yin dang / /dkyil 'khor cho ga sngon bzhin bya/ /gzhan yang cho ga lhag par ni/ /sbyin sreg 12dag kyang bya bar gsungs / /dbus su rang gi rig sngags kyis/ /bum pa gang ba bzhag nas sum / /de yi phyogs bzhi dag tu yang / /sbyin sreg micho ga bzhin du bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnams kun/ /shar gyi phyogs su bri bar bya/ /byang phyogs su ni pad+ma'i rigs/ /cha dang mthun bopar legs par bri/ /mkhas pas lho yi phyogs su ni/ /rdo rje'i rigs kun bri bar bya/ /nub kyi phyogs su drag po dang / /gcig pu gnod sbyin rigs rnams bri/ /de yi lhag pa'i cha dag kyang / /nang rim bzhin du phyi rol bri/ /de yi phyi rol 'jig rten skyong / /gzhan dag 96—709

kyang ni bya bar bsgrags/ /gsang sngags zlos pas dang por ni/ /bdag po lnga rnams dgod par bya/ /de nas rig sngags rgyal po dang / /rig sngags rgyal mor bsgrags pa dang / /las kun byed pas 1rigasang sngags dang / /dkyil 'khor dag tu gang bstan pa'i/ /pho nya che phra go rims nabazhin/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dgod par bya/ /sgo kur bgegs kyi sde dpon dang / /khro bo bdud rtsi thab 5sbyor dang / /lha mo gzhan gyis mi thub bzhagaca /lhag ma ci dgar rinabya bar bshad/ /de ltar rgyud don mthong ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor dgod par byas nas kyang / /der ni snying po spyan drangs te/ /cho ga lhag ma'ang (6)bya bar gsungs / /mkhas pas phyogs bzhi rigs re la/ /sbyin sreg (7)cho ga bzhin byas nas / /nub kyi bum pa'i drung du ni/ /rang gi rig sngags sbyin sreg (8)bya/ /'dir ni 9sbyin sreg 1 cho ga bzhin/ /byas na 11thams cad tshim par 'gyur/ /der ni gtor ma rgya cher bya/ /des ni 12lha rnams mgu bar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni bris nas kyang / /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg 1 ci dgar bya/ /rang rigs 1 rig pas rig sngags la/ /mar gyi sbyin sreg skadag kyang bya/ /'o thug mar dang sbyar ba 'am/ /til dang mngar gsum sbyar ba yis/ /mtshan mo'i lhag ma rang rigs kyi/ /rig pas rig sngags sbyin sreg 9bya/ /las 'di dag gis nges par yang / /lha nyid myur du 'grub 'gyur zhing / /tshim par 'gyur zhing mnyes par 'gyur/ /legs par yang ni skongs par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni bris nas kyang / /gsang sngags rjes mthun 1 sbyin sreg sna bya/ /lan bdun kho na bris nas kyang / /the tshom med par nges par 'grub/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i rig sngags sam/ /de bzhin rigs kyi rig sngags kyis/ /rig 96—710

sngags dag la drag spyad pa/ /thams cad btud de bya bar gsungs/ /spra tshil las ni gzugs byas 1nas/ /de yang rig sngags kyis bzlas te/ /drag shul spyod pa'i sbyin sreg tshonani/ /las kyi cho ga thams cad bya/ /ske tshe yungs rnamar gyis blugs na/ /rims nad drag pos 'debs par 'gyur/ /kha sbub tu ni bzhag byas nari / /lus la 5sdug bsngal tshor ba 'byung / /mi mthun 6pa yis brdeg (7༄pa dang / /me tog gis kyang bsnun par bya/ /de nyid la ni spyo bar 8gsungs / /tho 'tsham 99pa yang ci dgar bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir 1 ni gsang sngags dag /gdon bzhin du ni tshar bcad na/ /cho ga las ni bstan pa yi/ /dngos grub dag kyang stsol bar 'gyur/ /'dir ni lha nyid mngon gshegs nas/ /nyid kyis bsgrub 17pa nyid la ni/ /dngos grub myur du sbyin par 'gyur/ /byin nas zhi ba'i cho ga bya/ /gal te ci zhig ltar gyur na/ /dug khrag lan tshwa 12ske tshe dang / /yungs kur 1 sbyar nas dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /mtshan mo lhag ma bsreg 1 par byas/ /rang gi rig sngags lha nyid ni/ /sdug bsngal bzhin du myur gshegs nas/ /kye kye nga yis mchog sbyin zhes/ /sgrub pa po la gcugs 15par mdzad / /gal te bag med ma byon na/ /sgrub pa pos ni zhag gsum du/ /'jigs pa med pas sarang gi sha / sreg blugs 1 gsum ni der bsregs na/ /de tshe nges par mngon gshegs nas/ /sgrub pa po la chags mdzad cing / /ci 'dod pa yi dngos grub stsol/ /nyes pa ma lus brjod par mdzad/ /mtshams med lnga ni byed pas kyang / /zhag dgur las 'di des byas na/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub 'gyur bas/ /de phyir legs par brtsam 1 par bya/ /las 'di don yod bya ba'i phyir/ /rig sngags dag la rgol ba'i tshe/ /zlos 19pa 'jigs pa 96—711

med pa dang / /bsrung ba dag kyang byas te bya/ /'dir ni dngos grub legs byin na1/ /cho ga bzhin du zhi bar bya/ /las kyi nyes (51pa ci yod pa/ /de dag rab tu bsgrims te gshegs / /gsang sngags dngos grub thams cad la/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni dam pa yin/ /sbyin sreg (4las la bstan pa yi/ /sbyin sreg 5rnam gsum bya bar gsungs/ /las rnams thams cad byas na ni/ /dngos grub rnam gsum thob par 'gyur/ /zlos pa rang gi rig sngags dag /gdon bzhin tshar gcod 6byed pa na/ /nyin gcig (7)bzhin du yo byad ni/ /shin tu sar 8pa dag gis bya/ /mkhas pas bsrung (1)ba byas pa dag /bag yod pa la gtsang ba dang / /rgyud shes dka' thub ldan pa yis/ /rig sngags tshul bzhin drag shul spyad/ /gzhan du byas na nges par 'chi/ /legs par grub par byed pa'i rgyud chen po las bsgrub 7pa'i thabs bsdus pa rdzogs sto(lha// //96—712

mchog /gal te de ltar mi shes na/ /tshangs pa ji ltar shes pa smros/ /yang dag smra bar 6)mi spro na/ /nga yis bshad kyis nga la nyon/ /byang chub sems dang de nyid gsum/ /gal te shes na dngos grub snod/ /de dag legs par mi shes na / /khyod kyis dngos grub ci zhig 'thob(2)/ /rig sngags las ni grub ri nopa po(4//gzhan nam gzhan min ci zhig nyes/ /gal te gzhan na 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'on te gzhan min grub pa nyid/ /gal te gzhan min khyod 'grub pas/ /mkha' 9nyal sogs par da song zhigazhi /de ste min na brdzun tshig pas/ /ba lang rdzi dang lhan cig smros577/ /mi 'chi tshangs chen pha mchod kyis/ /yongs su bsams nas tshig smras pa/ /mi mjed bdag pos gang smras pa/ /gzhan pas bdag la dngos grub med/ /rigs las grub pa gzhan min na/ /dngos grub bdag la yod dam ci/ /de ltar gyur na ci zhig nyes/ /'on tang 8'gal ba ci zhig yod/ /e ma'o tshangs pa khyod sgyukyi blo/ /shin tu dri ma med pa dang / /shes rab gsal bar ngas bsams na/ /tshig re la ni rnyogs pa bzhin/ /gzhan pas khyod la dngos grub medang/ /gzhan min pa ni dngos nyurtagrub rgyu/ /gzhan min pa las grub 'dod na/ /smyon 12pa nyid ni yin par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i bdag po ji ltar na/ /dngos grub yod par khas 'che ba/ /ye shes sgron mar gyur pa khyod/ /ji ltar phan pa 1 bshad du gsol/ /bdag gis rnam par dpyad na ni/ /rig las gzhan nam ngami gzhan min/ /gzhan min mi gzhan ma yin pas / /bdag ni goms las dngos grub 'thobaska/ /shes bya bla med gang yin pa'i / /ye shes de yang goms 'thob 1 na/ /las kyi cho ga 'di dag gis/ /dngos grub yod pa ci zhig smos/ /bzlas brjod lha yi de nyid dang / /bdag gi 96—739

de nyid ji lta 17ba/ /gnas rten gzhan la med par ni/ /mtshungs pa med par bdag gis rtogs/ /tshig las tshig tu 'phros pa las/ /tshangs chen mi 'chi 95skuzhes bya ba/ /dngos grub 'dod pa skal chen po/ /gtsug tor rin)rgyud ni nyan par byed/ /de nas tshangs pa chen po de/ /rdo rje gtsug tor nyan pa la/ /sa yi me tog 'char 4byed pas/ /bsam gtan gyis ni brgyan 5par bshad/ /de nas ye shes kun rdzogs pa/ /rig sngags gsang sngags thabs chen de/ /phra ba de bzhin gshegs pas 6gsungs/ /bsam gtan gyis kyang shin tu brgyan / /rnal 'byor thabs ni kun bstan pa/ /sdug bsngal sdig pa sel ba ste/ /phyag na rdo rjes 8zhal nas gsungs/ /skye dang 'chi ba sdig byed pa/ /kun du mi 95tshugs brtan pa ste/ /'di dang pha rol byed par gnas/ /dkyil 'khor chen po la sogs 'byung / /'dod pa'i don ni rjes su bsgrub1 / /cho ga gang dang gang dag gis/ /bsam gtan las la gang gnas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal 1 nas/ /de dag ma lus bshad par bya/ /gsang sngags bsam gtan zhes bya ba/ /mchog tu gsang ba yang dag gsungs/ /drang srong dka' 1 thub chen po yang / /de dag med na mi 'grub po/ /gsang sngags rnal 'byor can rnams kyis/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod mer 'bar ba/ /skye dang 'chi ba 'jig byed pa/ /rdo rje can gyis sngon gsungs so/ /de bas de 'dir gsang sngags kyi na/ /bsam gtan tshim bya me dag la/ /dngos grub 'dod pa dag gis ni / /rtag par rgyun du sbyor bar bya/ /lha yi sku yi gnas de la/ /dang po kho nar mchod nas ni/ /rnal 'byor gnas bcas shes rab can/ /bde gshegs mdun du bsams nas ni/ /phyi nas yan lag rnam grol ba'i/ /mi 'byed 96—740
