༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ yaṃ ga la gā thā/ bod skad du/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la 2zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu /rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa'i chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi4/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ /don rnams thams cad 96—876

'grub par brtul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dgyes 1thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lha yis bskor ba'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lum zhuge'i'i gyitshal/ /lha mang dag gis 4bsten par mgon po bltam 5pa na / /srid pa'i mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /lhums 96)nas bltam du nopa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang /sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang 9/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer dam pa boser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad 11du grags pa che ba'i lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge bsgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang / /bkra 1 shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer mchog nas mngon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /be+e ḍūr+ya ltar sngo ba'i rtswa bting kyi steng bzhugs te/ / skyil mo krung 1 bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /chu bo'i 'gram na tsa sa sha'i phreng gis yongs bskor tshab/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa / / klu yi ñdza tshorgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye 96—877

dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /1)shing rgyal drung gshegs 92byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po btul te sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig daraphyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po dgra rnam (debatul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr 5drang srong mchog bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog 6bstan pa yi 7)bkra shis gang / /lha yul dang 58)'dir nyu)shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa/ /bsod nams bya byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i seng shes nyu tshogang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mu stegs 17byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhom lha pa dang/ /'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag12 /nye bar ston pa rgyal ba'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir mtho ris nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba mchog tu nyer gshegs pa/ /man skorā mar ba'i me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i bkra shes gang / /bkra shis des tshoni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lha dbang klu dang mi yi 1 dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang 96—878

tshigs su bcad pa/1༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ rat+na tri swa sti gā thā/ bod skad du/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin brlabs kyis na/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam sa 'phel ba/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal 4sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang srung 5rima'i byin brlabs kyis/ /phan mdzad lha yi 6bkra shis gnas gyur 96—881

e bi dri ma hā shra ma ṇa/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 yang 'usto/ stag lung rgyud 'bum la gtugs/ bsod nams chen po'i dpal gyis phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ gtsug lag gnyis kyi mdzad pas/ bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs tog dang / 'gro ba mang po'i mgon skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dam par gyur cing / sngon gyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs pas 'jig rten gyi bya ba la snying po med par gzigs nas/ rnam g.yeng kun spangs te ri khrod dben pa kho nar bslab gsum gyi khang bzangs mang du thos pa'i nor gyis phyug cing / thugs rje'i rgyal mtshan rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tog gis mdzes pa'i/ bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa/ dpal ldan bla ma bzang po'i mtshan can/ dge sbyong chen po de'i thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / 'gro ba ma lus pa'i gnas skabs dang / mthar thug gi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas shing / phyogs kun du dar cing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ bod khams su smon lam gyi stobs can mnga' bdag lha btsan po/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / lo paṇa skyes mchog khyad par can rnams kyi bdag rkyen la brten nas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab thog mtha' bar du dge zhing / sgro skur gyi mtha' dang bral la gzhung lugs ngan pa'i dri mas dben pa mdo sde dang / rgyud sde'i phyogs snga phyir 'gyur ro cog rnams/96wa 882

chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan rgyal ba'i sdes ston pa dang bstan pa la shes nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan pos kun nas bslang ste legs par bzhengs pa rnams la khyad par du gdul bya dbang po rnon po dag tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs mang zhing sla la dus myur bas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par byed pa/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa gsal bar byed pa'i gzhung lugs rgyud 'bum zhes grags pa 'di rnams ni bla ma rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas dang / bla ma chen po chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi gar chag dang / slob dpon chen po rigs pa'i ral gris mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi kur chag rgyud 'bum rgyan gyi me tog la sogs pa la brten nas gdan sa chen po dpal sa skya'i rgyud 'bum dang / shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po gser sdings pas zhus dag dang go rims mdzad nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen skye med ston shes bzhengs pa'i rgyud 'bum dang —/ dpal thar pa gling gi gtsug lag khang gi dge bshes 'dar phyar gyis bzhengs pa'i rgyud 'bum dang /bla ma gru spang rtsa ba'i phyag dpe dang / 'od dga' spun gsum gyi gtsug lag khang gi rgyud 'bum la sogs pa rgyud yang dag pa grangs mang zhing go rims legs la dag pa rnams la dpe phyi byas te/ mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas dpal snar thang du lung rigs kyi dbang phyug shākya'i dge slong 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis legs par bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur phyi mor gdan drangs nas mi'i dbang po thog gan the mur gyi ring la/ ti gri kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bstan pa skyong ba'i dus/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa lnga brgya bdun pa'i thar nye ba/ 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa gdul bya'i ngor zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas lo sum stong bzhi brgya brgyad bcu 'das pa/me mo phag gi lo gsar gyi zla ba tshes grangs gza' skar bzang po la dbu gtsugs te/ rgyal ba'i sras po rig pa 'dzin pa byang chub dpal ldan gyis zhal ta'i rim pa rnams dang / rgyu'i dngos po bzang zhing mang la kha na ma tho ba med pas mthun pa'i rkyen bsgrubs nas/ bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal na len tra dang mtshungs pa sprul pa'i rgyal po se chen gan gyi dgos kyi lha khang dpal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang chen por legs par bzhengs te/sde snod kyi tshul la cung zad blo kha phyogs pa thang po che pa'i btsun pa kun dga' 'bum gyis kha ta dang / zhus dag gi dang ngos bgyis shing / gzhan yang dang ba dang brtson 'grus che zhing blo gros gsal ba'i sdom brtson dam pa mang du thos shing sde snod 'dzin pa rnams kyis rgya gar skad la sogs pa legs par sbyar ba'i skad sor bzhag rnams ni sngon gyi lots+tsha ba chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa bye brag tu rtogs byed chen po dang / sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa la sogs pa la brten nas dag par byas shing / bod skad rnams ni yul skad dang / 'phral skad ngan pa rnams dang / ma 'dres par bod yul gyi sngon gyi brda mes mkhan po rnams dang / sgyur byed dam pa snga phyir byon pa rnams kyi brda gsar rnying dang / skad gsar bcad la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas da drag dang /ma mya dang sa stsogs la sogs pa yod med rnams mkhas pa rnams kyis ji ltar mdzad pa ltar gsung rab kyi dpe phyi rnams dang gtugs te/ brda don ma nor bar dag par byas nas/ gzhi dung gi sa gzhi ltar dkar zhing 'jam la mkhregs pa'i lho rgyal po lha khang gi sho gu la/ dam che zhing mdangs gsal ba/ ud pa la sngon po lta bu rgya nag chen po las 'ongs pa'i snag tshas/ 'bur dkyus tshugs gsum la mkhas pa'i mthar phyin pas yi ge'i 96—883

rig byed la/ slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob pas/ dag snyoms mdzes par bzhengs pa/ dbus gtsang gi yi ge pa yid gzhungs shing mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par bris pa la phyi zhus lan gsum du byas shing / rgyud dngos yin pa dang ma yin pa rnams legs par phye nas/ kha cig gis mdo sngags yod pa rgyud du bris pa rnams ni phye nas mdo nyid du bris shing / kha cig gis rgyud yin ngo shes pa mdo'i khrod du bris pa rnams kyang phye nas/ rgyud kyi nang du bris te/ 'dir ni rgyud sde bzhi po so sor phye nas rang rang gi gzhung tshad che chung dang brjod bya 'thun pa dang / mtshan 'thun pa dang / sde tshan 'thun po rnams so sor bsdebs te/ grangs dang go rims tshang la ma nor bar rgyu bzang zhing bkod pa legs par bzhengs pa yin no/ /de ltar bsod nams dpal gyis rab mtho ba / /chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan rgyal ba'i sde/ /mchog gi blo gros mtshungs pa med pa des/ /dpal ldan bla ma dge sbyong chen po de'i/ /thugs dgongs bla med rdzogs par bya phyir dang / /bstan pa spel phyir bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung / /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir ji snyed 'gyur ro cog /legs par bzhengs par gyur pa de dag las/ /'di dag rdo rje'i theg pa gsal byed pa/ /bstan pa'i snying po rgyud 'bum zhes bya'o/ /de ltar dpal ldan lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /gsung rab rin chen tshul bzhin bzhengs pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba ston ku'i zla 'od dang / /mkha' ltar dag cing yangs pa gang thob des/ /'gro kun phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba yi/ /bstan pa rin chen phyogs dus kun khyab cing / /sde 'dzin skyong dang srung ba'i dam pa rnams/ /skye dgu'i dpal du yun ring bzhugs gyur cig /gang gis gsung rab dri med 'di bzhengs pa/ /rgyal ba'i sras po byang chub dpal ldan yang / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag dam par ni/ /sa chen steng 'dir yun ring bzhugs gyur cig /khyad par du yang nges par sa skyong ba'i/ /mi dbang yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams / /bsnyun med sku tshe ring zhing chab srid brtan/ /byams brtse'i thugs kyis skye dgu skyong gyur cig /srid 'bangs rnams kyang phan tshun byams ldan zhing / /nad dang mu ge 'thab rtsod la sogs pa/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i gnod pa kun zhi nas/ /tshe ring 'byor ldan bstan la dad gyur cig /gang dag 'di la sgo gsum gus pa yis/ /bya ba byed dang rjes su yi rang dang / /rgyu rkyen 'bul dang chos spyod rnam bcu yis/ /tshul bzhin sgrub par byed pa de dag kyang / /'dir yang tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing / /skye zhing skye ba'i skye ba thams cad du'ang / /'khor lo bzhi dang yon tan
